sense_1dc3e5f5cc61381f467cac615ff28c04.text: Espere um pouco que a chuva já vai parar.
sense_1dc3e5f5cc61381f467cac615ff28c04.translation: Wait a little, for the rain is about to stop.

sense_1dc3e5f5cc61381f467cac615ff28c04.text: Se ella me pre­ferisse ao marido, não fazia mau negocio. E quando o velhote morresse, que aquelle trambolho não podia durar, eu amarrava-me a ella, passava a socio da firma e engendrava filhos muito bonitos.
sense_1dc3e5f5cc61381f467cac615ff28c04.translation: If she chose me over her husband, she wouldn’t be making a bad deal. And when the gramps died, seeing as that thing couldn’t last, I would get involved with her, rise to company partner and father beautiful children.

sense_62a90dec96a52b082b32ab40e9e63750.translation: I thought that they were invisible.

sense_62a90dec96a52b082b32ab40e9e63750.text: Pensei que você tivesse dito que ela estava só mandando você escrever!
sense_62a90dec96a52b082b32ab40e9e63750.translation: I thought that you had said that she was just ordering you to write!

sense_6bc1af2303c9e00948186239b6317518.translation: A book written with a pencil.
They bludgeoned the dog to death.

sense_a68914995509b966d21c1e761fd394a2.text: O filme começa às duas horas.
sense_a68914995509b966d21c1e761fd394a2.translation: The film starts at two o’clock.

sense_dffcc44e0aa4181a12eb293f1a325614.text: É mais barato comprar comida ao quilo.
sense_dffcc44e0aa4181a12eb293f1a325614.translation: It is cheaper to by food by the kilogram.

sense_33b2684dac6fda9ababb01cd3cf34b6b.text: Ele puxou o temperamento ao pai.
sense_33b2684dac6fda9ababb01cd3cf34b6b.translation: He inherited his temperament from his father.

sense_4cbf299e0b2d9cfd9243820bc4f3ef14.text: A vila fica a onze milhas
sense_4cbf299e0b2d9cfd9243820bc4f3ef14.translation: The village is eleven miles away.

sense_b831c06349c01cca5ee80c5b00e24003.translation: Let me show it to you...

sense_b831c06349c01cca5ee80c5b00e24003.text: Não é bonito dizer isso a uma pessoa.
sense_b831c06349c01cca5ee80c5b00e24003.translation: It's not nice to say that to a person.

sense_1416a87391080083c20df048d16555b0.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_1416a87391080083c20df048d16555b0.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_1416a87391080083c20df048d16555b0.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_1416a87391080083c20df048d16555b0.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_cd051b12f813e2e82291d54497084776.translation: Unfortunately, a robber stole her phone.

sense_05b34dae8f9e23eedb2847d797bb0d3d.text: Por que, então, ela o conduzira àquele lugar?
sense_05b34dae8f9e23eedb2847d797bb0d3d.translation: Why, then, did she lead him to that place?

sense_05b34dae8f9e23eedb2847d797bb0d3d.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_05b34dae8f9e23eedb2847d797bb0d3d.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_fcad5a66d41e221954725cd5c0c27dac.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_fcad5a66d41e221954725cd5c0c27dac.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_0a722305ab24088e3c4ee7dc0bf3caac.text: Harry teve a nítida impressão de que ele não era o único que estava omitindo informações naquele momento.
sense_0a722305ab24088e3c4ee7dc0bf3caac.translation: Harry had the clear impression that he was not the only one who was omitting information in that moment.

sense_4effd68be641fc9eb43543020277459a.translation: Nobody is really going to be arrested.

sense_748440c7c1ab345799f4df89e757dd11.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_748440c7c1ab345799f4df89e757dd11.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_208ae974b7ffb59e9ecc29a07d50228d.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_208ae974b7ffb59e9ecc29a07d50228d.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_7bcbe8847a2f3e043344e437a54c2396.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.

sense_4bc89da008c7bb11c1370fbc58b1a6e2.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_4bc89da008c7bb11c1370fbc58b1a6e2.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_4bc89da008c7bb11c1370fbc58b1a6e2.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_190e703a51548f5b5d3990525e45cc74.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_190e703a51548f5b5d3990525e45cc74.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_03c71f0b9fba6137955ea48df42460c8.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_03c71f0b9fba6137955ea48df42460c8.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_03c71f0b9fba6137955ea48df42460c8.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_03c71f0b9fba6137955ea48df42460c8.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_7c10e1d8b8e4b1ae6de06a0b558f738c.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém...
sense_7c10e1d8b8e4b1ae6de06a0b558f738c.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone...

sense_2da918b2769491aba30e883f80cc85a7.translation: He and I are going away.

sense_2da918b2769491aba30e883f80cc85a7.text: Tenho quatro frutas: uma maçã, uma pera, uma laranja e uma uva.
sense_2da918b2769491aba30e883f80cc85a7.translation: I have four fruits: an apple, a pear, an orange and a grape.

sense_c22d07c7daf0e784d4613569e91e63ec.text: Ela é baixa, e burra, e preguiçosa, e feia.
sense_c22d07c7daf0e784d4613569e91e63ec.translation: She is short, and stupid, and lazy, and ugly.

sense_c22d07c7daf0e784d4613569e91e63ec.text: Você notou os cabelos dela, são negros e brilhantes e macios...
sense_c22d07c7daf0e784d4613569e91e63ec.translation: You noticed her hair, it's dark and brilliant and soft...

sense_ac4fecce15c5dc32555206e722e2f150.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_0764cdcc205f69f4569867266d42533a.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_3ec70bd6c77ab0b3153bc8590ebbc309.translation: I have a message for you.

sense_3ec70bd6c77ab0b3153bc8590ebbc309.text: […] disse o professor com um sorrisinho […]
sense_3ec70bd6c77ab0b3153bc8590ebbc309.translation: […] the teacher said with a little smile […]

sense_7a40c85b6d931d1783c04aa745539e42.text: Ontem de noite caiu uma chuva.
sense_7a40c85b6d931d1783c04aa745539e42.translation: We had quite a rain last night.

sense_947ee1c4a84fcd31bbbf0a97aa7e6a9f.text: O que é bom para gripe?
sense_947ee1c4a84fcd31bbbf0a97aa7e6a9f.translation: What is good for the flu?
I have a message for you.

sense_02291371d3daceac5046eed559268b30.text: Ele podia ouvi-la se deslocando para a direita, para obter uma visão desimpedida dele.
sense_02291371d3daceac5046eed559268b30.translation: He could hear her moving herself to the right, to obtain an unobstructed view of him.

sense_49e2a48b4b5de13089e61147c8b00618.text: A cor da banana mudou de amarelo para preto.
sense_49e2a48b4b5de13089e61147c8b00618.translation: The colour of the banana changed from yellow to black.

sense_49e2a48b4b5de13089e61147c8b00618.text: O valor da minha casa baixou para menos do que o que eu paguei.
sense_49e2a48b4b5de13089e61147c8b00618.translation: The value of my house has fallen to less than what I paid.

sense_56b644b3d95174439153952c7df89cf2.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_56b644b3d95174439153952c7df89cf2.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_56b644b3d95174439153952c7df89cf2.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_56b644b3d95174439153952c7df89cf2.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_9e80575a22cb9a1a287b1b54bbc6be62.translation: Have you heard the latest news?

sense_e634148e127723dca805c5df10150b73.text: Se eu fosse você, não iria ali sozinha.
sense_e634148e127723dca805c5df10150b73.translation: If I were you, I wouldn't go there alone.

sense_e634148e127723dca805c5df10150b73.text: Se ela não tivesse me falado, não ia saber.
sense_e634148e127723dca805c5df10150b73.translation: If she hadn't told me, I wouldn't know.

sense_5e0f7039f989248b73e671ad5ea63258.text: Se você tem carro, por que ir a pé?
sense_5e0f7039f989248b73e671ad5ea63258.translation: If you have a car, why go on foot?

sense_5e0f7039f989248b73e671ad5ea63258.text: O ralo está entupido — e, se o ralo está entupido, a água não flui.
sense_5e0f7039f989248b73e671ad5ea63258.translation: The drain's blocked — and if the drain's blocked, the water won't flow.

sense_2e26bdb1bcdeea9cfc1840041f6bf36e.text: Pergunto-lhe se já tem uma solução para o caso.
sense_2e26bdb1bcdeea9cfc1840041f6bf36e.translation: I ask you whether you already have a solution for the case.
I don't know if she will come.

sense_1574ae93e6cefe25202f6b04ce13e352.text: Se ele fala, irrita a todos.
sense_1574ae93e6cefe25202f6b04ce13e352.translation: If he speaks, he annoys everyone.

sense_86cda67ff3d46d998670abb18dd56e55.text: Se for sair, leve um guarda-chuva.
sense_86cda67ff3d46d998670abb18dd56e55.translation: If you go out, take an umbrella.
We will only begin if they pay us.

sense_86cda67ff3d46d998670abb18dd56e55.text: Tu me devolva o que tirou daqui / Que o meu peito se abre e desata os nós / Se enfim, você um dia resolver mudar / Tirar meu pobre coração do altar
sense_86cda67ff3d46d998670abb18dd56e55.translation: Give me back what you took from here / 'Cause my chest will open and untie the knots / If you finally decide to change / Take my poor heart from the altar

sense_86cda67ff3d46d998670abb18dd56e55.text: Desculpe, acho que dá mais medo se for meia-noite!
sense_86cda67ff3d46d998670abb18dd56e55.translation: I'm sorry, I thought it would be more fearsome if it were midnight!

sense_6c0aa00e7eb7c9126d36ee276dc081be.text: Sempre se usavam roupas elegantes nessas reuniões.
sense_6c0aa00e7eb7c9126d36ee276dc081be.translation: Elegant clothes were always worn in these meetings.

sense_6c0aa00e7eb7c9126d36ee276dc081be.text: Começavam a fazer compras na venda; ensarilhavam-se discussões e resingas; ouviam-se gargalhadas e pragas; já se não fallava, gritava-se.
sense_6c0aa00e7eb7c9126d36ee276dc081be.translation: People started shopping at the sale; arguments and quarrels were entangled; laughter and curses were heard; people no longer talked: they shouted.

sense_93071fc829fa3a21be98dc913d154d1e.text: Você está me chamando de maluco?

sense_10394075cdfa28224b89ecfa19c7f0c0.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_10394075cdfa28224b89ecfa19c7f0c0.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_56d67144677e9f8c05ef944a1e95e332.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_9fe2dc3cb6e9d229f5f4c4a8c27c10ac.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_9fe2dc3cb6e9d229f5f4c4a8c27c10ac.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_61c46190a88874270e0d689009ad4696.text: Por que, então, ela o conduzira àquele lugar?
sense_61c46190a88874270e0d689009ad4696.translation: Why, then, did she lead him to that place?

sense_61c46190a88874270e0d689009ad4696.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_61c46190a88874270e0d689009ad4696.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_4eba1c90eeb194218fbd0872fb288f86.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_9014f112ed1ec09da945d46ccaa8d8fa.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_287201e0d05e3b8c152083c50dc61a56.translation: The price of a plate in the local markets is around twenty euros.

sense_d18139d24b3ea96abc670ed1e9340e09.text: Eu farei de tudo por uma cópia deste livro.
sense_d18139d24b3ea96abc670ed1e9340e09.translation: I will do anything for a copy of this book.

sense_336c054493c9cb94e85d26d4ec3c0300.text: O tesouro foi encontrado por Dudinka.
sense_336c054493c9cb94e85d26d4ec3c0300.translation: The treasure was found around Dudinka.

sense_cf8a842e3cd7f8da4a763cd5a40d6df1.text: Ainda passaríamos por muitos túneis antes de chegarmos.
sense_cf8a842e3cd7f8da4a763cd5a40d6df1.translation: We would still pass through many tunnels before we arrived.

sense_2a299db8d93ba2966cbfa8ffd8e2a513.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_2a299db8d93ba2966cbfa8ffd8e2a513.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_2a299db8d93ba2966cbfa8ffd8e2a513.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_2a299db8d93ba2966cbfa8ffd8e2a513.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_47fa1cd08bbb2084ab9bf2b070d0cdcc.text: Tenho coisas mais importantes a discutir com você hoje à noite.
sense_47fa1cd08bbb2084ab9bf2b070d0cdcc.translation: I have more important things to discuss with you tonight.

sense_7b009f61756bb925b30d92452a80a1bd.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_1e6b700d4d2bdb4b0ff898432d6343d8.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_1e6b700d4d2bdb4b0ff898432d6343d8.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_12bd6f8d5f2e5c615fd2d1a197ba291e.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_dda3e77df7de6f5b5b4dc3ef77353979.text: Ele tem razão, eu não quero mais dormir no mesmo dormitório que ele, ele é doido.
sense_dda3e77df7de6f5b5b4dc3ef77353979.translation: He is right, I don't want to sleep in the same dormitory as him anymore, he is crazy.

sense_dda3e77df7de6f5b5b4dc3ef77353979.text: Ele nunca vai reparar na gente [...]
Ele se aproximou e experimentou empurrá-la.
sense_dda3e77df7de6f5b5b4dc3ef77353979.translation: He came closer and tried to push it.

sense_b40732e514ea7408ffbcb563e65b6f9f.text: O professor ensinou-me/me ensinou como fazer subtrações.
sense_b40732e514ea7408ffbcb563e65b6f9f.translation: The teacher taught me how to do subtractions.
Is there a way for us to arrive earlier?

sense_406776000b4f1102abfe043b92d071f9.text: Como podem conferir por si mesmos, o animal já estava morto.
sense_406776000b4f1102abfe043b92d071f9.translation: As you can check for yourselves, the animal was already dead.

sense_406776000b4f1102abfe043b92d071f9.text: Sinto muito ter de contradizê-la, Minerva, mas, como pode ver no meu bilhete, Harry tem obtido resultados muito fracos nas minhas aulas...
sense_406776000b4f1102abfe043b92d071f9.translation: I'm sorry to contradict you, Minerva, but, as you can see in my note, Harry has obtained very weak results in my classes...

sense_9cc6d8d8863ae39d5d40cac27e58204b.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_8aaadabc5e54594a92f7da1423147997.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_8aaadabc5e54594a92f7da1423147997.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_e9050208e92a5ac225127a195b68a183.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_e9050208e92a5ac225127a195b68a183.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_e9050208e92a5ac225127a195b68a183.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_e9050208e92a5ac225127a195b68a183.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_f653f6cfe60c8df98b070603280a17c8.text: Ela não só leu o livro como escreveu uma crítica.
sense_f653f6cfe60c8df98b070603280a17c8.translation: She didn’t only read the book, but also wrote a review.
I am ugly as well as stupid.

sense_ac18cb93f7b31bf9cbaf313fb8a7f166.text: Ele não está bem da cabeça.
sense_ac18cb93f7b31bf9cbaf313fb8a7f166.translation: He’s not right in the head.
I’m fine, we can go on.

sense_6566d62084f6e5b6a1e65bcfdba06a38.text: Fazer o bem não custa nada.
sense_6566d62084f6e5b6a1e65bcfdba06a38.translation: It costs nothing to do the right thing.

sense_6566d62084f6e5b6a1e65bcfdba06a38.text: Hoje eu fiz um bem: ajudei uma velhinha a atravessar a rua.
sense_6566d62084f6e5b6a1e65bcfdba06a38.translation: Today I did a good deed: I helped an old lady cross the street.

sense_344a1a7e47e6e4e7db3441c4e1848c56.text: Coma isso logo para podermos sair.
sense_344a1a7e47e6e4e7db3441c4e1848c56.translation: Eat that quickly so we can leave.

sense_344a1a7e47e6e4e7db3441c4e1848c56.text: Conserte isso, sua imprestável, conserte isso!
sense_344a1a7e47e6e4e7db3441c4e1848c56.translation: Fix that, you worthless, fix that!

sense_92f0b8ca4b74fe58259c9bf7114419e7.text: O livro é curto, mas bom.

sense_eabf6c8d6c79f3cfce3c36fba251b4cf.translation: It's not nice to say that to a person.

sense_61c57c2e07186a39f62ef633c7d32ee3.text: Ele puxou o temperamento ao pai.

sense_a992de4acc6e6e99a850a778c2ef552b.literal_meaning: Unfortunately, a robber stole [from] her the phone.

sense_4b7389b773b3771e0a7bbb77312ae230.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]

sense_4b7389b773b3771e0a7bbb77312ae230.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_4b7389b773b3771e0a7bbb77312ae230.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_c5e9cfc673235da4c5a5aaebae1ff835.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_c5e9cfc673235da4c5a5aaebae1ff835.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_c5e9cfc673235da4c5a5aaebae1ff835.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_c5e9cfc673235da4c5a5aaebae1ff835.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_05f01d4ba4582322f4fbb6526b289641.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.

sense_4deea5ad30a24dd635108916e1496b05.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_4deea5ad30a24dd635108916e1496b05.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_78a873d7af6f87db83ddd4b5c89794bc.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_dff27c0afe83741f34a5250c9642e1cc.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_dff27c0afe83741f34a5250c9642e1cc.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_acec4c0db57954dd7b18007f3a7703ca.text: Aproveita a vida, porque ela é curta!
Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_acec4c0db57954dd7b18007f3a7703ca.translation: Ants. Little tiny ants, marching in line. And they talk. They say things that are impossible to understand because I don’t speak antese.

sense_a8131f1898061b35508432d1bc7f03e8.translation: I hid because I was afraid.

sense_a8131f1898061b35508432d1bc7f03e8.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite.
sense_a8131f1898061b35508432d1bc7f03e8.translation: That morning he had gotten up slightly slower than usual, because he had felt ill during the night.

sense_f7c4f3c487fdb88bcef8d29830980e28.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_f7c4f3c487fdb88bcef8d29830980e28.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_f61627be95197671c99f1afbcf246827.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_f61627be95197671c99f1afbcf246827.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_42f2dcad5e3ca176ce6327d9a05bcace.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_42f2dcad5e3ca176ce6327d9a05bcace.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_42f2dcad5e3ca176ce6327d9a05bcace.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_42f2dcad5e3ca176ce6327d9a05bcace.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_42f2dcad5e3ca176ce6327d9a05bcace.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_77687210487c01e280e90c6cfdc2b717.text: Quando tiver uma dúvida, vá à biblioteca.
sense_77687210487c01e280e90c6cfdc2b717.translation: When you are in doubt, go to the library.

sense_e0d9392c9120caf9f7154a10a1a3c35f.translation: The film starts at two o’clock.

sense_b01c231894e8adeb414853d8464c77f8.translation: The village is eleven miles away.

sense_1fa95e703b5dcabb84a1bbea25edebee.translation: It is cheaper to by food by the kilogram.

sense_3b941f5bbda87b057bf6dec2b8c68e0d.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_630341d01c7f69c5978c2ba4c07b6f14.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_d8e9b3552781085adbb3ad0b0ef68e99.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_d8e9b3552781085adbb3ad0b0ef68e99.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_da6b4a420bfb517ec6f6a7760bf713a0.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_e8fc22d0baf20acb215b2e7ca95dc629.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_e8fc22d0baf20acb215b2e7ca95dc629.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_e8fc22d0baf20acb215b2e7ca95dc629.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_e8fc22d0baf20acb215b2e7ca95dc629.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_d430a1de501a150bd310899208c83ae5.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_d430a1de501a150bd310899208c83ae5.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_189a8b69438146b755580056b6fcd12d.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_189a8b69438146b755580056b6fcd12d.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_04b5bba12081e0c66b806118c52697e7.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_04b5bba12081e0c66b806118c52697e7.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_04b5bba12081e0c66b806118c52697e7.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_04b5bba12081e0c66b806118c52697e7.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_b5aa11df3b05a074da7b4bcc49736bf3.translation: You idiots! (addressing a group of women)

sense_14cd068852fcb20253fb03208cac92ca.translation: Can I stay at your house?

sense_14cd068852fcb20253fb03208cac92ca.text: Se você sentir que a acupuntura incomoda, discuta o assunto com o seu acupunturista. Se não ficar satisfeito com o que ele lhe disser, procure outro acupunturista que use agulhas mais finas.
sense_14cd068852fcb20253fb03208cac92ca.translation: If you feel that acupuncture bothers you, discuss the matter with your acupuncturist. If you aren't satisfied with what he tells you, look for another acupuncturist who uses thinner needles.

sense_2c87a20bc1749febd7506141c52f041e.text: Os irmãos Grimm eram acadêmicos alemães. Suas publicações se tornaram clássicos da literatura infantil.
sense_2c87a20bc1749febd7506141c52f041e.translation: The Brothers Grimm were German academics. Their publications have become classics of children's literature.

sense_2c87a20bc1749febd7506141c52f041e.text: Os otakus não só incorporam diversos termos japoneses a sua fala como também se inspiram e são influenciados por características orientais em outras atividades, como o cosplay.
sense_2c87a20bc1749febd7506141c52f041e.translation: Not only do otakus incorporate various Japanese terms into their speech, they're also inspired and influenced by oriental characteristics in other activities, such as cosplay.

sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.text: Machado de Assis afirmou, no seu livro Ressurreição (1872): "Cada qual sabe amar a seu modo; o modo, pouco importa; o essencial é que saiba amar."
sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.translation: Machado de Assis said, in his book Resurrection (1872), “Everyone knows how to love in their way; the way matters little; the essential thing is that they know how to love.”

sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.text: Boêmio, falante, amigo do copo e das noitadas, folgazão e mulherengo, com todos convivia facilmente, mas suas presepadas por vezes pesavam demais e deixavam ressentimentos.
sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.translation: Bohemian, outspoken, a friend of the glass and of nights out, fun-loving and a womanizer, he got on easily with everyone, but his pranks sometimes weighed too heavily and left resentment.

sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.translation: Then the smile reappeared in his face …

sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.text: [...] seu vocabulário tinha apenas cinco palavras [...]
sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.translation: … his vocabulary had only five words …

sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.text: Com sua parte do dinheiro, resolveu contar a sua mãe que estaria de mudança para Nova Iorque. Lá estudaria, trabalharia com os produtores de filmes. Sempre desejara viver numa grande metrópole mundial.
sense_f0ed8a6fe52a4203e1bda42a81e021e0.translation: With his share of the money, he decided to tell his mother he was moving to New York. There he'd study, work with film producers. He'd always wanted to live in a major world metropolis.

sense_741e1c340770a56744c9300d4d8175d7.text: Se alguém precisa de ajuda com o seu projeto, pode vir a mim.
sense_741e1c340770a56744c9300d4d8175d7.translation: If anyone needs help with their project, they can come to me.

sense_741e1c340770a56744c9300d4d8175d7.text: Sam Smith é conhecido por seus álbuns "Stay With Me", "Too Good at Goodbyes" e "Unholy".
sense_741e1c340770a56744c9300d4d8175d7.translation: Sam Smith is known for their albums "Stay With Me", "Too Good at Goodbyes", and "Unholy".

sense_359772f60c513df8a7471630e569d612.text: Maria Antonieta foi a última rainha da França antes da Revolução Francesa. Nascida na Áustria, era detestada por sua corte e por seu povo.
sense_359772f60c513df8a7471630e569d612.translation: Marie Antoinette was the last queen of France before the French Revolution. Born in Austria, she was hated by her court and her people.

sense_359772f60c513df8a7471630e569d612.text: Era difícil dizer se a professora os ouvira, pois seu rosto estava oculto pelas sombras.
sense_359772f60c513df8a7471630e569d612.translation: It was difficult to tell whether the teacher had heard them, because her face was hidden by the shadows.

sense_f6dbe6e6a9971054845435d60cc89308.text: João ligou o computador, mas o seu sistema logo foi infectado por um ransomware.
sense_f6dbe6e6a9971054845435d60cc89308.translation: John turned on his computer, but its system was soon infected by ransomware.

sense_f6dbe6e6a9971054845435d60cc89308.text: Havia formas já selecionadas de abacaxi ou ananás na época pré-colombiana. É considerado o fruto mais saboroso da América e os primeiros indícios de seu cultivo são do México.
sense_f6dbe6e6a9971054845435d60cc89308.translation: There were already selected forms of pineapple in pre-Columbian times. It's considered the tastiest fruit in America and the first evidence of its cultivation comes from Mexico.

sense_f6dbe6e6a9971054845435d60cc89308.text: O adágio “A esperança é a última que morre” deve ser vivido literalmente, isto é, a esperança só deve morrer com o seu dono; deve acompanhá-lo até o último suspiro.
sense_f6dbe6e6a9971054845435d60cc89308.translation: The adage “Hope is the last thing that dies” should be taken literally, i.e. hope should only die with its owner; it should accompany them until their last breath.

sense_e607bbed1c7751704018dbab150701b3.translation: Defend yours, and I'll take care of mine.

sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.text: Machado de Assis afirmou, no seu livro Ressurreição (1872): "Cada qual sabe amar a seu modo; o modo, pouco importa; o essencial é que saiba amar."

sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.text: Boêmio, falante, amigo do copo e das noitadas, folgazão e mulherengo, com todos convivia facilmente, mas suas presepadas por vezes pesavam demais e deixavam ressentimentos.
sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.translation: Bohemian, outspoken, a friend of the glass and of nights out, fun-loving and a womanizer, he got on easily with everyone, but his pranks sometimes weighed too heavily and left resentment.

sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.translation: Then the smile reappeared in his face …

sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.text: [...] seu vocabulário tinha apenas cinco palavras [...]
sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.translation: … his vocabulary had only five words …

sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.text: Com sua parte do dinheiro, resolveu contar a sua mãe que estaria de mudança para Nova Iorque. Lá estudaria, trabalharia com os produtores de filmes. Sempre desejara viver numa grande metrópole mundial.
sense_47b95919c7e25660d678f805bbfb4e28.translation: With his share of the money, he decided to tell his mother he was moving to New York. There he'd study, work with film producers. He'd always wanted to live in a major world metropolis.

sense_f7206170243735f9e2a532f5e707944e.translation: You idiots! (addressing a group of women)

sense_1496d89e29253bbf18fa3b18ee4a15dc.text: Se alguém precisa de ajuda com o seu projeto, pode vir a mim.
sense_1496d89e29253bbf18fa3b18ee4a15dc.translation: If anyone needs help with their project, they can come to me.

sense_1496d89e29253bbf18fa3b18ee4a15dc.text: Sam Smith é conhecido por seus álbuns "Stay With Me", "Too Good at Goodbyes" e "Unholy".
sense_1496d89e29253bbf18fa3b18ee4a15dc.translation: Sam Smith is known for their albums "Stay With Me", "Too Good at Goodbyes", and "Unholy".

sense_b24382cb27ae295bb53de0555d682ed4.text: Maria Antonieta foi a última rainha da França antes da Revolução Francesa. Nascida na Áustria, era detestada por sua corte e por seu povo.
sense_b24382cb27ae295bb53de0555d682ed4.translation: Marie Antoinette was the last queen of France before the French Revolution. Born in Austria, she was hated by her court and her people.

sense_b24382cb27ae295bb53de0555d682ed4.text: Era difícil dizer se a professora os ouvira, pois seu rosto estava oculto pelas sombras.
sense_b24382cb27ae295bb53de0555d682ed4.translation: It was difficult to tell whether the teacher had heard them, because her face was hidden by the shadows.

sense_11621c79d24dd8763a82e6cee99d05e1.translation: Can I stay at your house?

sense_11621c79d24dd8763a82e6cee99d05e1.text: Se você sentir que a acupuntura incomoda, discuta o assunto com o seu acupunturista. Se não ficar satisfeito com o que ele lhe disser, procure outro acupunturista que use agulhas mais finas.
sense_11621c79d24dd8763a82e6cee99d05e1.translation: If you feel that acupuncture bothers you, discuss the matter with your acupuncturist. If you aren't satisfied with what he tells you, look for another acupuncturist who uses thinner needles.

sense_5f6de9748d4bba81c7d0bed87d794a66.text: Os irmãos Grimm eram acadêmicos alemães. Suas publicações se tornaram clássicos da literatura infantil.
sense_5f6de9748d4bba81c7d0bed87d794a66.translation: The Brothers Grimm were German academics. Their publications have become classics of children's literature.

sense_5f6de9748d4bba81c7d0bed87d794a66.text: Os otakus não só incorporam diversos termos japoneses a sua fala como também se inspiram e são influenciados por características orientais em outras atividades, como o cosplay.
sense_5f6de9748d4bba81c7d0bed87d794a66.translation: Not only do otakus incorporate various Japanese terms into their speech, they're also inspired and influenced by oriental characteristics in other activities, such as cosplay.

sense_c3203fbd27727b9606529afa0f01ce3e.text: João ligou o computador, mas o seu sistema logo foi infectado por um ransomware.
sense_c3203fbd27727b9606529afa0f01ce3e.translation: John turned on his computer, but its system was soon infected by ransomware.

sense_c3203fbd27727b9606529afa0f01ce3e.text: Havia formas já selecionadas de abacaxi ou ananás na época pré-colombiana. É considerado o fruto mais saboroso da América e os primeiros indícios de seu cultivo são do México.
sense_c3203fbd27727b9606529afa0f01ce3e.translation: There were already selected forms of pineapple in pre-Columbian times. It's considered the tastiest fruit in America and the first evidence of its cultivation comes from Mexico.

sense_c3203fbd27727b9606529afa0f01ce3e.text: O adágio “A esperança é a última que morre” deve ser vivido literalmente, isto é, a esperança só deve morrer com o seu dono; deve acompanhá-lo até o último suspiro.
sense_c3203fbd27727b9606529afa0f01ce3e.translation: The adage “Hope is the last thing that dies” should be taken literally, i.e. hope should only die with its owner; it should accompany them until their last breath.

sense_4a0a40112bccd6ba7a8f3a05d34765fa.text: Defende o seu, que eu trato do meu
sense_4a0a40112bccd6ba7a8f3a05d34765fa.translation: Defend yours, and I'll take care of mine.

sense_7a7251b1f89cd31383ae5a70c556a7e1.text: Vou ao restaurante onde ele gosta de comer.
sense_7a7251b1f89cd31383ae5a70c556a7e1.translation: I’m going to the restaurant where he likes to eat.

sense_7a7251b1f89cd31383ae5a70c556a7e1.text: Esta é a praia onde nos casamos.
sense_7a7251b1f89cd31383ae5a70c556a7e1.translation: This is the beach where we got married.

sense_65febfe87e3128f48f2c8713a23a94dd.text: Por favor, se sente onde você preferir.

sense_325d0e6f5a702ad15e697ec467179493.text: Quais são as modalidades onde seu filho é campeão?
sense_325d0e6f5a702ad15e697ec467179493.translation: Which are the sports where your child is a champion?

sense_325d0e6f5a702ad15e697ec467179493.text: Dezembro é a época do ano onde as pessoas ficam mais solidárias, não é mesmo?
sense_325d0e6f5a702ad15e697ec467179493.translation: December is the time of year where people are at their most supportive, isn't it?

sense_aeddd0d1a7481eeb6364c90ca5cfe782.text: Sempre pesquisa as leis de onde você vai viajar.
sense_aeddd0d1a7481eeb6364c90ca5cfe782.translation: Always search for the laws of wherever you'll travel.

sense_aeddd0d1a7481eeb6364c90ca5cfe782.text: Ela mora em São Paulo, onde a gente foi ano passado.
sense_aeddd0d1a7481eeb6364c90ca5cfe782.translation: She lives in São Paulo, where we went last year.

sense_aeddd0d1a7481eeb6364c90ca5cfe782.text: Essa é uma foto de onde eu fui nas férias.
sense_aeddd0d1a7481eeb6364c90ca5cfe782.translation: This is a photo of where I went on holiday.

sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.text: Não me lembro do nome de quem me ligou.
sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.translation: I don’t remember the name of the person who called me.

sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.text: Quem quiser sair, que o faça.
sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.translation: Whoever wants to leave may do so.

sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.text: A quem interessar possa, a decisão tomada está abaixo descrita.
sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.translation: To whom it may concern, the decision made is hereineafter described.

sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.text: Um acordar alegre e farto de quem dormio de uma assentada sete horas de chumbo.
sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.translation: A joyful and hearty awakening of someone who had slept for seven heavy hours straight. [Literally, “for seven lead-hours in a sitting”, because lead is a heavy metal.]

sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.text: Nuno Leal Maia é um grande amigo dos amigos. Quem já conviveu ou convive com ele sabe da sua personalidade alegre e descontraída, sem estrelismo, que cativa as pessoas com o seu bom humor constante.
sense_cd19055b97753925dcca0a4db61c7599.translation: Nuno Leal Maia is a great big friend. Whoever had lived or lives with him knows of his overjoyed and easygoing personality, which has no haughtiness and captivates people with his never-changing good spirits.

sense_0cfd468fdf5358c3dbdd5889a42ba1ee.text: Foi ele quem me falou de você.
sense_0cfd468fdf5358c3dbdd5889a42ba1ee.translation: It was he who told me about you.

sense_0cfd468fdf5358c3dbdd5889a42ba1ee.text: A moça a quem dei meu número não me ligou.
sense_0cfd468fdf5358c3dbdd5889a42ba1ee.translation: The young lady I gave my number to hasn't called me.

sense_227f7ee3b3868b544117118ae1f9c737.text: E este artigo foi escrito por quem?
sense_227f7ee3b3868b544117118ae1f9c737.translation: And this article was written by whom?
Who has seen the new film?

sense_227f7ee3b3868b544117118ae1f9c737.text: Quem disse essa frase, Kim Jong-un ou Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva? - "우리 나라를 핵탄으로 위협하던 시 대는 영원히 지나갔습니다."
sense_227f7ee3b3868b544117118ae1f9c737.translation: Who said this phrase? Kim Jong Un or Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva? - "우리 나라를 핵탄으로 위협하던 시 대는 영원히 지나갔습니다."

sense_0f112131efba76605ea323a907e99cb1.text: Aconteceu uma coisa bastante estranha ontem à noite.
sense_0f112131efba76605ea323a907e99cb1.translation: A very strange thing happened last night.

sense_0f112131efba76605ea323a907e99cb1.text: Comprei umas coisas com o salário desse mês.
sense_0f112131efba76605ea323a907e99cb1.translation: I bought some stuff with this month’s salary.

sense_63e980f7e6fcccc7b1d0ba36665a256a.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_63e980f7e6fcccc7b1d0ba36665a256a.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_63e980f7e6fcccc7b1d0ba36665a256a.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_63e980f7e6fcccc7b1d0ba36665a256a.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_8d8669b0dc31b0c4ed88f8809e3b42d7.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_6c14a2161d30b8795f49225d0c9e71de.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.

sense_5e84d971f0f0ea74c8969668fe050de7.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_943031429d740691d40d985f05b345d0.text: É para comermos toda a carne.

sense_856c6d1ae957007c1f666303163ff472.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_086616d7f55f65cd37020a23f1d373de.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_086616d7f55f65cd37020a23f1d373de.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_fedb6c057a400b557a1745114fc9fadf.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_a7a3b43fa7f8adfc64529315621db855.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_aa3dbcc95f5549fe0aed9956254a5e5e.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_dcb2c963b203ba26077e0b48ff5d5787.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_dcb2c963b203ba26077e0b48ff5d5787.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_dcb2c963b203ba26077e0b48ff5d5787.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_dcb2c963b203ba26077e0b48ff5d5787.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_fc56dd56a5a68edc22c2598fb122bc5a.text: O que quero mesmo é tomar um banho.
sense_fc56dd56a5a68edc22c2598fb122bc5a.translation: What I want really is to have a shower.

sense_51fb94bc1fe173ce59ee9590c14463e7.text: O que eu vi é esse mesmo.
sense_51fb94bc1fe173ce59ee9590c14463e7.translation: The one I saw is this one indeed.

sense_51fb94bc1fe173ce59ee9590c14463e7.text: O cidadão mesmo que o prendeu.

sense_fc64b9529562bc4bba0bf407e8eee5fd.translation: I will send him the document precisely tomorrow.
I will do it right now.

sense_c6529d859e81653fdd22b0f56272ca8f.text: Mesmo pobre, sempre conseguiu alimentar seus filhos.
sense_c6529d859e81653fdd22b0f56272ca8f.translation: Despite being poor, he was always able to feed his children.

sense_c6529d859e81653fdd22b0f56272ca8f.text: Mesmo sendo cedo, irei para casa.
sense_c6529d859e81653fdd22b0f56272ca8f.translation: Although it is early, I will go home.

sense_c67142a1dc1b3967dc867d99e70596c6.text: Ele agora tem uma casa nas montanhas.
sense_c67142a1dc1b3967dc867d99e70596c6.translation: He now has a house in the mountains.

sense_a64c54dcc64a033975285c669003aecf.translation: I have never seen this film.

sense_a64c54dcc64a033975285c669003aecf.text: Você nunca me deu a impressão de gostar tanto assim da matéria.
sense_a64c54dcc64a033975285c669003aecf.translation: You never gave me the impression of liking that subject so much.

sense_fae8874b727140fcef3e5c8229ae57e9.translation: We won four times in a row.

sense_2b6e2a2972d085c5ec0b879efc2afdf7.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_d2e8da6b879af69a9ce5ff59e6b943b2.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_ecb80672e0864a67701fb71e7f5591d5.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_775255db6d7ef95950e67d4586cb8207.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_775255db6d7ef95950e67d4586cb8207.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_727d3a26780901e1ad8580bb3d815a0d.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_727d3a26780901e1ad8580bb3d815a0d.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_6d11ddaf814615a07f7efffee773c382.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_6d11ddaf814615a07f7efffee773c382.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_6d11ddaf814615a07f7efffee773c382.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_6d11ddaf814615a07f7efffee773c382.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_fbce2a7d496431dd1ee37e874921a7b2.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_fbce2a7d496431dd1ee37e874921a7b2.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_fbce2a7d496431dd1ee37e874921a7b2.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_fbce2a7d496431dd1ee37e874921a7b2.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_9618d7b08ca4345462627118c51a9fcb.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_9618d7b08ca4345462627118c51a9fcb.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_9618d7b08ca4345462627118c51a9fcb.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_9618d7b08ca4345462627118c51a9fcb.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_8677f021ea92a54600f1311ea70000e4.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_8677f021ea92a54600f1311ea70000e4.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_8767698faec2f22745080543fa0f6735.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_1def10458aa9cf114c157acb924908d2.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_1def10458aa9cf114c157acb924908d2.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_1def10458aa9cf114c157acb924908d2.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_1def10458aa9cf114c157acb924908d2.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_1def10458aa9cf114c157acb924908d2.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_1def10458aa9cf114c157acb924908d2.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_4fb48b0075ad2fd0bd68fa466b2950b7.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_406fb57a03cdac65c6f36c4b3face527.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_4d26a579a2b42c93d40973083e6927fd.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_4d26a579a2b42c93d40973083e6927fd.translation: … the only teacher present when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_0861f43578b2ec044f72ee7f30d98469.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_b3f86fada9307a0e8deffd4e03340032.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_b3f86fada9307a0e8deffd4e03340032.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_2f920315f16f1694a0fae3d8f0333c88.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_2f920315f16f1694a0fae3d8f0333c88.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_2f920315f16f1694a0fae3d8f0333c88.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_2f920315f16f1694a0fae3d8f0333c88.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_50d985a5f465589ee81528b6228b1390.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_50d985a5f465589ee81528b6228b1390.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_50d985a5f465589ee81528b6228b1390.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_50d985a5f465589ee81528b6228b1390.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_e9d73ad08ddfd77713985fb550c3fabd.translation: A book still needs to be read.

sense_c59cb456180644580ee219b8f5ced9c1.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_c59cb456180644580ee219b8f5ced9c1.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_57cc7b2558f0d319e1a4077d05329a9a.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_57cc7b2558f0d319e1a4077d05329a9a.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_8810f8922d494f0354867d5efff55657.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_8810f8922d494f0354867d5efff55657.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_8810f8922d494f0354867d5efff55657.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_8810f8922d494f0354867d5efff55657.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_8810f8922d494f0354867d5efff55657.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_8810f8922d494f0354867d5efff55657.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_e95309e5c53c052e890684bd0c65e11a.text: Compra um livro e também um lápis.
sense_e95309e5c53c052e890684bd0c65e11a.translation: Buy a book and a pencil too.
Your brother also wants to go.

sense_7cbcdf314549ecc466b1bfdd3c1dcbab.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_7cbcdf314549ecc466b1bfdd3c1dcbab.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_7cbcdf314549ecc466b1bfdd3c1dcbab.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_7cbcdf314549ecc466b1bfdd3c1dcbab.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_0cc85e36fc3831dc27097873b051b429.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_0cc85e36fc3831dc27097873b051b429.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_a432aaf424cd3e9e1b5e5a467d547b14.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_fac6f5e9925ac1f103e89506fcd84164.text: Deixei a fatia mais doce da vida / Na mesa dos homens de vida vazia
sense_fac6f5e9925ac1f103e89506fcd84164.translation: I left the sweetest slice of life / On the table of the men who lead empty lives

sense_9e9c50a26fb0628c08194c03fbb95276.text: Ele não está bem da cabeça.
sense_9e9c50a26fb0628c08194c03fbb95276.translation: He’s not right in the head.
I’m fine, we can go on.

sense_4f771f4af35c5dc6dce195a70126f706.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_4f771f4af35c5dc6dce195a70126f706.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_4f771f4af35c5dc6dce195a70126f706.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_4f771f4af35c5dc6dce195a70126f706.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_069ee5879e54622435fa526aee9f1710.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_069ee5879e54622435fa526aee9f1710.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_2b582ab9bab1219d17b5e4e48a99b340.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_2b582ab9bab1219d17b5e4e48a99b340.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_6cd6cf87fbe4a26fab32ebcaa15e93aa.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_6cd6cf87fbe4a26fab32ebcaa15e93aa.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_9a068f3514c614bd5e8e75f40849138b.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_9a068f3514c614bd5e8e75f40849138b.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_d04f2db797d8cd8087cc265761a7ed16.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_ae0643add2f27a5e5f164a6b5732a4e9.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_ae0643add2f27a5e5f164a6b5732a4e9.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_ae0643add2f27a5e5f164a6b5732a4e9.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_ae0643add2f27a5e5f164a6b5732a4e9.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_d5948acdd34c2d2e789f92fcdb851b6b.text: Se ele fala, irrita a todos.
sense_d5948acdd34c2d2e789f92fcdb851b6b.translation: If he speaks, he annoys everyone.

sense_3eb8c3c8be4c4a055def48abe656f8c1.text: Se eu fosse você, não iria ali sozinha.
sense_3eb8c3c8be4c4a055def48abe656f8c1.translation: If I were you, I wouldn't go there alone.

sense_3eb8c3c8be4c4a055def48abe656f8c1.text: Se ela não tivesse me falado, não ia saber.
sense_3eb8c3c8be4c4a055def48abe656f8c1.translation: If she hadn't told me, I wouldn't know.

sense_86e7087d1385d837cb3f30b58d6f5f2b.text: Se você tem carro, por que ir a pé?
sense_86e7087d1385d837cb3f30b58d6f5f2b.translation: If you have a car, why go on foot?

sense_86e7087d1385d837cb3f30b58d6f5f2b.text: O ralo está entupido — e, se o ralo está entupido, a água não flui.
sense_86e7087d1385d837cb3f30b58d6f5f2b.translation: The drain's blocked — and if the drain's blocked, the water won't flow.

sense_0f83d1ac38a620da3b0c0dfc30b06a1a.text: Pergunto-lhe se já tem uma solução para o caso.
sense_0f83d1ac38a620da3b0c0dfc30b06a1a.translation: I ask you whether you already have a solution for the case.
I don't know if she will come.

sense_3e4d9ef906e3e45642695a12955bf5a7.text: Se for sair, leve um guarda-chuva.
sense_3e4d9ef906e3e45642695a12955bf5a7.translation: If you go out, take an umbrella.
We will only begin if they pay us.

sense_3e4d9ef906e3e45642695a12955bf5a7.text: Tu me devolva o que tirou daqui / Que o meu peito se abre e desata os nós / Se enfim, você um dia resolver mudar / Tirar meu pobre coração do altar
sense_3e4d9ef906e3e45642695a12955bf5a7.translation: Give me back what you took from here / 'Cause my chest will open and untie the knots / If you finally decide to change / Take my poor heart from the altar

sense_3e4d9ef906e3e45642695a12955bf5a7.text: Desculpe, acho que dá mais medo se for meia-noite!
sense_3e4d9ef906e3e45642695a12955bf5a7.translation: I'm sorry, I thought it would be more fearsome if it were midnight!

sense_9d95a407fdcda08bc17de918a4dff974.text: Ainda não recebeste o teu dinheiro?
sense_9d95a407fdcda08bc17de918a4dff974.translation: Haven't you received your money yet?

sense_9d95a407fdcda08bc17de918a4dff974.text: O teu computador deu tela azul.
O teu pai veio te visitar.
sense_9d95a407fdcda08bc17de918a4dff974.translation: Your father came to visit you.

sense_9d95a407fdcda08bc17de918a4dff974.text: Tu tem que devolver o teu livro pra biblioteca logo, cara.
sense_9d95a407fdcda08bc17de918a4dff974.translation: You gotta take your book back to the library soon, man.

sense_6f8347bc1d64f0d8c93399ad4b369aa9.text: O teu é suficiente para sobreviver?
A casa em si é tua, mas o terreno é meu.
sense_6f8347bc1d64f0d8c93399ad4b369aa9.translation: The house itself is yours, but the land is mine.

sense_6f8347bc1d64f0d8c93399ad4b369aa9.text: Tua por só uma semana, o quadro já parece um velho amigo.
sense_6f8347bc1d64f0d8c93399ad4b369aa9.translation: Yours for only a week so far, the painting already feels like an old friend.

sense_786e6653c0f0c1364d21c31a02e1307e.text: E à mulher disse: Multiplicarei grandemente a tua dor e a tua conceição; com dor terás filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará.
sense_786e6653c0f0c1364d21c31a02e1307e.translation: And to the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt have children; and thy desire shall be for thy husband, and he shall rule over thee."

sense_786e6653c0f0c1364d21c31a02e1307e.text: Honra ao Senhor com a tua fazenda e com as primícias de toda a tua renda; e se encherão os teus celeiros abundantemente, e trasbordarão de mosto os teus lagares.
sense_786e6653c0f0c1364d21c31a02e1307e.translation: Honor the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine income; and thy barns shall be filled with plenty, and thy winepresses shall overflow with new wine.

sense_786e6653c0f0c1364d21c31a02e1307e.text: Eu conheço as tuas obras, e o teu amor, e o teu serviço, e a tua fé, e a tua paciência, e que as tuas últimas obras são mais do que as primeiras.
sense_786e6653c0f0c1364d21c31a02e1307e.translation: I know thy works, and thy love, and thy service, and thy faith, and thy patience, and that thy latter works are more than thy former.

sense_bf64e041704f31d97a8055dad9b3c11d.text: Ainda não recebeste o teu dinheiro?

sense_293b2fb3f2b613c7fa16321f33a18351.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_134bd3213e4f223dc3f178e79b043da3.text: E onde foi que você conseguiu esse senhor colchão? Adorei!
sense_134bd3213e4f223dc3f178e79b043da3.translation: And where have you even got that great big mattress from? Loved it! [Literally, “that mister mattress”]

sense_134bd3213e4f223dc3f178e79b043da3.text: Olha esse! É um senhor carro, hein? Gosto de sua cor e tamanho.
sense_134bd3213e4f223dc3f178e79b043da3.translation: Looky this! It's such a fine-looking car, huh? I like her color and size.

sense_134bd3213e4f223dc3f178e79b043da3.text: Que vieste fazer em minha casa a essa hora e em companhia desse senhor cão?
sense_134bd3213e4f223dc3f178e79b043da3.translation: What are you doing in my house at this hour, and in the company of that big dog?

sense_3c5bed5bdd7c0404bfa10c59daca5162.text: Senhoras e senhores, vos apresento a primeira atração da noite!
sense_3c5bed5bdd7c0404bfa10c59daca5162.translation: Ladies and gentlemen, I present you this night's first attraction!

sense_dbd184fd3173719db57290bef8c5062f.text: Os escravizados frequentemente revoltavam-se contra seus senhores.
sense_dbd184fd3173719db57290bef8c5062f.translation: The enslaved used to frequently revolt against their masters.

sense_dbd184fd3173719db57290bef8c5062f.text: Escravos devem obedecer aos seus senhores.

sense_b6a11be591fe11e43afb179fe4f12df8.text: Ele é mais homem que seus amigos.
sense_b6a11be591fe11e43afb179fe4f12df8.translation: He is manlier than his friends.

sense_b6a11be591fe11e43afb179fe4f12df8.text: João não é muito homem; foge sempre às lutas.
sense_b6a11be591fe11e43afb179fe4f12df8.translation: John isn’t very manly; he always runs away from fights.

sense_7db2a14dd5a9d129bbbd56af4a0f9a2e.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_7db2a14dd5a9d129bbbd56af4a0f9a2e.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_f8bc39c48a6de110f6d11759bfe57470.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_f8bc39c48a6de110f6d11759bfe57470.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_f8bc39c48a6de110f6d11759bfe57470.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_f8bc39c48a6de110f6d11759bfe57470.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_cba9e02ee5caf79e31fabb8ddb8e5197.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_cba9e02ee5caf79e31fabb8ddb8e5197.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_39e27b1bb9838ebc6822aef3836f53c7.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_39e27b1bb9838ebc6822aef3836f53c7.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_cdc09373f27f3c8c02b5866d46df0fe7.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_cdc09373f27f3c8c02b5866d46df0fe7.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_cdc09373f27f3c8c02b5866d46df0fe7.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_cdc09373f27f3c8c02b5866d46df0fe7.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_846aeb4e2c74a2f68323ffdf7b33b7fe.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_846aeb4e2c74a2f68323ffdf7b33b7fe.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_5ac4ec00b642cf9cccc8dddab4fb121b.text: Aconteceu uma coisa bastante estranha ontem à noite.
sense_5ac4ec00b642cf9cccc8dddab4fb121b.translation: A very strange thing happened last night.

sense_5ac4ec00b642cf9cccc8dddab4fb121b.text: Comprei umas coisas com o salário desse mês.
sense_5ac4ec00b642cf9cccc8dddab4fb121b.translation: I bought some stuff with this month’s salary.

sense_28cc408e464d4ed8c28fc7be67ecad43.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_28cc408e464d4ed8c28fc7be67ecad43.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_4b46006615d040ba8935d63a2285d0d6.text: O tesouro foi encontrado por Dudinka.
sense_4b46006615d040ba8935d63a2285d0d6.translation: The treasure was found around Dudinka.

sense_9c3cd90e682d495d2caaccdfd3cf8773.text: Não toques no pelo de uma urtiga.

sense_d715e21157d50ee0d748a368d506d5b5.text: O preço de um prato nos mercados daqui é por vinte euros.
sense_d715e21157d50ee0d748a368d506d5b5.translation: The price of a plate in the local markets is around twenty euros.

sense_66693e6f97699aac09329c072a7ebe9e.text: Eu farei de tudo por uma cópia deste livro.
sense_66693e6f97699aac09329c072a7ebe9e.translation: I will do anything for a copy of this book.

sense_05d94737faa8107f9ed761ab9f15a4f1.text: Ainda passaríamos por muitos túneis antes de chegarmos.
sense_05d94737faa8107f9ed761ab9f15a4f1.translation: We would still pass through many tunnels before we arrived.

sense_76756b33dac7c3dc8b221645b45ec856.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_76756b33dac7c3dc8b221645b45ec856.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_76756b33dac7c3dc8b221645b45ec856.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_76756b33dac7c3dc8b221645b45ec856.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_1d259b1a1d10af193824e47204510292.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_1d259b1a1d10af193824e47204510292.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_6aa2eb3fd54bda9aece4979ccda2e929.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_e555309746a24da84d505e95096c642f.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_e555309746a24da84d505e95096c642f.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_e002a8d1a86248b605f6a85597632c47.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_e002a8d1a86248b605f6a85597632c47.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_e002a8d1a86248b605f6a85597632c47.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_e002a8d1a86248b605f6a85597632c47.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_e002a8d1a86248b605f6a85597632c47.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_e002a8d1a86248b605f6a85597632c47.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_cf9da6e40614b0a02352fd02581fe1d0.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_f1202833759cd06806670d3659be5765.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_f1202833759cd06806670d3659be5765.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_f1202833759cd06806670d3659be5765.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_f1202833759cd06806670d3659be5765.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_1800884ef1dbb8df468d3d45534d5c4e.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_1800884ef1dbb8df468d3d45534d5c4e.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_1800884ef1dbb8df468d3d45534d5c4e.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_1800884ef1dbb8df468d3d45534d5c4e.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_8badc05317cb32cbf00d5e7a51f46f85.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_8badc05317cb32cbf00d5e7a51f46f85.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_c89b8c434973c535220050866bc0b44a.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_245907de630c9f386ad84d9516e17a1e.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_245907de630c9f386ad84d9516e17a1e.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_e99d052c7e14855add25f7ad5f5f737b.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_52797e8c91c1d1572d18bd088ca1cacb.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_52797e8c91c1d1572d18bd088ca1cacb.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_d9474c7ebe34cc2700e0a589ef70b988.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_d9474c7ebe34cc2700e0a589ef70b988.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_0e56f60b771aff78c5caed7a3d20103b.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_bbed655c1a4ec575df3287634cbd81b9.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_e1b1ef55cb155a283a61a70383007fda.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_e1b1ef55cb155a283a61a70383007fda.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_19e3f31ca34ab5646f541739ba4439fe.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_91a77e5f8c29a8a6d6cce0c3602754c6.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_91a77e5f8c29a8a6d6cce0c3602754c6.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_ed8f3065e68fe43e68b2872b140dc946.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_ed8f3065e68fe43e68b2872b140dc946.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_061b85426bf2a7a7ba1d3ce0ddc1acb7.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_061b85426bf2a7a7ba1d3ce0ddc1acb7.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_061b85426bf2a7a7ba1d3ce0ddc1acb7.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_061b85426bf2a7a7ba1d3ce0ddc1acb7.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_f6a9ad7a94ff169f628dfc8c84113cf2.text: Este livro é maior do que aquele.
sense_f6a9ad7a94ff169f628dfc8c84113cf2.translation: This book is bigger than that one.

sense_2e5baf051c9e6cad6e9fc30d57508e8c.text: O Grande Porto é uma região metropolitana no norte de Portugal.
sense_2e5baf051c9e6cad6e9fc30d57508e8c.translation: Greater Porto is a metropolitan area in the north of Portugal.
I live in the metropolis of Lisbon.

sense_810701a1716d854d28835438d7fdaae7.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_810701a1716d854d28835438d7fdaae7.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_59f88459d0dec87a2163077e986666a4.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_59f88459d0dec87a2163077e986666a4.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_d00916604e18a36748f9a3696cdb0b3d.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_d00916604e18a36748f9a3696cdb0b3d.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_d00916604e18a36748f9a3696cdb0b3d.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_d00916604e18a36748f9a3696cdb0b3d.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_d00916604e18a36748f9a3696cdb0b3d.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_d00916604e18a36748f9a3696cdb0b3d.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_d2edb82c6210cee46a671b0d783f1f32.text: Sou lenhador, cortar árvores é o meu trabalho.
sense_d2edb82c6210cee46a671b0d783f1f32.translation: I’m a lumberjack, cutting trees is my job.

sense_d2edb82c6210cee46a671b0d783f1f32.text: Tenho dois trabalhos para sustentar minha família.
sense_d2edb82c6210cee46a671b0d783f1f32.translation: I have two jobs to support my family.

sense_bd2316dc6f0430be10adbedd97317efd.translation: We will leave in a short while.

sense_65241578b3a0664e484a1f9207a08727.text: Sobrou pouca comida e menos vinho.
sense_65241578b3a0664e484a1f9207a08727.translation: Little food was left and less wine.

sense_3d6daaa7411f48946a6109d9bc8c360a.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_3d6daaa7411f48946a6109d9bc8c360a.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_971307dcbc6b11f0d355cea3d3839cab.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_971307dcbc6b11f0d355cea3d3839cab.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_971307dcbc6b11f0d355cea3d3839cab.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_971307dcbc6b11f0d355cea3d3839cab.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_72b078ef1ce2d9d526ffb1c5b96cf514.text: Me dá outra cerveja, por favor.
Se não ficar satisfeito com o que ele lhe disser, procure outro acupunturista que use agulhas mais finas.
sense_72b078ef1ce2d9d526ffb1c5b96cf514.translation: If you’re not satisfied with what he [the acupuncturist] tells you, look for another acupuncturist who utilizes thinner needles.

sense_576a4223c775305ab0674524e602eaf1.text: Parar de invejar o sucesso do outro, de viver sempre tentando dar uma rasteira no nosso colega.
sense_576a4223c775305ab0674524e602eaf1.translation: We should stop envying the other’s success, living always trying to pull the rug out from under our peers.

sense_7e88923ea0283df53929d6a77a23bb35.text: Foi só uma idéia, pensei que você talvez gostasse de se encontrar comigo.
sense_7e88923ea0283df53929d6a77a23bb35.translation: It was just an idea, I thought maybe you’d like to go on a date with me.

sense_7e88923ea0283df53929d6a77a23bb35.text: — E’ o mesmo, disse comsigo. Até é melhor. Fico no Porto, e escrevo ao Sebastião que venha ter commigo se quer ir vêr o filho a Coimbra.
sense_7e88923ea0283df53929d6a77a23bb35.translation: “It’s the same”, he said to himself, “It’s actually better. I stay in Porto, and I write to Sebatião for him to come talk to me if he wishes to see his son in Coimbra.”

sense_1a2656b6acf2f68c46f515aa73488646.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_cbff955af40de5dd5669a0a19057f562.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_cbff955af40de5dd5669a0a19057f562.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_c450aebba7cae2c8e015d9ecf54e4e40.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_c3fdf403a7be3dcecaa3f30d2b5f686f.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_c3fdf403a7be3dcecaa3f30d2b5f686f.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_a37f6b4c0f934f699881999d0f6d93d9.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_a37f6b4c0f934f699881999d0f6d93d9.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_a37f6b4c0f934f699881999d0f6d93d9.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_a37f6b4c0f934f699881999d0f6d93d9.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_6f46bbbb7d1675252d1c37d6f9032a28.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_6f46bbbb7d1675252d1c37d6f9032a28.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_606fcb74bc78be3d68fd1e29efc7e9ad.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_606fcb74bc78be3d68fd1e29efc7e9ad.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_4f1b83b3c9880afc3eace0a1022bb498.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_4f1b83b3c9880afc3eace0a1022bb498.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_74d247d26ccf6459e878549d07051f45.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_74d247d26ccf6459e878549d07051f45.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_74d247d26ccf6459e878549d07051f45.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_74d247d26ccf6459e878549d07051f45.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_0e6554b5ed87124db401059cdbc1c9b0.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_0e6554b5ed87124db401059cdbc1c9b0.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_22ae5fce0bfcc4452607d52032497d9a.text: Todas as crianças devem ler livros.

sense_51cd563d878ecabe0f51e79c9e1971c9.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_5a96bd01c280551811497173591c1c94.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_5a96bd01c280551811497173591c1c94.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_cc3a7aa9859ef8d53f900c4210423b0a.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_17a3db1698ddfaba777a2eec20a388e9.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_17a3db1698ddfaba777a2eec20a388e9.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_3cec80a7a10201431964fb13ae068892.text: Para os europeus do século XV, a América era um novo mundo.
sense_3cec80a7a10201431964fb13ae068892.translation: For 15th century Europeans, America was a new world.

sense_3cec80a7a10201431964fb13ae068892.text: Por enquanto, Marte é um mundo inabitado.
sense_3cec80a7a10201431964fb13ae068892.translation: Mars is currently an uninhabited world.

sense_32e558135307f0bb503cc30ed1655fa3.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_32e558135307f0bb503cc30ed1655fa3.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_2cf6e77330b91bd02766c30d934eff7e.text: Eu farei de tudo por uma cópia deste livro.
sense_2cf6e77330b91bd02766c30d934eff7e.translation: I will do anything for a copy of this book.

sense_41f83333d025e72c5f0533c8c1e43991.text: O tesouro foi encontrado por Dudinka.
sense_41f83333d025e72c5f0533c8c1e43991.translation: The treasure was found around Dudinka.

sense_d9da8c9eec665c96a631aff3dbf5ebcc.text: O que é bom para gripe?
sense_d9da8c9eec665c96a631aff3dbf5ebcc.translation: What is good for the flu?
I have a message for you.

sense_c96f62aca0f46d92c209488ce7ae6b44.text: A cor da banana mudou de amarelo para preto.
sense_c96f62aca0f46d92c209488ce7ae6b44.translation: The colour of the banana changed from yellow to black.

sense_c96f62aca0f46d92c209488ce7ae6b44.text: O valor da minha casa baixou para menos do que o que eu paguei.
sense_c96f62aca0f46d92c209488ce7ae6b44.translation: The value of my house has fallen to less than what I paid.

sense_f37d3b4e36ed96ba3181d4b3bde08d80.text: Ele podia ouvi-la se deslocando para a direita, para obter uma visão desimpedida dele.
sense_f37d3b4e36ed96ba3181d4b3bde08d80.translation: He could hear her moving herself to the right, to obtain an unobstructed view of him.

sense_4c03d631536e3fd9772dc8db92afafd3.text: O preço de um prato nos mercados daqui é por vinte euros.
sense_4c03d631536e3fd9772dc8db92afafd3.translation: The price of a plate in the local markets is around twenty euros.

sense_dd46fe0908c9e2842e15def242845c2f.text: Ainda passaríamos por muitos túneis antes de chegarmos.
sense_dd46fe0908c9e2842e15def242845c2f.translation: We would still pass through many tunnels before we arrived.

sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.text: Machado de Assis afirmou, no seu livro Ressurreição (1872): "Cada qual sabe amar a seu modo; o modo, pouco importa; o essencial é que saiba amar."
sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.translation: Machado de Assis said, in his book Resurrection (1872), “Everyone knows how to love in their way; the way matters little; the essential thing is that they know how to love.”

sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.text: Boêmio, falante, amigo do copo e das noitadas, folgazão e mulherengo, com todos convivia facilmente, mas suas presepadas por vezes pesavam demais e deixavam ressentimentos.
sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.translation: Bohemian, outspoken, a friend of the glass and of nights out, fun-loving and a womanizer, he got on easily with everyone, but his pranks sometimes weighed too heavily and left resentment.

sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.translation: Then the smile reappeared in his face …

sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.text: [...] seu vocabulário tinha apenas cinco palavras [...]
sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.translation: … his vocabulary had only five words …

sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.text: Com sua parte do dinheiro, resolveu contar a sua mãe que estaria de mudança para Nova Iorque. Lá estudaria, trabalharia com os produtores de filmes. Sempre desejara viver numa grande metrópole mundial.
sense_4dead798e6795a319f809d24be195079.translation: With his share of the money, he decided to tell his mother he was moving to New York. There he'd study, work with film producers. He'd always wanted to live in a major world metropolis.

sense_77859b88e9e00a43e44a57bd1d1dc5da.translation: You idiots! (addressing a group of women)

sense_333f526e1ec831597016a47259ba88ae.text: Os irmãos Grimm eram acadêmicos alemães. Suas publicações se tornaram clássicos da literatura infantil.

sense_333f526e1ec831597016a47259ba88ae.text: Os otakus não só incorporam diversos termos japoneses a sua fala como também se inspiram e são influenciados por características orientais em outras atividades, como o cosplay.

sense_ff50cfc951fe604bec731f544772a331.text: Maria Antonieta foi a última rainha da França antes da Revolução Francesa. Nascida na Áustria, era detestada por sua corte e por seu povo.

sense_c4f0e34cb329811aa7abf47979e39203.text: O adágio “A esperança é a última que morre” deve ser vivido literalmente, isto é, a esperança só deve morrer com o seu dono; deve acompanhá-lo até o último suspiro.

sense_21fcfcc9724207ea6754be0c0b54051a.text: A gente deve tentar salvar o nosso casamento pro bem dos nossos filhos.
sense_21fcfcc9724207ea6754be0c0b54051a.translation: We must try to save our marriage for the sake of our children.

sense_21fcfcc9724207ea6754be0c0b54051a.text: […] já que estamos falando de números, talvez a questão do bug do milênio não seja só uma mudança do número dos nossos computadores que vai dar um tilt geral na humanidade.
sense_21fcfcc9724207ea6754be0c0b54051a.translation: […] while we're on the subject of numbers, perhaps the millennium bug isn't just a change in the number of our computers that will give humanity a general tilt.

sense_21fcfcc9724207ea6754be0c0b54051a.text: Nós devíamos baixar a cabeça, baixar o topete. E fazer honestamente o nosso trabalho. Parar de invejar o sucesso do outro, de viver sempre tentando dar uma rasteira no nosso colega.
sense_21fcfcc9724207ea6754be0c0b54051a.translation: We should suck it up, humble ourselves, do our job honestly, stop envying each other's success, and stop always trying to get the better of our colleagues.

sense_70e3d275413bc01668587304d9a95b8c.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_70e3d275413bc01668587304d9a95b8c.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!

sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.text: Machado de Assis afirmou, no seu livro Ressurreição (1872): "Cada qual sabe amar a seu modo; o modo, pouco importa; o essencial é que saiba amar."
sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.translation: Machado de Assis said, in his book Resurrection (1872), “Everyone knows how to love in their way; the way matters little; the essential thing is that they know how to love.”

sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.text: Boêmio, falante, amigo do copo e das noitadas, folgazão e mulherengo, com todos convivia facilmente, mas suas presepadas por vezes pesavam demais e deixavam ressentimentos.
sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.translation: Bohemian, outspoken, a friend of the glass and of nights out, fun-loving and a womanizer, he got on easily with everyone, but his pranks sometimes weighed too heavily and left resentment.
