sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.translation: Then the smile reappeared in his face …

sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.text: [...] seu vocabulário tinha apenas cinco palavras [...]
sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.translation: … his vocabulary had only five words …

sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.text: Com sua parte do dinheiro, resolveu contar a sua mãe que estaria de mudança para Nova Iorque. Lá estudaria, trabalharia com os produtores de filmes. Sempre desejara viver numa grande metrópole mundial.
sense_1d74c821d7a8fc65790e8d23e16f912c.translation: With his share of the money, he decided to tell his mother he was moving to New York. There he'd study, work with film producers. He'd always wanted to live in a major world metropolis.

sense_41419f9c23145367605221d63b669924.translation: You idiots! (addressing a group of women)

sense_7da045fb633ed7600a0dc310e42d10d1.text: Se alguém precisa de ajuda com o seu projeto, pode vir a mim.
sense_7da045fb633ed7600a0dc310e42d10d1.translation: If anyone needs help with their project, they can come to me.

sense_7da045fb633ed7600a0dc310e42d10d1.text: Sam Smith é conhecido por seus álbuns "Stay With Me", "Too Good at Goodbyes" e "Unholy".
sense_7da045fb633ed7600a0dc310e42d10d1.translation: Sam Smith is known for their albums "Stay With Me", "Too Good at Goodbyes", and "Unholy".

sense_fdc2222b092e1591b6b1d7ccce2db52a.text: Maria Antonieta foi a última rainha da França antes da Revolução Francesa. Nascida na Áustria, era detestada por sua corte e por seu povo.
sense_fdc2222b092e1591b6b1d7ccce2db52a.translation: Marie Antoinette was the last queen of France before the French Revolution. Born in Austria, she was hated by her court and her people.

sense_fdc2222b092e1591b6b1d7ccce2db52a.text: Era difícil dizer se a professora os ouvira, pois seu rosto estava oculto pelas sombras.
sense_fdc2222b092e1591b6b1d7ccce2db52a.translation: It was difficult to tell whether the teacher had heard them, because her face was hidden by the shadows.

sense_7a7bc852e83f172f06a97c21693a8c0a.translation: Can I stay at your house?

sense_7a7bc852e83f172f06a97c21693a8c0a.text: Se você sentir que a acupuntura incomoda, discuta o assunto com o seu acupunturista. Se não ficar satisfeito com o que ele lhe disser, procure outro acupunturista que use agulhas mais finas.
sense_7a7bc852e83f172f06a97c21693a8c0a.translation: If you feel that acupuncture bothers you, discuss the matter with your acupuncturist. If you aren't satisfied with what he tells you, look for another acupuncturist who uses thinner needles.

sense_a1b806e12bd96f644d77829db76e844d.text: João ligou o computador, mas o seu sistema logo foi infectado por um ransomware.
sense_a1b806e12bd96f644d77829db76e844d.translation: John turned on his computer, but its system was soon infected by ransomware.

sense_a1b806e12bd96f644d77829db76e844d.text: Havia formas já selecionadas de abacaxi ou ananás na época pré-colombiana. É considerado o fruto mais saboroso da América e os primeiros indícios de seu cultivo são do México.
sense_a1b806e12bd96f644d77829db76e844d.translation: There were already selected forms of pineapple in pre-Columbian times. It's considered the tastiest fruit in America and the first evidence of its cultivation comes from Mexico.

sense_a1b806e12bd96f644d77829db76e844d.text: O adágio “A esperança é a última que morre” deve ser vivido literalmente, isto é, a esperança só deve morrer com o seu dono; deve acompanhá-lo até o último suspiro.
sense_a1b806e12bd96f644d77829db76e844d.translation: The adage “Hope is the last thing that dies” should be taken literally, i.e. hope should only die with its owner; it should accompany them until their last breath.

sense_fd46d1d043e2a11eb82929c29b332586.text: Defende o seu, que eu trato do meu
sense_fd46d1d043e2a11eb82929c29b332586.translation: Defend yours, and I'll take care of mine.

sense_7827e3ea999103f0d78be74f31f81b16.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_7827e3ea999103f0d78be74f31f81b16.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_b4320d5741dbb656b0eb9188e88db184.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_b4320d5741dbb656b0eb9188e88db184.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_876075df67e1ce7a2fc018cc639f7fa2.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_876075df67e1ce7a2fc018cc639f7fa2.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_876075df67e1ce7a2fc018cc639f7fa2.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_876075df67e1ce7a2fc018cc639f7fa2.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_876075df67e1ce7a2fc018cc639f7fa2.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_876075df67e1ce7a2fc018cc639f7fa2.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_1091ac6d5381fa49c14b471300fa76d8.text: Perseverança é a melhor amiga do conhecimento.

sense_2368537dbe648033f31e0fd7737b9db7.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_2368537dbe648033f31e0fd7737b9db7.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_2368537dbe648033f31e0fd7737b9db7.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_2368537dbe648033f31e0fd7737b9db7.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_d139caf751969fe170150d9146724edd.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_d139caf751969fe170150d9146724edd.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_b1ae9f107cb7105c3e1387deacf4c9ce.text: Há vinte e quatro horas num dia.
sense_b1ae9f107cb7105c3e1387deacf4c9ce.translation: There are twenty-four hours in a day.

sense_b1ae9f107cb7105c3e1387deacf4c9ce.text: Ele estava aqui há uma hora.
sense_b1ae9f107cb7105c3e1387deacf4c9ce.translation: He was here one hour ago.

sense_ea201c4094d989e6ed619ee4999bc564.text: A alguma hora, eu passo aí.
sense_ea201c4094d989e6ed619ee4999bc564.translation: At some time, I’ll hop over there.

sense_521c32ad1580254e80743a206b37cda6.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_521c32ad1580254e80743a206b37cda6.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_260939dba9ecdd26c54feea691651a5b.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_260939dba9ecdd26c54feea691651a5b.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_260939dba9ecdd26c54feea691651a5b.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_260939dba9ecdd26c54feea691651a5b.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_fa3159db86cf3ef946da7e0c1c202fb4.text: Precisamos (de) descobrir o porquê disto ter acontecido.
sense_fa3159db86cf3ef946da7e0c1c202fb4.translation: We need to find out the reason that caused this to happen.

sense_7945246655a764e320bcad2d00472216.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_7945246655a764e320bcad2d00472216.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_7945246655a764e320bcad2d00472216.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_7945246655a764e320bcad2d00472216.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_2b17a3b1fb01fcbc6ba5d4eaa15c3695.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_2b17a3b1fb01fcbc6ba5d4eaa15c3695.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_88531833eded07317e49f86453720ad2.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_88531833eded07317e49f86453720ad2.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_8543f957ba9dbecbc6a564171fe9a6a1.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_8543f957ba9dbecbc6a564171fe9a6a1.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_be6d98f69fe764b73002f4381bdea771.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_be6d98f69fe764b73002f4381bdea771.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_be6d98f69fe764b73002f4381bdea771.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_be6d98f69fe764b73002f4381bdea771.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_cf52e9063362e84d909c535509ba9692.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_cf52e9063362e84d909c535509ba9692.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_bb926592036cfd3feed0acde7010c9a3.text: A mercadoria foi entregue em dois tantos.
sense_bb926592036cfd3feed0acde7010c9a3.translation: The wares were delivered in two portions.
I ate a bit of pie.

sense_cb8aa3ace4078b6863fce30c0385588e.text: Ele perdeu tanto sangue que morreu.
sense_cb8aa3ace4078b6863fce30c0385588e.translation: He lost so much blood that he died.

sense_6ba7b1f40682e95e9d9fc815664b78e7.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_6ba7b1f40682e95e9d9fc815664b78e7.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_6ba7b1f40682e95e9d9fc815664b78e7.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_6ba7b1f40682e95e9d9fc815664b78e7.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_e081ef1df4a8fdaa80c106ef21d0cecf.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_e081ef1df4a8fdaa80c106ef21d0cecf.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_3de6780533c5cd1cf4767bdda7945eb6.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_fb430bc2df1bf316e911beeadcfe33ec.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_fb430bc2df1bf316e911beeadcfe33ec.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_fb430bc2df1bf316e911beeadcfe33ec.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_fb430bc2df1bf316e911beeadcfe33ec.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_715600bd54992c6fb535943db31f2f4d.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_715600bd54992c6fb535943db31f2f4d.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_87f33023d92c967e5eee0a697540fe1e.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_87f33023d92c967e5eee0a697540fe1e.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_87f33023d92c967e5eee0a697540fe1e.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_87f33023d92c967e5eee0a697540fe1e.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_6ee3d80991d33356f8f6fbd8592a7f07.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_6ee3d80991d33356f8f6fbd8592a7f07.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_6ee3d80991d33356f8f6fbd8592a7f07.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_6ee3d80991d33356f8f6fbd8592a7f07.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_41e8a6dd1cd56189d02664aa0e5d8bb1.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_89625169b6da305ad3bbb354bcd3d2a6.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_89625169b6da305ad3bbb354bcd3d2a6.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_89625169b6da305ad3bbb354bcd3d2a6.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_89625169b6da305ad3bbb354bcd3d2a6.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_89625169b6da305ad3bbb354bcd3d2a6.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_89625169b6da305ad3bbb354bcd3d2a6.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_4d228b705f35e24a0445f539ce0bcea5.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_4d228b705f35e24a0445f539ce0bcea5.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_4d228b705f35e24a0445f539ce0bcea5.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_4d228b705f35e24a0445f539ce0bcea5.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_b9b2ced0cb962ec2ce01e59d240ab132.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_73e041138d1a25cb0e2715f7ee4f690b.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_4fbeb57999feb0683325b588537b99b7.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_4fbeb57999feb0683325b588537b99b7.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_b6965bf37a27d1dff030ec891fa78e0f.translation: You have good taste in music.

sense_9f4a3c7f4296d6941f161c86dc1064eb.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_9f4a3c7f4296d6941f161c86dc1064eb.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_86c84c95c6825bc14486ed4e1e99614a.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_86c84c95c6825bc14486ed4e1e99614a.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_86c84c95c6825bc14486ed4e1e99614a.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_86c84c95c6825bc14486ed4e1e99614a.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_3399178abdcf9a9ad20a2bbdccec1bac.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_3399178abdcf9a9ad20a2bbdccec1bac.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_a11ef6c609ad8f6b323332f1f4ac1e1c.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_a11ef6c609ad8f6b323332f1f4ac1e1c.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_a11ef6c609ad8f6b323332f1f4ac1e1c.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_a11ef6c609ad8f6b323332f1f4ac1e1c.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_160e3b0dfab25edf0cc32587a54c62c3.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_160e3b0dfab25edf0cc32587a54c62c3.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_e0a2be0c225e33e258bf29b2fb1d82d2.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_e0a2be0c225e33e258bf29b2fb1d82d2.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_63c9364223d799d408d7005efa266ebb.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_63c9364223d799d408d7005efa266ebb.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_81496387e093e88100ac65a577289bdf.translation: I have a message for you.

sense_81496387e093e88100ac65a577289bdf.translation: […] the teacher said with a little smile […]

sense_29915bca1d8b4d847e5ae9d8ec0a98ed.translation: We had quite a rain last night.

sense_a79a19c45a47e9f1cf6b63ecd20c4d8f.text: — Aqui me tem, prompto a luctar peito a peito contra o seu infortunio, e a vencêl-o.
sense_a79a19c45a47e9f1cf6b63ecd20c4d8f.translation: “Here you have me, ready to fight chest-to-chest against your misfortune, and to win against it.”

sense_74dc10dd136313a09786e265771cc2f6.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_feaea3c872aec098ea3126dbbb22e9d9.text: Minha mãe faz cada bolo que nem o espero esfriar.
sense_feaea3c872aec098ea3126dbbb22e9d9.translation: My mother makes such a cake that I don’t even wait for it to cool down.
You commit all sorts of crazy acts.

sense_b9a55830aa03753e40640220e229bbcb.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_b9a55830aa03753e40640220e229bbcb.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_b9a55830aa03753e40640220e229bbcb.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_b9a55830aa03753e40640220e229bbcb.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_09a4ad42a730b4301febe12270b4c65b.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_ebf39b85a99093dfdb167afe6fa80319.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.

sense_c624a7908b81c7fcd784df637f744eed.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_3833dad8affc488a5313bb48ee66105a.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_34358d0a1c4b1b2a16b71e58f08f782e.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_34358d0a1c4b1b2a16b71e58f08f782e.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_2b7111df7f3fa4748c98575167cc9480.text: Este é um documentário sério sobre os romanos.
sense_2b7111df7f3fa4748c98575167cc9480.translation: This is a serious documentary about the Romans.

sense_6d81e6536fc7cb830ca7fcc637fc7e7a.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_6d81e6536fc7cb830ca7fcc637fc7e7a.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_90916d2abf026e6a4f25929430dec4bb.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_90916d2abf026e6a4f25929430dec4bb.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_05bdeb6b296b9b8d5b192cf8d68e915b.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_42dfeeb1f8c040ba5e70c0b087d02ad0.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_42dfeeb1f8c040ba5e70c0b087d02ad0.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_94805f012c92f679f75321bceb044f5e.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_94805f012c92f679f75321bceb044f5e.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_8bced0be463b89c3e33bbf355d1f5381.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_8bced0be463b89c3e33bbf355d1f5381.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_1f7cf1478035ec136594c570eed838fd.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_1f7cf1478035ec136594c570eed838fd.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_1f7cf1478035ec136594c570eed838fd.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_1f7cf1478035ec136594c570eed838fd.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_5737550f8a9e724b49fbf63fdecc6cd7.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_5737550f8a9e724b49fbf63fdecc6cd7.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_5737550f8a9e724b49fbf63fdecc6cd7.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_5737550f8a9e724b49fbf63fdecc6cd7.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_2052cc756833948e6d3ab5b66115e0de.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_2052cc756833948e6d3ab5b66115e0de.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_05f3933d436ed1d9670c6c94172cb589.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_05f3933d436ed1d9670c6c94172cb589.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_33e9e634ccabe80400b9ede97f3c0937.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_33e9e634ccabe80400b9ede97f3c0937.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_33e9e634ccabe80400b9ede97f3c0937.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_33e9e634ccabe80400b9ede97f3c0937.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_33e9e634ccabe80400b9ede97f3c0937.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_33e9e634ccabe80400b9ede97f3c0937.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_4f0627391497832baf59890d26fda98c.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_4f0627391497832baf59890d26fda98c.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_4f0627391497832baf59890d26fda98c.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_4f0627391497832baf59890d26fda98c.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_62f0aa95cd6a207e30dca2691c9847fb.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_295559903a505997f7bd436db9a6d29b.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_295559903a505997f7bd436db9a6d29b.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_295559903a505997f7bd436db9a6d29b.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_295559903a505997f7bd436db9a6d29b.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_af15af0a3baadf1d2fe6d61c16a6ae07.text: Não é justo, são três contra um.
sense_af15af0a3baadf1d2fe6d61c16a6ae07.translation: It's not fair, it's three against/on one.

sense_af15af0a3baadf1d2fe6d61c16a6ae07.text: Tiveram que nadar contra a corrente.
sense_af15af0a3baadf1d2fe6d61c16a6ae07.translation: They had to swim against the current.

sense_f04e35e0b281ca7a3e06b64012787d06.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_f04e35e0b281ca7a3e06b64012787d06.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_634eb22fdacfe7d4245c633a9d60c765.text: Me dá outra cerveja, por favor.
Se não ficar satisfeito com o que ele lhe disser, procure outro acupunturista que use agulhas mais finas.
sense_634eb22fdacfe7d4245c633a9d60c765.translation: If you’re not satisfied with what he [the acupuncturist] tells you, look for another acupuncturist who utilizes thinner needles.

sense_004ac206775896036a93a00344e70d8a.text: Parar de invejar o sucesso do outro, de viver sempre tentando dar uma rasteira no nosso colega.
sense_004ac206775896036a93a00344e70d8a.translation: We should stop envying the other’s success, living always trying to pull the rug out from under our peers.

sense_5aa294d3e0c5533c638d676e25d4aba7.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_5aa294d3e0c5533c638d676e25d4aba7.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_b53e9e74263bf46c8868cff67c914a94.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_d10452b39631f415ea5aadd8b8f7272e.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_fe4510b65dc3182903e8c08de7503ff9.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_fe4510b65dc3182903e8c08de7503ff9.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_fe4510b65dc3182903e8c08de7503ff9.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_f8ac2c319b5482e22b6a69cdfc487cb7.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_f8ac2c319b5482e22b6a69cdfc487cb7.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_fbea71f5d1f5bc8aa3bf7e4bbd7b9f2d.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_fbea71f5d1f5bc8aa3bf7e4bbd7b9f2d.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_e4e1ad328c1ec022739bf36aa328f4b8.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_e4e1ad328c1ec022739bf36aa328f4b8.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_23b4464eec53d1441d2084ea1a0c3d8f.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_23b4464eec53d1441d2084ea1a0c3d8f.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_1014153b43f99d25b17fbee7819d6fe8.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_1014153b43f99d25b17fbee7819d6fe8.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_1014153b43f99d25b17fbee7819d6fe8.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_1014153b43f99d25b17fbee7819d6fe8.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_4f1cf45a27c7d13039f218afea2fd692.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_4f1cf45a27c7d13039f218afea2fd692.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_c3f7e18d7163828e909fbee222632640.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_3914c0dc42089af78689cc655edba79f.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_3914c0dc42089af78689cc655edba79f.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_bdc2517e3f91180fc7e2ad3dc4b1d862.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_bdc2517e3f91180fc7e2ad3dc4b1d862.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_bdc2517e3f91180fc7e2ad3dc4b1d862.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_bdc2517e3f91180fc7e2ad3dc4b1d862.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_46b33542424c37cc9a88b92e559b1ae9.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_46b33542424c37cc9a88b92e559b1ae9.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_46b33542424c37cc9a88b92e559b1ae9.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_46b33542424c37cc9a88b92e559b1ae9.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_1769d672c9beec881b42c548dac0ca2d.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_1769d672c9beec881b42c548dac0ca2d.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_1769d672c9beec881b42c548dac0ca2d.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_1769d672c9beec881b42c548dac0ca2d.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_5efca5f20fce27cea56416ba249d461b.text: Ela é a minha irmã mais nova.
Ele é demasiado novo para assistir isso.
sense_5efca5f20fce27cea56416ba249d461b.translation: He is too young to watch this.

sense_e84e3f5a055565dbd56327dc29794244.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_e84e3f5a055565dbd56327dc29794244.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_b6d55af0564040c6e36142af1772b01d.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_b6d55af0564040c6e36142af1772b01d.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_b6d55af0564040c6e36142af1772b01d.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_b6d55af0564040c6e36142af1772b01d.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_dcc82ac332b7a84ec29141e681722c16.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_dcc82ac332b7a84ec29141e681722c16.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_dcc82ac332b7a84ec29141e681722c16.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_dcc82ac332b7a84ec29141e681722c16.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_126850813619e4720a0735f24c46ca48.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_659b515ae861256bdedccabe965bde84.text: Não me importo que você venha.
sense_659b515ae861256bdedccabe965bde84.translation: I don't care whether you come.

sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.text: Tenho que devolver os meus livros pra biblioteca logo.
sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.translation: I have to take my books back to the library soon.

sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.text: O meu computador deu tela azul.
Ainda não recebi o meu dinheiro.
sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.translation: I still haven't received my money.

sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.text: O meu pai veio me visitar.
sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.translation: My father came to visit me.

sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.text: Retirei o meu obi, junto com Ootsuka, e o depositei sobre o capim baixo. Arrumei o meu kimono, que estava em farrapos, junto ao corpo e comecei a vestir a minha proteção.
sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.translation: I took off my obi, along with Ootsuka, and laid it on the low grass. I arranged my kimono, which was in tatters, next to my body and began to put on my protection.

sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.text: Liguei meu notebook para ver as mensagens do dia. Aos poucos eu estava voltando a responder os e-mails de meus leitores.
sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.translation: I turned on my laptop to check the day's messages. Little by little I was getting back to answering my readers' emails.

sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete, […]
sense_5df7efc6f33da436c14518b299284112.translation: […] opened the cupboard drawer, took out a safety pin, stopped in front of me, took the medal from my hand and bent down and put it in my vest, […]

sense_624f60ea81a4da858e99499ecb152e32.text: Desculpe, acho que dá mais medo se for meia-noite!
sense_624f60ea81a4da858e99499ecb152e32.translation: I'm sorry, I thought that it would be more fearsome if it were midnight!

sense_15c54be66118ecb867888061413cde4d.text: Enquanto vocês assistiam o filme, eu estudei.
sense_15c54be66118ecb867888061413cde4d.translation: While you were watching the film, I was studying.

sense_15c54be66118ecb867888061413cde4d.text: Então continuaram a estudar enquanto o céu lá fora se tornava gradualmente mais escuro.
sense_15c54be66118ecb867888061413cde4d.translation: Then they continued to study while the sky outside was becoming gradually darker.

sense_9b0bf5dd8bc3fceff1cd11ffa048e96a.text: Vocês querem vadiar enquanto nós queremos trabalhar.
sense_9b0bf5dd8bc3fceff1cd11ffa048e96a.translation: You want to idle while we want to work.

sense_9b0bf5dd8bc3fceff1cd11ffa048e96a.text: Enquanto eles são violentos e perigosos, nós somos pacíficos e amigáveis.
sense_9b0bf5dd8bc3fceff1cd11ffa048e96a.translation: While they are violent and dangerous, we are peaceful and friendly.

sense_851768a1106c1dad665805823ba2669d.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_851768a1106c1dad665805823ba2669d.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_1fd4c0a7bfb5b59e19d9ace7e33f06f6.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_0cee2067ef9687a23576b0b35dcefaa9.text: Luiza amava, e amava com o primeiro e grande affecto de quinze annos.
sense_0cee2067ef9687a23576b0b35dcefaa9.translation: Luiza was in love, and she loved with the first and profound affection of a fifteen-year-old.

sense_0cee2067ef9687a23576b0b35dcefaa9.text: Rony ralhou com um aluno do primeiro ano particularmente pequeno [...]
sense_0cee2067ef9687a23576b0b35dcefaa9.translation: Ron scolded a first-year student particularly small …

sense_e7a775b966985aa117f6e5f90e05644a.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_e7a775b966985aa117f6e5f90e05644a.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_8a5c77c87a90f186704cb0de0065a16e.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_8a5c77c87a90f186704cb0de0065a16e.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_8a5c77c87a90f186704cb0de0065a16e.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_8a5c77c87a90f186704cb0de0065a16e.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_86b471070ddd551ef794412806f59792.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_86b471070ddd551ef794412806f59792.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_86b471070ddd551ef794412806f59792.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_86b471070ddd551ef794412806f59792.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_75da988da195a53dc1d174e0f980ea59.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_75da988da195a53dc1d174e0f980ea59.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_32ab2f1140fac1166395317eb0112295.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_32ab2f1140fac1166395317eb0112295.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_8642271b6575f63f12427e9cd7ada86c.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_8642271b6575f63f12427e9cd7ada86c.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_68dc483131f4c07acee84c08cfe58600.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_68dc483131f4c07acee84c08cfe58600.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_68dc483131f4c07acee84c08cfe58600.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_68dc483131f4c07acee84c08cfe58600.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_65e31ae50e58a57fb762bc3f51cd7822.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_65e31ae50e58a57fb762bc3f51cd7822.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_65e31ae50e58a57fb762bc3f51cd7822.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_65e31ae50e58a57fb762bc3f51cd7822.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_72d37ca53a02186401f741c6052c739d.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_72d37ca53a02186401f741c6052c739d.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_07583ea151ac586d014232be63353c59.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_07583ea151ac586d014232be63353c59.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_2ab858cfc2468d1a10354cc8070757d1.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_78ea4bfd5ae13d9e923e1371cafaf784.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_8d94f4e83e93d9e7c1ac7087ccb4e9e6.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_f41bb60dd16148dfa6e6b9eef14a9cf9.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_f41bb60dd16148dfa6e6b9eef14a9cf9.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_f41bb60dd16148dfa6e6b9eef14a9cf9.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_f41bb60dd16148dfa6e6b9eef14a9cf9.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_f41bb60dd16148dfa6e6b9eef14a9cf9.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_f41bb60dd16148dfa6e6b9eef14a9cf9.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_d0af6330cbee37224ddbe6a0f0e00af8.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_d0af6330cbee37224ddbe6a0f0e00af8.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_d0af6330cbee37224ddbe6a0f0e00af8.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_d0af6330cbee37224ddbe6a0f0e00af8.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_a2a10ffb6c6b0d58d825c496c38886c6.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_3e0d1576f05f6309f11d00c84c355c9f.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_1de92a588fc7fd35922198245848e703.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_1de92a588fc7fd35922198245848e703.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_1de92a588fc7fd35922198245848e703.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_1de92a588fc7fd35922198245848e703.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_0ee984e88e35e31e463f3272d2bdf5e7.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_0ee984e88e35e31e463f3272d2bdf5e7.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_0ee984e88e35e31e463f3272d2bdf5e7.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_2c92bb74bc7b7326f8c29c04044e9e0f.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_faa095a6549b954147d0f2c9e2f6b5fc.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_faa095a6549b954147d0f2c9e2f6b5fc.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_bf05a9852eece78dbebcfa7db6743d81.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.

sense_b3d21533ac36c0dbe29833eaf2a94549.text: […] já que estamos falando de números, talvez a questão do bug do milênio não seja só uma mudança do número dos nossos computadores que vai dar um tilt geral na humanidade.
sense_b3d21533ac36c0dbe29833eaf2a94549.translation: […] while we're on the subject of numbers, perhaps the millennium bug isn't just a change in the number of our computers that will give humanity a general tilt.

sense_b3d21533ac36c0dbe29833eaf2a94549.text: Nós devíamos baixar a cabeça, baixar o topete. E fazer honestamente o nosso trabalho. Parar de invejar o sucesso do outro, de viver sempre tentando dar uma rasteira no nosso colega.

sense_084f82c46f571c18ad86cc42b74f7a16.translation: This bridge doesn’t look very safe.

sense_084f82c46f571c18ad86cc42b74f7a16.text: Não te preocupes, voar é seguro.

sense_e0a5d2a42050339a9aad9cc6be8600a6.translation: I have a message for you.

sense_e0a5d2a42050339a9aad9cc6be8600a6.translation: […] the teacher said with a little smile […]

sense_17bedbb4ac643fae0b01d892b8484325.text: Ontem de noite caiu uma chuva.
sense_17bedbb4ac643fae0b01d892b8484325.translation: We had quite a rain last night.

sense_c0419e496c409dce7e13519c960496dd.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_c0419e496c409dce7e13519c960496dd.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_8a3e227f44c65e8cf998adecbd1c6bc6.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_8a3e227f44c65e8cf998adecbd1c6bc6.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_8a3e227f44c65e8cf998adecbd1c6bc6.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_8a3e227f44c65e8cf998adecbd1c6bc6.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_fc696b9e7f1d7044bdf8d92aee481167.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_fc696b9e7f1d7044bdf8d92aee481167.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_eb9456d8ba57ce82107f6a3bcbe47320.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_3295fe400c4ccf5be4ce3f0ede919cdc.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_3295fe400c4ccf5be4ce3f0ede919cdc.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_c68f869cd0851379989a8b80149c2f36.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_8d0ef90422c972ca4441c9eb19465f77.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_8d0ef90422c972ca4441c9eb19465f77.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_7a78a7b1d962bbfd067bfe325e372b52.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_7a78a7b1d962bbfd067bfe325e372b52.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_a31644145ac33a479392b76e1383fcc9.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_a92bb8c19fd2f27ad8866afba38c3c8a.text: Acalme seus filhos, senão expulso vocês da loja.
sense_a92bb8c19fd2f27ad8866afba38c3c8a.translation: Calm your children down or I will throw you out of the store.

sense_a92bb8c19fd2f27ad8866afba38c3c8a.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_a92bb8c19fd2f27ad8866afba38c3c8a.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_0295102db69a3edf8bd8f465feb7d565.text: Depois da tempestade, o mar se acalmou.
sense_0295102db69a3edf8bd8f465feb7d565.translation: After the storm, the sea calmed down.
The noise of the leaves calmed down.

sense_21e805b9e092049e664a74be2ea90c3d.text: Ainda não recebeste o teu dinheiro?
sense_21e805b9e092049e664a74be2ea90c3d.translation: Haven't you received your money yet?

sense_21e805b9e092049e664a74be2ea90c3d.text: O teu computador deu tela azul.
O teu pai veio te visitar.
sense_21e805b9e092049e664a74be2ea90c3d.translation: Your father came to visit you.

sense_21e805b9e092049e664a74be2ea90c3d.text: Tu tem que devolver o teu livro pra biblioteca logo, cara.
sense_21e805b9e092049e664a74be2ea90c3d.translation: You gotta take your book back to the library soon, man.

sense_3193b1ef8766d5c9fec2ce50e49ba96d.text: O teu é suficiente para sobreviver?
A casa em si é tua, mas o terreno é meu.
sense_3193b1ef8766d5c9fec2ce50e49ba96d.translation: The house itself is yours, but the land is mine.

sense_3193b1ef8766d5c9fec2ce50e49ba96d.text: Tua por só uma semana, o quadro já parece um velho amigo.
sense_3193b1ef8766d5c9fec2ce50e49ba96d.translation: Yours for only a week so far, the painting already feels like an old friend.

sense_298ffc2b932d19530ed678996e001b8b.text: E à mulher disse: Multiplicarei grandemente a tua dor e a tua conceição; com dor terás filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará.
sense_298ffc2b932d19530ed678996e001b8b.translation: And to the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt have children; and thy desire shall be for thy husband, and he shall rule over thee."

sense_298ffc2b932d19530ed678996e001b8b.text: Honra ao Senhor com a tua fazenda e com as primícias de toda a tua renda; e se encherão os teus celeiros abundantemente, e trasbordarão de mosto os teus lagares.
sense_298ffc2b932d19530ed678996e001b8b.translation: Honor the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine income; and thy barns shall be filled with plenty, and thy winepresses shall overflow with new wine.

sense_298ffc2b932d19530ed678996e001b8b.text: Eu conheço as tuas obras, e o teu amor, e o teu serviço, e a tua fé, e a tua paciência, e que as tuas últimas obras são mais do que as primeiras.
sense_298ffc2b932d19530ed678996e001b8b.translation: I know thy works, and thy love, and thy service, and thy faith, and thy patience, and that thy latter works are more than thy former.

sense_56d8fcf6fdb88fc2d3e00a9a9753cecb.translation: You only talk with your relatives.

sense_cfad7d6ea20eda45f9efe25d2d192df0.text: Este livro é maior do que aquele.
sense_cfad7d6ea20eda45f9efe25d2d192df0.translation: This book is bigger than that one.

sense_ffc1b4b4530abf9ea832d781a07ef001.text: O Grande Porto é uma região metropolitana no norte de Portugal.
sense_ffc1b4b4530abf9ea832d781a07ef001.translation: Greater Porto is a metropolitan area in the north of Portugal.
I live in the metropolis of Lisbon.

sense_ed0a418fc1cb308b6e526068bd3f47d6.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_ed0a418fc1cb308b6e526068bd3f47d6.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_17d82067504d3437ad0d5dc7709dfc16.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_17d82067504d3437ad0d5dc7709dfc16.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_e9c45fe6136a7d0427182da0e5c671ad.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_e9c45fe6136a7d0427182da0e5c671ad.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_615bc1e4cdff15f7eaf9bde166d48028.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_615bc1e4cdff15f7eaf9bde166d48028.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_615bc1e4cdff15f7eaf9bde166d48028.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_615bc1e4cdff15f7eaf9bde166d48028.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_615bc1e4cdff15f7eaf9bde166d48028.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_615bc1e4cdff15f7eaf9bde166d48028.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_7a8212743a17bd06e768f5407865eedd.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_7a8212743a17bd06e768f5407865eedd.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_7a8212743a17bd06e768f5407865eedd.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_7a8212743a17bd06e768f5407865eedd.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_6e9cede4f7471dfe52f08b56b26bb1f4.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_6e9cede4f7471dfe52f08b56b26bb1f4.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_6e9cede4f7471dfe52f08b56b26bb1f4.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_6e9cede4f7471dfe52f08b56b26bb1f4.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_85faacd8ad38d09c19a6d13fc7179993.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_85faacd8ad38d09c19a6d13fc7179993.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_c5a995c218b9c2dcb046aff74b6a6797.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_c5a995c218b9c2dcb046aff74b6a6797.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_c5a995c218b9c2dcb046aff74b6a6797.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_c5a995c218b9c2dcb046aff74b6a6797.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_ca8511dc0813c3e4a66398231fa04f5d.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_ca8511dc0813c3e4a66398231fa04f5d.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_01435be8313bd91c0a04bf86146ce967.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_01435be8313bd91c0a04bf86146ce967.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_88081c693814e269c66ea81c1f873525.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_88081c693814e269c66ea81c1f873525.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_88081c693814e269c66ea81c1f873525.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_88081c693814e269c66ea81c1f873525.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_9e118bcf3f8b0402ef0e46a7b03af6bc.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_9e118bcf3f8b0402ef0e46a7b03af6bc.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_72a8a93fc39e19890e4220daeb65bd1f.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_72a8a93fc39e19890e4220daeb65bd1f.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_c7228bfdeee49909d4f75a1473532e76.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_c7228bfdeee49909d4f75a1473532e76.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_17b76c809a65cb9aede542f37a2dc664.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_17b76c809a65cb9aede542f37a2dc664.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_02e24c2eea0209feaa92e28ec25c9461.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_02e24c2eea0209feaa92e28ec25c9461.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_02e24c2eea0209feaa92e28ec25c9461.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_02e24c2eea0209feaa92e28ec25c9461.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_d3e31e86bb17054464277765cd3c2f5b.literal_meaning: The woman [as such] has the right to vote.
sense_d3e31e86bb17054464277765cd3c2f5b.text: A mulher tem o direito a votar.

sense_416e437a99919275cc535a82aa1a2360.text: A mulher do João está ali.
Depois de saber disso, eu disse à minha esposa, "Vem cá, mulher."
sense_416e437a99919275cc535a82aa1a2360.translation: After knowing of that, I said to my wife, "Come here, woman."

sense_0516fa54ad3fe1d654b658e19bd59ce4.text: Aprendi bastante coisa com esse curso!
sense_0516fa54ad3fe1d654b658e19bd59ce4.translation: I've learned a ton of things from that course!
A large number of trucks arrived at the location.
There was a lot of food at the party.

sense_f9057722722d46e92465f75a85094b24.text: Estas grades de ferro estão aqui para nossa segurança.
sense_f9057722722d46e92465f75a85094b24.translation: These iron bars are here for our safety.

sense_f9057722722d46e92465f75a85094b24.text: A segurança está cem vezes mais rigorosa este verão.
sense_f9057722722d46e92465f75a85094b24.translation: The security is a hundred times more severe this summer.

sense_c3257a000b60cb19553da5f4d8ee149d.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_c3257a000b60cb19553da5f4d8ee149d.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_c3257a000b60cb19553da5f4d8ee149d.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_c3257a000b60cb19553da5f4d8ee149d.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_93b3a4150d9e5a061ef7a355508d7782.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_93b3a4150d9e5a061ef7a355508d7782.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_93b3a4150d9e5a061ef7a355508d7782.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_93b3a4150d9e5a061ef7a355508d7782.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_194f48ff6451d96510f48798f5dde39b.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_fe0e52ebe0dd5653f316b7b637f3d548.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_fe0e52ebe0dd5653f316b7b637f3d548.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_fe0e52ebe0dd5653f316b7b637f3d548.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_fe0e52ebe0dd5653f316b7b637f3d548.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_c58795c4b9e7ce536592526194e81954.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_c58795c4b9e7ce536592526194e81954.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_f01f9f4738307cc3c9a8effaef4091bc.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_b64315f8817e6b2159fb73b5cef749ca.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_b64315f8817e6b2159fb73b5cef749ca.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_b64315f8817e6b2159fb73b5cef749ca.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_b64315f8817e6b2159fb73b5cef749ca.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_b64315f8817e6b2159fb73b5cef749ca.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_b64315f8817e6b2159fb73b5cef749ca.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_438667e05e290e302fd01dcee545404b.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_f773f57b83ea6864906267389f29146d.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_f773f57b83ea6864906267389f29146d.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_e0e4da2f635a9da431b18b320426cf9d.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_e0e4da2f635a9da431b18b320426cf9d.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_e0e4da2f635a9da431b18b320426cf9d.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_e0e4da2f635a9da431b18b320426cf9d.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_e0e4da2f635a9da431b18b320426cf9d.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_e0e4da2f635a9da431b18b320426cf9d.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_c6819049470b1d11fff5e51b8554bc2d.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_cf66e3d4ad849347d4469c51bc168877.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_cf66e3d4ad849347d4469c51bc168877.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_1b1171fd7c2a5337f9f4df818da53502.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_1b1171fd7c2a5337f9f4df818da53502.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.

sense_5eecea51bb93191e39ee1745b5ca45ab.translation: It is not permitted to leave the king under check.

sense_01d66410e09201b2b9f6e08b56cf3e7b.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_01d66410e09201b2b9f6e08b56cf3e7b.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_01d66410e09201b2b9f6e08b56cf3e7b.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_01d66410e09201b2b9f6e08b56cf3e7b.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_30c6bfb53852cc946eaf48a2d967559f.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_30c6bfb53852cc946eaf48a2d967559f.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_a25f79fe5344eb0040a5c7515467f495.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_9efd7429ecdecbf92504b9a0092e913a.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_9efd7429ecdecbf92504b9a0092e913a.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_9efd7429ecdecbf92504b9a0092e913a.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_9efd7429ecdecbf92504b9a0092e913a.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_9efd7429ecdecbf92504b9a0092e913a.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_9efd7429ecdecbf92504b9a0092e913a.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_b24c18c75e74201c961c87ef2b42775c.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_b24c18c75e74201c961c87ef2b42775c.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_b24c18c75e74201c961c87ef2b42775c.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_b24c18c75e74201c961c87ef2b42775c.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_e9cb4a6b55c82643af50b3f3cd54c8e1.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_0e5ea553469da93f23b1aebcc864b64f.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_0e5ea553469da93f23b1aebcc864b64f.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_7e0fd84825ca48cae7ccbff62947a6c0.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_7e0fd84825ca48cae7ccbff62947a6c0.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_7e0fd84825ca48cae7ccbff62947a6c0.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_7e0fd84825ca48cae7ccbff62947a6c0.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_6a784d0a819e4fcde3d205ad632878ee.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_6a784d0a819e4fcde3d205ad632878ee.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_64f59a3b6be3ea6ce1e3168ec4e3e4cb.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_c80698b1c91480206d924b0ab39d1e0a.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_56c8f4e81710612779c4b8d965165686.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_f22c19f1f432781dadb4c030bddf480d.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_6ce65663feb7a5bb0a854f98daba9948.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_6ce65663feb7a5bb0a854f98daba9948.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_fe0adc71cd500487303dcd953655ac3e.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_ec161eb676ef8bbfd673f872a8ce8eeb.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_ec161eb676ef8bbfd673f872a8ce8eeb.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_4c68434c219a03ad1a60389cce86fe8f.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_4c68434c219a03ad1a60389cce86fe8f.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_4c68434c219a03ad1a60389cce86fe8f.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_4c68434c219a03ad1a60389cce86fe8f.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_c9195b0b2c5ea8e80ca7ca0674e8a98f.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_ad77dbc9d0507fe1784d22cabd64f9f2.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_42cb1fd9c05e4d11cf3c9b981fee34a1.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_42cb1fd9c05e4d11cf3c9b981fee34a1.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_4e84464e0c749f17124e50c9986813d5.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_4e84464e0c749f17124e50c9986813d5.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_46429791452bfe571804621c710f411a.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_b2801a7197aa2bf4329f9a8b0605d8b2.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_b2801a7197aa2bf4329f9a8b0605d8b2.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_a92657f01722bd43f1093a96d64343b9.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_df9520a9936b6a4157241203dcff00c4.text:
E o mundo tem sido pequeno demais pra nós, pra nós
E a vida tem dado conquistas demais pra nós
sense_df9520a9936b6a4157241203dcff00c4.translation:
And the world has been too small for us, for us
And life has given too many achievements to us

sense_684ec193bb97bd88ad6d299ce735c5a1.text:
E o mundo tem sido pequeno demais pra nós, pra nós
E a vida tem dado conquistas demais pra nós
sense_684ec193bb97bd88ad6d299ce735c5a1.translation:
And the world has been too small for us, for us
And life has given too many achievements to us

sense_408b4cc118ff81982a7a40cfcefea78e.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_408b4cc118ff81982a7a40cfcefea78e.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_f66c55af6b16617246333c3c00b769ba.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_f66c55af6b16617246333c3c00b769ba.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_f66c55af6b16617246333c3c00b769ba.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_f66c55af6b16617246333c3c00b769ba.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_f5c91f08538ccda8c688f0f23061a5e7.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_f5c91f08538ccda8c688f0f23061a5e7.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_f5c91f08538ccda8c688f0f23061a5e7.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_6c2eeff22119339609422377a4bd5e4f.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_be18cb9fab71906b5c007166391cfd48.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_be18cb9fab71906b5c007166391cfd48.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_174ea8497b1ab8b89122364f5bc662d9.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_174ea8497b1ab8b89122364f5bc662d9.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_2a68fe8b2f38a3d3d544618770043627.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_33f2f4847bace92af30fbe7e2ba17964.text: Não conseguiria nunca extender os ossos numa cama, o unico desejo que tinha.
sense_33f2f4847bace92af30fbe7e2ba17964.translation: She would never be able to stretch her bones on a bed, her only wish.

sense_76f7922a82e5144090c25097ef510423.text: Nota-se a falta de problemas sociais nesta região.
sense_76f7922a82e5144090c25097ef510423.translation: One can notice the lack of social issues in this region.
I fainted due to lack of water.

sense_2eecd269c53baea5ad8392aea2763212.text: O goleiro teve que cometer uma falta para evitar o gol.
sense_2eecd269c53baea5ad8392aea2763212.translation: The goalkeeper had to commit a foul to avoid the goal.

sense_c9d4f73142dacdc15b60be959b301e26.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_c9d4f73142dacdc15b60be959b301e26.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_db0038ec4045d5659bd7a110780cc69f.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_db0038ec4045d5659bd7a110780cc69f.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_db0038ec4045d5659bd7a110780cc69f.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_db0038ec4045d5659bd7a110780cc69f.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_413e8449e61a24591f3a1906c6a33711.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_413e8449e61a24591f3a1906c6a33711.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_413e8449e61a24591f3a1906c6a33711.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_413e8449e61a24591f3a1906c6a33711.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_30283b6926f67123f13c272119007eeb.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_30283b6926f67123f13c272119007eeb.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_30283b6926f67123f13c272119007eeb.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_b92f20f20d7a4c669cb57ea7dfd70fb2.literal_meaning: I stranged your behavior a lot.
sense_b92f20f20d7a4c669cb57ea7dfd70fb2.translation: I found your behaviour very strange.

sense_b92f20f20d7a4c669cb57ea7dfd70fb2.text: — O jury? extranhei. O senhor também. Está visto. O senhor appellou?
sense_b92f20f20d7a4c669cb57ea7dfd70fb2.translation: “The jury? I found it strange. You did too, sir. It’s clear. Did you appeal?”

sense_90386e2f2c740aa91d18e878848f65c1.text: No ano passado li três livros.
sense_90386e2f2c740aa91d18e878848f65c1.translation: I read three books in the previous year.
I read three books last year.

sense_19a132dc15237e114e5b9550aea8cfa8.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_19a132dc15237e114e5b9550aea8cfa8.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_ab1c7e0f9509ebe2ae15ec79162cc30a.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_ab1c7e0f9509ebe2ae15ec79162cc30a.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_ab1c7e0f9509ebe2ae15ec79162cc30a.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_ab1c7e0f9509ebe2ae15ec79162cc30a.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_8d107531877aab23a6a624a93d9d6d21.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_8d107531877aab23a6a624a93d9d6d21.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_8d107531877aab23a6a624a93d9d6d21.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_8d107531877aab23a6a624a93d9d6d21.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_65cb499ad09ceafc35622cc9acadeefa.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_65cb499ad09ceafc35622cc9acadeefa.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_68f6b1362ca842a69b8ada9217fc2d8d.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_68f6b1362ca842a69b8ada9217fc2d8d.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_9d1a43bed6be8edc768e213d57011384.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_9d1a43bed6be8edc768e213d57011384.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_373ee0a754508c152932a30be79eafcc.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_373ee0a754508c152932a30be79eafcc.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_da503c67f6921f5228f54d42b3b7d287.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_da503c67f6921f5228f54d42b3b7d287.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_2108bb6722bfeefe7327361040db4ffd.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_2108bb6722bfeefe7327361040db4ffd.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_3603e3093e8d8de7da50d02e4a436316.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_218744881722211b52813e3551d71261.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_948aafb20936bb9dc4320057c246fe7d.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_948aafb20936bb9dc4320057c246fe7d.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_948aafb20936bb9dc4320057c246fe7d.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_948aafb20936bb9dc4320057c246fe7d.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_948aafb20936bb9dc4320057c246fe7d.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_948aafb20936bb9dc4320057c246fe7d.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_be964f2c4214c45d1d8732fb099813b5.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_be964f2c4214c45d1d8732fb099813b5.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_be964f2c4214c45d1d8732fb099813b5.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_be964f2c4214c45d1d8732fb099813b5.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_47242e2c08b989d19cddb8a8e95e7531.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_1c5f48b70587e1c46b7cac730854b8e4.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_1c5f48b70587e1c46b7cac730854b8e4.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_1c5f48b70587e1c46b7cac730854b8e4.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_1c5f48b70587e1c46b7cac730854b8e4.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_cd6713a964c1cc6d7be06aed044faf17.text: A gente deve tentar salvar o nosso casamento pro bem dos nossos filhos.
sense_cd6713a964c1cc6d7be06aed044faf17.translation: We must try to save our marriage for the sake of our children.

sense_cd6713a964c1cc6d7be06aed044faf17.text: […] já que estamos falando de números, talvez a questão do bug do milênio não seja só uma mudança do número dos nossos computadores que vai dar um tilt geral na humanidade.
sense_cd6713a964c1cc6d7be06aed044faf17.translation: […] while we're on the subject of numbers, perhaps the millennium bug isn't just a change in the number of our computers that will give humanity a general tilt.

sense_cd6713a964c1cc6d7be06aed044faf17.text: Nós devíamos baixar a cabeça, baixar o topete. E fazer honestamente o nosso trabalho. Parar de invejar o sucesso do outro, de viver sempre tentando dar uma rasteira no nosso colega.
sense_cd6713a964c1cc6d7be06aed044faf17.translation: We should suck it up, humble ourselves, do our job honestly, stop envying each other's success, and stop always trying to get the better of our colleagues.

sense_c244013491bd8f67daaef68c351007fa.text: Evite respirar pela boca enquanto corre
sense_c244013491bd8f67daaef68c351007fa.translation: Avoid breathing by the mouth when running

sense_c244013491bd8f67daaef68c351007fa.text: Ah! é que umas são a ignorancia na sua perfeição mais divina, outras guardam na bocca o gosto amargo de todos os fructos vedados que teem devorado!
sense_c244013491bd8f67daaef68c351007fa.translation: Ah! It is that some embody ignorance in its most divine perfection, while others carry in their mouth the bitter taste of all the forbidden fruits they have devoured!

sense_895079037b513efe79a18ca7c30f1cdf.text: Me dá outra cerveja, por favor.
Se não ficar satisfeito com o que ele lhe disser, procure outro acupunturista que use agulhas mais finas.
sense_895079037b513efe79a18ca7c30f1cdf.translation: If you’re not satisfied with what he [the acupuncturist] tells you, look for another acupuncturist who utilizes thinner needles.

sense_e1b21d52b7c42b87ab39e1130aa6c4bd.text: Parar de invejar o sucesso do outro, de viver sempre tentando dar uma rasteira no nosso colega.
sense_e1b21d52b7c42b87ab39e1130aa6c4bd.translation: We should stop envying the other’s success, living always trying to pull the rug out from under our peers.

sense_662a0ec7538146764c134e0c7c66c3c9.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.
