sense_d4ff949e6e19bfe80a99e5867af418c0.text: Não pude ir lá porque estava uma puta tempestade.
sense_d4ff949e6e19bfe80a99e5867af418c0.translation: I could not go there, because there was a huge fucking storm.

sense_1ca603fae653fcff3d49b7e2dd5664c6.text: Minha mãe ficou puta com a situação.
sense_1ca603fae653fcff3d49b7e2dd5664c6.translation: My mom became angry with the situation.

sense_cf011dbde8a25e14d1b30cd7c89ac896.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_cf011dbde8a25e14d1b30cd7c89ac896.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_1ed36d9958ea269dee6d266f80dc5cef.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_3e839fc816abd6e1ab33c385faaccc31.translation: We are in a mountainous land.

sense_97b3714d13e5b43e07b6e4d748174a87.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_97b3714d13e5b43e07b6e4d748174a87.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_97b3714d13e5b43e07b6e4d748174a87.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_97b3714d13e5b43e07b6e4d748174a87.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_ce77ac2dea44887f9dcb4723609a8c51.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_ce77ac2dea44887f9dcb4723609a8c51.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_cb9d526303062884ad8a83e3d09bc887.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_cb9d526303062884ad8a83e3d09bc887.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_cb9d526303062884ad8a83e3d09bc887.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_cb9d526303062884ad8a83e3d09bc887.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_48f143b4bc8b83bf7b9e1e09e2658b01.text: Devolvam os vossos livros para a biblioteca agora!
sense_48f143b4bc8b83bf7b9e1e09e2658b01.translation: Take your books back to the library now!

sense_48f143b4bc8b83bf7b9e1e09e2658b01.text: Vocês não receberam as vossas indenizações?
sense_48f143b4bc8b83bf7b9e1e09e2658b01.translation: Haven't you guys received your compensation?
Your parents are going to come here.

sense_48f143b4bc8b83bf7b9e1e09e2658b01.text: Vós todos estais hoje perante o Senhor, vosso Deus: os cabeças de vossas tribos, vossos anciãos, os vossos oficiais, todo o homem de Israel, os vossos meninos, as vossas mulheres e o estrangeiro que está no meio do teu arraial; desde o rachador da tua lenha até ao tirador da tua água;
sense_48f143b4bc8b83bf7b9e1e09e2658b01.translation: All of you stand today before the Lord, your God: the leaders of your tribes, your elders, your officers, every man of Israel, your children, your wives, and the foreigner who is in the midst of thy camp; from the cutter of thy wood to the drawer of thy water;

sense_34db0ee9a622083e8350cd1a8961f08e.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_34db0ee9a622083e8350cd1a8961f08e.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_34db0ee9a622083e8350cd1a8961f08e.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_34db0ee9a622083e8350cd1a8961f08e.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_46f2c166bcf65c58424e0385377a2768.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_46f2c166bcf65c58424e0385377a2768.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_6e4f81126385476313ee3cfd1fd9e746.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_6e4f81126385476313ee3cfd1fd9e746.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_6e4f81126385476313ee3cfd1fd9e746.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_6e4f81126385476313ee3cfd1fd9e746.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: Em scismar — sósinho — á noite — / Mais prazer encontro eu lá; / Minha terra tem palmeiras, / Onde canta o Sabiá.
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: When ruminating — alone — at night — / I find more pleasure there; / My land has palm trees, / where the Thrush sings.

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: O marquez tinha ido sósinho para França. Fôra, ao que se dizia, buscar a filha ao Sacré-Cœur.
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: The marquess had gone to France alone. He’d gone, supposedly, to fetch his daughter from the Sacré-Cœur.

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: — Ai! volto, volto... Não posso deixar sózinha a mãe do meu homem, que tem oitenta annos e está entrevada.
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: “Oh! I’ll go back, yes... I can’t leave my man’s mother, who’s eighty years old and paralysed, by herself.

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: No momento actual, não era possivel ao Brasil vencer sosinho as suas difficuldades financeiras, nem lhe será possivel.
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: Currently, it was not possible for Brazil to overcome its financial difficulties by itself, nor will it be possible.

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: Impossivel dar cabo daquella praga. Estirou os olhos pela campina, achou-se isolado. Sózinho num mundo coberto de pennas, de aves queriam comel-o.
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: It was impossible to put an end to that pest. He looked over the plains, found himself isolated. Alone in a world covered in feathers, in birds that sought to eat him.

sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.text: Uma canção dizendo tudo a ela / Que ainda estou sozinho, apaixonado
sense_ab9292075334e6c232f1e617502dd3c2.translation: A song telling her everything / That I’m still lonely, in love

sense_a7017d21f7a39f0f620010675925acb1.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_a7017d21f7a39f0f620010675925acb1.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_918019273da69f539f567da00d3541ab.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_918019273da69f539f567da00d3541ab.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_918019273da69f539f567da00d3541ab.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_918019273da69f539f567da00d3541ab.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_7425eafde999abb6f169645a14970d40.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_7425eafde999abb6f169645a14970d40.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_aab7e681a86a031af92733236c2ff80a.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_aab7e681a86a031af92733236c2ff80a.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_aab7e681a86a031af92733236c2ff80a.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_aab7e681a86a031af92733236c2ff80a.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_88dd3365879817c1010051257c021b9f.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_88dd3365879817c1010051257c021b9f.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_7d1ff29014671a18b7362e75b6826921.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_7d1ff29014671a18b7362e75b6826921.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_97f86a11b5a0b28fdb79946b60e3c78f.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_97f86a11b5a0b28fdb79946b60e3c78f.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_6834e72f8c60a02df916f661cf046874.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_6834e72f8c60a02df916f661cf046874.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_6834e72f8c60a02df916f661cf046874.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_6834e72f8c60a02df916f661cf046874.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_0407fa73699387ce3dfd602ead160168.text: A criança aprendeu a não colocar a mão no fogo da maneira mais difícil.
sense_0407fa73699387ce3dfd602ead160168.translation: The child learned not to put his hand in the fire the hard way.

sense_0407fa73699387ce3dfd602ead160168.text: 1607, Luís Vaz de Camões, Rimas, Amor é fogo que arde sem se ver
sense_0407fa73699387ce3dfd602ead160168.translation: Love is a fire that burns without being seen

sense_f94d456d741e1c03fe645504ad05d68c.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_f94d456d741e1c03fe645504ad05d68c.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_f94d456d741e1c03fe645504ad05d68c.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_f94d456d741e1c03fe645504ad05d68c.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_7bb56a65af8d934bc31446e2f1bca9f6.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_7bb56a65af8d934bc31446e2f1bca9f6.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_7bb56a65af8d934bc31446e2f1bca9f6.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_7bb56a65af8d934bc31446e2f1bca9f6.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_e751bbc95a5dfd09ab5589f587577978.text: Eu farei de tudo por uma cópia deste livro.
sense_e751bbc95a5dfd09ab5589f587577978.translation: I will do anything for a copy of this book.

sense_4aff5acce4e962b22afb049ec194bf9c.text: Não toques no pelo de uma urtiga.

sense_cec3483fb4846cf96ee7c1be029d278b.text: O preço de um prato nos mercados daqui é por vinte euros.
sense_cec3483fb4846cf96ee7c1be029d278b.translation: The price of a plate in the local markets is around twenty euros.

sense_6ac9c54ec88afac52d9e79af911cdd5e.text: O tesouro foi encontrado por Dudinka.
sense_6ac9c54ec88afac52d9e79af911cdd5e.translation: The treasure was found around Dudinka.

sense_c657c39a37cd99b17b5ba13999aeda83.text: Ainda passaríamos por muitos túneis antes de chegarmos.
sense_c657c39a37cd99b17b5ba13999aeda83.translation: We would still pass through many tunnels before we arrived.

sense_94662fb9d9c62732d239b49823ff326a.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_94662fb9d9c62732d239b49823ff326a.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_94662fb9d9c62732d239b49823ff326a.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_94662fb9d9c62732d239b49823ff326a.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_b79f312a6652d87aa54a96e03663d85d.translation: Doctor, is it a boy or a girl?

sense_b79f312a6652d87aa54a96e03663d85d.text: Ela é minha menina / E eu sou o menino dela / Ela é o meu amor / E eu sou o amor todinho dela
sense_b79f312a6652d87aa54a96e03663d85d.translation: She is my girl / And I am her boy / She is my love / And I am her whole love.

sense_237788e1683d49d4fcb3ff029ca1f721.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_237788e1683d49d4fcb3ff029ca1f721.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_237788e1683d49d4fcb3ff029ca1f721.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_237788e1683d49d4fcb3ff029ca1f721.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_7d42c3b088cc50264f5b6bde6ec2d96b.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_7d42c3b088cc50264f5b6bde6ec2d96b.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_7d42c3b088cc50264f5b6bde6ec2d96b.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_7d42c3b088cc50264f5b6bde6ec2d96b.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_411ce65280e501353a231b2cdd3bf92c.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_411ce65280e501353a231b2cdd3bf92c.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_411ce65280e501353a231b2cdd3bf92c.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_411ce65280e501353a231b2cdd3bf92c.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_47c7ef678047e49813da137bf9d9bf6f.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_47c7ef678047e49813da137bf9d9bf6f.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_6994fea9db0102f3bc24420f4418c68a.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_6994fea9db0102f3bc24420f4418c68a.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_d4d669866f4eb9017e67352d72ced17c.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_bd2eb94442782263445704410038b734.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_bd2eb94442782263445704410038b734.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_bd2eb94442782263445704410038b734.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_bd2eb94442782263445704410038b734.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_b768bbd572a6dd956d8f080563205c1a.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_b768bbd572a6dd956d8f080563205c1a.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_b768bbd572a6dd956d8f080563205c1a.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_b768bbd572a6dd956d8f080563205c1a.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_b768bbd572a6dd956d8f080563205c1a.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_b768bbd572a6dd956d8f080563205c1a.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_34e8b6b32961a6eae54108608f813bb4.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_34e8b6b32961a6eae54108608f813bb4.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_34e8b6b32961a6eae54108608f813bb4.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_34e8b6b32961a6eae54108608f813bb4.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_2449a5d411ef947c826f115a6225e513.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_2449a5d411ef947c826f115a6225e513.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_2449a5d411ef947c826f115a6225e513.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_2449a5d411ef947c826f115a6225e513.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_a5a0607fb4423e9266af8d71b434d801.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_a5a0607fb4423e9266af8d71b434d801.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_a5a0607fb4423e9266af8d71b434d801.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_a5a0607fb4423e9266af8d71b434d801.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_a5a0607fb4423e9266af8d71b434d801.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_a5a0607fb4423e9266af8d71b434d801.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_e51c0ea1244670d4a96a0b9a71d59a69.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_e51c0ea1244670d4a96a0b9a71d59a69.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_e51c0ea1244670d4a96a0b9a71d59a69.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_e51c0ea1244670d4a96a0b9a71d59a69.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_654cf3a4b7fbb5aa22c659bc10fa97be.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_57b51ffda24174956525601d6c186f48.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_57b51ffda24174956525601d6c186f48.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_57b51ffda24174956525601d6c186f48.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_57b51ffda24174956525601d6c186f48.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_f1565f9f9f638ab9998a5128aa9cc5dc.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_847399e3bb154c09334a64fbbc88908f.text: Ainda não recebeste o teu dinheiro?
sense_847399e3bb154c09334a64fbbc88908f.translation: Haven't you received your money yet?

sense_847399e3bb154c09334a64fbbc88908f.text: O teu computador deu tela azul.
O teu pai veio te visitar.
sense_847399e3bb154c09334a64fbbc88908f.translation: Your father came to visit you.

sense_847399e3bb154c09334a64fbbc88908f.text: Tu tem que devolver o teu livro pra biblioteca logo, cara.
sense_847399e3bb154c09334a64fbbc88908f.translation: You gotta take your book back to the library soon, man.

sense_13fc57b682b586e28f50515830f4def7.text: O teu é suficiente para sobreviver?
A casa em si é tua, mas o terreno é meu.
sense_13fc57b682b586e28f50515830f4def7.translation: The house itself is yours, but the land is mine.

sense_13fc57b682b586e28f50515830f4def7.text: Tua por só uma semana, o quadro já parece um velho amigo.
sense_13fc57b682b586e28f50515830f4def7.translation: Yours for only a week so far, the painting already feels like an old friend.

sense_45e04f369b40741e630d52b184614d0e.text: E à mulher disse: Multiplicarei grandemente a tua dor e a tua conceição; com dor terás filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará.
sense_45e04f369b40741e630d52b184614d0e.translation: And to the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt have children; and thy desire shall be for thy husband, and he shall rule over thee."

sense_45e04f369b40741e630d52b184614d0e.text: Honra ao Senhor com a tua fazenda e com as primícias de toda a tua renda; e se encherão os teus celeiros abundantemente, e trasbordarão de mosto os teus lagares.
sense_45e04f369b40741e630d52b184614d0e.translation: Honor the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine income; and thy barns shall be filled with plenty, and thy winepresses shall overflow with new wine.

sense_45e04f369b40741e630d52b184614d0e.text: Eu conheço as tuas obras, e o teu amor, e o teu serviço, e a tua fé, e a tua paciência, e que as tuas últimas obras são mais do que as primeiras.
sense_45e04f369b40741e630d52b184614d0e.translation: I know thy works, and thy love, and thy service, and thy faith, and thy patience, and that thy latter works are more than thy former.

sense_73532deaa1ef850820dcd51af887f788.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_ca385f70567cf02a3d5031d49b018b2e.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_ca385f70567cf02a3d5031d49b018b2e.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_ca385f70567cf02a3d5031d49b018b2e.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_ca385f70567cf02a3d5031d49b018b2e.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_ee8bb9ae50c9e00528a2612352f7ed89.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_ee8bb9ae50c9e00528a2612352f7ed89.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_c35e78c0063f01e562bedd5f9f7e6043.text: Este livro é maior do que aquele.
sense_c35e78c0063f01e562bedd5f9f7e6043.translation: This book is bigger than that one.

sense_1f271fd9220b232a0570a234e34b105b.text: O Grande Porto é uma região metropolitana no norte de Portugal.
sense_1f271fd9220b232a0570a234e34b105b.translation: Greater Porto is a metropolitan area in the north of Portugal.
I live in the metropolis of Lisbon.

sense_9d590a57147df5f4806056314befea78.text: O carro está a funcionar/funcionando bem mal.
sense_9d590a57147df5f4806056314befea78.translation: The car is running pretty badly.

sense_46a77ced1f97fedd4dca0caf7155209f.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_46a77ced1f97fedd4dca0caf7155209f.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_46a77ced1f97fedd4dca0caf7155209f.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_46a77ced1f97fedd4dca0caf7155209f.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_301feacd15097404588ffffe1f0a49c1.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_301feacd15097404588ffffe1f0a49c1.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_813b0f7794b6bee68cac2ada940f7993.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_813b0f7794b6bee68cac2ada940f7993.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_813b0f7794b6bee68cac2ada940f7993.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_01383887fc1cc8bc1adb2efa8266b3b6.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_c5f394bf430e2f1798070208ad19a1be.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_c5f394bf430e2f1798070208ad19a1be.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_69a0cde82f8394459ec81528b4371177.translation: Nothing beats feeling the sun on your skin.
The sun is really hot today.

sense_08ce0fb06f8162239a3fbc6036b89284.text: Adoro sentir brilho do Sol de manhã.
sense_08ce0fb06f8162239a3fbc6036b89284.translation: I love feeling the sunshine in the morning.

sense_08ce0fb06f8162239a3fbc6036b89284.text: O Sol é um milhão de vezes maior do que a Terra.
sense_08ce0fb06f8162239a3fbc6036b89284.translation: The Sun is one million times larger than the Earth.

sense_5ab84ac158e21908e4f912fac9523813.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_5ab84ac158e21908e4f912fac9523813.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_99d18efba24e38bcd0e0da1df2a86b58.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_a088452c51dfc58f3560824ea75fa8ce.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_2d31b75b722c761dac1cf6c359c5c08c.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_2d31b75b722c761dac1cf6c359c5c08c.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_2d31b75b722c761dac1cf6c359c5c08c.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_7f98831d58265c20da01dcef83823327.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_7f98831d58265c20da01dcef83823327.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_7f98831d58265c20da01dcef83823327.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_7f98831d58265c20da01dcef83823327.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_2ebbf8777c11bd7d2087a1950a78c774.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_2ebbf8777c11bd7d2087a1950a78c774.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_e5cfa3090eb23ab946464c66683c6913.text: O preço de um prato nos mercados daqui é por vinte euros.
sense_e5cfa3090eb23ab946464c66683c6913.translation: The price of a plate in the local markets is around twenty euros.

sense_bb1d63ed70421e11912fdb8321c5bff1.text: O tesouro foi encontrado por Dudinka.
sense_bb1d63ed70421e11912fdb8321c5bff1.translation: The treasure was found around Dudinka.

sense_43a4d7c3376e77932231ef3d159f4556.text: Eu farei de tudo por uma cópia deste livro.
sense_43a4d7c3376e77932231ef3d159f4556.translation: I will do anything for a copy of this book.

sense_69c53f7f65b58d9e111a5316bf441860.text: Ainda passaríamos por muitos túneis antes de chegarmos.
sense_69c53f7f65b58d9e111a5316bf441860.translation: We would still pass through many tunnels before we arrived.

sense_b4a0eeb308cacab3fa9d4f25904437f8.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_b4a0eeb308cacab3fa9d4f25904437f8.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_b4a0eeb308cacab3fa9d4f25904437f8.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_b4a0eeb308cacab3fa9d4f25904437f8.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]
