sense_5e972587ca0b704b4e2b57abc36dbdf9.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_834ac5783011764d89615824867f8e5a.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_834ac5783011764d89615824867f8e5a.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_834ac5783011764d89615824867f8e5a.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_834ac5783011764d89615824867f8e5a.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_8894b16e3a497137377597848f1d176d.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_8894b16e3a497137377597848f1d176d.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_b803f8b33c2a46ba93aab74750a94779.text: Ela adora conversar com os amigos.
sense_b803f8b33c2a46ba93aab74750a94779.translation: She loves to chat with her friends.

sense_b803f8b33c2a46ba93aab74750a94779.text: Quero conversar com os senhores e exijo sua total e absoluta atenção.
sense_b803f8b33c2a46ba93aab74750a94779.translation: I want to talk with you and I demand your total and absolute attention.

sense_5f98c1cd25c6ffddfa8eeb2e3060ce69.literal_meaning: Son, we're going to have a talk when we get home.
sense_5f98c1cd25c6ffddfa8eeb2e3060ce69.text: Filho, nós vamos conversar quando chegarmos em casa.
sense_5f98c1cd25c6ffddfa8eeb2e3060ce69.translation: Son, I'm going to spank you when we get home.

sense_5f98c1cd25c6ffddfa8eeb2e3060ce69.text: Repórter: [depois de perguntar por que Jeanderson falou palavrão no jogo] Cê viu o chinelo que ela mostrou pra você?
sense_5f98c1cd25c6ffddfa8eeb2e3060ce69.translation: Interviewer: [after asking why Jeanderson cussed during the game] Didya see the chancla she showed you?

sense_805cdf49889fd77f5a7d2c894046fd02.text: E onde foi que você conseguiu esse senhor colchão? Adorei!
sense_805cdf49889fd77f5a7d2c894046fd02.translation: And where have you even got that great big mattress from? Loved it! [Literally, “that mister mattress”]

sense_805cdf49889fd77f5a7d2c894046fd02.text: Olha esse! É um senhor carro, hein? Gosto de sua cor e tamanho.
sense_805cdf49889fd77f5a7d2c894046fd02.translation: Looky this! It's such a fine-looking car, huh? I like her color and size.

sense_805cdf49889fd77f5a7d2c894046fd02.text: Que vieste fazer em minha casa a essa hora e em companhia desse senhor cão?
sense_805cdf49889fd77f5a7d2c894046fd02.translation: What are you doing in my house at this hour, and in the company of that big dog?

sense_99cffbfa9a4d0a3a77e75856d3198536.text: Os escravizados frequentemente revoltavam-se contra seus senhores.
sense_99cffbfa9a4d0a3a77e75856d3198536.translation: The enslaved used to frequently revolt against their masters.

sense_99cffbfa9a4d0a3a77e75856d3198536.text: Escravos devem obedecer aos seus senhores.

sense_f9d3f1a7c69846fb3b5cc5a12d8632d2.text: Senhoras e senhores, vos apresento a primeira atração da noite!
sense_f9d3f1a7c69846fb3b5cc5a12d8632d2.translation: Ladies and gentlemen, I present you this night's first attraction!

sense_af099934ebd582b4e8555c140d8211c1.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_af099934ebd582b4e8555c140d8211c1.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_af099934ebd582b4e8555c140d8211c1.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_af099934ebd582b4e8555c140d8211c1.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_2d5bb79213488a697addeb4f016bdae6.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_2e7a85046051ef5e2fe8b55f9a70d83f.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_373f0898dcb10696bd19f61e1ea21a52.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_373f0898dcb10696bd19f61e1ea21a52.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_373f0898dcb10696bd19f61e1ea21a52.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_373f0898dcb10696bd19f61e1ea21a52.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_86262d6c11a09c33da85ce378fce40ff.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_86262d6c11a09c33da85ce378fce40ff.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_8b8191810a65efa4dad79c14fc12c2d0.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_8b8191810a65efa4dad79c14fc12c2d0.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_a65e30496539385e9cf5d5f9cbc411e7.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_ff724ddebafbb385325c444211ce7220.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_ff724ddebafbb385325c444211ce7220.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_ff724ddebafbb385325c444211ce7220.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_ff724ddebafbb385325c444211ce7220.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_ff724ddebafbb385325c444211ce7220.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_ff724ddebafbb385325c444211ce7220.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_54cf59ede875a692975a26f9be58cb05.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_54cf59ede875a692975a26f9be58cb05.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_54cf59ede875a692975a26f9be58cb05.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_54cf59ede875a692975a26f9be58cb05.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_ef03bb57d8afd7e398723719115a208d.text: Ele não está bem da cabeça.
sense_ef03bb57d8afd7e398723719115a208d.translation: He’s not right in the head.
I’m fine, we can go on.

sense_ca3450d974d6390696621d46952d4486.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_ca3450d974d6390696621d46952d4486.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_5376b4ac010b63aa825fb47009b24935.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_a537590a7da39c90dfe6e28f1fc196cf.text: Vou ao restaurante onde ele gosta de comer.
sense_a537590a7da39c90dfe6e28f1fc196cf.translation: I’m going to the restaurant where he likes to eat.

sense_a537590a7da39c90dfe6e28f1fc196cf.text: Esta é a praia onde nos casamos.
sense_a537590a7da39c90dfe6e28f1fc196cf.translation: This is the beach where we got married.

sense_ae92bd4dc77416462b9eca0fedac081f.text: Por favor, se sente onde você preferir.

sense_79ec2d90c52170dd66d8a965df6078da.text: Quais são as modalidades onde seu filho é campeão?
sense_79ec2d90c52170dd66d8a965df6078da.translation: Which are the sports where your child is a champion?

sense_79ec2d90c52170dd66d8a965df6078da.text: Dezembro é a época do ano onde as pessoas ficam mais solidárias, não é mesmo?
sense_79ec2d90c52170dd66d8a965df6078da.translation: December is the time of year where people are at their most supportive, isn't it?

sense_e41549ceddd9453e32db4fac09416089.text: Sempre pesquisa as leis de onde você vai viajar.
sense_e41549ceddd9453e32db4fac09416089.translation: Always search for the laws of wherever you'll travel.

sense_e41549ceddd9453e32db4fac09416089.text: Ela mora em São Paulo, onde a gente foi ano passado.
sense_e41549ceddd9453e32db4fac09416089.translation: She lives in São Paulo, where we went last year.

sense_e41549ceddd9453e32db4fac09416089.text: Essa é uma foto de onde eu fui nas férias.
sense_e41549ceddd9453e32db4fac09416089.translation: This is a photo of where I went on holiday.

sense_430e52777e2b13b9e3270c882e7c05e8.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_e09d8886e3427ba6594127378453f707.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_e09d8886e3427ba6594127378453f707.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_2b7ba891745c296f4d3268b9a41260f2.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_4a64838f2070b427f948bbefefcc2e72.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_4a64838f2070b427f948bbefefcc2e72.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_1335187fc2cf650f40c427aab70277c8.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_1335187fc2cf650f40c427aab70277c8.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_6e5b44cab06473b462f7ef50cc980b7d.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: Em scismar — sósinho — á noite — / Mais prazer encontro eu lá; / Minha terra tem palmeiras, / Onde canta o Sabiá.
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: When ruminating — alone — at night — / I find more pleasure there; / My land has palm trees, / where the Thrush sings.

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: O marquez tinha ido sósinho para França. Fôra, ao que se dizia, buscar a filha ao Sacré-Cœur.
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: The marquess had gone to France alone. He’d gone, supposedly, to fetch his daughter from the Sacré-Cœur.

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: — Ai! volto, volto... Não posso deixar sózinha a mãe do meu homem, que tem oitenta annos e está entrevada.
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: “Oh! I’ll go back, yes... I can’t leave my man’s mother, who’s eighty years old and paralysed, by herself.

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: No momento actual, não era possivel ao Brasil vencer sosinho as suas difficuldades financeiras, nem lhe será possivel.
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: Currently, it was not possible for Brazil to overcome its financial difficulties by itself, nor will it be possible.

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: Impossivel dar cabo daquella praga. Estirou os olhos pela campina, achou-se isolado. Sózinho num mundo coberto de pennas, de aves queriam comel-o.
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: It was impossible to put an end to that pest. He looked over the plains, found himself isolated. Alone in a world covered in feathers, in birds that sought to eat him.

sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.text: Uma canção dizendo tudo a ela / Que ainda estou sozinho, apaixonado
sense_2d375742ab9f1180138e1cc6442ea9b3.translation: A song telling her everything / That I’m still lonely, in love

sense_52b940676d9069e6b2010dae25ecc323.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_52b940676d9069e6b2010dae25ecc323.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_52b940676d9069e6b2010dae25ecc323.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_109a21af74806d11aa328269493f9d59.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_51f37116cde2d819af7d79d9a638a1a4.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_51f37116cde2d819af7d79d9a638a1a4.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_77beb0cecf26bab4af4327d2848b6a53.text: Um bocado de pessoas viu aquilo.
sense_77beb0cecf26bab4af4327d2848b6a53.translation: A lot of people saw that.
I waited for a lot of time.

sense_4c630c32d30a5aa5db268e65b81900bf.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_4c630c32d30a5aa5db268e65b81900bf.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_4c630c32d30a5aa5db268e65b81900bf.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_4c630c32d30a5aa5db268e65b81900bf.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_9404c04337b86e058d171fd31a7762c2.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_9404c04337b86e058d171fd31a7762c2.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_dc829cb15eb267c1fdc1a5682992984e.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_dc829cb15eb267c1fdc1a5682992984e.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_d92c2b72e3f74ce8ebf9ac3c11f81b02.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_d92c2b72e3f74ce8ebf9ac3c11f81b02.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_d92c2b72e3f74ce8ebf9ac3c11f81b02.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_d92c2b72e3f74ce8ebf9ac3c11f81b02.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_a6e8721cbc4fd53777e19ce532c9a97f.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_a6e8721cbc4fd53777e19ce532c9a97f.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_5b59ce2c3951135d11798db2829258a8.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_5b59ce2c3951135d11798db2829258a8.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_5b59ce2c3951135d11798db2829258a8.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_20e5d9988885d80ad4f42774ea00642b.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_20e5d9988885d80ad4f42774ea00642b.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_20e5d9988885d80ad4f42774ea00642b.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_20e5d9988885d80ad4f42774ea00642b.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_f576e1432ddc2024a3e7174ed2ebf0d8.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_f576e1432ddc2024a3e7174ed2ebf0d8.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_8f786e42f01c71fc13f2e59698594a04.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_8f786e42f01c71fc13f2e59698594a04.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_8f786e42f01c71fc13f2e59698594a04.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_8f786e42f01c71fc13f2e59698594a04.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_9d8da6f1a3597f5ca411667f4924d506.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_f03ffa1181d19b17e4b559a0edc1eb32.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_f03ffa1181d19b17e4b559a0edc1eb32.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_f03ffa1181d19b17e4b559a0edc1eb32.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_f03ffa1181d19b17e4b559a0edc1eb32.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_f03ffa1181d19b17e4b559a0edc1eb32.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_f03ffa1181d19b17e4b559a0edc1eb32.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_1620aecfee0e87be26b95c125a1dedd1.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_1620aecfee0e87be26b95c125a1dedd1.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_1620aecfee0e87be26b95c125a1dedd1.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_1620aecfee0e87be26b95c125a1dedd1.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_8d4d7ec0e5ca6f57766df0d946493bc8.text: A segunda batalha foi muito mais violenta.
sense_8d4d7ec0e5ca6f57766df0d946493bc8.translation: The second battle was a lot more violent.

sense_649da5abbd38545ac68630cb6e29878d.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_649da5abbd38545ac68630cb6e29878d.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_260c4a9d923854a9aa6ee117b26bb9cc.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_260c4a9d923854a9aa6ee117b26bb9cc.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_260c4a9d923854a9aa6ee117b26bb9cc.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_e86d51551978e24900cd72c7a9881d4c.text: A segunda batalha foi muito mais violenta.
sense_e86d51551978e24900cd72c7a9881d4c.translation: The second battle was a lot more violent.

sense_71637fec5865cc81ea830b609d8488f6.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_25d6a5bb11f035c290dfe4f40a22b261.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_366d1707f5ac06481b10c957bf175b53.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_366d1707f5ac06481b10c957bf175b53.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_110d8a2c13aee09aca1b9814b38799d8.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_87102526f38c5f1845fe250a72e95c52.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_f49249ebe42f8199ef6bc25988e24ba0.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_f49249ebe42f8199ef6bc25988e24ba0.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_7f9f088ffe013d003247a54a03449790.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_7f9f088ffe013d003247a54a03449790.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_40369321558877396602fe34e5f5b8aa.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_40369321558877396602fe34e5f5b8aa.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_40369321558877396602fe34e5f5b8aa.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_40369321558877396602fe34e5f5b8aa.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_861fb1a3e68c78dcfbfe2c076ba05ff7.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_861fb1a3e68c78dcfbfe2c076ba05ff7.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_861fb1a3e68c78dcfbfe2c076ba05ff7.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_861fb1a3e68c78dcfbfe2c076ba05ff7.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_791e09317c926d846bce6d796e20866a.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_791e09317c926d846bce6d796e20866a.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_791e09317c926d846bce6d796e20866a.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_791e09317c926d846bce6d796e20866a.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_974062fb69546cd6f60e1bc6824d83db.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_974062fb69546cd6f60e1bc6824d83db.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_974062fb69546cd6f60e1bc6824d83db.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_974062fb69546cd6f60e1bc6824d83db.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_5ab51e6a2a828b9db9862629b461507c.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_5ab51e6a2a828b9db9862629b461507c.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_c324b009cbc1c3cfccc566d5ddbff086.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_c324b009cbc1c3cfccc566d5ddbff086.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_60409c803bb1305ce381306ce7af9c0b.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_60409c803bb1305ce381306ce7af9c0b.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_60409c803bb1305ce381306ce7af9c0b.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_60409c803bb1305ce381306ce7af9c0b.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_bff24697a1d286b56cc971ab2b368ac8.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_bff24697a1d286b56cc971ab2b368ac8.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_daedf3fc314020d767b7fa86da31ac03.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_daedf3fc314020d767b7fa86da31ac03.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_daedf3fc314020d767b7fa86da31ac03.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_daedf3fc314020d767b7fa86da31ac03.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_e4ba164665f9e6154d4c1e3fa9aab15c.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_e4ba164665f9e6154d4c1e3fa9aab15c.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_e20b4cf481bee3fe826b479562c540fc.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_e20b4cf481bee3fe826b479562c540fc.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_183e22eaac61b9665228ff547058cc23.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_7fb6c99ab6878226a43448ac3d196fad.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_7fb6c99ab6878226a43448ac3d196fad.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_7fb6c99ab6878226a43448ac3d196fad.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_7fb6c99ab6878226a43448ac3d196fad.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_6e513356e71c3f5cdd73434ed08a7450.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_bc14d9d9297c2a8e2998ef26415677f8.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_bc14d9d9297c2a8e2998ef26415677f8.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_0dfff3d7444c11a648f2c9aec4c32268.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_0dfff3d7444c11a648f2c9aec4c32268.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_0dfff3d7444c11a648f2c9aec4c32268.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_0dfff3d7444c11a648f2c9aec4c32268.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_92feeb517ee21f9b2e573659522d2799.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_92feeb517ee21f9b2e573659522d2799.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_92feeb517ee21f9b2e573659522d2799.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_92feeb517ee21f9b2e573659522d2799.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_03632ec08b5fc0a0edba6b3b95977edf.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_eca6bf6110861b26b4ffbfd1168c3f13.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_eca6bf6110861b26b4ffbfd1168c3f13.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_eca6bf6110861b26b4ffbfd1168c3f13.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_eca6bf6110861b26b4ffbfd1168c3f13.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_0447c17604035bf9377ce4682349c076.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_0447c17604035bf9377ce4682349c076.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_0447c17604035bf9377ce4682349c076.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_0447c17604035bf9377ce4682349c076.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_784e822d135c7feb8fe91dd8196d44f1.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_784e822d135c7feb8fe91dd8196d44f1.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_59c84ffd9f72444eba845b414eb20adb.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_59c84ffd9f72444eba845b414eb20adb.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_59c84ffd9f72444eba845b414eb20adb.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_59c84ffd9f72444eba845b414eb20adb.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_59c84ffd9f72444eba845b414eb20adb.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_59c84ffd9f72444eba845b414eb20adb.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_b09680caa6604f71741238ff6f9ac756.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_52da93d75561af79612ebe2c222289f2.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_431bc4c43937615fbcd4e6318348bbf7.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_431bc4c43937615fbcd4e6318348bbf7.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_61ce1d227fad45b91793c8055ddb6461.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_19a927155310fcf052aa9410efaeddda.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_19a927155310fcf052aa9410efaeddda.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_a269afe8d0df0f67798c25be59c8d5fc.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_a269afe8d0df0f67798c25be59c8d5fc.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_a269afe8d0df0f67798c25be59c8d5fc.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_a269afe8d0df0f67798c25be59c8d5fc.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_0ec7fdf753dc02cc83adca536d19e6a1.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_0ec7fdf753dc02cc83adca536d19e6a1.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_0ec7fdf753dc02cc83adca536d19e6a1.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_0ec7fdf753dc02cc83adca536d19e6a1.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_a1564861e6cad02edfec727bfcf996dc.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_a1564861e6cad02edfec727bfcf996dc.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_af74d71be49a3567ec5d40b4d2d9ff3b.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_af74d71be49a3567ec5d40b4d2d9ff3b.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_2e379aba4509df8979a3101f20daf7f2.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_2e379aba4509df8979a3101f20daf7f2.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_80d2a811aa8e46e7d0f2e54bc7fb53f2.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_80d2a811aa8e46e7d0f2e54bc7fb53f2.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_80d2a811aa8e46e7d0f2e54bc7fb53f2.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_80d2a811aa8e46e7d0f2e54bc7fb53f2.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_ad76d6d2d9fa604b993937db65f13d01.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_ad76d6d2d9fa604b993937db65f13d01.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_3b9e109b92812b9afa46a4a2a3932faf.text: Será que os Androides Sonham com Ovelhas Elétricas?
sense_3b9e109b92812b9afa46a4a2a3932faf.translation: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
I had a dream about him.

sense_d5cda9e09fa3b78e5065482bb415618d.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_d5cda9e09fa3b78e5065482bb415618d.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_56de1febd6acd4e658a8261857f67107.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_56de1febd6acd4e658a8261857f67107.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_56de1febd6acd4e658a8261857f67107.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_56de1febd6acd4e658a8261857f67107.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_48d29a7bf29a17fb1879a4a0c850c507.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_48d29a7bf29a17fb1879a4a0c850c507.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_48d29a7bf29a17fb1879a4a0c850c507.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_48d29a7bf29a17fb1879a4a0c850c507.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_e4c121ee73e697a2a4044af169d51c72.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_e4c121ee73e697a2a4044af169d51c72.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_e4c121ee73e697a2a4044af169d51c72.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_e4c121ee73e697a2a4044af169d51c72.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_24a46b5bdc45fb4c416fd8f2d369613d.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_24a46b5bdc45fb4c416fd8f2d369613d.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_24a46b5bdc45fb4c416fd8f2d369613d.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_24a46b5bdc45fb4c416fd8f2d369613d.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_74f78b7ee0030dfed8268c5bdfab698c.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_74f78b7ee0030dfed8268c5bdfab698c.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_74f78b7ee0030dfed8268c5bdfab698c.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_74f78b7ee0030dfed8268c5bdfab698c.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_74f78b7ee0030dfed8268c5bdfab698c.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_74f78b7ee0030dfed8268c5bdfab698c.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_cecbae5228b997c1c005c7cfb1e0f53a.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_cecbae5228b997c1c005c7cfb1e0f53a.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_cecbae5228b997c1c005c7cfb1e0f53a.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_cecbae5228b997c1c005c7cfb1e0f53a.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_10dc7e6c131435858acd6f620e3eabf2.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_10dc7e6c131435858acd6f620e3eabf2.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_44330364f6a06f25209220cef44bfa6b.text: Essa ponte não me parece muito segura.
sense_44330364f6a06f25209220cef44bfa6b.translation: This bridge doesn’t look very safe.

sense_44330364f6a06f25209220cef44bfa6b.text: Não te preocupes, voar é seguro.

sense_5b0d24bf9b02a1f6fd9242c992cfb566.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_5b0d24bf9b02a1f6fd9242c992cfb566.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_f0514c54765de79062f415e8cdef1852.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_f0514c54765de79062f415e8cdef1852.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_749fc7fd92eabf59cc7c0292902408cc.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_d8fdf28eccd7fd9a75497e9a72af28af.text: Ela adora conversar com os amigos.
sense_d8fdf28eccd7fd9a75497e9a72af28af.translation: She loves to chat with her friends.

sense_d8fdf28eccd7fd9a75497e9a72af28af.text: Quero conversar com os senhores e exijo sua total e absoluta atenção.
sense_d8fdf28eccd7fd9a75497e9a72af28af.translation: I want to talk with you and I demand your total and absolute attention.

sense_836f742347dd8f13e1287119c330134a.literal_meaning: Son, we're going to have a talk when we get home.
sense_836f742347dd8f13e1287119c330134a.text: Filho, nós vamos conversar quando chegarmos em casa.
sense_836f742347dd8f13e1287119c330134a.translation: Son, I'm going to spank you when we get home.

sense_836f742347dd8f13e1287119c330134a.text: Repórter: [depois de perguntar por que Jeanderson falou palavrão no jogo] Cê viu o chinelo que ela mostrou pra você?
sense_836f742347dd8f13e1287119c330134a.translation: Interviewer: [after asking why Jeanderson cussed during the game] Didya see the chancla she showed you?

sense_6ddef64639d34b6da820b958582eee38.translation: I saw her through the glass.

sense_6ddef64639d34b6da820b958582eee38.text: A folhagem dos joazeiros appareceu longe, atravez dos galhos pelados da catinga rala.
sense_6ddef64639d34b6da820b958582eee38.translation: The juazeiros’ foliage was visible in the distance, through the caatinga brush’s bare branches.

sense_ecec6186d0e991fcecf990b880f759de.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_617351e64f22f8651681686a5f614c20.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_617351e64f22f8651681686a5f614c20.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_6b1b93236b9099a49ad840a428c7fb4d.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_9b185d2cfce39b8f14bd7dffb56737d9.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_9b185d2cfce39b8f14bd7dffb56737d9.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_e7f24f6fdf9fadd92ce7ba124ed28ccc.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_b1609582a176018780a54fdacda4e4de.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_b1609582a176018780a54fdacda4e4de.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_b1609582a176018780a54fdacda4e4de.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_b1609582a176018780a54fdacda4e4de.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_7df9026d4b901f65b2e2ac1341cc9171.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_7df9026d4b901f65b2e2ac1341cc9171.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_cb7f287ad153d26ea12c6e1a35a02e0b.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_cb7f287ad153d26ea12c6e1a35a02e0b.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_17f87f00bf48b8220c4d3a51dcf866a4.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_17f87f00bf48b8220c4d3a51dcf866a4.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_7cb75c79f4fc878d20bb2a412341bde4.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_7cb75c79f4fc878d20bb2a412341bde4.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_53df85748f9c03f5d12593c449d8c277.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_53df85748f9c03f5d12593c449d8c277.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_53df85748f9c03f5d12593c449d8c277.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_53df85748f9c03f5d12593c449d8c277.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_2d30672227b0275fc0d4e39d512adfd9.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_2d30672227b0275fc0d4e39d512adfd9.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_8968a984db184a95be1a14125ef56d47.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_8968a984db184a95be1a14125ef56d47.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_8968a984db184a95be1a14125ef56d47.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_1726ccd29268ad066ded9d1ba7b06434.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_1726ccd29268ad066ded9d1ba7b06434.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_1726ccd29268ad066ded9d1ba7b06434.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_1726ccd29268ad066ded9d1ba7b06434.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_c6b72737b4fc1aaf132f591d24dcb9cf.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_c6b72737b4fc1aaf132f591d24dcb9cf.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_a516f21e7e9ca9a97c5a1539eebd886f.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_a516f21e7e9ca9a97c5a1539eebd886f.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_2ae886ab844d0f6ae402c255e61fdf26.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_2ae886ab844d0f6ae402c255e61fdf26.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_2ae886ab844d0f6ae402c255e61fdf26.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_2ae886ab844d0f6ae402c255e61fdf26.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_2ae886ab844d0f6ae402c255e61fdf26.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_2ae886ab844d0f6ae402c255e61fdf26.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_a94081983a7f4d612bd3404f74f7e127.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_a94081983a7f4d612bd3404f74f7e127.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_4e64e786908a35cd87e71f8901fa0c4e.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_4e64e786908a35cd87e71f8901fa0c4e.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_4e64e786908a35cd87e71f8901fa0c4e.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_4e64e786908a35cd87e71f8901fa0c4e.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_b46fad25ba89f77ce431cefaeab6852d.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_b46fad25ba89f77ce431cefaeab6852d.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_e643eb7641d296e58a37356a562e20b2.text: Estrogonofe de carne ou de frango
O que é mais nutritivo carne ou frango?
sense_e643eb7641d296e58a37356a562e20b2.translation: What's more nutritious beef or chicken?

sense_01328d5fb35160904f93645137f87a9f.text: Deixei a fatia mais doce da vida / Na mesa dos homens de vida vazia
sense_01328d5fb35160904f93645137f87a9f.translation: I left the sweetest slice of life / On the table of the men who lead empty lives

sense_03fbd155f81f91feb78c4fb6fdcdb573.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_03fbd155f81f91feb78c4fb6fdcdb573.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_43e44f2e2aad3a5affc4c8ce959bcf73.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_43e44f2e2aad3a5affc4c8ce959bcf73.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_43e44f2e2aad3a5affc4c8ce959bcf73.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_43e44f2e2aad3a5affc4c8ce959bcf73.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_97ebec4e050e960e46c435e85c9050c5.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_97ebec4e050e960e46c435e85c9050c5.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_97ebec4e050e960e46c435e85c9050c5.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_97ebec4e050e960e46c435e85c9050c5.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_2742316649313d19dcb8e8e731459494.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_2742316649313d19dcb8e8e731459494.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_2742316649313d19dcb8e8e731459494.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_2742316649313d19dcb8e8e731459494.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_24206930753f192beddafebaf00cae41.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_24206930753f192beddafebaf00cae41.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_1d66aedb74a1c4254f89887975eee7e9.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_b7e7b7f3fb40dea0203b7026ebc21fa4.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_b7e7b7f3fb40dea0203b7026ebc21fa4.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_b7e7b7f3fb40dea0203b7026ebc21fa4.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_b7e7b7f3fb40dea0203b7026ebc21fa4.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_b7e7b7f3fb40dea0203b7026ebc21fa4.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_b7e7b7f3fb40dea0203b7026ebc21fa4.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_c3fc99db7e5ac3f65c93f69643254848.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_c3fc99db7e5ac3f65c93f69643254848.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_726b46c60d90d2aba7dd311683fe7d43.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_726b46c60d90d2aba7dd311683fe7d43.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_726b46c60d90d2aba7dd311683fe7d43.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_726b46c60d90d2aba7dd311683fe7d43.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_d4236f0006fd0290290c9ff2ed63cbec.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_d4236f0006fd0290290c9ff2ed63cbec.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_83abeaa515eaeceefcf43d5874dd45a4.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_83abeaa515eaeceefcf43d5874dd45a4.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_8d7e95e880b09aa2dade7dff06b914aa.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_8d7e95e880b09aa2dade7dff06b914aa.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_ee453e2632a677e6b3e7dc5c3cbade1b.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_ee453e2632a677e6b3e7dc5c3cbade1b.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_ee453e2632a677e6b3e7dc5c3cbade1b.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_ee453e2632a677e6b3e7dc5c3cbade1b.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_e67769425a93e226131678422d0c29d2.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_e67769425a93e226131678422d0c29d2.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_9f9b27ba630757710f729e40f1f08e92.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_9f9b27ba630757710f729e40f1f08e92.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_9f9b27ba630757710f729e40f1f08e92.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_9f9b27ba630757710f729e40f1f08e92.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_181abc8f71838089caa4b3573bfe53ac.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_181abc8f71838089caa4b3573bfe53ac.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_181abc8f71838089caa4b3573bfe53ac.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_181abc8f71838089caa4b3573bfe53ac.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_241bbaac9e441c13b400d09ad41419eb.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_241bbaac9e441c13b400d09ad41419eb.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_241bbaac9e441c13b400d09ad41419eb.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_241bbaac9e441c13b400d09ad41419eb.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_8e701bf7efebdb1995537cf241f517e1.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_8e701bf7efebdb1995537cf241f517e1.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_b6ef5a69bd9ea01c5bb37dba839e71a6.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_b6ef5a69bd9ea01c5bb37dba839e71a6.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_f75cb803d8e0d0f5dc7b5410ac3df380.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_09d8a6d452d35a2b24e2dfad0d274425.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_09d8a6d452d35a2b24e2dfad0d274425.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_09d8a6d452d35a2b24e2dfad0d274425.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_09d8a6d452d35a2b24e2dfad0d274425.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_09d8a6d452d35a2b24e2dfad0d274425.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_09d8a6d452d35a2b24e2dfad0d274425.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_8708c323bd12c45bc4bc748e7f80584b.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_af1fc62e92cc5ae7099c8c08cba0eef0.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_6e92f6a84f80675e81b99b818775db04.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_6e92f6a84f80675e81b99b818775db04.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_246f40f54e79fb8f254333437b5001b6.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_5a43fecf09e950e7fdc03cdb143bf6a0.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_5a43fecf09e950e7fdc03cdb143bf6a0.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_9ee1a265eeaa6be3844522adbfffd913.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_9ee1a265eeaa6be3844522adbfffd913.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_9ee1a265eeaa6be3844522adbfffd913.text: O Fado nasceu um dia, / quando o vento mal bulia / e o céu o mar prolongava, / na amurada dum veleiro, / no peito dum marinheiro / que, estando triste, cantava.
sense_9ee1a265eeaa6be3844522adbfffd913.translation: Fado was born one day, / when the wind was blowing hard / and the sky was extending the sea, / in the bulwark of a ship, / in the chest of a sailor / who, being sad, was singing.

sense_9ee1a265eeaa6be3844522adbfffd913.text: Então continuaram a estudar enquanto o céu lá fora se tornava gradualmente mais escuro.
sense_9ee1a265eeaa6be3844522adbfffd913.translation: Then they continued to study while the sky outside was becoming gradually darker.

sense_64cd8aa35a46c7928dc0210581f3d291.text: Como é bom ir para o céo! Nunca mais hei-de ter frio!
sense_64cd8aa35a46c7928dc0210581f3d291.translation: It feels so good to go to heaven! I’ll never feel cold again!

sense_204647da2dc950b24b9a87316b32497c.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_204647da2dc950b24b9a87316b32497c.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_beb39e48f0869600f98908436cc1174e.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_beb39e48f0869600f98908436cc1174e.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_de96dead9f92dab0ccd2111a0533c9f3.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_de96dead9f92dab0ccd2111a0533c9f3.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_a5586be09a37bce2062c3383ebb65999.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_a5586be09a37bce2062c3383ebb65999.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_edb289d5f12519a1efa9f54778855f3a.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_edb289d5f12519a1efa9f54778855f3a.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_f98f3fe9b49c25b1d3383f49a008be3f.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_f98f3fe9b49c25b1d3383f49a008be3f.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_0098151fdc8a31ace7e9b29f0c47a9f0.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_21b87a604f48638914b5f6ad7193d14d.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_21b87a604f48638914b5f6ad7193d14d.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_21b87a604f48638914b5f6ad7193d14d.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_21b87a604f48638914b5f6ad7193d14d.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_647baa87c184896b3afcb2d7516038c8.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_647baa87c184896b3afcb2d7516038c8.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_1b28128a78ecb31228d669f8766bdf30.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_1b28128a78ecb31228d669f8766bdf30.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_3e968b42024e11da2f8ee6b74eb158a5.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_3e968b42024e11da2f8ee6b74eb158a5.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_fdcc06cec928bb8c0184c095c98def31.text: A minhã mãe está na esquerda da foto.
sense_fdcc06cec928bb8c0184c095c98def31.translation: My mother is on the left side of the picture.

sense_fdcc06cec928bb8c0184c095c98def31.text: Cuidado, tem um bicho à sua esquerda!
sense_fdcc06cec928bb8c0184c095c98def31.translation: Watch out, there’s a creature to your left!

sense_fdcc06cec928bb8c0184c095c98def31.text: Pega a esquerda que você chega mais rápido.
sense_fdcc06cec928bb8c0184c095c98def31.translation: Take the left and you’ll get there faster.

sense_9beb0f1a8838a80ad39cd641b9ffe1ef.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_9beb0f1a8838a80ad39cd641b9ffe1ef.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_9beb0f1a8838a80ad39cd641b9ffe1ef.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_9beb0f1a8838a80ad39cd641b9ffe1ef.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_112fa6ef00c0594d96ddbf8905359538.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_112fa6ef00c0594d96ddbf8905359538.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_112fa6ef00c0594d96ddbf8905359538.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_112fa6ef00c0594d96ddbf8905359538.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_70ee63855cb4d3649d1d35db3a83a450.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_70ee63855cb4d3649d1d35db3a83a450.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_70ee63855cb4d3649d1d35db3a83a450.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_70ee63855cb4d3649d1d35db3a83a450.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_d48b57f1646676783ed0cf525eefb8ac.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_d48b57f1646676783ed0cf525eefb8ac.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_d48b57f1646676783ed0cf525eefb8ac.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_d48b57f1646676783ed0cf525eefb8ac.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_d48b57f1646676783ed0cf525eefb8ac.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_d48b57f1646676783ed0cf525eefb8ac.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_36916aa522679eb93881b339f7d2fb74.translation: They’ve been going out for three months.

sense_2c15b62631943c9baa92b330cccb699c.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_2c15b62631943c9baa92b330cccb699c.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_2c15b62631943c9baa92b330cccb699c.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_2c15b62631943c9baa92b330cccb699c.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_5f62e490a0ff0326d4c3a75e36a2d0dd.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_5f62e490a0ff0326d4c3a75e36a2d0dd.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_5f62e490a0ff0326d4c3a75e36a2d0dd.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_5f62e490a0ff0326d4c3a75e36a2d0dd.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_3b5411d39c7538c9040b1cdade597ffa.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_ca23ee7027b867207b5c15d3bd036484.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_ca23ee7027b867207b5c15d3bd036484.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_84689b3de005465bd749573ec4373550.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_84689b3de005465bd749573ec4373550.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_84689b3de005465bd749573ec4373550.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_84689b3de005465bd749573ec4373550.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_bfb5ace97275a7433f0f4889ae13fe88.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_bfb5ace97275a7433f0f4889ae13fe88.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_bfb5ace97275a7433f0f4889ae13fe88.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_bfb5ace97275a7433f0f4889ae13fe88.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_e3378b8e799f76ea7fdf3f5142992420.text: No ano passado li três livros.
sense_e3378b8e799f76ea7fdf3f5142992420.translation: I read three books in the previous year.
I read three books last year.

sense_61c8d3b78f747e53dd82815f1f32ca5b.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_61c8d3b78f747e53dd82815f1f32ca5b.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_899918175b0cd8bcb68754177249c919.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_899918175b0cd8bcb68754177249c919.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_899918175b0cd8bcb68754177249c919.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_899918175b0cd8bcb68754177249c919.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_29d54c2cfba2f5028fa61e8feacd114f.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_29d54c2cfba2f5028fa61e8feacd114f.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_29d54c2cfba2f5028fa61e8feacd114f.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_29d54c2cfba2f5028fa61e8feacd114f.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_5d79d118c61567782e8008358959d56c.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_5d79d118c61567782e8008358959d56c.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_656c9aee89c6f79be0f8daa81b4faf6e.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_656c9aee89c6f79be0f8daa81b4faf6e.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_2d0d50d7c70a41962ca15d6035eeebe5.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_2d0d50d7c70a41962ca15d6035eeebe5.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_2e2fe0dd5e0e498815ce88c8a2abcdf3.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_2e2fe0dd5e0e498815ce88c8a2abcdf3.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_cd1d5a7889082917173ebeef68606970.text: A rua está cheia de trânsito.
sense_cd1d5a7889082917173ebeef68606970.translation: The street is full of traffic.

sense_61dc61414a3838ef905b1a00cdc62b5b.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_61dc61414a3838ef905b1a00cdc62b5b.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_61dc61414a3838ef905b1a00cdc62b5b.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_6d29889071a18468be618d9dcc247b7f.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_b164b771b9e27974ff75b195d13852b0.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_b164b771b9e27974ff75b195d13852b0.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_094d0b04f58b680600c6c71b70721f42.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_094d0b04f58b680600c6c71b70721f42.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_e53631eeed47ad9595c00db2b0d2b688.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_e53631eeed47ad9595c00db2b0d2b688.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_6c7596b33e3c09afc2efcc4f36994478.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_9b6209bf0e3f3b80ad2c950f9409f0fb.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_9b6209bf0e3f3b80ad2c950f9409f0fb.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_01d78b7b8cc0547890032fa63545b173.text: E onde foi que você conseguiu esse senhor colchão? Adorei!
sense_01d78b7b8cc0547890032fa63545b173.translation: And where have you even got that great big mattress from? Loved it! [Literally, “that mister mattress”]

sense_01d78b7b8cc0547890032fa63545b173.text: Olha esse! É um senhor carro, hein? Gosto de sua cor e tamanho.
sense_01d78b7b8cc0547890032fa63545b173.translation: Looky this! It's such a fine-looking car, huh? I like her color and size.

sense_01d78b7b8cc0547890032fa63545b173.text: Que vieste fazer em minha casa a essa hora e em companhia desse senhor cão?
sense_01d78b7b8cc0547890032fa63545b173.translation: What are you doing in my house at this hour, and in the company of that big dog?

sense_195fe7d1460e1c2b6c546934d712dc24.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_f22e769c12c3a602fe61d34f337827a6.text: O carro está a funcionar/funcionando bem mal.
sense_f22e769c12c3a602fe61d34f337827a6.translation: The car is running pretty badly.

sense_c0133654b289091686cad13704173840.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_c0133654b289091686cad13704173840.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_c0133654b289091686cad13704173840.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_c0133654b289091686cad13704173840.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_e333f5cab6cc9ec1dac96f02918a96d6.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_e333f5cab6cc9ec1dac96f02918a96d6.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_e333f5cab6cc9ec1dac96f02918a96d6.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_e333f5cab6cc9ec1dac96f02918a96d6.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_53e4c1d093a487d81776d7cf2195e240.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_53e4c1d093a487d81776d7cf2195e240.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_53e4c1d093a487d81776d7cf2195e240.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_53e4c1d093a487d81776d7cf2195e240.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_7403a4bd77d4a987bf17bee5e131e6c6.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_7403a4bd77d4a987bf17bee5e131e6c6.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_b5c6a48396421ed17c16ba52f77a7553.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_ded63f68310c5b2d5fea901ce389898e.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_ded63f68310c5b2d5fea901ce389898e.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_ded63f68310c5b2d5fea901ce389898e.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_ded63f68310c5b2d5fea901ce389898e.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_ded63f68310c5b2d5fea901ce389898e.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_ded63f68310c5b2d5fea901ce389898e.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_8608e1e81889d36af74c16f969fb2f22.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_0c4d899c42988282b9f766f49f95a712.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_15053505d942f87f4d47019385717b9f.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_15053505d942f87f4d47019385717b9f.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_fbd95a630099bcd507d463d1a0b3f558.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_f35294e02531f63e483133cd57a1ba15.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_fcbe8d0a6e73166a26f0e57d489b9d48.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_fcbe8d0a6e73166a26f0e57d489b9d48.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_9e535b23572d44cbebe0f1395af5ffdf.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_9e535b23572d44cbebe0f1395af5ffdf.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_9e535b23572d44cbebe0f1395af5ffdf.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_9e535b23572d44cbebe0f1395af5ffdf.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_200c5067011ee52b0d5a3b4f2090c68c.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_200c5067011ee52b0d5a3b4f2090c68c.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_200c5067011ee52b0d5a3b4f2090c68c.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_200c5067011ee52b0d5a3b4f2090c68c.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_395546147a7d931d56c8e303550fc721.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_395546147a7d931d56c8e303550fc721.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_f8eb8956502c5fef425043411a2299bc.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_889e079a74a56825f019f9c3f175c9f9.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_712c7f765cc5c1e15ff75c1fd64847e8.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_712c7f765cc5c1e15ff75c1fd64847e8.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_718f4a79cde70f33af5ec4d003c0847a.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_718f4a79cde70f33af5ec4d003c0847a.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_9f483316d8d4593222db565a1481642c.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_a9a0d779ec373a21aff92ff2ec44b926.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_a9a0d779ec373a21aff92ff2ec44b926.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_f084ea2fbca9537611adadfd16332857.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_f084ea2fbca9537611adadfd16332857.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_f084ea2fbca9537611adadfd16332857.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_f084ea2fbca9537611adadfd16332857.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_fad63bc6cd5c9eb6f5ecee665973d899.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_fad63bc6cd5c9eb6f5ecee665973d899.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_fad63bc6cd5c9eb6f5ecee665973d899.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_2f3dc11b7850f09b959617ea8ebe6e5e.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_2f3dc11b7850f09b959617ea8ebe6e5e.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_b7d203e6a8bf198c4bfa9ef432ef769a.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_b7d203e6a8bf198c4bfa9ef432ef769a.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_6a397b22c69be2009c4c55b56d73c27a.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_6a397b22c69be2009c4c55b56d73c27a.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_0662e434fa1efc10a3b42bd3b233d008.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_0662e434fa1efc10a3b42bd3b233d008.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_b62ab4b958905eaff898c651f056009c.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_b62ab4b958905eaff898c651f056009c.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_b62ab4b958905eaff898c651f056009c.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_b62ab4b958905eaff898c651f056009c.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_617f3fd1dda6910b6cab75700c6a72e8.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_617f3fd1dda6910b6cab75700c6a72e8.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_46b82bcb91a3a22a455626a0867c782c.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_46b82bcb91a3a22a455626a0867c782c.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_46b82bcb91a3a22a455626a0867c782c.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_46b82bcb91a3a22a455626a0867c782c.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_46b82bcb91a3a22a455626a0867c782c.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_2dfaa3a799e35e57d91841f102acab3c.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_2dfaa3a799e35e57d91841f102acab3c.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_2dfaa3a799e35e57d91841f102acab3c.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_2dfaa3a799e35e57d91841f102acab3c.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_791f150e2303a6c88003bfb27503fad9.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_791f150e2303a6c88003bfb27503fad9.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_791f150e2303a6c88003bfb27503fad9.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_791f150e2303a6c88003bfb27503fad9.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_f87f41ce5c03e0007a81b09274cff453.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_f87f41ce5c03e0007a81b09274cff453.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_20c9b171799b4c5629d8e081c033c469.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_cd99c43b9a67294375150bfaea9ea90d.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_a2f79c31b9c17fd6a267d7e7d8387f5c.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_a2f79c31b9c17fd6a267d7e7d8387f5c.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_926c7051e15f8529fdcb4a5bb4171bb0.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_7d6c53d7d64f727e3f34778375f82bbc.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_e322b54c688d673c86bf9e9d511f1154.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_e322b54c688d673c86bf9e9d511f1154.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_46ab0990dc303f52bf163d37d01e8786.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_46ab0990dc303f52bf163d37d01e8786.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_46ab0990dc303f52bf163d37d01e8786.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_46ab0990dc303f52bf163d37d01e8786.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_199810050b6c66a0f41cf364fdca23da.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_199810050b6c66a0f41cf364fdca23da.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_199810050b6c66a0f41cf364fdca23da.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_199810050b6c66a0f41cf364fdca23da.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_309c92b9c9708f076ce4d45add464aa3.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_309c92b9c9708f076ce4d45add464aa3.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_51d837b652d3a7c1d749f8e10b6947a9.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_51d837b652d3a7c1d749f8e10b6947a9.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_ea36395506bb6c4f8f55cebd4ddac9ce.translation: That boy always gets on my nerves.

sense_6dd3c01ba0a5e431c26f3b2a58528081.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_6dd3c01ba0a5e431c26f3b2a58528081.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_6dd3c01ba0a5e431c26f3b2a58528081.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_6dd3c01ba0a5e431c26f3b2a58528081.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_192610788cafc3c47bbea5ffc43e4459.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_192610788cafc3c47bbea5ffc43e4459.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_192610788cafc3c47bbea5ffc43e4459.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_a0997f7c11a1409a4b1d155bc93e9610.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_6f69e016dffeac45acf0f4e4e4c1ac05.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_d589c813df8e3dacee8dd81b093139c5.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_d589c813df8e3dacee8dd81b093139c5.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_d589c813df8e3dacee8dd81b093139c5.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_d589c813df8e3dacee8dd81b093139c5.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_d589c813df8e3dacee8dd81b093139c5.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_b0022b0a4d5cf483e1c1d44f3afc5965.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_b0022b0a4d5cf483e1c1d44f3afc5965.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_b0022b0a4d5cf483e1c1d44f3afc5965.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_b0022b0a4d5cf483e1c1d44f3afc5965.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_02dc385c2af92f4437ea50ac66a592db.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_b13fc79946d81903d43c6a65b2a9fe41.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_80cee8d2db79c6aab1a45c64c246ad0a.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_80cee8d2db79c6aab1a45c64c246ad0a.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_b0cb4a4b967faaeec0443b98969c2a7e.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_b0cb4a4b967faaeec0443b98969c2a7e.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_b0cb4a4b967faaeec0443b98969c2a7e.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_b0cb4a4b967faaeec0443b98969c2a7e.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_247c2707c521ecc077af5dd677206c3c.text: Começou a chover! Fecha as janelas!
sense_247c2707c521ecc077af5dd677206c3c.translation: It started raining! Shut the windows!

sense_247c2707c521ecc077af5dd677206c3c.text: Quando eu me sento à janela / P'los vidros qu'a neve embaça / Vejo a doce imagem d'ela / Quando passa… passa… passa…
sense_247c2707c521ecc077af5dd677206c3c.translation: When I sit at the window / I see through the panes clouded by snow / The sweet image of her / When (she) passes… passes… passes…

sense_b93dbca249d470c0c1cc257d2324cb7c.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_b93dbca249d470c0c1cc257d2324cb7c.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_bbbf4217a91f25f43d9e404618088ceb.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_2517c853720df80be31d341f15f09aea.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_2517c853720df80be31d341f15f09aea.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_f2778a3a8a89a41c7e3ade72140441ae.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_c6d113cb173e9a75b768a008be574e06.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_c6d113cb173e9a75b768a008be574e06.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_a4571327530236cb39004fbe4ad8a801.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_a4571327530236cb39004fbe4ad8a801.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_0d4a9ea71c379b8bc007573382624534.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_2564c56d5b4a2332528cd0e42354b3e5.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_2564c56d5b4a2332528cd0e42354b3e5.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_2564c56d5b4a2332528cd0e42354b3e5.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_2564c56d5b4a2332528cd0e42354b3e5.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_2564c56d5b4a2332528cd0e42354b3e5.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_2564c56d5b4a2332528cd0e42354b3e5.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_75a7788e902d0e267ebb38880dcbce55.text: Meu deus, que saco! Não posso fazer nada que você já vem brigar comigo!
sense_75a7788e902d0e267ebb38880dcbce55.translation: My goodness, that's so annoying! I can't do anything without you telling me off!

sense_3a214ea1fab19b2fc822c5a6f6d8a89f.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_3a214ea1fab19b2fc822c5a6f6d8a89f.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_0939fa2802d2d9bb8c44525fc9a039b7.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_0939fa2802d2d9bb8c44525fc9a039b7.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_0939fa2802d2d9bb8c44525fc9a039b7.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_0939fa2802d2d9bb8c44525fc9a039b7.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_f422707d725d831b6f9270e7352aed40.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_2e193753a229fa279e75f2b69f2ee009.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_2e193753a229fa279e75f2b69f2ee009.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_addcd7c163d72e12b6f9a8cfa69ec58e.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_addcd7c163d72e12b6f9a8cfa69ec58e.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_addcd7c163d72e12b6f9a8cfa69ec58e.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_addcd7c163d72e12b6f9a8cfa69ec58e.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_a79e29ebeb831f85caa2e14a51b072fc.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_a79e29ebeb831f85caa2e14a51b072fc.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_a79e29ebeb831f85caa2e14a51b072fc.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_a79e29ebeb831f85caa2e14a51b072fc.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_0f92edeb22c106a65ca291df07452c54.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_0f92edeb22c106a65ca291df07452c54.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_0f92edeb22c106a65ca291df07452c54.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_0f92edeb22c106a65ca291df07452c54.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_bbcd0bf0a00fd755a672ed0cd600b813.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_bbcd0bf0a00fd755a672ed0cd600b813.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_bbcd0bf0a00fd755a672ed0cd600b813.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_bbcd0bf0a00fd755a672ed0cd600b813.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_54ec57ea4e09bb3676c523685c4dcd42.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_54ec57ea4e09bb3676c523685c4dcd42.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_d5d8baac934c7d46836c0d48c25e8add.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_dabb414846b8be99de785544aa34404e.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_dabb414846b8be99de785544aa34404e.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?

sense_dabb414846b8be99de785544aa34404e.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_dabb414846b8be99de785544aa34404e.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_ce9e604586d575fb270e2a3d21d0908c.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
