sense_94dbc3a6f1c3ece7ffe97b95cfef65e3.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_94dbc3a6f1c3ece7ffe97b95cfef65e3.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_d6cf2e18a85baba0a0edfdd30346b6fa.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_d6cf2e18a85baba0a0edfdd30346b6fa.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_d6cf2e18a85baba0a0edfdd30346b6fa.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_d6cf2e18a85baba0a0edfdd30346b6fa.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_438e14946a064a3faeec15adebdafebf.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_438e14946a064a3faeec15adebdafebf.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_438e14946a064a3faeec15adebdafebf.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_ed7c37a980984dd2464b9399a831eaf1.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_ed7c37a980984dd2464b9399a831eaf1.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_9f173eb43c15bac1995e465e5b47b170.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_9f173eb43c15bac1995e465e5b47b170.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_40c6a5834aaea11c48ca4659a93c1156.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_40c6a5834aaea11c48ca4659a93c1156.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_40c6a5834aaea11c48ca4659a93c1156.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_40c6a5834aaea11c48ca4659a93c1156.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_8b282ed6efd1d6245e34da45faea4585.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_8b282ed6efd1d6245e34da45faea4585.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_e7e1b2d662ce301d28667afb063f24b0.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_e7e1b2d662ce301d28667afb063f24b0.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_e7e1b2d662ce301d28667afb063f24b0.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_e7e1b2d662ce301d28667afb063f24b0.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_6f6b608e5e53825d829b6f07312ce11d.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_6f6b608e5e53825d829b6f07312ce11d.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_812ea8f0e607673a9df6a2c66f828a86.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_812ea8f0e607673a9df6a2c66f828a86.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_c38b284b066f026cc794483528d4ab72.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_c38b284b066f026cc794483528d4ab72.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_918def0b5d1984dc33095be07793b16c.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_918def0b5d1984dc33095be07793b16c.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_918def0b5d1984dc33095be07793b16c.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_918def0b5d1984dc33095be07793b16c.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_2929aff959124dd43ac8356eaf17a52a.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_2929aff959124dd43ac8356eaf17a52a.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_79c9a6033740c16e794370a9a39b9c19.text: Será que os Androides Sonham com Ovelhas Elétricas?
sense_79c9a6033740c16e794370a9a39b9c19.translation: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
I had a dream about him.

sense_206862ae0dbed1705fd2cec6d1180436.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_206862ae0dbed1705fd2cec6d1180436.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_c1643dbddb078571875f5944b01ca208.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_c1643dbddb078571875f5944b01ca208.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_d4d80afdc868e9ec4352cce35926ed8c.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_1c503ba062edffccba3446e28ae86232.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_1c503ba062edffccba3446e28ae86232.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_2e1b713a5644db9fda36a094cc464b22.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_2e1b713a5644db9fda36a094cc464b22.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_2e1b713a5644db9fda36a094cc464b22.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_2e1b713a5644db9fda36a094cc464b22.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_741aa156a418b29c0ce4b2a1f8a1af5e.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_741aa156a418b29c0ce4b2a1f8a1af5e.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_741aa156a418b29c0ce4b2a1f8a1af5e.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_741aa156a418b29c0ce4b2a1f8a1af5e.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_732546e2c7f686db47c500761ce5efa0.text: Tu não consegues levantar o piano.
É algo que levantei do chão.
sense_732546e2c7f686db47c500761ce5efa0.translation: It’s something I lifted from the floor.

sense_00a1836814729e89f5e8348a067639b0.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_fb464e586480e8dfa90f9334bb8d8447.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_fb464e586480e8dfa90f9334bb8d8447.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_fb464e586480e8dfa90f9334bb8d8447.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_fb464e586480e8dfa90f9334bb8d8447.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_fb464e586480e8dfa90f9334bb8d8447.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_fb464e586480e8dfa90f9334bb8d8447.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_880a0a27f090395bd8d11a0c3016d5a5.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_38a19ebfd16fdffa94ea5261873bb52f.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_a1a6ccd505e3d34c678424853e9008fc.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_a1a6ccd505e3d34c678424853e9008fc.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_b97bf13d33908bb3c51a9e9b3fe86e64.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_b37b62c4a76cae56ff6c1313f588f480.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_b37b62c4a76cae56ff6c1313f588f480.translation: No one would suspect of him with that stupid look of his. It was actually a good thing to have a stupid look, they would never think it had been him.

sense_ab071f1a221fd6b1e8de7b275cdd8cff.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_ab071f1a221fd6b1e8de7b275cdd8cff.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_703dcee19321997d7f6c41afbcc7b702.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_703dcee19321997d7f6c41afbcc7b702.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_d2e7ba078ba1b11bca0299d07296e226.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_d2e7ba078ba1b11bca0299d07296e226.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_d2e7ba078ba1b11bca0299d07296e226.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_1143fbb5c664a4dfd75aa834e9086ffb.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_458bff9a76e77c6fcb9f955065377b1a.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_458bff9a76e77c6fcb9f955065377b1a.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_864115ad3ab4429bfb11dd077f66c7c9.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_864115ad3ab4429bfb11dd077f66c7c9.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_85055649acdcd79c8e892766b384ead5.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_85055649acdcd79c8e892766b384ead5.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_478edcd7466d147149f5b9d04cd877df.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_78d2191c118a688c7c833eaa7a7ca9d2.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_78d2191c118a688c7c833eaa7a7ca9d2.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_2e68fa001e40d8a116d131a790927a45.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_8b48a562ce65efc8268977e647dcaf7f.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_8b48a562ce65efc8268977e647dcaf7f.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_854ae001678a70ffe2ece6f5869fb18d.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_854ae001678a70ffe2ece6f5869fb18d.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_970065e35561e2ce5029575ba054e151.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_d37f7053cfc7cfef96cb439ea8189bbd.text: Quando tiver uma dúvida, vá à biblioteca.
sense_d37f7053cfc7cfef96cb439ea8189bbd.translation: When you are in doubt, go to the library.

sense_8bd92a39851b06a1d3d669caad313115.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_8bd92a39851b06a1d3d669caad313115.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_981728a29b76ee864e1c4fad618818a2.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_981728a29b76ee864e1c4fad618818a2.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_981728a29b76ee864e1c4fad618818a2.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_1f0eb01a4d8b4a6cdd2cec47c1a1cab8.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_1f0eb01a4d8b4a6cdd2cec47c1a1cab8.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_972ad6ae6c915b05866b5be9b7abc63e.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_972ad6ae6c915b05866b5be9b7abc63e.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_972ad6ae6c915b05866b5be9b7abc63e.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_972ad6ae6c915b05866b5be9b7abc63e.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_3c06ce9292646694e9f4f1f986e00846.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_3c06ce9292646694e9f4f1f986e00846.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_3c06ce9292646694e9f4f1f986e00846.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_3c06ce9292646694e9f4f1f986e00846.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_a7a6efb9775ed49e1907dfb64516e519.translation: The thieves cleaned out the house.

sense_51d9b154189ec4ff5a909a7ddc7895a1.text: Ela escreveu o livro inteiro sozinha.
sense_51d9b154189ec4ff5a909a7ddc7895a1.translation: She wrote the entire book by herself.

sense_398b9ff2cb00856360783f82b4608c5d.translation: Doctor, is it a boy or a girl?

sense_398b9ff2cb00856360783f82b4608c5d.text: Ela é minha menina / E eu sou o menino dela / Ela é o meu amor / E eu sou o amor todinho dela
sense_398b9ff2cb00856360783f82b4608c5d.translation: She is my girl / And I am her boy / She is my love / And I am her whole love.

sense_52136280ff7e0e9acea8e13c61f3be97.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_52136280ff7e0e9acea8e13c61f3be97.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_3dfd22442becbef3fac04feb82e2c4ec.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_3dfd22442becbef3fac04feb82e2c4ec.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_3dfd22442becbef3fac04feb82e2c4ec.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_9b22669e479febe33eac2cf532d85f6a.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_9b22669e479febe33eac2cf532d85f6a.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_45215551d0a7021077abf2c94b8f2242.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_45215551d0a7021077abf2c94b8f2242.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_f6a69c4c5df6316bbf752961f1569d46.text: Devolvam os vossos livros para a biblioteca agora!
sense_f6a69c4c5df6316bbf752961f1569d46.translation: Take your books back to the library now!

sense_f6a69c4c5df6316bbf752961f1569d46.text: Vocês não receberam as vossas indenizações?
sense_f6a69c4c5df6316bbf752961f1569d46.translation: Haven't you guys received your compensation?
Your parents are going to come here.

sense_f6a69c4c5df6316bbf752961f1569d46.text: Vós todos estais hoje perante o Senhor, vosso Deus: os cabeças de vossas tribos, vossos anciãos, os vossos oficiais, todo o homem de Israel, os vossos meninos, as vossas mulheres e o estrangeiro que está no meio do teu arraial; desde o rachador da tua lenha até ao tirador da tua água;
sense_f6a69c4c5df6316bbf752961f1569d46.translation: All of you stand today before the Lord, your God: the leaders of your tribes, your elders, your officers, every man of Israel, your children, your wives, and the foreigner who is in the midst of thy camp; from the cutter of thy wood to the drawer of thy water;

sense_4f8df4e911a386edb5a1fefc4da8b469.text: Vocês só conversam com os vossos.
sense_4f8df4e911a386edb5a1fefc4da8b469.translation: You guys only talk with your people.
Teach these doctrines to your flocks.

sense_bc15a5f2daefe232ec2582b2119dbdc9.text: Não tive lugar para terminar o serviço.
sense_bc15a5f2daefe232ec2582b2119dbdc9.translation: I didn’t have an opportunity to finish the job.

sense_1d86d3d75023017caa2fb2c2358dadd0.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_1d86d3d75023017caa2fb2c2358dadd0.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_1d86d3d75023017caa2fb2c2358dadd0.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_1d86d3d75023017caa2fb2c2358dadd0.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_a4a83cb27477a694c1da522d582bdaf7.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_feab45ca24ff6405378cd75ba2d1a357.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_feab45ca24ff6405378cd75ba2d1a357.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_c8c0c0e5f47dea9c57ceabe31d64cb0d.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_c8c0c0e5f47dea9c57ceabe31d64cb0d.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_ad0bfb54eb5ba8a7f286b296283a469b.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_f507b8b170a3bc914c4a6d0765a7ab1e.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_f507b8b170a3bc914c4a6d0765a7ab1e.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_f507b8b170a3bc914c4a6d0765a7ab1e.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_f507b8b170a3bc914c4a6d0765a7ab1e.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_59e9fcc2fa4c5a9f1dab1bb985925a20.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_59e9fcc2fa4c5a9f1dab1bb985925a20.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_59e9fcc2fa4c5a9f1dab1bb985925a20.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_59e9fcc2fa4c5a9f1dab1bb985925a20.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_e54d43968b3935fccbd3fcf90138686c.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_e54d43968b3935fccbd3fcf90138686c.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_432b62ee2546acd471f9bf848e30bbeb.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_432b62ee2546acd471f9bf848e30bbeb.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_432b62ee2546acd471f9bf848e30bbeb.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_432b62ee2546acd471f9bf848e30bbeb.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_432b62ee2546acd471f9bf848e30bbeb.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_432b62ee2546acd471f9bf848e30bbeb.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_c3eb4fe379890a87ee8715406828041a.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_c3eb4fe379890a87ee8715406828041a.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_c3eb4fe379890a87ee8715406828041a.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_c3eb4fe379890a87ee8715406828041a.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_83c6e4f5adda739b45b0ed8ffc3ef75c.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_696c94515e1090fcdde72c89cc02696c.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_696c94515e1090fcdde72c89cc02696c.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_696c94515e1090fcdde72c89cc02696c.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_696c94515e1090fcdde72c89cc02696c.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_28bacdee8bd5089ba4541d8aea3c6db7.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_28bacdee8bd5089ba4541d8aea3c6db7.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_28bacdee8bd5089ba4541d8aea3c6db7.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_28bacdee8bd5089ba4541d8aea3c6db7.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_004c16d9f72037f40f257a9178ea13b3.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_004c16d9f72037f40f257a9178ea13b3.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_79837a243e71b0a3f0806495582a0586.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_79837a243e71b0a3f0806495582a0586.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_f7a56ac22e63080ab56cac450405a579.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_f7a56ac22e63080ab56cac450405a579.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_2006b3e319e69627bbd94090b5b956bb.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_2006b3e319e69627bbd94090b5b956bb.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_2006b3e319e69627bbd94090b5b956bb.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_2006b3e319e69627bbd94090b5b956bb.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_a6a861f1196f8e4635d0ead93d5960c1.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_bc1e79b0713631cc2d94f3064486778e.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_bc1e79b0713631cc2d94f3064486778e.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_bc1e79b0713631cc2d94f3064486778e.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_bc1e79b0713631cc2d94f3064486778e.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_db46333a01df3ba157eb25c0ab06ceee.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_db46333a01df3ba157eb25c0ab06ceee.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_db46333a01df3ba157eb25c0ab06ceee.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_db46333a01df3ba157eb25c0ab06ceee.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_a49230c34ed78b89a32c2925872f38de.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_91eac180e6f11f8d2f0a5fc540b7c7f1.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_91eac180e6f11f8d2f0a5fc540b7c7f1.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_f0689bd79506d1b475afef29dc98c9d2.text: A rua está cheia de trânsito.

sense_b71fc03e1f19942efd334eebfaf3dbda.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_b71fc03e1f19942efd334eebfaf3dbda.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_3bd98fbe3c0d58858bb8ccf9e3325cb3.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_3bd98fbe3c0d58858bb8ccf9e3325cb3.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_3bd98fbe3c0d58858bb8ccf9e3325cb3.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_3bd98fbe3c0d58858bb8ccf9e3325cb3.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_1d12c20949121a6d4caac0d034c16064.text: Devolvam os vossos livros para a biblioteca agora!
sense_1d12c20949121a6d4caac0d034c16064.translation: Take your books back to the library now!

sense_1d12c20949121a6d4caac0d034c16064.text: Vocês não receberam as vossas indenizações?
sense_1d12c20949121a6d4caac0d034c16064.translation: Haven't you guys received your compensation?
Your parents are going to come here.

sense_1d12c20949121a6d4caac0d034c16064.text: Vós todos estais hoje perante o Senhor, vosso Deus: os cabeças de vossas tribos, vossos anciãos, os vossos oficiais, todo o homem de Israel, os vossos meninos, as vossas mulheres e o estrangeiro que está no meio do teu arraial; desde o rachador da tua lenha até ao tirador da tua água;
sense_1d12c20949121a6d4caac0d034c16064.translation: All of you stand today before the Lord, your God: the leaders of your tribes, your elders, your officers, every man of Israel, your children, your wives, and the foreigner who is in the midst of thy camp; from the cutter of thy wood to the drawer of thy water;

sense_80009822731e3d4d006c734fb538c356.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_80009822731e3d4d006c734fb538c356.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_9cd5ac4544cbe1d409321e74518370f9.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_9cd5ac4544cbe1d409321e74518370f9.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_7c847f0db00e1ca021b6f2d91710983b.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_d5716d7a7f11e0dd69ab75186102d8cd.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_d5716d7a7f11e0dd69ab75186102d8cd.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_d5716d7a7f11e0dd69ab75186102d8cd.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_d5716d7a7f11e0dd69ab75186102d8cd.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_3f2c9c3bd20ef19c29de53e127cf021f.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_3f2c9c3bd20ef19c29de53e127cf021f.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_3f2c9c3bd20ef19c29de53e127cf021f.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_3f2c9c3bd20ef19c29de53e127cf021f.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_a1bf5ed81404f8075a104d4b977ec190.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_a1bf5ed81404f8075a104d4b977ec190.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_9bc8e7080138fd15551b03b888211536.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_9bc8e7080138fd15551b03b888211536.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_c320092f0a2bb319a772b351a1430376.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_6bfefd866f799910f40f21f8a1ca0eaa.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_6bfefd866f799910f40f21f8a1ca0eaa.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_6bfefd866f799910f40f21f8a1ca0eaa.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_6bfefd866f799910f40f21f8a1ca0eaa.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_6bfefd866f799910f40f21f8a1ca0eaa.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_6bfefd866f799910f40f21f8a1ca0eaa.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_9788be9cd4391ab3b6e5429e987d4e90.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_9788be9cd4391ab3b6e5429e987d4e90.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_9788be9cd4391ab3b6e5429e987d4e90.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_9788be9cd4391ab3b6e5429e987d4e90.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_b52ddab8927ccf2d8bc6c45c0d549287.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_db98ce09466e6217d28e3ee82a3e6778.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_df0c0da9f701d7e1260442c0f32725d4.text: Memória sobre o Estabelecimento de Macau
sense_df0c0da9f701d7e1260442c0f32725d4.translation: Paper on the Establishment of Macao

sense_df0c0da9f701d7e1260442c0f32725d4.text: “Memórias Póstumas de Brás Cubas” é um obra literária de Machado de Assis
sense_df0c0da9f701d7e1260442c0f32725d4.translation: Posthumous Memoirs of Brás Cubas is a literary work by Machado de Assis

sense_85596e13c1be6a1246dd4e6523294b81.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_85596e13c1be6a1246dd4e6523294b81.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_7ec2a23e4426a8be03a19b95b0975a08.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_bb7d814113b0ffa72cd1b201f7219e26.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_bb7d814113b0ffa72cd1b201f7219e26.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_bb7d814113b0ffa72cd1b201f7219e26.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_bb7d814113b0ffa72cd1b201f7219e26.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_e73b57dd1e028fa491e36c410077d7b6.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_e73b57dd1e028fa491e36c410077d7b6.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_462cacceaab19c1a7b9c582fbf57e41a.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_462cacceaab19c1a7b9c582fbf57e41a.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_a04984d97ada0964bb4d2c2b40dd5cab.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_a04984d97ada0964bb4d2c2b40dd5cab.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_c22b18833e14539d4f9a6e248e1ccde3.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_c22b18833e14539d4f9a6e248e1ccde3.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_c22b18833e14539d4f9a6e248e1ccde3.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_c22b18833e14539d4f9a6e248e1ccde3.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_fb0bf9a09c82d2e46eb4cbb14a83edcb.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_fb0bf9a09c82d2e46eb4cbb14a83edcb.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_e20e226da3779d8632cdaef1bc123c13.text: O que é bom para gripe?
sense_e20e226da3779d8632cdaef1bc123c13.translation: What is good for the flu?
I have a message for you.

sense_86b40ef237c7d39d827dc29ce107fae4.text: A cor da banana mudou de amarelo para preto.
sense_86b40ef237c7d39d827dc29ce107fae4.translation: The colour of the banana changed from yellow to black.

sense_86b40ef237c7d39d827dc29ce107fae4.text: O valor da minha casa baixou para menos do que o que eu paguei.
sense_86b40ef237c7d39d827dc29ce107fae4.translation: The value of my house has fallen to less than what I paid.

sense_ffbc765f51b8bbb62178e7dc1878ec04.text: Ele podia ouvi-la se deslocando para a direita, para obter uma visão desimpedida dele.
sense_ffbc765f51b8bbb62178e7dc1878ec04.translation: He could hear her moving herself to the right, to obtain an unobstructed view of him.

sense_9c79aa1bb19f4ae703e8390f786db738.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_9c79aa1bb19f4ae703e8390f786db738.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_9c79aa1bb19f4ae703e8390f786db738.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_9c79aa1bb19f4ae703e8390f786db738.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_61928c833988adb609d3f0b9652bd623.translation: Hey man, where are you going?

sense_43c20c7ddcbe3f0dc15044660a4b2869.text: O Brasil é conhecido pelas suas praias arenosas.
sense_43c20c7ddcbe3f0dc15044660a4b2869.translation: Brazil is known for its sandy beaches.

sense_43c20c7ddcbe3f0dc15044660a4b2869.text: Mas os Mouros que andauão pela praya, / Por lhe defender a agoa deſejada, / Hum de eſcudo embarcado, & de azagaya, / Outro de arco encuruado, & ſeta eruada:[…]
sense_43c20c7ddcbe3f0dc15044660a4b2869.translation: But the Moors who were around the beach, / to defend its desired water, / one who was embarked with a shield and an assegai, / other with a recurve bow and poisoned arrow: […]

sense_75b7109c6123de1066022780c7de5a6e.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_75b7109c6123de1066022780c7de5a6e.translation: Then the smile reappeared in his face …

sense_75b7109c6123de1066022780c7de5a6e.text: Era difícil dizer se a professora os ouvira, pois seu rosto estava oculto pelas sombras.
sense_75b7109c6123de1066022780c7de5a6e.translation: It was difficult to tell whether the teacher had heard them, because her face was hidden by the shadows.

sense_a7a4209e0b06a1a65bf35a1bbb3f483c.text: Ele agora tem uma casa nas montanhas.
sense_a7a4209e0b06a1a65bf35a1bbb3f483c.translation: He now has a house in the mountains.

sense_3bbddbb2d7e8a44f1fe3236365dce421.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_6bd1895aba015f7b2f51daf0d80f632f.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_6bd1895aba015f7b2f51daf0d80f632f.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_708903490c6dd95c10a72dfcbe577ff8.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_708903490c6dd95c10a72dfcbe577ff8.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_10743d1edf7f23a5a168086e4ab80b82.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_35ffb154402a2c465e9154a1bb2e3004.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_35ffb154402a2c465e9154a1bb2e3004.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_a62d7c98f78de09628ab3b26b1db4e26.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_a62d7c98f78de09628ab3b26b1db4e26.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_a62d7c98f78de09628ab3b26b1db4e26.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_a62d7c98f78de09628ab3b26b1db4e26.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_e79545fb901f1cdcf018c23db4d6dca0.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_e79545fb901f1cdcf018c23db4d6dca0.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_f53521c5c9ecbd85d81af5d2e3bab2f1.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_f53521c5c9ecbd85d81af5d2e3bab2f1.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_f53521c5c9ecbd85d81af5d2e3bab2f1.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_f53521c5c9ecbd85d81af5d2e3bab2f1.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_85383cb8c7d0e9deefd0456e51661dbe.translation: to miss home, to feel homesick

sense_85383cb8c7d0e9deefd0456e51661dbe.text: E hoje, quando do sol a claridade / Forra o meu barracão, sinto saudade / Da mulher, pomba-rola que voou
sense_85383cb8c7d0e9deefd0456e51661dbe.translation: And today, when the sunlight covers my home, I miss the woman, the dove who flew away.

sense_78c9f28a43c399d21d7304a7b7381c11.text: Há um dedo de psicologia no atendimento ao cliente.
sense_78c9f28a43c399d21d7304a7b7381c11.translation: There is a hint of psychology in costumer service.
Add a small amount of sugar

sense_09afd8be8b9dbda9bbebee4aac50caaa.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_09afd8be8b9dbda9bbebee4aac50caaa.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_225f416133c4815528fa0257d06527f9.translation: The thieves cleaned out the house.

sense_4292f1a0d9719fafb21271428496df9d.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_4292f1a0d9719fafb21271428496df9d.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_4292f1a0d9719fafb21271428496df9d.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_4292f1a0d9719fafb21271428496df9d.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_4a0f0eb7a99646046a39b92cf3807e50.text: Chegamos a casa, pois agora troquemo-nos.
sense_4a0f0eb7a99646046a39b92cf3807e50.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_4cfefec89ae0e9f48bfa8cb08a353333.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.
sense_4cfefec89ae0e9f48bfa8cb08a353333.translation: I want to replace my car with a new one.
We have to replace the burnt-out lightbulbs.

sense_a5e7c4b0fbfd7a96b24a24d1273c42fd.text: Os boxeadores estão trocando socos na cabeça.
sense_a5e7c4b0fbfd7a96b24a24d1273c42fd.translation: The boxers are exchanging blows to their heads.

sense_a5e7c4b0fbfd7a96b24a24d1273c42fd.text: Todo dia eu trocava umas ideias com o vizinho.
sense_a5e7c4b0fbfd7a96b24a24d1273c42fd.translation: I used to chat with the neighbor every single day.

sense_d4ef6bec2d618a57e56fe81a4077826f.text: Troco um par de sapatos por uma blusa.
sense_d4ef6bec2d618a57e56fe81a4077826f.translation: I’ll exchange a pair of shoes for a blouse.

sense_d4ef6bec2d618a57e56fe81a4077826f.text: Eu e o meu primo trocamos livros.
sense_d4ef6bec2d618a57e56fe81a4077826f.translation: My cousin and I traded books.

sense_d4ef6bec2d618a57e56fe81a4077826f.text: O explorador trocou presentes com os nativos.
sense_d4ef6bec2d618a57e56fe81a4077826f.translation: The explorer exchanged gifts with the natives.

sense_5dcd0856e72d74df7a9f29e5d11936f9.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_5dcd0856e72d74df7a9f29e5d11936f9.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_7c7b63a73b73f1909b787d3ab4c53a27.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_c92e1ac761c18036886eb4d849814422.literal_meaning: I stranged your behavior a lot.
sense_c92e1ac761c18036886eb4d849814422.translation: I found your behaviour very strange.

sense_c92e1ac761c18036886eb4d849814422.text: — O jury? extranhei. O senhor também. Está visto. O senhor appellou?
sense_c92e1ac761c18036886eb4d849814422.translation: “The jury? I found it strange. You did too, sir. It’s clear. Did you appeal?”

sense_6cc66c10aa1b10c95414500c8407728e.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_6cc66c10aa1b10c95414500c8407728e.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_6cc66c10aa1b10c95414500c8407728e.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_6cc66c10aa1b10c95414500c8407728e.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_ea30260b87d860f51883778d9a04ad5a.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_ea30260b87d860f51883778d9a04ad5a.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_ea30260b87d860f51883778d9a04ad5a.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_ea30260b87d860f51883778d9a04ad5a.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_65c58d2a2154a8755661a1a37a38ccd7.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_65c58d2a2154a8755661a1a37a38ccd7.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_65c58d2a2154a8755661a1a37a38ccd7.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_65c58d2a2154a8755661a1a37a38ccd7.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_04bd8c2b183c297afd89cde6b0388d2f.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_04bd8c2b183c297afd89cde6b0388d2f.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_4c8efebb106ad04a89cfe61829a9ec0b.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_4c8efebb106ad04a89cfe61829a9ec0b.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_c0d47e8056ff448fed627821028557f6.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_c53095a495472a0f448f4fd5a302d6cf.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_c53095a495472a0f448f4fd5a302d6cf.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_c53095a495472a0f448f4fd5a302d6cf.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_c53095a495472a0f448f4fd5a302d6cf.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_c53095a495472a0f448f4fd5a302d6cf.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_c53095a495472a0f448f4fd5a302d6cf.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_301a8f4d40ec263c48f1866e7cdee937.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_3987aecea09e0529cd452e176c16a731.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_4556787d22b8ada20793d2cd8fdc6960.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_4556787d22b8ada20793d2cd8fdc6960.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_4556787d22b8ada20793d2cd8fdc6960.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_4556787d22b8ada20793d2cd8fdc6960.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_fc7417a2b0fadeb320a29d5b82d150d9.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_fc7417a2b0fadeb320a29d5b82d150d9.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_8b6a1e29681fdf895e4c4636cdf08fb2.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_8b6a1e29681fdf895e4c4636cdf08fb2.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_a5a08d8f1f75e652786afee63129e8d8.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_a5a08d8f1f75e652786afee63129e8d8.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_d7e3739f497e2790228f1176d0029d19.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_5f078b81c5f7aff5e9d4a610b7486cfa.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_609308209803cf8a4ae1b5b9baecab27.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_418fc99960ec6bf5a4e3807a441b624b.translation:
– Can we reach him?

sense_da0dd85ee96b76a5914fe4ec4132da2b.translation: […] , I feel that the pregnant trans man might constitute a new gender identity.

sense_da0dd85ee96b76a5914fe4ec4132da2b.text: […], que o cônjuge virago não está grávido ou, ao menos, que não têm conhecimento sobre tal condição.
