sense_d24f9f05322072de39c785828bf9446c.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_d24f9f05322072de39c785828bf9446c.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_10c1d20ff8abdfb531652bd6e60fdee0.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_10c1d20ff8abdfb531652bd6e60fdee0.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_d1b4fa3933349d3460aea8fc2bc9ff62.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_d1b4fa3933349d3460aea8fc2bc9ff62.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_d1b4fa3933349d3460aea8fc2bc9ff62.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_d1b4fa3933349d3460aea8fc2bc9ff62.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_f191f9c8567910849d8b796b84e95820.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_36d386ff25c35d8f768089cb3031c835.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_c008baeb32eaf709948d2e6187a4f1a0.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_c008baeb32eaf709948d2e6187a4f1a0.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_c008baeb32eaf709948d2e6187a4f1a0.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_c008baeb32eaf709948d2e6187a4f1a0.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_958327655f6216ec6693f7aa2a10b827.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_958327655f6216ec6693f7aa2a10b827.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_8b7236c5f9e1733adc3910c4d286c6ee.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_8b7236c5f9e1733adc3910c4d286c6ee.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_8b7236c5f9e1733adc3910c4d286c6ee.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_8b7236c5f9e1733adc3910c4d286c6ee.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_8b7236c5f9e1733adc3910c4d286c6ee.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_8b7236c5f9e1733adc3910c4d286c6ee.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_6ea88c2eb4df514ee3f447dfe4286a9b.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_6ea88c2eb4df514ee3f447dfe4286a9b.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_6ea88c2eb4df514ee3f447dfe4286a9b.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_6ea88c2eb4df514ee3f447dfe4286a9b.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_1524fc2a07a6735418841fa357c74b15.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_319fe8d01ee8de8fa525b327ff48ecfe.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_319fe8d01ee8de8fa525b327ff48ecfe.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_51834c034f746ad233e9342711612681.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_51834c034f746ad233e9342711612681.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_51834c034f746ad233e9342711612681.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_51834c034f746ad233e9342711612681.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_c3e42f2f420b7699baa7906d1a25d016.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_c3e42f2f420b7699baa7906d1a25d016.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_2345f09024e727cd65cb63fef8f71722.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_2345f09024e727cd65cb63fef8f71722.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_2345f09024e727cd65cb63fef8f71722.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_2345f09024e727cd65cb63fef8f71722.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_1c7290833b0e588fa3ffce7593149641.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_1c7290833b0e588fa3ffce7593149641.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_42ada7ef6e6dfc331382dc5feddfec66.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_42ada7ef6e6dfc331382dc5feddfec66.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_29cc51f028651064e6bc59e9ce2e63e3.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_29cc51f028651064e6bc59e9ce2e63e3.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_5179fe7210512c30f5b775a87e8d2b00.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_5179fe7210512c30f5b775a87e8d2b00.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_b56e8a77436bec27f555051317d22743.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_b56e8a77436bec27f555051317d22743.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_b56e8a77436bec27f555051317d22743.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_b56e8a77436bec27f555051317d22743.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_a4eb75d2a00c9e72e541cc399d06cf09.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_a4eb75d2a00c9e72e541cc399d06cf09.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_1e53822a4c5fd66803f56c266249d427.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_1e53822a4c5fd66803f56c266249d427.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_f5cb7cf253b5aa3fd8e44d4617d618e8.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_f5cb7cf253b5aa3fd8e44d4617d618e8.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_a11293ce4738c048ef69b62382b4198c.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_a11293ce4738c048ef69b62382b4198c.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_a11293ce4738c048ef69b62382b4198c.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_a11293ce4738c048ef69b62382b4198c.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_604ac657abc2263acde72774ce63fe78.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_604ac657abc2263acde72774ce63fe78.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_09f9c17fcace329b275833a85c6189af.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_a4abd8cbd473d96ea30bfa9234f3ac29.text: Estava andando quando notei uma moeda no chão.
sense_a4abd8cbd473d96ea30bfa9234f3ac29.translation: I was walking when I noticed a coin on the floor.

sense_a4abd8cbd473d96ea30bfa9234f3ac29.text: Notem que a porta está fechada.
sense_a4abd8cbd473d96ea30bfa9234f3ac29.translation: Notice that the door is closed.

sense_a4abd8cbd473d96ea30bfa9234f3ac29.text: Ela não foi a única a notar.
sense_a4abd8cbd473d96ea30bfa9234f3ac29.translation: She was not the only one to notice.

sense_665c1f068bf145e8064119609a569d30.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_665c1f068bf145e8064119609a569d30.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_665c1f068bf145e8064119609a569d30.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_665c1f068bf145e8064119609a569d30.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_23692319ea29c5019f0ecadc58101484.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_23692319ea29c5019f0ecadc58101484.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_a7587315bd345592eb816bc699120ea2.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_a7587315bd345592eb816bc699120ea2.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_a7587315bd345592eb816bc699120ea2.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_a7587315bd345592eb816bc699120ea2.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_06380f5f096c51850b02a6776e1a710c.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_06380f5f096c51850b02a6776e1a710c.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_e77a0502131153624b0b7fcea2bed18f.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_e77a0502131153624b0b7fcea2bed18f.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_e77a0502131153624b0b7fcea2bed18f.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_e77a0502131153624b0b7fcea2bed18f.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_28246137e23711e926ad5dde68cd5c48.text: Não me importo que você venha.
sense_28246137e23711e926ad5dde68cd5c48.translation: I don't care whether you come.

sense_70d4b5e9904b1378a0e18df263619959.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_70d4b5e9904b1378a0e18df263619959.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_70d4b5e9904b1378a0e18df263619959.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_70d4b5e9904b1378a0e18df263619959.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_70d4b5e9904b1378a0e18df263619959.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_70d4b5e9904b1378a0e18df263619959.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_2fd2a752773a6263bcab6ac79df3a317.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_2fd2a752773a6263bcab6ac79df3a317.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_2fd2a752773a6263bcab6ac79df3a317.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_2fd2a752773a6263bcab6ac79df3a317.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_fbe0618f4897eca9e0dcaf657e02d355.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_b8a257935cb471a37a0e5cff0db94896.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_b8a257935cb471a37a0e5cff0db94896.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_b8a257935cb471a37a0e5cff0db94896.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_b8a257935cb471a37a0e5cff0db94896.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_c06c1b152925b01f1067dc70d4ba9568.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_c06c1b152925b01f1067dc70d4ba9568.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_a19d829b0e041039a108d888bcc3c267.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_a19d829b0e041039a108d888bcc3c267.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_a19d829b0e041039a108d888bcc3c267.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_a19d829b0e041039a108d888bcc3c267.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_0395d86ad9b631902a523b832e4d8947.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_0395d86ad9b631902a523b832e4d8947.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_aed3366145172273d16736a3f4b7cd03.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_aed3366145172273d16736a3f4b7cd03.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_eb4e382330df6fa7c6bf6944817d2eac.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_eb4e382330df6fa7c6bf6944817d2eac.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_764acce34a0dec26ff2a73bf5c72c673.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_764acce34a0dec26ff2a73bf5c72c673.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_764acce34a0dec26ff2a73bf5c72c673.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_764acce34a0dec26ff2a73bf5c72c673.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_764acce34a0dec26ff2a73bf5c72c673.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_764acce34a0dec26ff2a73bf5c72c673.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_f522503ffc16226074d421d789d4162c.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_0344343ff6e27f0bc4bbf3ea97a231ee.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_0344343ff6e27f0bc4bbf3ea97a231ee.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_bd0eddbe1c2dce339699cf358bf2d576.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_ea1b31901fe258805e5b2250694b1bde.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_ea1b31901fe258805e5b2250694b1bde.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_171ca15c3ec75039e30cc60a7c6cc59a.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_171ca15c3ec75039e30cc60a7c6cc59a.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_9976d3f6cfc4def05186e3dee6308d3f.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_79e1de5df6046f203fd26b492c6c324f.text: Se ela chegar, avise o diretor, por favor.
sense_79e1de5df6046f203fd26b492c6c324f.translation: If she arrives, inform the director, please.

sense_79e1de5df6046f203fd26b492c6c324f.text: Se precisar de mais papel verde, me avisa.
sense_79e1de5df6046f203fd26b492c6c324f.translation: If you need more green paper, let me know.

sense_e7f3396a996b15315804362c5ac03690.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_e7f3396a996b15315804362c5ac03690.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_e7f3396a996b15315804362c5ac03690.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_e7f3396a996b15315804362c5ac03690.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_15f1d099752ab2c0b2e351aad2a3ad34.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_15f1d099752ab2c0b2e351aad2a3ad34.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_15f1d099752ab2c0b2e351aad2a3ad34.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_15f1d099752ab2c0b2e351aad2a3ad34.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_7559dea09cfaebfe9b8c2a8f8b5fafe3.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_7559dea09cfaebfe9b8c2a8f8b5fafe3.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_2d9dbf6f050abba414907c4aaef25770.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_2d9dbf6f050abba414907c4aaef25770.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_2d9dbf6f050abba414907c4aaef25770.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_2d9dbf6f050abba414907c4aaef25770.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_f4d7f0c795e36484d8833a50143c5a51.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_f4d7f0c795e36484d8833a50143c5a51.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_cdac033e0fdb37390526ed54b6475fcc.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_cdac033e0fdb37390526ed54b6475fcc.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_ae947f4c8eaf02c046efe96376f24b87.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_ae947f4c8eaf02c046efe96376f24b87.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_3d15d73cdd25b63bbd3605c9cad28dc4.text: Suas ameaças não me dão medo!

sense_cdc9e5e162a67cbce8cd2ff4aef52e4d.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_cdc9e5e162a67cbce8cd2ff4aef52e4d.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_cdc9e5e162a67cbce8cd2ff4aef52e4d.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_cdc9e5e162a67cbce8cd2ff4aef52e4d.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_cdc9e5e162a67cbce8cd2ff4aef52e4d.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_cdc9e5e162a67cbce8cd2ff4aef52e4d.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_6da84deb0167b8090a17e581d53d28bf.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_6da84deb0167b8090a17e581d53d28bf.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_6da84deb0167b8090a17e581d53d28bf.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_6da84deb0167b8090a17e581d53d28bf.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_c12ce82f28f32dd0fe51906082193425.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_72524c33acee7259ca7f603f40b8306c.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_72524c33acee7259ca7f603f40b8306c.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_72524c33acee7259ca7f603f40b8306c.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_72524c33acee7259ca7f603f40b8306c.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_799b0c60899431cb949c9cf4a6cc22ff.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_799b0c60899431cb949c9cf4a6cc22ff.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_7a999dc17a6102252559df1ba8bd017a.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_7a999dc17a6102252559df1ba8bd017a.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_7a999dc17a6102252559df1ba8bd017a.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_2e1e515b58ac687aa47d13dcc2dfffeb.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_2e1e515b58ac687aa47d13dcc2dfffeb.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_2e1e515b58ac687aa47d13dcc2dfffeb.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_2e1e515b58ac687aa47d13dcc2dfffeb.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_f173205ac8caff11fe18dc6afc687ffb.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_f173205ac8caff11fe18dc6afc687ffb.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_7dab9ceda4e1042b64f0f7066ae5cc4e.text: Sobrou pouca comida e menos vinho.
sense_7dab9ceda4e1042b64f0f7066ae5cc4e.translation: Little food was left and less wine.

sense_146c72822152ead82bced8d83d4003d8.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_bd1cc93a3c5225998f0132605ec9ac7b.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_3c719442748bba2ef376c20cd555c7f8.text: Eu moro na rua da Igreja.
Olha para os dois lados antes de atravessar a rua.
sense_3c719442748bba2ef376c20cd555c7f8.translation: Look both ways before you cross the street.

sense_a615472fd1ae52a39cfa21b785f30c50.text: Eu gosto de café com leite e açúcar.
sense_a615472fd1ae52a39cfa21b785f30c50.translation: I like coffee with milk and sugar.

sense_b87e389da397c8ca322c01873b675dc4.translation: Cum for me, you naughty boy.

sense_b87e389da397c8ca322c01873b675dc4.text: Sempre que gozo dentro eu me sinto profano / Ela sorri e fala, "Baco eu te amo / Se lembre, você é humano / 'Cê é forte, aguente o dano"
sense_b87e389da397c8ca322c01873b675dc4.translation: Whenever I cum inside, I feel profane / She smiles and says, "Baco, I love you / Remember, you're human / You're strong, withstand the pain"

sense_66e8eadd365d8b51da63c87a8250d07b.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_66e8eadd365d8b51da63c87a8250d07b.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_66e8eadd365d8b51da63c87a8250d07b.text: O Fado nasceu um dia, / quando o vento mal bulia / e o céu o mar prolongava, / na amurada dum veleiro, / no peito dum marinheiro / que, estando triste, cantava.
sense_66e8eadd365d8b51da63c87a8250d07b.translation: Fado was born one day, / when the wind was blowing hard / and the sky was extending the sea, / in the bulwark of a ship, / in the chest of a sailor / who, being sad, was singing.

sense_66e8eadd365d8b51da63c87a8250d07b.text: Então continuaram a estudar enquanto o céu lá fora se tornava gradualmente mais escuro.
sense_66e8eadd365d8b51da63c87a8250d07b.translation: Then they continued to study while the sky outside was becoming gradually darker.

sense_5e0026510dc3b7db3ee43518fc9f393f.text: Como é bom ir para o céo! Nunca mais hei-de ter frio!
sense_5e0026510dc3b7db3ee43518fc9f393f.translation: It feels so good to go to heaven! I’ll never feel cold again!

sense_0d82682b7c5024a294c6265db6629608.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_0d82682b7c5024a294c6265db6629608.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_0d82682b7c5024a294c6265db6629608.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_0d82682b7c5024a294c6265db6629608.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_c60d91caecc21191723e047974801e94.text: Em 22 de janeiro de 1968, ocorreu o vôo da Apollo 5.

sense_cd1f31153e0c2284e36a79cad92b3dc6.text: Estava andando quando notei uma moeda no chão.
sense_cd1f31153e0c2284e36a79cad92b3dc6.translation: I was walking when I noticed a coin on the floor.

sense_cd1f31153e0c2284e36a79cad92b3dc6.text: Notem que a porta está fechada.
sense_cd1f31153e0c2284e36a79cad92b3dc6.translation: Notice that the door is closed.

sense_cd1f31153e0c2284e36a79cad92b3dc6.text: Ela não foi a única a notar.
sense_cd1f31153e0c2284e36a79cad92b3dc6.translation: She was not the only one to notice.

sense_4af70c8b126f9106f7dbf82289f994e1.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_4af70c8b126f9106f7dbf82289f994e1.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_4af70c8b126f9106f7dbf82289f994e1.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_4af70c8b126f9106f7dbf82289f994e1.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_351edd967a6f1cc63885292c238fd596.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_351edd967a6f1cc63885292c238fd596.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_0c9638e68229401c6717233677c34726.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_0c9638e68229401c6717233677c34726.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_0c9638e68229401c6717233677c34726.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_0c9638e68229401c6717233677c34726.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_3ad7481852c694cbd459d293be1e788e.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_3ad7481852c694cbd459d293be1e788e.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_3ad7481852c694cbd459d293be1e788e.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_b1ac09d30e2f68221d67f96cb0cf309f.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_b1ac09d30e2f68221d67f96cb0cf309f.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_7d20c19de3c41d59e5598284d09e5fda.text: A fala dele é sempre arrastada assim?
sense_7d20c19de3c41d59e5598284d09e5fda.translation: Is his pronunciation always so slurred?

sense_7d20c19de3c41d59e5598284d09e5fda.text: Meu pai sempre tem a fala grave.
sense_7d20c19de3c41d59e5598284d09e5fda.translation: My father always has a serious tone.

sense_545095ab3002eeac332240208c6556e4.text: É importante analisar a fala da personagem.
sense_545095ab3002eeac332240208c6556e4.translation: It is important to analyse what the character said.

sense_545095ab3002eeac332240208c6556e4.text: Justo na hora de sua apresentação, ele esqueceu sua fala.
sense_545095ab3002eeac332240208c6556e4.translation: Right at the time of his presentation, he forgot his line.

sense_642442c86c514b2c99bd9d1b3bbec69e.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_642442c86c514b2c99bd9d1b3bbec69e.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_642442c86c514b2c99bd9d1b3bbec69e.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_642442c86c514b2c99bd9d1b3bbec69e.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_8f1f4c34499cb6a658046b910d75eed0.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_8f1f4c34499cb6a658046b910d75eed0.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_5069e05f7b5770851149eac962adc7a7.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_5069e05f7b5770851149eac962adc7a7.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_a75fc6bd06a8fc3f4d6da89cb843281a.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_f3ca5c94923eba7d954c4ab51b4d2cc2.text: Minha perna doía tanto que eu não conseguia andar.
sense_f3ca5c94923eba7d954c4ab51b4d2cc2.translation: My leg was hurting so much that I couldn’t walk.

sense_5d481f168b516a0a5057b177acf3b8ab.text: Este livro é maior do que aquele.
sense_5d481f168b516a0a5057b177acf3b8ab.translation: This book is bigger than that one.

sense_d940bef6d2353cc202dcd22e6947f8b3.text: O Grande Porto é uma região metropolitana no norte de Portugal.
sense_d940bef6d2353cc202dcd22e6947f8b3.translation: Greater Porto is a metropolitan area in the north of Portugal.
I live in the metropolis of Lisbon.

sense_4a434c249f7fe3ec4efcba0ae681628f.text: A TV não está ligada na tomada.
sense_4a434c249f7fe3ec4efcba0ae681628f.translation: The TV is not plugged in (lit.: not linked in the socket).

sense_4a434c249f7fe3ec4efcba0ae681628f.text: De acordo com o documento, o governador está ligado ao esquema de corrupção.
sense_4a434c249f7fe3ec4efcba0ae681628f.translation: According to the report, the governor is linked to the corruption scheme.

sense_d8a591d5fb48f748af4e462247081e08.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_d8a591d5fb48f748af4e462247081e08.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_077d046d5b816341799de9caeed4163a.text: Procurei as chaves por todo o lado. Chapéu!
sense_077d046d5b816341799de9caeed4163a.translation: I looked for the keys everywhere. They are gone!

sense_077d046d5b816341799de9caeed4163a.text: Combinei com ele às 16h e chapéu! Não apareceu.
sense_077d046d5b816341799de9caeed4163a.translation: I agreed to meet him at 4 pm, and bam! nothing! He didn't show up.

sense_ba715368f9bf0032f75e3d14709f3ed3.text: Ele perdeu tanto sangue que morreu.
sense_ba715368f9bf0032f75e3d14709f3ed3.translation: He lost so much blood that he died.

sense_68c3a015c4f23aca6d8da344418532f7.text: A mercadoria foi entregue em dois tantos.
sense_68c3a015c4f23aca6d8da344418532f7.translation: The wares were delivered in two portions.
I ate a bit of pie.

sense_127cfa581510a98e8b6b69d2ecd38fd4.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_127cfa581510a98e8b6b69d2ecd38fd4.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_54e83abef7df6d523e833957c96409f4.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_a0fcf1203807bce2df7cdf47f65ea76c.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_a0fcf1203807bce2df7cdf47f65ea76c.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_d7789efe6accfacfe8bfbd0efe263ed7.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_d7789efe6accfacfe8bfbd0efe263ed7.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_d7789efe6accfacfe8bfbd0efe263ed7.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_d7789efe6accfacfe8bfbd0efe263ed7.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_b48435414313ad3034003a8928065e8f.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_b48435414313ad3034003a8928065e8f.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_b48435414313ad3034003a8928065e8f.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_b48435414313ad3034003a8928065e8f.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_16282336010e7613d979501791060230.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_16282336010e7613d979501791060230.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_31033912e623c26063d6901396626982.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_501aeddb552d5e5c7a56b9a7be1d19e7.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_501aeddb552d5e5c7a56b9a7be1d19e7.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_b47ef8bcdcb269fc442f53dbe3f804d5.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_b47ef8bcdcb269fc442f53dbe3f804d5.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_b47ef8bcdcb269fc442f53dbe3f804d5.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_b47ef8bcdcb269fc442f53dbe3f804d5.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_0f1835fa6036fad813092629d16c6abc.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_0f1835fa6036fad813092629d16c6abc.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_f8ab64ddc69ac8b5c2567abc3aa0da01.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_f8ab64ddc69ac8b5c2567abc3aa0da01.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_f8ab64ddc69ac8b5c2567abc3aa0da01.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_f8ab64ddc69ac8b5c2567abc3aa0da01.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_e9b227430d36b5512d7164eff8131407.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_e9b227430d36b5512d7164eff8131407.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_e9b227430d36b5512d7164eff8131407.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_e9b227430d36b5512d7164eff8131407.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_08601c99f190f39223e7484e5baaa131.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_08601c99f190f39223e7484e5baaa131.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_08601c99f190f39223e7484e5baaa131.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_08601c99f190f39223e7484e5baaa131.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_de22a9e68d1f5ccdf30463d90e602af9.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_de22a9e68d1f5ccdf30463d90e602af9.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_2c848f06ab2e7e7e710640dfcbb8da4e.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_2c848f06ab2e7e7e710640dfcbb8da4e.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_112b3bd9a7b6f5d3c314d0f667288304.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_112b3bd9a7b6f5d3c314d0f667288304.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_112b3bd9a7b6f5d3c314d0f667288304.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_112b3bd9a7b6f5d3c314d0f667288304.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_ebba0f26502529f8e3b2431e50dbcaf2.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_ebba0f26502529f8e3b2431e50dbcaf2.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_32cc63e8210dc7bfdd59acbb11f42fbd.text: Eu temo o dia em que ninguém more mais aqui.
sense_32cc63e8210dc7bfdd59acbb11f42fbd.translation: I fear the day no one lives here any more.

sense_73e809f4900e0d23c71ea412e2d35229.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_73e809f4900e0d23c71ea412e2d35229.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_73e809f4900e0d23c71ea412e2d35229.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_73e809f4900e0d23c71ea412e2d35229.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_73e809f4900e0d23c71ea412e2d35229.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_73e809f4900e0d23c71ea412e2d35229.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_8cafee1d85c44f46d2c72969f92c8139.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_8cafee1d85c44f46d2c72969f92c8139.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_70ec6581de17323300a2480a37e12df9.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_70ec6581de17323300a2480a37e12df9.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_70ec6581de17323300a2480a37e12df9.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_70ec6581de17323300a2480a37e12df9.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_5e3869af48d4542af5566c9757fa203f.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_5e3869af48d4542af5566c9757fa203f.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_fd09c1ee332b910630afc9c43df991a0.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_fd09c1ee332b910630afc9c43df991a0.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_2a4f19c00b4e81f487718d840f713bc4.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_7e63c0c2f10b1e7443eff01864d2c2ff.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_7e63c0c2f10b1e7443eff01864d2c2ff.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_9dc8bcc3f02fd009f95df1c04c300269.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_9dc8bcc3f02fd009f95df1c04c300269.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_9dc8bcc3f02fd009f95df1c04c300269.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_9dc8bcc3f02fd009f95df1c04c300269.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_70c4aa3df7cb1f60b817571c443be656.text: Tu não consegues levantar o piano.
É algo que levantei do chão.
sense_70c4aa3df7cb1f60b817571c443be656.translation: It’s something I lifted from the floor.

sense_c771b6e093c7c25d90f91d7faa1fc783.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_c771b6e093c7c25d90f91d7faa1fc783.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_0d2c2d3e9b36c8c324aac2657552c55d.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_0d2c2d3e9b36c8c324aac2657552c55d.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_0d2c2d3e9b36c8c324aac2657552c55d.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_0d2c2d3e9b36c8c324aac2657552c55d.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_9f44d810e5f99b33d9c92cb9b8c31c88.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_9f44d810e5f99b33d9c92cb9b8c31c88.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_9f44d810e5f99b33d9c92cb9b8c31c88.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_9f44d810e5f99b33d9c92cb9b8c31c88.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_4a086270675141dce5913ffbc2d071e3.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_4a086270675141dce5913ffbc2d071e3.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_4d41293e0b7e23b72311cded03498ef1.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_1de8e5a4f442910cb1015a3e76e17820.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_1de8e5a4f442910cb1015a3e76e17820.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_315b5bf88dadea7eca2c0da2220348f2.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_315b5bf88dadea7eca2c0da2220348f2.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_df36456d8c89abd84269f65306da29b9.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_df36456d8c89abd84269f65306da29b9.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_ea5f3bd6759846086c4bd6b18013b1d0.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_ea5f3bd6759846086c4bd6b18013b1d0.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_ea5f3bd6759846086c4bd6b18013b1d0.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_ea5f3bd6759846086c4bd6b18013b1d0.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_11a9a7259003858c255cb6495eb23cfa.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_13d474bc358114c563917d707ea9e7ae.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_13d474bc358114c563917d707ea9e7ae.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_ef1283e43f49f24b1c775911878c2054.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_ef1283e43f49f24b1c775911878c2054.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_ef1283e43f49f24b1c775911878c2054.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_ef1283e43f49f24b1c775911878c2054.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_a3a848b36cefd78dc280dd4de693e3a8.text: Perseverança é a melhor amiga do conhecimento.

sense_884feb149035f666e89e33ef9d23766e.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_fa8ae761d365ed409bf6eb0f446c2b6f.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_fa8ae761d365ed409bf6eb0f446c2b6f.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_2c4d1b3f0a296cd86676e6f2673f8aa6.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_05defb1579ed620fa0224120b7a54fc2.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_05defb1579ed620fa0224120b7a54fc2.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_bd4d12e1b8ec8424c6d112a728d2fdbb.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_bd4d12e1b8ec8424c6d112a728d2fdbb.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_3f1c933cba0476fef8fae0c1b2838eb1.translation: We need to win the competition.
It is not important to win.

sense_05930157e1dcec3d0100ebf0bbf6ee3a.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_05930157e1dcec3d0100ebf0bbf6ee3a.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_f11656ca71c6e2957af544d7408ffaf2.text: O que eu vi é esse mesmo.
sense_f11656ca71c6e2957af544d7408ffaf2.translation: The one I saw is this one indeed.

sense_f11656ca71c6e2957af544d7408ffaf2.text: O cidadão mesmo que o prendeu.

sense_bf3612363634e6b3e960c2adf20eed87.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.

sense_64334f5fa51f046d5c8f080510608fca.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_64334f5fa51f046d5c8f080510608fca.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_64334f5fa51f046d5c8f080510608fca.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_966605e4d07346c3b48b2dda107dcf90.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_e7a01b9d190fc8ed285ff5f4428195e4.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_e7a01b9d190fc8ed285ff5f4428195e4.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_18e70e7dbb3959cb9ba85a3a57924beb.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_20d422edcafaa39a0785791c4f785687.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_20d422edcafaa39a0785791c4f785687.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_20d422edcafaa39a0785791c4f785687.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_20d422edcafaa39a0785791c4f785687.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_f193c544de6a41f49d1bdf9746923253.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_4ff2aa9fb2b9d493b5c01fa4859328cf.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_14f427c98f02a161f1a29348e5182bcf.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_f70564242c529e3cf038a5890967d3b7.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_1e95987f6a99500f56b497a800a6b5f7.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_d3439de1cb2629c40e6eb2ad0467cfd3.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.

sense_624a41775a585f6a02bbc70e9ad2b380.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_624a41775a585f6a02bbc70e9ad2b380.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_de41d8917c254092e7ceeb74e2fc7ffd.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_de41d8917c254092e7ceeb74e2fc7ffd.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_de41d8917c254092e7ceeb74e2fc7ffd.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_435f984069a7c479d05b89cdf6293ac7.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_1379754a864c925525dd50d401123b3a.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_1379754a864c925525dd50d401123b3a.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_92ff7e5e23b3fb90e8ceda5b028537d8.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_92ff7e5e23b3fb90e8ceda5b028537d8.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_92ff7e5e23b3fb90e8ceda5b028537d8.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_92ff7e5e23b3fb90e8ceda5b028537d8.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_c2c0f9af91ecf64d519ebf89e1d11db5.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_8a35e938f4cafd16d68f85db62783dc2.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_8a35e938f4cafd16d68f85db62783dc2.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_8a35e938f4cafd16d68f85db62783dc2.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_8a35e938f4cafd16d68f85db62783dc2.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_8b8453fc63dfbe02bb7e456aaaa5bb87.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_8b8453fc63dfbe02bb7e456aaaa5bb87.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_8b8453fc63dfbe02bb7e456aaaa5bb87.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_8b8453fc63dfbe02bb7e456aaaa5bb87.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_dccc66db71ba43d0b30b9b89bcb140a9.translation: Please take care of our dog while we're away.

sense_dccc66db71ba43d0b30b9b89bcb140a9.text: A cachorra Baleia corria na frente, o focinho arregaçado, procurando na catinga a novilha raposa.
sense_dccc66db71ba43d0b30b9b89bcb140a9.translation: Baleia the dog [doggess] ran ahead, her snout up high, looking for the young fox in the caatinga.

sense_a45d0692503727f5c6cf3eb1ec8b2ca5.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_f34a43da1ea9f3ad4a1baac975c3df82.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_f34a43da1ea9f3ad4a1baac975c3df82.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_6a7dc4ba9df8e495d419bcf8d0dc3cce.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_6a7dc4ba9df8e495d419bcf8d0dc3cce.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_6a7dc4ba9df8e495d419bcf8d0dc3cce.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_6a7dc4ba9df8e495d419bcf8d0dc3cce.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_d1d152a0fa0b323a4a4352b7e146dbd6.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_d1d152a0fa0b323a4a4352b7e146dbd6.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_c31d4f6fed597d7a57b33cb061ba73a5.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_c31d4f6fed597d7a57b33cb061ba73a5.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_c31d4f6fed597d7a57b33cb061ba73a5.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_d5731de8e5bf8e5b7a26ab40374c5cc9.translation: There was an accident in the highway.

sense_7508431b7d17d064452298d8734ae756.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_7508431b7d17d064452298d8734ae756.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_0e6cf1c42ddb006a06d164a4afc8b4b8.text: Chegamos a casa, pois agora troquemo-nos.
sense_0e6cf1c42ddb006a06d164a4afc8b4b8.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_dd577366050bd94885e41fe2015dbc85.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.

sense_31cc08130667dcf3652154b84c2f7d5f.translation: I’ll exchange a pair of shoes for a blouse.

sense_4e7868681247b7c2b2019fca6bc7b10b.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_4e7868681247b7c2b2019fca6bc7b10b.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_4e7868681247b7c2b2019fca6bc7b10b.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_a98f1bc29b582df1b81d99a78fa6b72f.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_a98f1bc29b582df1b81d99a78fa6b72f.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_a98f1bc29b582df1b81d99a78fa6b72f.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_c9fc7a4bb53e774a5f8c687f89ee460d.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_b38ccee42fec89b9a3f382bc9c951c52.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_004257c6f16b07111d87c55205e592b5.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_004257c6f16b07111d87c55205e592b5.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_004257c6f16b07111d87c55205e592b5.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_004257c6f16b07111d87c55205e592b5.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_004257c6f16b07111d87c55205e592b5.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_004257c6f16b07111d87c55205e592b5.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_11477f4b2c839d8ded18253c039927a3.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_11477f4b2c839d8ded18253c039927a3.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_11477f4b2c839d8ded18253c039927a3.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_11477f4b2c839d8ded18253c039927a3.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_5d307ad775f0d341a420751cdd0a8ee6.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_eb555d084285faab988012fe9dd74507.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_eaf4710eed84f2d5982c1d2628f28721.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_eaf4710eed84f2d5982c1d2628f28721.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_6937b3761b2e3ebd2eb133339fed1d95.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_6937b3761b2e3ebd2eb133339fed1d95.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_5278b762a61e3c9d0a5de92f667608cd.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_5278b762a61e3c9d0a5de92f667608cd.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_5278b762a61e3c9d0a5de92f667608cd.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_f4aeac7c0f280d50d08f004069bf32dd.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_f4aeac7c0f280d50d08f004069bf32dd.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_7228975c7704f0878fb077719f42884b.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_7228975c7704f0878fb077719f42884b.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_4ab921227cf41aa15950cec4c4465db9.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_4ab921227cf41aa15950cec4c4465db9.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_4ab921227cf41aa15950cec4c4465db9.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_4ab921227cf41aa15950cec4c4465db9.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.
