sense_0e0a198a0e25f4416068fcdd531c6374.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_0e0a198a0e25f4416068fcdd531c6374.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_0e0a198a0e25f4416068fcdd531c6374.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_76c2a4d425ca3cf0b741fc2024899a53.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_76c2a4d425ca3cf0b741fc2024899a53.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_76c2a4d425ca3cf0b741fc2024899a53.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_76c2a4d425ca3cf0b741fc2024899a53.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_7d51dd07b9970204f1f11c7b06d2fa98.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_7d51dd07b9970204f1f11c7b06d2fa98.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_3789d5e6a1ca493481617842c24e3af4.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_3789d5e6a1ca493481617842c24e3af4.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_3789d5e6a1ca493481617842c24e3af4.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_3789d5e6a1ca493481617842c24e3af4.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_590f967d0d41a8b946fa40894726c118.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_dafde6f8479a184bc547278b67d436d2.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_dafde6f8479a184bc547278b67d436d2.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_dafde6f8479a184bc547278b67d436d2.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_dafde6f8479a184bc547278b67d436d2.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_42c9f4de3bbfc068ce1d3feeecbdb5a7.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_811a7aad4a69f442e9596689f2942061.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_811a7aad4a69f442e9596689f2942061.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_811a7aad4a69f442e9596689f2942061.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_811a7aad4a69f442e9596689f2942061.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_2eefdbeae08b5c263eda03dd7b5227fc.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_2eefdbeae08b5c263eda03dd7b5227fc.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_a3e8d2375c08d4734eb7755a9009d7a2.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_a3e8d2375c08d4734eb7755a9009d7a2.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_a3e8d2375c08d4734eb7755a9009d7a2.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_a3e8d2375c08d4734eb7755a9009d7a2.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_a3e8d2375c08d4734eb7755a9009d7a2.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_a3e8d2375c08d4734eb7755a9009d7a2.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_9552a793aa590420fd406ded7cd06b66.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_4fedb51d4779b91a5d11755aa95424fa.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_4fedb51d4779b91a5d11755aa95424fa.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_7eecaaf2c361df6624d64b45f4ec9b7d.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_7eecaaf2c361df6624d64b45f4ec9b7d.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_7eecaaf2c361df6624d64b45f4ec9b7d.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_7eecaaf2c361df6624d64b45f4ec9b7d.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_5a7c6fca548ad8e7affea1ff0d9b222e.text: A corda da guitarra soa desafinada.
sense_5a7c6fca548ad8e7affea1ff0d9b222e.translation: The guitar string sounds out of tune.

sense_5a7c6fca548ad8e7affea1ff0d9b222e.text: Ó sino da minha aldeia, / Dolente na tarde calma, / Cada tua badalada / Soa dentro da minha alma.
sense_5a7c6fca548ad8e7affea1ff0d9b222e.translation: Oh bell of my village, / Lazy in this peaceful afternoon, / Each one of your tollings / Resounds in my soul.

sense_ef073cfb0367817347469f0d07993f7f.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_ef073cfb0367817347469f0d07993f7f.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_c6894425f1a8f51878cc6e137e7222b1.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_c6894425f1a8f51878cc6e137e7222b1.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_56337c884de7a377cdd7a72995210482.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_ae964a6cee2a56f66c06f6a25270605c.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_ae964a6cee2a56f66c06f6a25270605c.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_f828bbad01a54ebebb0b5088c64d0ad2.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_020f9b17408b6760da7c6643b4739081.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_020f9b17408b6760da7c6643b4739081.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_577fd3d4f8445ab6c50a35d92f9c78cf.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_577fd3d4f8445ab6c50a35d92f9c78cf.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_96a2afcea21785b30a8c88e116fdb280.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_96a2afcea21785b30a8c88e116fdb280.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_6430207f0b90a85745d482723561fd3f.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_6430207f0b90a85745d482723561fd3f.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_6430207f0b90a85745d482723561fd3f.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_6430207f0b90a85745d482723561fd3f.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_95ca969fbcafbd93c8c1e215012fc179.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_95ca969fbcafbd93c8c1e215012fc179.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_4a7037402dfa4cd66fc376352b9b6632.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_4a7037402dfa4cd66fc376352b9b6632.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_df3e7d1495d775f950f55a862314e4a5.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_df3e7d1495d775f950f55a862314e4a5.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_0379d28e587721ac755a8ade597fcfc5.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_7c4a528a45a599296b147034ff9923d4.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_7c4a528a45a599296b147034ff9923d4.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_ce677dc9d2c9e4aa2a1cf6016964f537.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_03c86f37e9bd88ec711a744f9a8f9d31.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_03c86f37e9bd88ec711a744f9a8f9d31.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_7eea16102672531e7713e79c05bad2e0.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_7eea16102672531e7713e79c05bad2e0.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_bea5fe53688ece1e1bd47fbc56c2c833.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_d1c5aa66f007fd318dfb6610e52d671e.text: Acalme seus filhos, senão expulso vocês da loja.
sense_d1c5aa66f007fd318dfb6610e52d671e.translation: Calm your children down or I will throw you out of the store.

sense_d1c5aa66f007fd318dfb6610e52d671e.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_d1c5aa66f007fd318dfb6610e52d671e.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_358cce8baf17561d43699ca6e1b61990.text: Depois da tempestade, o mar se acalmou.
sense_358cce8baf17561d43699ca6e1b61990.translation: After the storm, the sea calmed down.
The noise of the leaves calmed down.

sense_7b4eebebbb4840c82863105ef45b72d9.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_7b4eebebbb4840c82863105ef45b72d9.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_7b4eebebbb4840c82863105ef45b72d9.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_f855be6100d13b0d71ab284aa4f846f9.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_f855be6100d13b0d71ab284aa4f846f9.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_c12938bf138903621d4fe562349543ae.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_c12938bf138903621d4fe562349543ae.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_c368612d74437ae9c69c9d7aa3869344.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_c368612d74437ae9c69c9d7aa3869344.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_c368612d74437ae9c69c9d7aa3869344.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_c368612d74437ae9c69c9d7aa3869344.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_0ab9f0bc566af35391f18c8a6d192255.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_718ca222823757807b3421b34d6b9914.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_718ca222823757807b3421b34d6b9914.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_ed4cb455386e725df337bdff5c4da6e9.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_ed4cb455386e725df337bdff5c4da6e9.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_ed4cb455386e725df337bdff5c4da6e9.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_ed4cb455386e725df337bdff5c4da6e9.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_dbb5ffe5a487205c7b7be8397e5d0011.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_dbb5ffe5a487205c7b7be8397e5d0011.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_32e1ef60517786643a0fa7c006b68fb4.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_68171e8ddba9c70c1e63e2432a53c150.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_68171e8ddba9c70c1e63e2432a53c150.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_68171e8ddba9c70c1e63e2432a53c150.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_68171e8ddba9c70c1e63e2432a53c150.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_15f8db638d90324b7f0ad90629dd6fbf.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_15f8db638d90324b7f0ad90629dd6fbf.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_fa1d3358ed843605024642e446afda9a.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_fa1d3358ed843605024642e446afda9a.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_c09f4253fea220661cf3d55a5cdb313c.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_c09f4253fea220661cf3d55a5cdb313c.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_c09f4253fea220661cf3d55a5cdb313c.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_e8bee2731f12dcd156f7fb7237889c34.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_e8bee2731f12dcd156f7fb7237889c34.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_702671671d714bcc62a9f04d6f525f59.translation: I have a message for you.

sense_702671671d714bcc62a9f04d6f525f59.text: […] disse o professor com um sorrisinho […]
sense_702671671d714bcc62a9f04d6f525f59.translation: […] the teacher said with a little smile […]

sense_4986b3ab299e0cfc38e15e7af3bfa8e4.text: Ontem de noite caiu uma chuva.
sense_4986b3ab299e0cfc38e15e7af3bfa8e4.translation: We had quite a rain last night.

sense_d761ab095132a94fc99bb8708649d12f.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_cbc74a353b184c6998b2297781cdfb9c.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_a5a71f9720ae8430a4e3e5aa2535a64c.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_a5a71f9720ae8430a4e3e5aa2535a64c.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_b1fc9a4184f893abcfc9ca219952a071.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_ccc710ea940d001dc54977049eb8e1e1.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_ccc710ea940d001dc54977049eb8e1e1.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_ccc710ea940d001dc54977049eb8e1e1.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_ccc710ea940d001dc54977049eb8e1e1.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_ddf1f42d20a2b80bb64610f1bd1fc1ac.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_ddf1f42d20a2b80bb64610f1bd1fc1ac.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_a21c53a6e7e588690602235076fbccf0.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_a21c53a6e7e588690602235076fbccf0.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_939be1eeb1bfb8978861dd5d66389635.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_939be1eeb1bfb8978861dd5d66389635.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_939be1eeb1bfb8978861dd5d66389635.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_939be1eeb1bfb8978861dd5d66389635.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_3281bfea834ef794e21e6760319ed9f5.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_3281bfea834ef794e21e6760319ed9f5.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_7e0c2dc1c13ad63aefc86a8b08bf28c8.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_7e0c2dc1c13ad63aefc86a8b08bf28c8.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_65c86332526d16de8cd4f27e29fc2799.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_65c86332526d16de8cd4f27e29fc2799.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_65c86332526d16de8cd4f27e29fc2799.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_65c86332526d16de8cd4f27e29fc2799.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_98de785ddb73b14232c1c366ace7cce7.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_98de785ddb73b14232c1c366ace7cce7.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_d7902a97a06288cabba03a6d4172de07.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_d7902a97a06288cabba03a6d4172de07.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_d7902a97a06288cabba03a6d4172de07.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_d7902a97a06288cabba03a6d4172de07.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_a1faed63484984e80f19e6ed114178c4.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_a1faed63484984e80f19e6ed114178c4.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_a1faed63484984e80f19e6ed114178c4.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_a1faed63484984e80f19e6ed114178c4.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_d9f105b3cf1b6a335732e936fb1fddd6.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_d9f105b3cf1b6a335732e936fb1fddd6.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_d41ddef91c1e054ce4bc75bc715d55d7.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_d41ddef91c1e054ce4bc75bc715d55d7.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_97b4189528328baa055400f63a3e6c81.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_d817ddbf63e581ae2230a0574ba905fe.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_d817ddbf63e581ae2230a0574ba905fe.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_d817ddbf63e581ae2230a0574ba905fe.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_d817ddbf63e581ae2230a0574ba905fe.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_00db55cf289b7948634b3a0b1f357e46.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_7f46701c65a0134c5fa2fb6e96ca3f24.text: Onde é que você estava, hein?

sense_185e54dec9f9756588692d94fff02a12.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_2e351f9eff78189ce3e761c0964bee46.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_2e351f9eff78189ce3e761c0964bee46.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_fe386f54b66d649b69e22d67781bd95b.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_fe00ff95de2d6a3f0d5b9a989ea57b74.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_fe00ff95de2d6a3f0d5b9a989ea57b74.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_95e7f50b8361fadbd7fd6be23ad06997.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_95e7f50b8361fadbd7fd6be23ad06997.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_95e7f50b8361fadbd7fd6be23ad06997.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_95e7f50b8361fadbd7fd6be23ad06997.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_62e1c490d44106dea88465df09bcff5a.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_62e1c490d44106dea88465df09bcff5a.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_62e1c490d44106dea88465df09bcff5a.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_62e1c490d44106dea88465df09bcff5a.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_62e1c490d44106dea88465df09bcff5a.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_33d3e28918ae1e40706b4a1d7763d1fd.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_33d3e28918ae1e40706b4a1d7763d1fd.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_33d3e28918ae1e40706b4a1d7763d1fd.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_33d3e28918ae1e40706b4a1d7763d1fd.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_67a3897e5db788d8e1a97cdf4a696fb5.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_67a3897e5db788d8e1a97cdf4a696fb5.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_67a3897e5db788d8e1a97cdf4a696fb5.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_67a3897e5db788d8e1a97cdf4a696fb5.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_d50eada575885df28be27b5578cde761.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
sense_d50eada575885df28be27b5578cde761.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

sense_d50eada575885df28be27b5578cde761.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
sense_d50eada575885df28be27b5578cde761.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

sense_e824d6862a5a296c53bc7f6f3dabcf04.text: A pintura é atribuída à oficina de Rubens.
sense_e824d6862a5a296c53bc7f6f3dabcf04.translation: The painting is attributed to the workshop of Rubens.

sense_e824d6862a5a296c53bc7f6f3dabcf04.text: O escultor trabalhava sempre até tarde na sua oficina.
sense_e824d6862a5a296c53bc7f6f3dabcf04.translation: The sculptor always worked late in his workshop.

sense_aeba7b1700f51e5c79b51ccb31bd1f43.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_aeba7b1700f51e5c79b51ccb31bd1f43.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_aeba7b1700f51e5c79b51ccb31bd1f43.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_aeba7b1700f51e5c79b51ccb31bd1f43.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_533fbbe6fa55b08e9603d745ea4f0a79.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_533fbbe6fa55b08e9603d745ea4f0a79.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_533fbbe6fa55b08e9603d745ea4f0a79.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_533fbbe6fa55b08e9603d745ea4f0a79.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_8b7b579a51e3a3bf80ce9fc6cf0982b5.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_8b7b579a51e3a3bf80ce9fc6cf0982b5.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_8b7b579a51e3a3bf80ce9fc6cf0982b5.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_8b7b579a51e3a3bf80ce9fc6cf0982b5.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_42f6ecb31fb2187ba67e05ac1f08ec10.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_42f6ecb31fb2187ba67e05ac1f08ec10.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_42f6ecb31fb2187ba67e05ac1f08ec10.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_42f6ecb31fb2187ba67e05ac1f08ec10.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_70946778c199a19f16b07ce6d3cb8ce2.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_70946778c199a19f16b07ce6d3cb8ce2.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_070d3c3741f74f058126d41ee2d652cb.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_070d3c3741f74f058126d41ee2d652cb.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_070d3c3741f74f058126d41ee2d652cb.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_070d3c3741f74f058126d41ee2d652cb.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_8b187e80d3a233229ae441e32d75cd22.text: As galinhas andam soltas pelo curral.
sense_8b187e80d3a233229ae441e32d75cd22.translation: The chickens roam free in the corral.

sense_d95965561e7fdfdd8b01e03881ddb135.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_d95965561e7fdfdd8b01e03881ddb135.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_19a39bf4f7805dc9d53cff5e086bd2b2.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_19a39bf4f7805dc9d53cff5e086bd2b2.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_643edfec3c721482779871400d6a9717.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_643edfec3c721482779871400d6a9717.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_643edfec3c721482779871400d6a9717.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_643edfec3c721482779871400d6a9717.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_643edfec3c721482779871400d6a9717.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_643edfec3c721482779871400d6a9717.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_5fff2bca360526ecfcfb87657c8f03e2.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_b2680fdb7bde37422c324c5ab3b5a811.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_b2680fdb7bde37422c324c5ab3b5a811.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_324a4e44081957a7bfce87d8d2c39662.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_324a4e44081957a7bfce87d8d2c39662.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_96ab5601c8194305b7dc03e6b188fa65.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_2dcd20db865e2a643128901f54a94279.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_85fa4d0741879a1f708512d50fa6aace.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_85fa4d0741879a1f708512d50fa6aace.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_053b6419a3d24cad58954a65d0b22a2d.text: Minha mãe ficou puta com a situação.
sense_053b6419a3d24cad58954a65d0b22a2d.translation: My mom became angry with the situation.

sense_275a71b10ae744872a85f2fcec6ef8f4.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_275a71b10ae744872a85f2fcec6ef8f4.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_275a71b10ae744872a85f2fcec6ef8f4.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_275a71b10ae744872a85f2fcec6ef8f4.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_f6a2b13057b764c3bc8708a969fc780c.text: O papel de parede é muito giro.

sense_81173bc246efa3fe5bea81e0e1032ccb.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_eb4cd3cf954a56f2ecf0791581aa46c3.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_eb4cd3cf954a56f2ecf0791581aa46c3.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_eb4cd3cf954a56f2ecf0791581aa46c3.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_eb4cd3cf954a56f2ecf0791581aa46c3.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_eb4cd3cf954a56f2ecf0791581aa46c3.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_eb4cd3cf954a56f2ecf0791581aa46c3.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_1fc2156e129b8ed73428fb1d964f3b12.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_1fc2156e129b8ed73428fb1d964f3b12.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_1fc2156e129b8ed73428fb1d964f3b12.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_1fc2156e129b8ed73428fb1d964f3b12.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_a5fc3abcdaddcb9161ff195addc4548b.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_a5fc3abcdaddcb9161ff195addc4548b.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_a5fc3abcdaddcb9161ff195addc4548b.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_a5fc3abcdaddcb9161ff195addc4548b.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_f8fe11e5b594de1fcbebb67fbf6741a1.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_f8fe11e5b594de1fcbebb67fbf6741a1.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_f8fe11e5b594de1fcbebb67fbf6741a1.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_f8fe11e5b594de1fcbebb67fbf6741a1.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_daba5d337695e0789861d26b0110e553.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_daba5d337695e0789861d26b0110e553.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_956fd46f7997eb7eec4fedac348a3590.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_956fd46f7997eb7eec4fedac348a3590.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_956fd46f7997eb7eec4fedac348a3590.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_956fd46f7997eb7eec4fedac348a3590.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_e1b1fd692cbf150400840277bbafe188.text: O exército teve de abandonar o forte.
sense_e1b1fd692cbf150400840277bbafe188.translation: The army had to abandon the fort.

sense_e1b1fd692cbf150400840277bbafe188.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_e1b1fd692cbf150400840277bbafe188.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_1e15b7450868bbd314e69e3b7100267f.text: O réu abandonou-se/se abandonou nas mãos do advogado.
sense_1e15b7450868bbd314e69e3b7100267f.translation: The accused put himself in his lawyer’s hands.
We let ourselves be seized by sadness.

sense_ddd8817b0e198632fbaef53652881d9e.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_ddd8817b0e198632fbaef53652881d9e.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_ddd8817b0e198632fbaef53652881d9e.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_ddd8817b0e198632fbaef53652881d9e.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_25c8b19d1bf55b7ce3958253c9ed45a2.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_25c8b19d1bf55b7ce3958253c9ed45a2.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_bab93103267a81d8b7354defa3fb88b3.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_bab93103267a81d8b7354defa3fb88b3.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_f81aa11b487d8bf5b07e1e4bf560bbb0.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_f81aa11b487d8bf5b07e1e4bf560bbb0.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_f81aa11b487d8bf5b07e1e4bf560bbb0.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_f81aa11b487d8bf5b07e1e4bf560bbb0.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_4d05377fb3172fafc5cd3e5246370098.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_4d05377fb3172fafc5cd3e5246370098.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_4d05377fb3172fafc5cd3e5246370098.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_4d05377fb3172fafc5cd3e5246370098.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_5ac5173bb7c1a8d1af6fac08ebe08834.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_5ac5173bb7c1a8d1af6fac08ebe08834.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_5ac5173bb7c1a8d1af6fac08ebe08834.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_5ac5173bb7c1a8d1af6fac08ebe08834.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_4590800fcc9b3f31d21a51795e0c8f35.text: Roupas novas podem causar uma boa impressão.
sense_4590800fcc9b3f31d21a51795e0c8f35.translation: New clothes may cause a good impression.

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: Em scismar — sósinho — á noite — / Mais prazer encontro eu lá; / Minha terra tem palmeiras, / Onde canta o Sabiá.
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: When ruminating — alone — at night — / I find more pleasure there; / My land has palm trees, / where the Thrush sings.

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: O marquez tinha ido sósinho para França. Fôra, ao que se dizia, buscar a filha ao Sacré-Cœur.
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: The marquess had gone to France alone. He’d gone, supposedly, to fetch his daughter from the Sacré-Cœur.

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: — Ai! volto, volto... Não posso deixar sózinha a mãe do meu homem, que tem oitenta annos e está entrevada.
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: “Oh! I’ll go back, yes... I can’t leave my man’s mother, who’s eighty years old and paralysed, by herself.

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: No momento actual, não era possivel ao Brasil vencer sosinho as suas difficuldades financeiras, nem lhe será possivel.
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: Currently, it was not possible for Brazil to overcome its financial difficulties by itself, nor will it be possible.

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: Impossivel dar cabo daquella praga. Estirou os olhos pela campina, achou-se isolado. Sózinho num mundo coberto de pennas, de aves queriam comel-o.
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: It was impossible to put an end to that pest. He looked over the plains, found himself isolated. Alone in a world covered in feathers, in birds that sought to eat him.

sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.text: Uma canção dizendo tudo a ela / Que ainda estou sozinho, apaixonado
sense_1a33c49eebae7e129a65197685be0e42.translation: A song telling her everything / That I’m still lonely, in love

sense_fdb5cb79d5e91b6eccbccc27959a8418.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_fdb5cb79d5e91b6eccbccc27959a8418.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_fdb5cb79d5e91b6eccbccc27959a8418.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_fdb5cb79d5e91b6eccbccc27959a8418.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_a73425ee6b572c28213d0af6d2a8ebdb.text: Minha mãe se dana comigo se escuta dessa!
sense_a73425ee6b572c28213d0af6d2a8ebdb.translation: My mom will be mad at me if she hears about this!

sense_a73425ee6b572c28213d0af6d2a8ebdb.text: Sinha Victoria ia damnar-se, e com razão.
sense_a73425ee6b572c28213d0af6d2a8ebdb.translation: Mrs. Victoria would get mad, and rightfully so.

sense_891c3d0afbb96a5791008fa2be13fc37.text: Luiza lia um romance francez; ou tocava piano; ou pensava indignada nos beijos que lhe dei no pescoço.
sense_891c3d0afbb96a5791008fa2be13fc37.translation: Luiza was reading a French novel; or playing piano; or thinking, outraged, about the kisses I gave her on the neck.

sense_891c3d0afbb96a5791008fa2be13fc37.text: Alda contou para o grupo que a tia Belinha tinha ido sozinha a Paris e lá conhecera um conde francês, ligeiramente arruinado e ligeiramente maluco, com quem tivera um tórrido caso de verão.
sense_891c3d0afbb96a5791008fa2be13fc37.translation: Alda told the group that aunt Belinha had gone alone to Paris and met a French count, slightly ruined and slightly mad, with whom she’d had a steamy summer affair.

sense_04d7872efa642522e9adfd440f23d7ef.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_04d7872efa642522e9adfd440f23d7ef.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_e5a2ad0797d8f96ebe3a37dd17f8ed32.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_d1f2afecbd7c2c399c489735a587a041.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_d1f2afecbd7c2c399c489735a587a041.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_51bf885e5c41e9f755d2fd31c4c354d7.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_782482ed7d33e040bba342486b736c2d.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_782482ed7d33e040bba342486b736c2d.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_7e9c61c3aa635e723fe859a3af632cb7.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_7e9c61c3aa635e723fe859a3af632cb7.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_c6ae5462b78bbeefa70a8823d76df229.text: Meus alunos são preguiçosos demais. Quero zerá-los todos.
sense_c6ae5462b78bbeefa70a8823d76df229.translation: My students are too lazy. I want to give them all a zero.

sense_c6ae5462b78bbeefa70a8823d76df229.text: Droga! Zerei em português de novo.
sense_c6ae5462b78bbeefa70a8823d76df229.translation: Damn it! I got zero in Portuguese again.

sense_c6ae5462b78bbeefa70a8823d76df229.text: Três alunos zeraram na última prova.
sense_c6ae5462b78bbeefa70a8823d76df229.translation: Three students got zero in the last test.

sense_98fdf6d6dde6459b30f0343620178797.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_aafa9e7a0a41544592077eeac394da8d.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_aafa9e7a0a41544592077eeac394da8d.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_aafa9e7a0a41544592077eeac394da8d.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_aafa9e7a0a41544592077eeac394da8d.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_4da7e5720afed041ac45a82bf99f4c5f.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_c02968e75a1a09e3b1b20b71ad20509f.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_c02968e75a1a09e3b1b20b71ad20509f.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_c02968e75a1a09e3b1b20b71ad20509f.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_c02968e75a1a09e3b1b20b71ad20509f.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_8c19184ba074e79e791a0fcfa295c647.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_8c19184ba074e79e791a0fcfa295c647.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_8c19184ba074e79e791a0fcfa295c647.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_8c19184ba074e79e791a0fcfa295c647.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_8c19184ba074e79e791a0fcfa295c647.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_8c19184ba074e79e791a0fcfa295c647.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_4af2476dc185431b805d1bcf69cdfd93.text: Um bocado de pessoas viu aquilo.
sense_4af2476dc185431b805d1bcf69cdfd93.translation: A lot of people saw that.
I waited for a lot of time.

sense_d9f8302c64645fbc18cb1e9a3b0a2f6f.text: O objeto está ao alcance dos meus braços.
sense_d9f8302c64645fbc18cb1e9a3b0a2f6f.translation: The object is within my arms’ reach.

sense_d9f8302c64645fbc18cb1e9a3b0a2f6f.text: Esta arma tem um alcance maior do que aquela.
sense_d9f8302c64645fbc18cb1e9a3b0a2f6f.translation: This weapon has a longer range than that one.

sense_31a968ef6141997004d2bf68a4cfbcce.text: Vencer esta corrida está fora do meu alcance.
sense_31a968ef6141997004d2bf68a4cfbcce.translation: Winning this race is beyond my reach.

sense_31a968ef6141997004d2bf68a4cfbcce.text: Essa lição está dentro do meu alcance.
sense_31a968ef6141997004d2bf68a4cfbcce.translation: This lesson is within my reach.

sense_b651c05b7f0a43bff79938e815866690.text: Essa ponte não me parece muito segura.
sense_b651c05b7f0a43bff79938e815866690.translation: This bridge doesn’t look very safe.

sense_b651c05b7f0a43bff79938e815866690.text: Não te preocupes, voar é seguro.

sense_62b263b63b9122fe277f7f25271be0fd.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_62b263b63b9122fe277f7f25271be0fd.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_62b263b63b9122fe277f7f25271be0fd.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_62b263b63b9122fe277f7f25271be0fd.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_b313050997463e0ecb602d437a54dcd0.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_b313050997463e0ecb602d437a54dcd0.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_5dc4ca2adb6c6737b0b28d0ec6717d27.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_5dc4ca2adb6c6737b0b28d0ec6717d27.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_d186f5e2f3c7a0f2bed37c5c43f325ec.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_d186f5e2f3c7a0f2bed37c5c43f325ec.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_63aeb8ef2ac09f1b585eb9661f2878a2.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_63aeb8ef2ac09f1b585eb9661f2878a2.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_63aeb8ef2ac09f1b585eb9661f2878a2.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_63aeb8ef2ac09f1b585eb9661f2878a2.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_7d81f29f51c08ae032c8d39bcf2baf26.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_7d81f29f51c08ae032c8d39bcf2baf26.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_1cc229889b6e886657551248988fd9a8.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_1cc229889b6e886657551248988fd9a8.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_f6e9f0ec5f3c25ecc85ccf015bcaa9c4.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_f6e9f0ec5f3c25ecc85ccf015bcaa9c4.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_2e07a24bfc017adf8c79ffa017a93713.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_2e07a24bfc017adf8c79ffa017a93713.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_2e07a24bfc017adf8c79ffa017a93713.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_2e07a24bfc017adf8c79ffa017a93713.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_2e07a24bfc017adf8c79ffa017a93713.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_2e07a24bfc017adf8c79ffa017a93713.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_e4bf7d76f9e9c8290b91900c74884a30.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_e4bf7d76f9e9c8290b91900c74884a30.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_a452ee0cc99a1c6d3f26b797948fed7a.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_a452ee0cc99a1c6d3f26b797948fed7a.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_a452ee0cc99a1c6d3f26b797948fed7a.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_a452ee0cc99a1c6d3f26b797948fed7a.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_fff9f7319dccc6bc8f7bb7ab1d8ea104.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_fff9f7319dccc6bc8f7bb7ab1d8ea104.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_fff9f7319dccc6bc8f7bb7ab1d8ea104.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_fff9f7319dccc6bc8f7bb7ab1d8ea104.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_98d728f442bbdbb50750c1f9f53ebfe1.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_98d728f442bbdbb50750c1f9f53ebfe1.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_4155f13036c49930cef73d9b06bdea24.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_4155f13036c49930cef73d9b06bdea24.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_4155f13036c49930cef73d9b06bdea24.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_4155f13036c49930cef73d9b06bdea24.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_a8cad2b613cf05212deb235c57db4f61.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_a8cad2b613cf05212deb235c57db4f61.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_a8cad2b613cf05212deb235c57db4f61.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_a8cad2b613cf05212deb235c57db4f61.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_dac0121912e84ce4d02fb9cd5b7a1a01.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_dac0121912e84ce4d02fb9cd5b7a1a01.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_6bd3bab87aafe7042ba5baa094d4ad39.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_6bd3bab87aafe7042ba5baa094d4ad39.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_c3d713128caf462b6782ae6a98ae2fe2.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_c3d713128caf462b6782ae6a98ae2fe2.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_c3d713128caf462b6782ae6a98ae2fe2.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_c3d713128caf462b6782ae6a98ae2fe2.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_72ca12022020128d5ad20cb77f780b58.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_818595361f98e72534643b11c5250bd9.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_818595361f98e72534643b11c5250bd9.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_818595361f98e72534643b11c5250bd9.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_818595361f98e72534643b11c5250bd9.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_02d2d441ecd5ad0cfdb9b55e8707737f.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_02d2d441ecd5ad0cfdb9b55e8707737f.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_02d2d441ecd5ad0cfdb9b55e8707737f.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_02d2d441ecd5ad0cfdb9b55e8707737f.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_4d3cb31d1e49aaa547150a62b78b2041.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_4d3cb31d1e49aaa547150a62b78b2041.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_362e85dab7d7e7158c4e2f63784cadca.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_f31e76617ab9bd8675a6924693148e9f.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_f31e76617ab9bd8675a6924693148e9f.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_f31e76617ab9bd8675a6924693148e9f.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_f31e76617ab9bd8675a6924693148e9f.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_23b0ac0a541818eb21b3227289b61486.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_23b0ac0a541818eb21b3227289b61486.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_df0cc53f8fe02f7bfc4e26868bcfade4.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_ce9785d30c1e3995e6c8b1a71b04871f.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_ce9785d30c1e3995e6c8b1a71b04871f.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_f3bbac16e2e6eaa5295b74fb9f500a51.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_f3bbac16e2e6eaa5295b74fb9f500a51.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_f00e03bb5ed01151b25582b1cf9e7892.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_f00e03bb5ed01151b25582b1cf9e7892.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_e1b370d78258014a7d036de13b94d48b.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_e1b370d78258014a7d036de13b94d48b.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_e1b370d78258014a7d036de13b94d48b.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_e1b370d78258014a7d036de13b94d48b.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_5491a8543610d0109afad3e6bba6e64b.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_5491a8543610d0109afad3e6bba6e64b.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_9799059a6e0568a5a619f8bd6f130474.text: Sou lenhador, cortar árvores é o meu trabalho.
sense_9799059a6e0568a5a619f8bd6f130474.translation: I’m a lumberjack, cutting trees is my job.

sense_9799059a6e0568a5a619f8bd6f130474.text: Tenho dois trabalhos para sustentar minha família.
sense_9799059a6e0568a5a619f8bd6f130474.translation: I have two jobs to support my family.

sense_c8765a80ad93feac7a70e4fdf99ef8a7.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_c8765a80ad93feac7a70e4fdf99ef8a7.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_c8765a80ad93feac7a70e4fdf99ef8a7.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_c8765a80ad93feac7a70e4fdf99ef8a7.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_c8765a80ad93feac7a70e4fdf99ef8a7.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_c8765a80ad93feac7a70e4fdf99ef8a7.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_6835b3f4c18e90b7cb0b31c1493a31d8.text: Mel,ela tesourou com a sua mãe para você estar tão obcecada assim?
sense_6835b3f4c18e90b7cb0b31c1493a31d8.translation: Mel, did she scissor your mother to make you obsessed like this?

sense_6835b3f4c18e90b7cb0b31c1493a31d8.text:
CHEGUEI
tô preparada pra colar
quando o grave bater eu vou tesourar
na sua cara vou jogar e rebolar
por que eu sou linda lésbica e louca.
sense_6835b3f4c18e90b7cb0b31c1493a31d8.translation:
IM HERE
and im all ready to trib
when the bass drops im gonna scissor
ill throw it on your face and twerk
cuz i’m a beautiful crazy lesbian.

sense_139a05a431b2c3eb07d0f87eec1d50c0.text: Até agora, a proposta pra tesoureira do Banco do Brasil é a mais tentadora. Adoro tesourar, picotar e ganhar dinheiro. HAHAHA
sense_139a05a431b2c3eb07d0f87eec1d50c0.translation: Up to this point, the offering for the treasurer role at Banco do Brasil is the most tempting. I love to scissor, cut things up and make money.

sense_139a05a431b2c3eb07d0f87eec1d50c0.text: Esse cabelinho do MT é a coisa mais ridícula, só sobe pro profissional se virar homem e tesourar essa merda. Se bem que não tá jogando nada. Arthur Salles eu subiria.
sense_139a05a431b2c3eb07d0f87eec1d50c0.translation: MT’s haircut is the most ridiculous thing, he’ll only become a pro player if he mans up and scissors this shit. Actually, he doesn’t even play well. I would move Arthur Salles up.

sense_03ee49833fb0b56926c7ae99468965cd.text: @Angelicakeka ja voltou linda q bom vc aki ai podemos tesourar os outros rsrs
sense_03ee49833fb0b56926c7ae99468965cd.translation: @Angelicakeka R u back bb that’s nice ur here so we can rant abt other people lol

sense_03ee49833fb0b56926c7ae99468965cd.text: Mas, só para chegar ao convite era uma tortura e depois, a lembrança de que se havia de dizer, de se commentar, de se conversar na botica e tesourar durante a ceia fazia desanimar.
sense_03ee49833fb0b56926c7ae99468965cd.translation: But just getting to the [wedding] proposal was already a torture, and then remembering that one would have to talk, comment, discuss at the pharmacy, and gossip over dinner was discouraging.

sense_f100a7363b51b0d4f55839a1c033cbb5.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_f100a7363b51b0d4f55839a1c033cbb5.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_f42a69ea21b10ae8b9ba82f7e547fadf.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_f42a69ea21b10ae8b9ba82f7e547fadf.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_f42a69ea21b10ae8b9ba82f7e547fadf.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_f42a69ea21b10ae8b9ba82f7e547fadf.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_1f101f92de6652998660f0df006241c2.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_1f101f92de6652998660f0df006241c2.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_77009a3662341bcbc3b96b2dcd6d08db.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_0384c9a03fa993c665ff8bb564cd715a.text: Os bêbados começaram a se agarrar.
Um idiota queria se agarrar comigo.
sense_0384c9a03fa993c665ff8bb564cd715a.translation: Some idiot wanted to fight with me.

sense_7f1658b38be2362639f470a9b11898c8.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_7f1658b38be2362639f470a9b11898c8.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_e000ca3e3c153b2ceba52ad01f6f51ac.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_2226c3ec98e453876fff8fd81c5459d0.text: Graças às suas reclamações, não estou mais tranquilo.
sense_2226c3ec98e453876fff8fd81c5459d0.translation: Thanks to your complaints, I am no longer calm.

sense_9ccf09fda9ef8d06e30775f38a5f7616.text: Vivemos eu e elle n’uma casinha de um bairro tranquillo e retirado.
sense_9ccf09fda9ef8d06e30775f38a5f7616.translation: He and I live in a small house from a quiet and distanced neighbourhood.

sense_c617e742f392c03c6bab23f632b5305a.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_c617e742f392c03c6bab23f632b5305a.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_c617e742f392c03c6bab23f632b5305a.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_c617e742f392c03c6bab23f632b5305a.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_c617e742f392c03c6bab23f632b5305a.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_c617e742f392c03c6bab23f632b5305a.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_d51c8e54f4ead03c82740c4442beab55.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_d51c8e54f4ead03c82740c4442beab55.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_d51c8e54f4ead03c82740c4442beab55.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_d51c8e54f4ead03c82740c4442beab55.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_93e229871abc7dbf693c91569a6eee76.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_93abe95fa648d380edb882d5f042b48f.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_93abe95fa648d380edb882d5f042b48f.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_93abe95fa648d380edb882d5f042b48f.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_93abe95fa648d380edb882d5f042b48f.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_2a579e7951d2384b46c59c1c890733fe.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_2a579e7951d2384b46c59c1c890733fe.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_3dcd92ddbc685e3785b1aab706377420.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_3dcd92ddbc685e3785b1aab706377420.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_3dcd92ddbc685e3785b1aab706377420.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_3dcd92ddbc685e3785b1aab706377420.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_9aa5c18fe9ba33a34f02abda248e20b0.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_9aa5c18fe9ba33a34f02abda248e20b0.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_9aa5c18fe9ba33a34f02abda248e20b0.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_9aa5c18fe9ba33a34f02abda248e20b0.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_b9e43dd97bc48d9ab3eede56534f5af3.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_2062294b1bd64be7477375d930dc2f14.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_2062294b1bd64be7477375d930dc2f14.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_2062294b1bd64be7477375d930dc2f14.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_2062294b1bd64be7477375d930dc2f14.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_2062294b1bd64be7477375d930dc2f14.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_2062294b1bd64be7477375d930dc2f14.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_590f549ba9aede8b9e80678a4b7c3f99.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_590f549ba9aede8b9e80678a4b7c3f99.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_590f549ba9aede8b9e80678a4b7c3f99.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_590f549ba9aede8b9e80678a4b7c3f99.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_f623ceea9174ef776ffd6a4bd9fb818a.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_10ed6aefaeeb7a7bac3838229adbb9ff.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_1c106971b8aab2cbd1ba57a5a84cab30.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_1c106971b8aab2cbd1ba57a5a84cab30.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_79fcef3c3de30f81e17fb7f9f4bef670.text: Acalme seus filhos, senão expulso vocês da loja.
sense_79fcef3c3de30f81e17fb7f9f4bef670.translation: Calm your children down or I will throw you out of the store.

sense_79fcef3c3de30f81e17fb7f9f4bef670.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_79fcef3c3de30f81e17fb7f9f4bef670.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_aa1f644526f8aa7c0f3a9822089b1899.text: Depois da tempestade, o mar se acalmou.
sense_aa1f644526f8aa7c0f3a9822089b1899.translation: After the storm, the sea calmed down.
The noise of the leaves calmed down.

sense_10dcea7c849b87e331385c7787548bd0.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_10dcea7c849b87e331385c7787548bd0.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_10dcea7c849b87e331385c7787548bd0.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_10dcea7c849b87e331385c7787548bd0.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_bb099015c3ad4b7a0b4255ffa278e45e.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_bb099015c3ad4b7a0b4255ffa278e45e.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_4680eda22eebb39a874a1b07ffa4c4bb.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_4680eda22eebb39a874a1b07ffa4c4bb.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_ec326abf6d6e93ee8d5bd1c7f9fdbe50.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_ec326abf6d6e93ee8d5bd1c7f9fdbe50.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_ec326abf6d6e93ee8d5bd1c7f9fdbe50.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_ec326abf6d6e93ee8d5bd1c7f9fdbe50.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_6cedd54310ab4ec1e8a1f6950b330755.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_6cedd54310ab4ec1e8a1f6950b330755.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_6cedd54310ab4ec1e8a1f6950b330755.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_6cedd54310ab4ec1e8a1f6950b330755.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_f5cddcd89e2de45b6968e6bdb29342e6.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_f5cddcd89e2de45b6968e6bdb29342e6.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_f5cddcd89e2de45b6968e6bdb29342e6.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_6415dbbf278c114fb7dde80e11bc3757.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_6415dbbf278c114fb7dde80e11bc3757.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_2dadda17fb5d16e280895caf7762427f.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_2dadda17fb5d16e280895caf7762427f.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_cbc54c42f3f95dc74414683a7c6df1c1.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_cbc54c42f3f95dc74414683a7c6df1c1.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_cbc54c42f3f95dc74414683a7c6df1c1.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_cbc54c42f3f95dc74414683a7c6df1c1.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_cbc54c42f3f95dc74414683a7c6df1c1.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_cbc54c42f3f95dc74414683a7c6df1c1.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_d12ae181c664cc7ad8939f21f4ce5346.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_d12ae181c664cc7ad8939f21f4ce5346.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_d12ae181c664cc7ad8939f21f4ce5346.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_d12ae181c664cc7ad8939f21f4ce5346.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_8726691d60b1be729097eff32cfcd0ec.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_8726691d60b1be729097eff32cfcd0ec.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_79cb07b498753c3236645922cebed545.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_79cb07b498753c3236645922cebed545.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_05e1207d49ff93563a08f46493cea4dd.literal_meaning: I stranged your behavior a lot.
sense_05e1207d49ff93563a08f46493cea4dd.translation: I found your behaviour very strange.

sense_05e1207d49ff93563a08f46493cea4dd.text: — O jury? extranhei. O senhor também. Está visto. O senhor appellou?
sense_05e1207d49ff93563a08f46493cea4dd.translation: “The jury? I found it strange. You did too, sir. It’s clear. Did you appeal?”

sense_dfb448817810974548cb4f414dff70ea.text: Traga-me um copo d’água / Tenho sede
sense_dfb448817810974548cb4f414dff70ea.translation: Bring me a glass of water / I am thirsty

sense_c991a688ed52880fe6bb8755ff995d22.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_c991a688ed52880fe6bb8755ff995d22.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_c991a688ed52880fe6bb8755ff995d22.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_c991a688ed52880fe6bb8755ff995d22.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_e764f6edc7ce1f12483ae6c2fd335a91.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_e764f6edc7ce1f12483ae6c2fd335a91.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_edf9db3585d4ce07fa7a7b4ea4d9b3ca.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_edf9db3585d4ce07fa7a7b4ea4d9b3ca.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_423a50d4c78a1dc762a76f454f8176d0.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_423a50d4c78a1dc762a76f454f8176d0.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_9d6f17ff8c580c889846c8bbac7cba81.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_9d6f17ff8c580c889846c8bbac7cba81.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_9d6f17ff8c580c889846c8bbac7cba81.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_9d6f17ff8c580c889846c8bbac7cba81.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_84c90f92a36a5d640bc403580c038420.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_84c90f92a36a5d640bc403580c038420.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_47e8bd5ce05d465255c176bfe9d6619b.text: O que é bom para gripe?
sense_47e8bd5ce05d465255c176bfe9d6619b.translation: What is good for the flu?
I have a message for you.

sense_8367fdd82289314281dbd3f1a6aa4caa.text: A cor da banana mudou de amarelo para preto.
sense_8367fdd82289314281dbd3f1a6aa4caa.translation: The colour of the banana changed from yellow to black.

sense_8367fdd82289314281dbd3f1a6aa4caa.text: O valor da minha casa baixou para menos do que o que eu paguei.
sense_8367fdd82289314281dbd3f1a6aa4caa.translation: The value of my house has fallen to less than what I paid.

sense_00eb8a47a21a1ce211d2b966237b5ba4.text: Ele podia ouvi-la se deslocando para a direita, para obter uma visão desimpedida dele.
sense_00eb8a47a21a1ce211d2b966237b5ba4.translation: He could hear her moving herself to the right, to obtain an unobstructed view of him.

sense_3b85bd839b60f7c77945184f200a3fdb.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_3b85bd839b60f7c77945184f200a3fdb.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_3b85bd839b60f7c77945184f200a3fdb.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_3b85bd839b60f7c77945184f200a3fdb.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_d560feb470438b059f69c52554f910cc.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_d560feb470438b059f69c52554f910cc.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_9947e6ba7bc7a8989175e00ad9f21049.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_9947e6ba7bc7a8989175e00ad9f21049.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_9947e6ba7bc7a8989175e00ad9f21049.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_f67c7f292b766436d5ad321928440157.text: Era difícil dizer se a professora os ouvira, pois seu rosto estava oculto pelas sombras.
sense_f67c7f292b766436d5ad321928440157.translation: It was difficult to tell whether the teacher had heard them, because her face was hidden by the shadows.

sense_f67c7f292b766436d5ad321928440157.text: Essa história de “amigos certos para as horas incertas”, além de pai, mãe, filhos e irmãos, é muito difícil de acontecer. Até mesmo os parentes mais próximos não ajudam os necessitados muitas vezes.
sense_f67c7f292b766436d5ad321928440157.translation: That “right friends for times of uncertainty” thing, besides father, mother, children and siblings, is pretty unlikely to happen. Even the closest relatives oftentimes don't help the needy.

sense_8d32ff28db07eb782ac7d0747a5d1630.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_8d32ff28db07eb782ac7d0747a5d1630.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_8d32ff28db07eb782ac7d0747a5d1630.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_8d32ff28db07eb782ac7d0747a5d1630.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_8d32ff28db07eb782ac7d0747a5d1630.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_8d32ff28db07eb782ac7d0747a5d1630.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_d5cb50f6f9f3f3a9ad17a5692fb84e36.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_d5cb50f6f9f3f3a9ad17a5692fb84e36.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_d5cb50f6f9f3f3a9ad17a5692fb84e36.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_d5cb50f6f9f3f3a9ad17a5692fb84e36.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_a3cc69308c0d6786c5f33dccd7d8ea00.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_5ac0b8d1fec2eabf98bdab52652284ef.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_5ac0b8d1fec2eabf98bdab52652284ef.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_5ac0b8d1fec2eabf98bdab52652284ef.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_5ac0b8d1fec2eabf98bdab52652284ef.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_43075c6379cd2778bff6e6ee3fa69261.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_7d2100c155c240b2783b55c90a544c59.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_7d2100c155c240b2783b55c90a544c59.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_be33b262e4a62693fc1c9dda2de8c4bc.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_be33b262e4a62693fc1c9dda2de8c4bc.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_be33b262e4a62693fc1c9dda2de8c4bc.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_be33b262e4a62693fc1c9dda2de8c4bc.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_356d8fc02eb6c2a8bbfbaa4d64760fac.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_356d8fc02eb6c2a8bbfbaa4d64760fac.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_356d8fc02eb6c2a8bbfbaa4d64760fac.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_356d8fc02eb6c2a8bbfbaa4d64760fac.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_b874e718fe1505e26634e5db7d76a0d8.text: A chuva de granizo que deu ontem estragou a porcaria do telhado.
sense_b874e718fe1505e26634e5db7d76a0d8.translation: Yesterday's hailstorm destroyed the damn roof.

sense_840890d041c10d0ab67c89360be23cd9.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_840890d041c10d0ab67c89360be23cd9.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_5e4c5c1106ea28a2e426d32db076dc5d.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_58ad36c948454dfbc6f559becd229d5f.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_58ad36c948454dfbc6f559becd229d5f.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_f3e8dc54b3afe961b272f1b2d570ccfd.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_f3e8dc54b3afe961b272f1b2d570ccfd.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_b5e3b9b355f2aa383c0decf79dbdf499.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_5268fed07482e4667783a485915251ac.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_cc3f314804d73995ed025296aa63f7c4.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_cc3f314804d73995ed025296aa63f7c4.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_9ac4a343fe6fb9e0661e1e11cdb8c1f9.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_8c8ed96ced2f6c6f896b9796df0c23ac.text: Eu temo o dia em que ninguém more mais aqui.
sense_8c8ed96ced2f6c6f896b9796df0c23ac.translation: I fear the day no one lives here any more.

sense_f68da67b5c320aeac68f2cc4e6cc1efb.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_f68da67b5c320aeac68f2cc4e6cc1efb.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_f1f44df6a4579c5fbba0f589a51df510.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_f1f44df6a4579c5fbba0f589a51df510.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_d7f710e2b03daca5bb462f0d262af8ec.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_d7f710e2b03daca5bb462f0d262af8ec.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_9c93583b8a6f65f185049f660d54d0c6.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_9c93583b8a6f65f185049f660d54d0c6.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_9c93583b8a6f65f185049f660d54d0c6.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_9c93583b8a6f65f185049f660d54d0c6.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_071d456b2421679e0011f2564aacf7d2.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_071d456b2421679e0011f2564aacf7d2.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_071d456b2421679e0011f2564aacf7d2.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_071d456b2421679e0011f2564aacf7d2.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_796ac84017e68c56727f29f8871281be.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_796ac84017e68c56727f29f8871281be.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_6340164da0e99267015db044da9454a6.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_6340164da0e99267015db044da9454a6.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_6340164da0e99267015db044da9454a6.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_6340164da0e99267015db044da9454a6.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_3092b06266a94dfab9199c2213da22f6.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_3092b06266a94dfab9199c2213da22f6.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_3092b06266a94dfab9199c2213da22f6.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_3092b06266a94dfab9199c2213da22f6.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_e5689e1b3393efdddacc8de37bccb572.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_e5689e1b3393efdddacc8de37bccb572.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_a06592295a471708dc690f4cb7aa9185.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_c852548a0e81d8ee52605102d8f7a9b6.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_c852548a0e81d8ee52605102d8f7a9b6.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_c852548a0e81d8ee52605102d8f7a9b6.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_c852548a0e81d8ee52605102d8f7a9b6.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_c852548a0e81d8ee52605102d8f7a9b6.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_c852548a0e81d8ee52605102d8f7a9b6.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_e098ac6fae73ee346b8acf6710745487.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_e098ac6fae73ee346b8acf6710745487.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_e098ac6fae73ee346b8acf6710745487.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_e098ac6fae73ee346b8acf6710745487.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.
