sense_701784db1f5cfdf2fd8a84d0a6d59440.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_5aaf1d9643361153f22685a5bb45dec6.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_fa9877c65766402136ec784fa702bf88.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_41e867727f0231b579dbd4c43d7926a3.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_41e867727f0231b579dbd4c43d7926a3.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_b515369f4e537ac8858ac8b344f2857c.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_b515369f4e537ac8858ac8b344f2857c.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_b515369f4e537ac8858ac8b344f2857c.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_b515369f4e537ac8858ac8b344f2857c.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_4199905a256118505d928718d70f020a.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_4199905a256118505d928718d70f020a.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_4199905a256118505d928718d70f020a.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_4199905a256118505d928718d70f020a.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_b5390bf2cae278e06deeb9fa0a4c6762.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_359978d71b52a223b63a0aee55d3fb7c.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_359978d71b52a223b63a0aee55d3fb7c.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_359978d71b52a223b63a0aee55d3fb7c.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_359978d71b52a223b63a0aee55d3fb7c.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_359978d71b52a223b63a0aee55d3fb7c.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_359978d71b52a223b63a0aee55d3fb7c.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_9df3aa354929b9a1504b78345a845826.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_9df3aa354929b9a1504b78345a845826.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_9df3aa354929b9a1504b78345a845826.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_9df3aa354929b9a1504b78345a845826.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_8171aae26db1175dfab26b3cccbaba11.text: Não vai se desculpar por ter pisado no meu pé?
sense_8171aae26db1175dfab26b3cccbaba11.translation: Aren't you gonna apologize for stepping on my foot?

sense_8171aae26db1175dfab26b3cccbaba11.text: Depois que o primeiro homem / Maravilhosamente pisou na lua / Eu me senti com direitos, com princípios / E dignidade / De me libertar
sense_8171aae26db1175dfab26b3cccbaba11.translation: After the first man / Wonderfully stepped on the moon / I felt I had rights, principles / And dignity / To liberate myself

sense_c6b8f1eeadc08ac26f5733413ad4d0f0.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_c6b8f1eeadc08ac26f5733413ad4d0f0.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_c6b8f1eeadc08ac26f5733413ad4d0f0.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_c6b8f1eeadc08ac26f5733413ad4d0f0.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_1ca0eba901ee2a85205eeb54e17e2327.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_1ca0eba901ee2a85205eeb54e17e2327.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_634fe0cc0ea7a16f905e755c206f5be2.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_634fe0cc0ea7a16f905e755c206f5be2.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_634fe0cc0ea7a16f905e755c206f5be2.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_634fe0cc0ea7a16f905e755c206f5be2.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.text: Succede á esta embriaguez do amor o mesmo que á embriaguez do alcool.
sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.translation: What succeeds this intoxication by love is the same as that of intoxication by alcohol.

sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.text: — […] Arranjou uma casa muito bonita ao pé de Richmond... Mas está muito avelhado, queixa-se muito do figado. E, desgraçadamente, carrega de mais nos alcools. É uma pena!
sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.translation: “ […] He’s got a lovely house near Richmond... But he’s grown old, he often complains about his liver. And, unfortunately, he overdoes it on the booze. It’s a shame!”

sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.text: Sobrio como era, e depois daquelle despendio de suor, o alcool produzio-lhe logo de pronto o effeito voluptuoso e agradavel da embriaguez nos que não são bebedos […]
sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.translation: Sober as he was, and after that expenditure of sweat, the alcohol immediately yielded him the voluptuous and pleasant effect of intoxication in those who are not drunks […]

sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.text:
Henry Ford continuou:
“A industria deve necessariamente declinar num paiz entregue á bebida. Não é possivel combinar um regimen dos alcooes e um dia ou uma semana reduzidos de trabalhos.
sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.translation:
Henry Ford continued:
“Industry must necessarily decline in a country surrendered to liquor. It’s not possible to combine a regimen of the alcohols and a day or week with reduced work.

sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.text: O inventario é rápido num estabelecimento que só vende aguardente, alcool e assucar.
sense_cd29795e0e1586a07d5888e9c938cd00.translation: The inventory goes fast in an establishment that only sells aguardiente, liquor and sugar.

sense_28e2453d82b02b3085597f34ff8ed9a3.text: 5 — Freire, Affonso de Castilho — Determinação do kerosene nos alcohoes desnaturados.
sense_28e2453d82b02b3085597f34ff8ed9a3.translation: 5 — Freire, Affonso de Castilho — Determination of kerosene in denatured alcohols.

sense_53d22a923fa97dc3f86fc4a5f9a1d7f4.text: A gente puxava briga com qualquer um.

sense_53d22a923fa97dc3f86fc4a5f9a1d7f4.translation: He initiated a chat with the neighbours.

sense_6daf821edf137551d63239e226d0adc3.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_6daf821edf137551d63239e226d0adc3.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_55844fdd4c653a69a00f9fe438951e17.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_55844fdd4c653a69a00f9fe438951e17.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_55844fdd4c653a69a00f9fe438951e17.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_55844fdd4c653a69a00f9fe438951e17.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_5466e92cdb46a7f2a6f9babd3b1a0b84.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_5466e92cdb46a7f2a6f9babd3b1a0b84.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_5466e92cdb46a7f2a6f9babd3b1a0b84.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_5466e92cdb46a7f2a6f9babd3b1a0b84.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_14ea075b97196f70a30e07cec6b70384.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_14ea075b97196f70a30e07cec6b70384.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_14ea075b97196f70a30e07cec6b70384.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_14ea075b97196f70a30e07cec6b70384.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_3e6876fb42ddf75f3bd7c9f4501f8c7d.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_3e6876fb42ddf75f3bd7c9f4501f8c7d.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_3e6876fb42ddf75f3bd7c9f4501f8c7d.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_3e6876fb42ddf75f3bd7c9f4501f8c7d.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_3e6876fb42ddf75f3bd7c9f4501f8c7d.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_3e6876fb42ddf75f3bd7c9f4501f8c7d.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_bf8b981dc2d60af58e3ff15378b89c77.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_bf8b981dc2d60af58e3ff15378b89c77.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_bf8b981dc2d60af58e3ff15378b89c77.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_bf8b981dc2d60af58e3ff15378b89c77.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_c0161ecda99cf8eadf23014bf72d1922.text: Os alunos assistiram às aulas de português.
sense_c0161ecda99cf8eadf23014bf72d1922.translation: The students attended the Portuguese classes.

sense_c0161ecda99cf8eadf23014bf72d1922.text: Assistimos o filme até o final.
sense_c0161ecda99cf8eadf23014bf72d1922.translation: We watched the film until the end.

sense_c0161ecda99cf8eadf23014bf72d1922.text: Nem gosto mais de assistir TV.
sense_c0161ecda99cf8eadf23014bf72d1922.translation: I don’t even like to watch TV anymore.

sense_5c46ff9e3529f6b96e0eedae75cf223c.text: Assistimos aqui em Guarulhos há tempo.
sense_5c46ff9e3529f6b96e0eedae75cf223c.translation: We live here in Guarulhos for a long time.

sense_5c46ff9e3529f6b96e0eedae75cf223c.text: Tenho próprio casal e nele assisto
sense_5c46ff9e3529f6b96e0eedae75cf223c.translation: I have my own village and in it I reside

sense_49f2720df6e2f5b93498f53e673f1077.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_49f2720df6e2f5b93498f53e673f1077.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_11ff9e3d01d3da11d3798fcb5f6be766.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_11ff9e3d01d3da11d3798fcb5f6be766.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_fee83200103ca079677d55d7e0328f82.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_fee83200103ca079677d55d7e0328f82.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_2462795642bb97e562f68960850c1be7.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_9274739a8d000f8ad86db45ea88713a5.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_9274739a8d000f8ad86db45ea88713a5.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_9274739a8d000f8ad86db45ea88713a5.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_9274739a8d000f8ad86db45ea88713a5.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_8fa5b6ec0df6cdfcdde481c4fee3e606.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_8fa5b6ec0df6cdfcdde481c4fee3e606.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_8674c260337a32e1ec6cf8a6272f55fd.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_8674c260337a32e1ec6cf8a6272f55fd.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_8b11f26605fd980bac019444c75d6e72.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_8b11f26605fd980bac019444c75d6e72.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_8b11f26605fd980bac019444c75d6e72.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_8b11f26605fd980bac019444c75d6e72.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_d025b38752405e917be042d34d7bc4ad.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_d025b38752405e917be042d34d7bc4ad.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_ff338720a885c64ffc992cd983daf190.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_ff338720a885c64ffc992cd983daf190.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_e979ca236cd16d955b1366cceebc6043.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_e979ca236cd16d955b1366cceebc6043.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_1e0873d104d38b645588019f39e55609.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_1e0873d104d38b645588019f39e55609.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_1e0873d104d38b645588019f39e55609.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_1e0873d104d38b645588019f39e55609.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_c682c150b6a43ff4337dc258833c5ea8.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_c682c150b6a43ff4337dc258833c5ea8.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_c682c150b6a43ff4337dc258833c5ea8.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_c682c150b6a43ff4337dc258833c5ea8.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_6f1374d359b1324e9006ef01813a9e41.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_6f1374d359b1324e9006ef01813a9e41.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_fefbdef4ce447dc0352503d4d620701a.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_fefbdef4ce447dc0352503d4d620701a.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_60b799d05770eeaf7ee82aa7c272d6b1.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_60b799d05770eeaf7ee82aa7c272d6b1.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_60b799d05770eeaf7ee82aa7c272d6b1.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_60b799d05770eeaf7ee82aa7c272d6b1.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_9bd8c3f835b4e0dcb53f3ed6dbfdad8f.text: Acalme seus filhos, senão expulso vocês da loja.
sense_9bd8c3f835b4e0dcb53f3ed6dbfdad8f.translation: Calm your children down or I will throw you out of the store.

sense_9bd8c3f835b4e0dcb53f3ed6dbfdad8f.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_9bd8c3f835b4e0dcb53f3ed6dbfdad8f.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_b8ddfbd80c08c8718cc16388d9680f26.text: Depois da tempestade, o mar se acalmou.
sense_b8ddfbd80c08c8718cc16388d9680f26.translation: After the storm, the sea calmed down.
The noise of the leaves calmed down.

sense_9d0eac00b0c1550bae0297c26b4189d7.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_9d0eac00b0c1550bae0297c26b4189d7.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_9d0eac00b0c1550bae0297c26b4189d7.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_9d0eac00b0c1550bae0297c26b4189d7.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_db8550d77dbce73a509cc99771a9f023.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_db8550d77dbce73a509cc99771a9f023.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_db8550d77dbce73a509cc99771a9f023.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_db8550d77dbce73a509cc99771a9f023.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_02fe152dd7b156e6e9bd2d2660b5bba8.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_02fe152dd7b156e6e9bd2d2660b5bba8.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_3d101852d5e6e76a6776509b570d6def.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_d4777c49aa33c2e75722d3088fdff8f7.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_d4777c49aa33c2e75722d3088fdff8f7.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_d29af001cee7306e9a06ad776d59f7be.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_d4b18301d932fe8f5b9ed0f7963b6401.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_d4b18301d932fe8f5b9ed0f7963b6401.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_bfee93596b51116eb09983f7b1e8b4d8.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_bfee93596b51116eb09983f7b1e8b4d8.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_bfee93596b51116eb09983f7b1e8b4d8.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_bfee93596b51116eb09983f7b1e8b4d8.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_53c21d516c7f0f19f967ef4545ebad80.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_53c21d516c7f0f19f967ef4545ebad80.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_2ca2cba293567d6eba8f3215bc5ef515.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_2ca2cba293567d6eba8f3215bc5ef515.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_569eb040ae22e3f5b3769678aa531990.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_569eb040ae22e3f5b3769678aa531990.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_b015746484581254762fafa3e0f9d6c0.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_b015746484581254762fafa3e0f9d6c0.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_b015746484581254762fafa3e0f9d6c0.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_b015746484581254762fafa3e0f9d6c0.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_85713565b09ffcf6479411ffef5714ef.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_85713565b09ffcf6479411ffef5714ef.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_78e00174d59fe54f7493e3f3bb0bb8c0.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_78e00174d59fe54f7493e3f3bb0bb8c0.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_322f62df33b3975f5805df7046380d55.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_322f62df33b3975f5805df7046380d55.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_3bf0861978593bdeb9d426b4eff6a2a7.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_3bf0861978593bdeb9d426b4eff6a2a7.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_3bf0861978593bdeb9d426b4eff6a2a7.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_3bf0861978593bdeb9d426b4eff6a2a7.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_c2251f0a24f47c5811bc34b831d60372.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_c2251f0a24f47c5811bc34b831d60372.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_c2251f0a24f47c5811bc34b831d60372.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_c2251f0a24f47c5811bc34b831d60372.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_6a23ea24414f5def443c266a192f7e95.text: Este livro é maior do que aquele.
sense_6a23ea24414f5def443c266a192f7e95.translation: This book is bigger than that one.

sense_eab1a24ccfb09a22ec3e55c6401ebc14.text: O Grande Porto é uma região metropolitana no norte de Portugal.
sense_eab1a24ccfb09a22ec3e55c6401ebc14.translation: Greater Porto is a metropolitan area in the north of Portugal.
I live in the metropolis of Lisbon.

sense_f18e8c773ca04b3426118e4b87dcd90c.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_f18e8c773ca04b3426118e4b87dcd90c.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_f18e8c773ca04b3426118e4b87dcd90c.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_554088a1feb043a502d10e463c4c1f8f.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_554088a1feb043a502d10e463c4c1f8f.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_554088a1feb043a502d10e463c4c1f8f.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_554088a1feb043a502d10e463c4c1f8f.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_f95a36956ac536687fe8537d5b5748f8.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_dcc03516f9cd315fec3aeb7b5f0e7699.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_0809f34139b72ac6bbc64c62d1c020cc.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_0809f34139b72ac6bbc64c62d1c020cc.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_3362ba85b16b65631133ef0ee61f92f7.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_e5ec175edb773ac80afd1d946af09ebb.text: Acalme seus filhos, senão expulso vocês da loja.
sense_e5ec175edb773ac80afd1d946af09ebb.translation: Calm your children down or I will throw you out of the store.

sense_e5ec175edb773ac80afd1d946af09ebb.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_e5ec175edb773ac80afd1d946af09ebb.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_5d1b9df35458f72c5b92671caae0dd94.text: Depois da tempestade, o mar se acalmou.
sense_5d1b9df35458f72c5b92671caae0dd94.translation: After the storm, the sea calmed down.
The noise of the leaves calmed down.

sense_304bf594860ee5ba5827ce5925903e4d.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_ab12aa8025ee16cb1b49cd5a819a554f.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_47fd2885137a0170ce156324390c975e.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_7e30eee2d9cd26430274e6ea097ea450.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_7e30eee2d9cd26430274e6ea097ea450.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_8c271fdb58b1463fd9580f0994ded334.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_8c271fdb58b1463fd9580f0994ded334.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_f61777c9f301a4d759db005a624c94cf.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_f047e4efa67f7379027d5c2581d603e5.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_f047e4efa67f7379027d5c2581d603e5.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_84b82f7d7831d2c4b4d6b761a7e1d2a1.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_81082c307d768e6eb02c4786764b2d16.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_81082c307d768e6eb02c4786764b2d16.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_6c9a50ae85b8b9ce4dd4a37fcad5551c.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_3220c1130a9912eac8dc198b3b174daa.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_3220c1130a9912eac8dc198b3b174daa.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_4de4f3c5c33bbdc4db6d66ce951565eb.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_d2de552b209b83cc3f5337824c3895c7.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_d2de552b209b83cc3f5337824c3895c7.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_87e27c935f758e403ee5182448b548b6.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_87e27c935f758e403ee5182448b548b6.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_ea60e4f38da052852ff59a7f2ff7093d.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_ea60e4f38da052852ff59a7f2ff7093d.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_ea60e4f38da052852ff59a7f2ff7093d.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_ea60e4f38da052852ff59a7f2ff7093d.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_85b2d03a984d765ea7d639664a8347b4.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_85b2d03a984d765ea7d639664a8347b4.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_85b2d03a984d765ea7d639664a8347b4.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_85b2d03a984d765ea7d639664a8347b4.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_da11ce32b0354213988ed61535b59695.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_da11ce32b0354213988ed61535b59695.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_06d969c634cdadbb7d21d04a03f457a9.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_06d969c634cdadbb7d21d04a03f457a9.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_48d6d64271f4bb89312a8fe27671b30c.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_48d6d64271f4bb89312a8fe27671b30c.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_5e48fffa47a019622035ab469ed2834a.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_5e48fffa47a019622035ab469ed2834a.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_56cfeaa1d0e2c7bead90b7c99f4b7d3d.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_ab376684b24e97ebd166d126180a3eda.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_af7e8d44acec69fc7c5f89434eecce5f.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_af7e8d44acec69fc7c5f89434eecce5f.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_756cf2cdaf151939116e241b6bcba67e.text: Crispiniano quis virar valente. Que é que adiantava? Fifi reteve com dificuldade umas lágrimas sinceras.
sense_756cf2cdaf151939116e241b6bcba67e.translation: Crispiniano wanted to become valiant. What was the point? Fifi retained with difficulty some sincere tears.

sense_756cf2cdaf151939116e241b6bcba67e.text: Subornar também não adianta. Quer dizer: é impossível. Melhor é revelar o segredo.
sense_756cf2cdaf151939116e241b6bcba67e.translation: Bribing also doesn't work. I mean: it is impossible. It is better to reveal the secret.

sense_9017340bbba3ecf51d26a0ee986fa74f.text: A palavra “livro” significa um conjunto de páginas ligadas.
sense_9017340bbba3ecf51d26a0ee986fa74f.translation: The word “book” means a collection of bound pages.

sense_3eaf1a0bcd341360072e26c1dad462ca.text: Peixe e vinho tinto não combinam.
sense_3eaf1a0bcd341360072e26c1dad462ca.translation: Fish and red wine don't go together.

sense_ab1430844f571934dfe366ac291cd5bc.text: Os bêbados começaram a se agarrar.
Um idiota queria se agarrar comigo.
sense_ab1430844f571934dfe366ac291cd5bc.translation: Some idiot wanted to fight with me.

sense_c0b6511c7396778d93ea6cb361be6feb.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_c0b6511c7396778d93ea6cb361be6feb.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_c0b6511c7396778d93ea6cb361be6feb.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_c0b6511c7396778d93ea6cb361be6feb.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_75e7777dc541d7617145f150b12dedc0.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_643d47781dd6cd800e44ca2ac24ca47a.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_dd34a253f18378cb00a9ec22b72046a6.text: Para/e de ser tolo e começa/ce a pensar.
sense_dd34a253f18378cb00a9ec22b72046a6.translation: Stop being foolish and start thinking.

sense_dd34a253f18378cb00a9ec22b72046a6.text: Infelizmente, o que fizemos foi extremamente tolo.
sense_dd34a253f18378cb00a9ec22b72046a6.translation: Unfortunately, what we did was extremely foolish.

sense_ea8f1158d03fc6ede691988cf1e342db.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_ddd8546de918d284818907286248a0a5.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_746a451b1b424d109318472e74ca256e.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_746a451b1b424d109318472e74ca256e.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_746a451b1b424d109318472e74ca256e.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_0a0551066134941d623264f2178022d1.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_0a0551066134941d623264f2178022d1.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_a1a64b67d291339075d956cd6f4c2bfd.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_66d5f25e7453853017494e2ab5492ddb.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_66d5f25e7453853017494e2ab5492ddb.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_66a03b12513aba9344f51e3df7b7a079.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_66a03b12513aba9344f51e3df7b7a079.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_66a03b12513aba9344f51e3df7b7a079.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_66a03b12513aba9344f51e3df7b7a079.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_5acefc2d5138260791e39bf48e6cac60.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_6a58f998b0d245c1f0e59963564d9edf.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_6a58f998b0d245c1f0e59963564d9edf.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_983b42a24ea9627c0ea17337e29a6bbd.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_983b42a24ea9627c0ea17337e29a6bbd.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_035c0e4b443bb19e0235fa6aae517c3b.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_035c0e4b443bb19e0235fa6aae517c3b.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_035c0e4b443bb19e0235fa6aae517c3b.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_035c0e4b443bb19e0235fa6aae517c3b.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_035c0e4b443bb19e0235fa6aae517c3b.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_035c0e4b443bb19e0235fa6aae517c3b.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_19fc699c081f9d2d67377309be7e843c.text: Vocês estão cegos? A resposta é óbvia!
sense_19fc699c081f9d2d67377309be7e843c.translation: Are you guys blind? The answer is obvious!

sense_2b6b8bfd74a0397056c262c79de619fc.translation: I became blind in my left eye.

sense_4d8303c19e56c245ef194896cb8dcee4.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_4d8303c19e56c245ef194896cb8dcee4.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_449b01d6aa540e23ed6d4cb0dc29538d.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_449b01d6aa540e23ed6d4cb0dc29538d.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_8c803444c6c15a3d74863e7291b13bf8.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_8c803444c6c15a3d74863e7291b13bf8.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_3551e668a8f7b38acb5cdd95f5963dce.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_3551e668a8f7b38acb5cdd95f5963dce.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_5247ea9fae72a72aeb62a8854e9bc3d7.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_5247ea9fae72a72aeb62a8854e9bc3d7.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_40c6e62e5375a7c70ce8accbdd411a72.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_40c6e62e5375a7c70ce8accbdd411a72.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_40c6e62e5375a7c70ce8accbdd411a72.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_40c6e62e5375a7c70ce8accbdd411a72.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_e18880ec371a91fdd4c2ed87e4dec4cc.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_e18880ec371a91fdd4c2ed87e4dec4cc.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_e18880ec371a91fdd4c2ed87e4dec4cc.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_e18880ec371a91fdd4c2ed87e4dec4cc.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_d2a448b34d20515ce952b258489d7db6.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_d2a448b34d20515ce952b258489d7db6.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_4d5667c298aec3ed9510a26e2fd51b84.text: O paciente se atrasou e perdeu a consulta.
sense_4d5667c298aec3ed9510a26e2fd51b84.translation: The patient was late and missed the appointment.

sense_458306d5a45bc2c1f278aa5585f081fd.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_458306d5a45bc2c1f278aa5585f081fd.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_c6b5b76868297b71a638fe48de1580fb.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_4a1cce95477d28f292d387f89cf3872a.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_4a1cce95477d28f292d387f89cf3872a.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_4a1cce95477d28f292d387f89cf3872a.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_4a1cce95477d28f292d387f89cf3872a.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_28bd3fc7a7fdd045de32a741f6d995ac.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_28bd3fc7a7fdd045de32a741f6d995ac.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_877ace4b55e1a92bab2d5860759e295b.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_877ace4b55e1a92bab2d5860759e295b.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_877ace4b55e1a92bab2d5860759e295b.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_877ace4b55e1a92bab2d5860759e295b.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_f3259d2ea6d0f9ebe1f982f331dc7c70.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_64aaa17b37223d7dea605a8d32e96e6f.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_64aaa17b37223d7dea605a8d32e96e6f.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_639563730125d998a3f7cc648f21efa3.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_639563730125d998a3f7cc648f21efa3.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_874bb5e2c421691711c679d450946f56.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_874bb5e2c421691711c679d450946f56.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_94a37acc9749d942a45cbd1493a66fb1.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_94a37acc9749d942a45cbd1493a66fb1.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_7a4473852b21f5e7c23a1882ae07ad2c.text: O que eu vi é esse mesmo.
sense_7a4473852b21f5e7c23a1882ae07ad2c.translation: The one I saw is this one indeed.

sense_7a4473852b21f5e7c23a1882ae07ad2c.text: O cidadão mesmo que o prendeu.

sense_b76d6b9d8c10a89c2769d6290ccae5c1.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_b76d6b9d8c10a89c2769d6290ccae5c1.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_ffb0563f92a303b041f6d6807550c88d.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_ffb0563f92a303b041f6d6807550c88d.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_082b3e93d3ebb2af684728c52f96e1a5.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_19880ecbc6a76d59e2fbeefcc68006f0.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_19880ecbc6a76d59e2fbeefcc68006f0.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_d424018366a06ee316295ca0f63785ee.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_a0701d9cdcbd19f4ed697a8eb8aac654.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_a0701d9cdcbd19f4ed697a8eb8aac654.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_4e74e30d947fa02b2a9f54ed46afa3d1.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_4e74e30d947fa02b2a9f54ed46afa3d1.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_4e74e30d947fa02b2a9f54ed46afa3d1.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_4e74e30d947fa02b2a9f54ed46afa3d1.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_4e74e30d947fa02b2a9f54ed46afa3d1.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_4e74e30d947fa02b2a9f54ed46afa3d1.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_23d4b62aa326df1b2b7fc22714926087.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_23d4b62aa326df1b2b7fc22714926087.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_e2f18c3c16b3eee7fb59be2a46fd72bf.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_e2f18c3c16b3eee7fb59be2a46fd72bf.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_e2f18c3c16b3eee7fb59be2a46fd72bf.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_e2f18c3c16b3eee7fb59be2a46fd72bf.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_2df59b546e830099f8f50a1eb1a9a06b.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_2df59b546e830099f8f50a1eb1a9a06b.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_2df59b546e830099f8f50a1eb1a9a06b.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_2df59b546e830099f8f50a1eb1a9a06b.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_77e7b03ed6aea77ebf0549ca3925500d.text: Só três pessoas vão receber o prémio.
sense_77e7b03ed6aea77ebf0549ca3925500d.translation: Only three people will receive the prize.

sense_fea2025e9289b915053e2da9eff32988.text: Pensei que você tivesse dito que ela estava só mandando você escrever!
sense_fea2025e9289b915053e2da9eff32988.translation: I thought you said that she was just telling you to write!

sense_d500dd3f603725976000a690574137c6.text: Desconectar o computador direto da tomada sem desligá-lo antes pode queimá-lo.
sense_d500dd3f603725976000a690574137c6.translation: Unplugging the computer directly without turning it off first may break it.

sense_57de209de4dffad0d12d08c041de8c85.text: Quando tiver uma dúvida, vá à biblioteca.
sense_57de209de4dffad0d12d08c041de8c85.translation: When you are in doubt, go to the library.

sense_d3aa65c2d92a1e866fd5c3a32fdbb9cc.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_d3aa65c2d92a1e866fd5c3a32fdbb9cc.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_d3aa65c2d92a1e866fd5c3a32fdbb9cc.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_d3aa65c2d92a1e866fd5c3a32fdbb9cc.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_efa1bd966c277ffa57197977b01b49cb.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_efa1bd966c277ffa57197977b01b49cb.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_b286b132a465afdc0371efc82a25a681.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_b286b132a465afdc0371efc82a25a681.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_b286b132a465afdc0371efc82a25a681.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_b286b132a465afdc0371efc82a25a681.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_d7679a00492b5bbe1b724002dcbda43e.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_d7679a00492b5bbe1b724002dcbda43e.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_d7679a00492b5bbe1b724002dcbda43e.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_d7679a00492b5bbe1b724002dcbda43e.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_5475d8ea953f7dbd4252a82dfe60863e.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_23cda325eac45479143b842d224ca8a1.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_23cda325eac45479143b842d224ca8a1.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_23cda325eac45479143b842d224ca8a1.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_23cda325eac45479143b842d224ca8a1.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_c7e748187c4cad926367a1747ad7f832.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_bdf426d4bc4678e4ca28dc56e6a576d0.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_bdf426d4bc4678e4ca28dc56e6a576d0.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_bdf426d4bc4678e4ca28dc56e6a576d0.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_bdf426d4bc4678e4ca28dc56e6a576d0.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_bdf426d4bc4678e4ca28dc56e6a576d0.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_bdf426d4bc4678e4ca28dc56e6a576d0.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_2d8674606bccd30a947956165c29f131.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_2e6b84718e094c32da98390737d28214.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_2e6b84718e094c32da98390737d28214.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_f6229b2fffad736c37c41af563ccb29e.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_f6229b2fffad736c37c41af563ccb29e.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_32f8d58c1fea17f721dd43bcf6cd4d24.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_3d66356059945992f46cd7ec6efe2e19.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_3d66356059945992f46cd7ec6efe2e19.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_5d22d2377095081dc7c25890e39f25e4.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_3003171a351fad711211235f86a540c9.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_3003171a351fad711211235f86a540c9.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_3003171a351fad711211235f86a540c9.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_3003171a351fad711211235f86a540c9.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_be102929579ae2f7550c4b754196d981.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_be102929579ae2f7550c4b754196d981.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_ef9d9aef47461dd2f8e765b5e6f25c1d.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_ef9d9aef47461dd2f8e765b5e6f25c1d.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_ef9d9aef47461dd2f8e765b5e6f25c1d.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_ef9d9aef47461dd2f8e765b5e6f25c1d.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_3cf467b00ff9bdee3bde601d2c306879.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_3cf467b00ff9bdee3bde601d2c306879.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_3cf467b00ff9bdee3bde601d2c306879.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_3cf467b00ff9bdee3bde601d2c306879.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_b0ddbdcfade7ee83d4cba7e0902d0fe8.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_b0ddbdcfade7ee83d4cba7e0902d0fe8.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_495b83fbe0ce4b9ba17ad9b98c6e0b17.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_495b83fbe0ce4b9ba17ad9b98c6e0b17.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_495b83fbe0ce4b9ba17ad9b98c6e0b17.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_495b83fbe0ce4b9ba17ad9b98c6e0b17.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_9f133c5df0b0079661a4f7f98dd90494.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_9f133c5df0b0079661a4f7f98dd90494.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_41b8d873d13a4062ab03320709c0f779.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_4a37514671fedf05361bff4637d4dd34.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_4a37514671fedf05361bff4637d4dd34.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_74e066d8a649f781c40ff4691395f4da.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_f46a16d5cfaa2f97ec12d4ceb0a6d57d.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_f46a16d5cfaa2f97ec12d4ceb0a6d57d.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_88aefd9c2f4a313d49ca485806f7be64.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_88aefd9c2f4a313d49ca485806f7be64.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_d3ca01aed69dccb7829e24b0c9801aa8.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_9762372293fa45de6051c2cddfa4acee.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_9762372293fa45de6051c2cddfa4acee.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_9762372293fa45de6051c2cddfa4acee.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_9762372293fa45de6051c2cddfa4acee.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_24da39acdedf2f58ca3fb273033c6484.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_24da39acdedf2f58ca3fb273033c6484.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_ab5ef724da74a72fa9b41a691957e952.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_ab5ef724da74a72fa9b41a691957e952.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_49cd00f81fb105316f0a91032a49c9ed.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_49cd00f81fb105316f0a91032a49c9ed.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_665e86b93f45c27f94195bb010668219.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_665e86b93f45c27f94195bb010668219.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_665e86b93f45c27f94195bb010668219.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_665e86b93f45c27f94195bb010668219.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_61e68657604da76f7b2d63364c4406d7.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_adb795ffd393aef43d319a5f697b562f.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_adb795ffd393aef43d319a5f697b562f.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_adb795ffd393aef43d319a5f697b562f.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_adb795ffd393aef43d319a5f697b562f.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_1e56a1b4ad54f16a8dfb3eaafbaf281e.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_1e56a1b4ad54f16a8dfb3eaafbaf281e.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_1e56a1b4ad54f16a8dfb3eaafbaf281e.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_1e56a1b4ad54f16a8dfb3eaafbaf281e.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_4170f528c61242c3970347f6ab76ca13.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_4170f528c61242c3970347f6ab76ca13.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_d6f70cc08b31e050cb1d955008201263.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_d6f70cc08b31e050cb1d955008201263.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_d6f70cc08b31e050cb1d955008201263.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_d6f70cc08b31e050cb1d955008201263.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_098a78465f09603972245cf0b6bdfa1a.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_098a78465f09603972245cf0b6bdfa1a.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_098a78465f09603972245cf0b6bdfa1a.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_098a78465f09603972245cf0b6bdfa1a.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_e115549691b6e54bc88d56719960317d.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_944765a4ec89fbba7a3486ee6a31146c.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_f048402ec295aa5856eed480989bdba3.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_f048402ec295aa5856eed480989bdba3.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_b9d560eea80b8c65da85f7a48a2294fe.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_af5ad9ff85fe15178163b5ee098f6f24.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_af5ad9ff85fe15178163b5ee098f6f24.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_639c4c8f0f903c4b192ce9b8c434eebc.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_639c4c8f0f903c4b192ce9b8c434eebc.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_1399730b00e04f7bab28f29181e15586.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_1399730b00e04f7bab28f29181e15586.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_1399730b00e04f7bab28f29181e15586.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_1399730b00e04f7bab28f29181e15586.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_c5d6ebb9ea60b00d6726365fbcf122e6.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_c5d6ebb9ea60b00d6726365fbcf122e6.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_c5d6ebb9ea60b00d6726365fbcf122e6.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_c5d6ebb9ea60b00d6726365fbcf122e6.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_f908d93556768e268c48ee7bfdb72610.text: O papel de parede é muito giro.

sense_2a8bbb3106ed2ade956600170255610a.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_2a1cf15606e8e63cb7a134d15024916b.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_2a1cf15606e8e63cb7a134d15024916b.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_3ee6487e867c5614e48d4a33430deb75.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_3ee6487e867c5614e48d4a33430deb75.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_3ee6487e867c5614e48d4a33430deb75.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_3ee6487e867c5614e48d4a33430deb75.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_1999af3120b7302e4d65a834f63da15c.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_1999af3120b7302e4d65a834f63da15c.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_1999af3120b7302e4d65a834f63da15c.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_1999af3120b7302e4d65a834f63da15c.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_ccb2bd5baefbb71e27628f9984f590dd.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_ccb2bd5baefbb71e27628f9984f590dd.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_ccb2bd5baefbb71e27628f9984f590dd.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_ccb2bd5baefbb71e27628f9984f590dd.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_97a7bac691faea951e216c8ca6be3353.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_97a7bac691faea951e216c8ca6be3353.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_ba06e3c377b8043fa8eb152c8841e233.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_f1e4b1a558d04dd9923e81eb6ded789b.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_f1e4b1a558d04dd9923e81eb6ded789b.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_f1e4b1a558d04dd9923e81eb6ded789b.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_f30ef09a1ae79b9aff7114822d74f0a7.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_f30ef09a1ae79b9aff7114822d74f0a7.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_f94d73bc4802d4d94462a6d4692fe436.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_f94d73bc4802d4d94462a6d4692fe436.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_5b0e04f80062755bfdbdbd8d8acc9c3e.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_044d710b82c43cfdfd99f0b5b690cf4f.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_044d710b82c43cfdfd99f0b5b690cf4f.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_044d710b82c43cfdfd99f0b5b690cf4f.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_044d710b82c43cfdfd99f0b5b690cf4f.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_462b72a35de857bc85b7dae8ad4ef4da.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_462b72a35de857bc85b7dae8ad4ef4da.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_d174592dfff214c910937fad819d1cec.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_084def4ade12c9fcfc97a921fc8fe5e6.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_084def4ade12c9fcfc97a921fc8fe5e6.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_e9964b18a298e0584189914172d7ea41.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_e9964b18a298e0584189914172d7ea41.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_ad5d37464c3566ba6c9af0c2472f0879.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_ad5d37464c3566ba6c9af0c2472f0879.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_b0760fd414a29c0d00032142f5fd04ce.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_b0760fd414a29c0d00032142f5fd04ce.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_b0760fd414a29c0d00032142f5fd04ce.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_b0760fd414a29c0d00032142f5fd04ce.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_deb001c15b93dc6b6d82781fb0f206ec.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_deb001c15b93dc6b6d82781fb0f206ec.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_93cda2c10f6d2c738ba3a3d655bf7be8.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_93cda2c10f6d2c738ba3a3d655bf7be8.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_93cda2c10f6d2c738ba3a3d655bf7be8.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_93cda2c10f6d2c738ba3a3d655bf7be8.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_1efef194f4c99c27766a567ea641d13f.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_1efef194f4c99c27766a567ea641d13f.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_d6c8dee7b8aa3e6452162c2a597ac0a4.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_d6c8dee7b8aa3e6452162c2a597ac0a4.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_974c3250e9ce723ef8b5aeed7a7dc65e.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_974c3250e9ce723ef8b5aeed7a7dc65e.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_7f660bbc42ceb6d0b8fd1e1fb07bfd17.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_7f660bbc42ceb6d0b8fd1e1fb07bfd17.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_7f660bbc42ceb6d0b8fd1e1fb07bfd17.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_7f660bbc42ceb6d0b8fd1e1fb07bfd17.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_482c076bdc2803ec7ce536e4845b21f2.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_8f335b5c3e597b214ec3ec9aeeb9a2b2.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_8f335b5c3e597b214ec3ec9aeeb9a2b2.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_8f335b5c3e597b214ec3ec9aeeb9a2b2.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_f348fb3082938032d08517eaad4447ed.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_f348fb3082938032d08517eaad4447ed.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_f348fb3082938032d08517eaad4447ed.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_f348fb3082938032d08517eaad4447ed.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_7b6afa2fa75be6cea00dec0f16bd8bcd.text: O carro está a funcionar/funcionando bem mal.
sense_7b6afa2fa75be6cea00dec0f16bd8bcd.translation: The car is running pretty badly.

sense_f082474f60a099e285610b5f335d4d33.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_f082474f60a099e285610b5f335d4d33.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_f082474f60a099e285610b5f335d4d33.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_1d0734c6631dd195760142249f6f9de8.text: O paciente se atrasou e perdeu a consulta.
sense_1d0734c6631dd195760142249f6f9de8.translation: The patient was late and missed the appointment.

sense_5b33ee731774a87b82d002ecdbc699a8.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_5b33ee731774a87b82d002ecdbc699a8.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_599f38bd63964cf11dfef3747ec182e4.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_599f38bd63964cf11dfef3747ec182e4.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_599f38bd63964cf11dfef3747ec182e4.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_599f38bd63964cf11dfef3747ec182e4.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_93804432d4b469677abbfee8519aabdf.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_4e6bc8ca0c707db32a04d0b53cc1288a.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_4e6bc8ca0c707db32a04d0b53cc1288a.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_4e6bc8ca0c707db32a04d0b53cc1288a.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_4e6bc8ca0c707db32a04d0b53cc1288a.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_aa490c0c09a3f610ed10ddbc6f82f932.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_aa490c0c09a3f610ed10ddbc6f82f932.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_aa490c0c09a3f610ed10ddbc6f82f932.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_aa490c0c09a3f610ed10ddbc6f82f932.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_6b75ef8d09fef30d0a52c988b9beb624.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_da6c9ae04158e51aeca9ca8a627c2a5e.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_da6c9ae04158e51aeca9ca8a627c2a5e.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_da6c9ae04158e51aeca9ca8a627c2a5e.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_da6c9ae04158e51aeca9ca8a627c2a5e.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_5be869c1b7a4715d3c3ba347ba61d945.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_5be869c1b7a4715d3c3ba347ba61d945.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_c91b08439910bdcc2fc3f33ae7cb79b3.text: Dizem que os porcos-espinhos conseguem deixar seus espinhos armados.
sense_c91b08439910bdcc2fc3f33ae7cb79b3.translation: They say that porcupines can make their quills erect.

sense_c91b08439910bdcc2fc3f33ae7cb79b3.text: Tenho tantos redemoinhos que meu cabelo está sempre armado.
sense_c91b08439910bdcc2fc3f33ae7cb79b3.translation: I have so many cowlicks that my hair is always sticking up.

sense_e6986c267e2ab91e024035b63bcae481.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_e6986c267e2ab91e024035b63bcae481.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_80eff59cce38d34c2b570acc059ef0d2.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_80eff59cce38d34c2b570acc059ef0d2.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_80eff59cce38d34c2b570acc059ef0d2.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_80eff59cce38d34c2b570acc059ef0d2.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_96aaf7cfbeea66b6aefefb0f91d8f6ef.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_96aaf7cfbeea66b6aefefb0f91d8f6ef.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_96aaf7cfbeea66b6aefefb0f91d8f6ef.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_96aaf7cfbeea66b6aefefb0f91d8f6ef.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_b8de2f0241f6e4875cb19c05e3837023.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_b8de2f0241f6e4875cb19c05e3837023.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_e2cd8f7335770348850d7af2fe136bd6.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_6d95c762e5bac0b2b7c8564fb5ebb294.text: E aí, qual é o lance?
Esse é o lance, mano. As coisas não podem ficar assim.
sense_6d95c762e5bac0b2b7c8564fb5ebb294.translation: That's the thing, dude. Things can't stay this way.

sense_1710b263a8847f87bca0e5999dde584b.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_1710b263a8847f87bca0e5999dde584b.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_1710b263a8847f87bca0e5999dde584b.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_1710b263a8847f87bca0e5999dde584b.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_8a43caa4b284d046b7a2dadb04c9d231.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_8a43caa4b284d046b7a2dadb04c9d231.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_405c88403132717be0b247e592e77368.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_6632edb1564ca3824977b7e4b77de651.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_6632edb1564ca3824977b7e4b77de651.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_6632edb1564ca3824977b7e4b77de651.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_6632edb1564ca3824977b7e4b77de651.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_6632edb1564ca3824977b7e4b77de651.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_6632edb1564ca3824977b7e4b77de651.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_68ff4948dec675fcb303cc0fd8f1dc40.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_68ff4948dec675fcb303cc0fd8f1dc40.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_68ff4948dec675fcb303cc0fd8f1dc40.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_68ff4948dec675fcb303cc0fd8f1dc40.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_427871bcd411c89ad6f0cd24db7519fa.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_fef77060b98a60504bc34cc1191321c5.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_ee10daf4ddca1377985c0b6bd4d978f8.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_ee10daf4ddca1377985c0b6bd4d978f8.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_ee10daf4ddca1377985c0b6bd4d978f8.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_ee10daf4ddca1377985c0b6bd4d978f8.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_a3a6d70db4738bd01699dd180b2fc50a.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_a3a6d70db4738bd01699dd180b2fc50a.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_26132108f30ef4de027b0a29525f7c2c.text: Houve, portanto, um augmento medio nos salarios de 40 °|° […]
sense_26132108f30ef4de027b0a29525f7c2c.translation: There was, thus an average increase in pay of 40% […]

sense_5a455deb5e673f6e141880855dbe399b.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_5a455deb5e673f6e141880855dbe399b.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_5a455deb5e673f6e141880855dbe399b.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_5a455deb5e673f6e141880855dbe399b.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_73a434dbc39337dd22768ab348c2939f.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_73a434dbc39337dd22768ab348c2939f.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_73a434dbc39337dd22768ab348c2939f.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_73a434dbc39337dd22768ab348c2939f.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_c1e78d9d4e73f449c02be25ae19ee6c8.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_c1e78d9d4e73f449c02be25ae19ee6c8.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_c198c229a51991f5fc9baf8e85d76906.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_c198c229a51991f5fc9baf8e85d76906.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_850121db6d38c667d23001ea74ca28ff.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_850121db6d38c667d23001ea74ca28ff.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_db8a9ef4d2af1a3215a1e23c54465139.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_db8a9ef4d2af1a3215a1e23c54465139.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_db8a9ef4d2af1a3215a1e23c54465139.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_db8a9ef4d2af1a3215a1e23c54465139.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_e6502799b0e7ae4a41b0fac636669a75.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_e6502799b0e7ae4a41b0fac636669a75.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_495d6c632dd9a1723a4895ffb3413aca.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_495d6c632dd9a1723a4895ffb3413aca.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_495d6c632dd9a1723a4895ffb3413aca.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_495d6c632dd9a1723a4895ffb3413aca.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_495d6c632dd9a1723a4895ffb3413aca.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_495d6c632dd9a1723a4895ffb3413aca.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_be4fcc4b72a5a6f41d6b495b44adee6a.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_be4fcc4b72a5a6f41d6b495b44adee6a.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_773a1faed68ba57bca5464cf06c2b558.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_773a1faed68ba57bca5464cf06c2b558.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_cfd16d4b3f2c31c41848854d0ef3c043.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_cfd16d4b3f2c31c41848854d0ef3c043.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_cfd16d4b3f2c31c41848854d0ef3c043.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_cfd16d4b3f2c31c41848854d0ef3c043.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_02a9283d57dc889acae7cdd42600d81c.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_02a9283d57dc889acae7cdd42600d81c.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_12d628ae7853a22cecd900234a1c06ef.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_12d628ae7853a22cecd900234a1c06ef.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_5118039655bfd64d3bb0b605dd8487b5.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_5118039655bfd64d3bb0b605dd8487b5.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_5118039655bfd64d3bb0b605dd8487b5.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_5118039655bfd64d3bb0b605dd8487b5.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_5118039655bfd64d3bb0b605dd8487b5.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_5118039655bfd64d3bb0b605dd8487b5.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_78d271b4dbe030a9dbab84d23c110279.text: Bebendo vinho / Quebrando as taças / Fudendo por toda casa / Se eu divido o maço, eu te amo, desgraça
sense_78d271b4dbe030a9dbab84d23c110279.translation: Drinking wine / Breaking the glasses / Fucking all around the house / If I share the pack, I love you, disgrace

sense_b0e678defee34439c04f12e4e6ca9bfc.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_964cd6156f3e16e65762a7c19288f7dc.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_964cd6156f3e16e65762a7c19288f7dc.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_964cd6156f3e16e65762a7c19288f7dc.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_e1121dbf53914406447647fd5ab9307a.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_e1121dbf53914406447647fd5ab9307a.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_901d2fefd513abfd2f8d1f107bc340da.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_901d2fefd513abfd2f8d1f107bc340da.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_8d2df0b10f29f0797f550a5e454018d6.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_8d2df0b10f29f0797f550a5e454018d6.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_8d2df0b10f29f0797f550a5e454018d6.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_8d2df0b10f29f0797f550a5e454018d6.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_1615136f60305a0d8813a37541389de2.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_39a3f81beca418ecb97acddf70ed47ce.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_ec93a54c443bddef39614b74e75642ac.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_ec93a54c443bddef39614b74e75642ac.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_ec93a54c443bddef39614b74e75642ac.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_ec93a54c443bddef39614b74e75642ac.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_b334c459b08265251308ebd739f63a18.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_b334c459b08265251308ebd739f63a18.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_81b9022e0eb034bd1499049031fc5f84.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_81b9022e0eb034bd1499049031fc5f84.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_81b9022e0eb034bd1499049031fc5f84.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_5e8e941c08037d123a7757b4f95ee249.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_5e8e941c08037d123a7757b4f95ee249.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_5e8e941c08037d123a7757b4f95ee249.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_7ff013d425cf9ee668bbe3948032aa65.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_bfbac6bfff4f8220bc2195dee6cc2e95.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_bfbac6bfff4f8220bc2195dee6cc2e95.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_5f40b613d9366d8dc8c1ad84335ac6fe.text: Muitos estão condenados a morrer de fome ou de doença.
sense_5f40b613d9366d8dc8c1ad84335ac6fe.translation: Many are condemned to die of starvation or disease.

sense_5f40b613d9366d8dc8c1ad84335ac6fe.text: Puz-me a tremer com violencia e a bater os dentes. Percebi que aquella attitude me condemnava e esforcei-me por cerrar os queixos e dominar os musculos, o que não consegui.
sense_5f40b613d9366d8dc8c1ad84335ac6fe.translation: I started to shiver violently and gnashing my teeth. I realized that doing so doomed me and made an effort to close my jaw and take control of my muscles, which I could not do.

sense_08e67bb9e50fbf11ffd2c7e351ce8239.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_08e67bb9e50fbf11ffd2c7e351ce8239.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_08e67bb9e50fbf11ffd2c7e351ce8239.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_08e67bb9e50fbf11ffd2c7e351ce8239.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_b43b28a3af3d374f9ad27cd33d6f319a.text: Não me importo que você venha.
sense_b43b28a3af3d374f9ad27cd33d6f319a.translation: I don't care whether you come.

sense_44ef1500ae42eaedf08567c2753ed286.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.
