sense_763a562cb77151f93b1beceb81ded0a8.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_763a562cb77151f93b1beceb81ded0a8.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_4bce0d7a8139ccf556fafe156111a0a1.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_4bce0d7a8139ccf556fafe156111a0a1.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_0cb99ee56c92ceb9604308d4ed0ac08f.text: Começou a chover! Fecha as janelas!
sense_0cb99ee56c92ceb9604308d4ed0ac08f.translation: It started raining! Shut the windows!

sense_0cb99ee56c92ceb9604308d4ed0ac08f.text: Quando eu me sento à janela / P'los vidros qu'a neve embaça / Vejo a doce imagem d'ela / Quando passa… passa… passa…
sense_0cb99ee56c92ceb9604308d4ed0ac08f.translation: When I sit at the window / I see through the panes clouded by snow / The sweet image of her / When (she) passes… passes… passes…

sense_26ea3df700b53941b14437259d477a67.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
sense_26ea3df700b53941b14437259d477a67.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

sense_26ea3df700b53941b14437259d477a67.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
sense_26ea3df700b53941b14437259d477a67.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

sense_96f5d9a2f7cc61235998796b921b5d0a.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_96f5d9a2f7cc61235998796b921b5d0a.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_96f5d9a2f7cc61235998796b921b5d0a.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_96f5d9a2f7cc61235998796b921b5d0a.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_c734ec9fd6b395d1b4cb9ca600997bb0.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_c734ec9fd6b395d1b4cb9ca600997bb0.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_a9acc0afba02e10f1bb72ccb02352450.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_a9acc0afba02e10f1bb72ccb02352450.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_a9acc0afba02e10f1bb72ccb02352450.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_a9acc0afba02e10f1bb72ccb02352450.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_7898ca4ddbaca1e28df4703eddbacedc.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_7898ca4ddbaca1e28df4703eddbacedc.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_7898ca4ddbaca1e28df4703eddbacedc.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_7898ca4ddbaca1e28df4703eddbacedc.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_29b8307a0a26935e77d6c846a35745fc.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_29b8307a0a26935e77d6c846a35745fc.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_01d20da045d4b44c64a57365221f7a2f.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_01d20da045d4b44c64a57365221f7a2f.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_d4cdec3fcd89f49c3d38b3ca77aa7d8d.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_d4d39ab43d792fd9c61975f06420fb71.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_d4d39ab43d792fd9c61975f06420fb71.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_d4d39ab43d792fd9c61975f06420fb71.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_d4d39ab43d792fd9c61975f06420fb71.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_372e9a5e14a4209a96a49c90353fc68a.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_372e9a5e14a4209a96a49c90353fc68a.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_372e9a5e14a4209a96a49c90353fc68a.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_372e9a5e14a4209a96a49c90353fc68a.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_2d050dcd195cc107e2b2047a175f886c.text: “Cara, você pode morrer se fizer isso.” “Azar.”
sense_2d050dcd195cc107e2b2047a175f886c.translation: “Dude, you could die if you do this.” “I don’t care.”

sense_2d050dcd195cc107e2b2047a175f886c.text: “As crianças na África estão morrendo de fome!” “Azar.”
sense_2d050dcd195cc107e2b2047a175f886c.translation: “Children in Africa are starving to death!” “Tough luck.”

sense_0d4e81d370c50b25a0c2a66845e49164.text: Essa porcaria de celular barato não durou um dia.
sense_0d4e81d370c50b25a0c2a66845e49164.translation: That bloody cheap mobile didn’t last a day.

sense_0d4e81d370c50b25a0c2a66845e49164.text: Não se preocupe com essas pessoas baratas.
sense_0d4e81d370c50b25a0c2a66845e49164.translation: Don’t worry about those worthless people.

sense_25c85f494f2ebf667ca7b733f8d247c8.text: Esse livro é o maior barato!
sense_25c85f494f2ebf667ca7b733f8d247c8.translation: That book is a lot of fun!

sense_420c92aeee9eb7a68470d71793aa67b7.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_420c92aeee9eb7a68470d71793aa67b7.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_0bacdf59741d533b5f95b3525e33c7ad.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_0bacdf59741d533b5f95b3525e33c7ad.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_0bacdf59741d533b5f95b3525e33c7ad.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_0bacdf59741d533b5f95b3525e33c7ad.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_7ba26b0c18bb754c432235e63c181075.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_7ba26b0c18bb754c432235e63c181075.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_7ba26b0c18bb754c432235e63c181075.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_7ba26b0c18bb754c432235e63c181075.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_7ba26b0c18bb754c432235e63c181075.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_7ba26b0c18bb754c432235e63c181075.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_26ae11f548d477b90d14981ecc3b29ab.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_de187d2db358db3c928c6cd6d5bbe060.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_de187d2db358db3c928c6cd6d5bbe060.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_de187d2db358db3c928c6cd6d5bbe060.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_de187d2db358db3c928c6cd6d5bbe060.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_f580d50566819d5b416be486b51c47f8.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_f580d50566819d5b416be486b51c47f8.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_f580d50566819d5b416be486b51c47f8.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_f580d50566819d5b416be486b51c47f8.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_90c7fadad68eb15afde604f69b9e218b.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_90c7fadad68eb15afde604f69b9e218b.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_f5195eb0a5b8a4261182858fd1a4640f.text: Apresentamos o novo produto ao mercado.
sense_f5195eb0a5b8a4261182858fd1a4640f.translation: We presented the new product to the market.

sense_8a4c6d07d0cbdaacd1a32200a21f172f.text: A gente puxava briga com qualquer um.

sense_8a4c6d07d0cbdaacd1a32200a21f172f.translation: He initiated a chat with the neighbours.

sense_ac9808afad60753c24bad7435aef9dc8.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_ac9808afad60753c24bad7435aef9dc8.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_ac9808afad60753c24bad7435aef9dc8.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_ac9808afad60753c24bad7435aef9dc8.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_7c89b51b5a5fb629b904589bebd3856e.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_7c89b51b5a5fb629b904589bebd3856e.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_7c89b51b5a5fb629b904589bebd3856e.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_7c89b51b5a5fb629b904589bebd3856e.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_ae8f79254221eafb8f6acdc87e6ef37a.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_ae8f79254221eafb8f6acdc87e6ef37a.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_ae8f79254221eafb8f6acdc87e6ef37a.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_ae8f79254221eafb8f6acdc87e6ef37a.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_193f6f6fe1e3ccaf92048f361205e0b3.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_193f6f6fe1e3ccaf92048f361205e0b3.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_193f6f6fe1e3ccaf92048f361205e0b3.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_193f6f6fe1e3ccaf92048f361205e0b3.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_d53ad3ca258378a018dd5f4e2d9cfd31.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_d53ad3ca258378a018dd5f4e2d9cfd31.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_7016c8541c75e8e689c8e9301b7225dd.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_7016c8541c75e8e689c8e9301b7225dd.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_7016c8541c75e8e689c8e9301b7225dd.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_7016c8541c75e8e689c8e9301b7225dd.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_f859b517d5f6dc7eb4fdec694461ee80.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_f859b517d5f6dc7eb4fdec694461ee80.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_f859b517d5f6dc7eb4fdec694461ee80.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_f859b517d5f6dc7eb4fdec694461ee80.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_f859b517d5f6dc7eb4fdec694461ee80.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_f859b517d5f6dc7eb4fdec694461ee80.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_d2474efae1f532ca6a7f3e1cefae8b7c.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_d2474efae1f532ca6a7f3e1cefae8b7c.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_76b1416bb6111088f6e9ab151e0cfbaa.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_76b1416bb6111088f6e9ab151e0cfbaa.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_0d7e34a03bae11d59ca7b4263d18b68c.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_0d7e34a03bae11d59ca7b4263d18b68c.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_6fc664fdfb1cd28055d598ba04b2f108.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_6fc664fdfb1cd28055d598ba04b2f108.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_6fc664fdfb1cd28055d598ba04b2f108.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_6fc664fdfb1cd28055d598ba04b2f108.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_072ef8d3a9ab82863c5ad8773a24ca39.literal_meaning: I stranged your behavior a lot.
sense_072ef8d3a9ab82863c5ad8773a24ca39.translation: I found your behaviour very strange.

sense_072ef8d3a9ab82863c5ad8773a24ca39.text: — O jury? extranhei. O senhor também. Está visto. O senhor appellou?
sense_072ef8d3a9ab82863c5ad8773a24ca39.translation: “The jury? I found it strange. You did too, sir. It’s clear. Did you appeal?”

sense_4808d8d13defdd0d39f5cdca56aa711d.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_d3640e9d6b22159e97bb25d0f4b9a8b3.text: Assim, este frango, que eu almocei agora mesmo, é o resultado de uma multidão de esforços e lutas, executados com o unico fim de dar mato ao meu appetite.
sense_d3640e9d6b22159e97bb25d0f4b9a8b3.translation: As such, this chicken, which I have just now had for lunch, is the result of a multitude of efforts and struggles, carried out with the sole purpose of feeding my appetite.

sense_3b3159715d3836077cf50510d776864d.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_3b3159715d3836077cf50510d776864d.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_3b3159715d3836077cf50510d776864d.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_3b3159715d3836077cf50510d776864d.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_bf6a39126d174f638d8a42c11add99d9.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_bf6a39126d174f638d8a42c11add99d9.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_e40fb1111c592ac35a2b3140a168eaf4.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_e40fb1111c592ac35a2b3140a168eaf4.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_0eeb01fd3b1594250ee053eb6cbd7844.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_0eeb01fd3b1594250ee053eb6cbd7844.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_0eeb01fd3b1594250ee053eb6cbd7844.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_0eeb01fd3b1594250ee053eb6cbd7844.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_0eeb01fd3b1594250ee053eb6cbd7844.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_0eeb01fd3b1594250ee053eb6cbd7844.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_825008de12c5e7c4f110fd5364b211af.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_825008de12c5e7c4f110fd5364b211af.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_dba51958c5e3a09b1a939f8b94abb695.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_3adac11b5ca90efaa9cee215b41457d4.translation: Paper on the Establishment of Macao

sense_3adac11b5ca90efaa9cee215b41457d4.translation: Posthumous Memoirs of Brás Cubas is a literary work by Machado de Assis

sense_a0952f19456be9aba9d87d1c1399c274.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_c9a4f495a08ac59749ebdd3bcf5e0998.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_aa27afb086796286f86ca86217482502.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_aa27afb086796286f86ca86217482502.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_9952a331c3bffc629b7f39ef254bf3be.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_5ade80857a08b57a402489d01f7f27c2.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_5ade80857a08b57a402489d01f7f27c2.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_ce165ee29c580b966731c44c3c585518.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_ce165ee29c580b966731c44c3c585518.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_ce165ee29c580b966731c44c3c585518.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_c015c0c1f598b6b568fb0c1780b7db1a.text: Será que os Androides Sonham com Ovelhas Elétricas?
sense_c015c0c1f598b6b568fb0c1780b7db1a.translation: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
I had a dream about him.

sense_97b433266502ee3b84626be505ea8f8d.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_97b433266502ee3b84626be505ea8f8d.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_97b433266502ee3b84626be505ea8f8d.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_97b433266502ee3b84626be505ea8f8d.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_07304eb74a8cade4a328273cdc94352c.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_07304eb74a8cade4a328273cdc94352c.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_0064e2fb1895e7eab699d498b576ffe9.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_0064e2fb1895e7eab699d498b576ffe9.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_a907059021a1670ec9ed37f9ea2a5c3b.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_a907059021a1670ec9ed37f9ea2a5c3b.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_a907059021a1670ec9ed37f9ea2a5c3b.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_a907059021a1670ec9ed37f9ea2a5c3b.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_fffc65f5ec79981560835dded8e893a3.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_af3437177e2747a1456a8486c301de03.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_af3437177e2747a1456a8486c301de03.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_af3437177e2747a1456a8486c301de03.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_af3437177e2747a1456a8486c301de03.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_8e60978b36ecfdd809fd992395029221.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_8e60978b36ecfdd809fd992395029221.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_13c02b5920aaeea283076db99b9b5924.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_13c02b5920aaeea283076db99b9b5924.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_13c02b5920aaeea283076db99b9b5924.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_13c02b5920aaeea283076db99b9b5924.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_13c02b5920aaeea283076db99b9b5924.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_13c02b5920aaeea283076db99b9b5924.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_407ec57c4767f70f77832ae83f1632c8.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_407ec57c4767f70f77832ae83f1632c8.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_407ec57c4767f70f77832ae83f1632c8.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_407ec57c4767f70f77832ae83f1632c8.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_495572ae25e4740b78b14659f1b07e42.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_969213544bd08d950493496dfde1b1d9.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_7fa2f5e8392974b3044b701618ca4cbe.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_7fa2f5e8392974b3044b701618ca4cbe.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_bc8084b40c1553881138dd93ca5d315e.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_bc8084b40c1553881138dd93ca5d315e.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_bc8084b40c1553881138dd93ca5d315e.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_bc8084b40c1553881138dd93ca5d315e.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_712b8b259bebfd24bc31d0d47e59e336.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_712b8b259bebfd24bc31d0d47e59e336.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_57262ee8080fe5760d8ebfe6d0edcb49.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_57262ee8080fe5760d8ebfe6d0edcb49.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_e09aae001aa1138984653b62b46b2b7f.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_e09aae001aa1138984653b62b46b2b7f.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_cf35893ba0bf72e213fa4bfff707df8d.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_cf35893ba0bf72e213fa4bfff707df8d.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_08cc784a67ee73a87d8f899c7b672f5a.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_08cc784a67ee73a87d8f899c7b672f5a.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_08cc784a67ee73a87d8f899c7b672f5a.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_08cc784a67ee73a87d8f899c7b672f5a.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_e6d2368c648f48e71a43ef043d9d8f32.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_753e38be76e554396669db0e7589d4e1.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_753e38be76e554396669db0e7589d4e1.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_d91f126f51f6f17f8419669a289dff1b.translation: We are in a mountainous land.

sense_a8157874ab650f95ea47b2730f6ea317.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_a8157874ab650f95ea47b2730f6ea317.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_523d0e23096f8aff964d816ddebf6e1b.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_bf93016a537cb78acf0ded661c8a367a.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_bf93016a537cb78acf0ded661c8a367a.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_bf93016a537cb78acf0ded661c8a367a.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_bf93016a537cb78acf0ded661c8a367a.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_8c327aa55242bc27cb45dce9776550fa.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_db14c359d815f41090a8cad05b4df41d.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_db14c359d815f41090a8cad05b4df41d.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_db14c359d815f41090a8cad05b4df41d.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_db14c359d815f41090a8cad05b4df41d.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_e640fa728fc0c281e6dd9aba29a227b1.translation: I don't like that at all.

sense_67f6efc3808c26f8c714a536a8d68d18.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_67f6efc3808c26f8c714a536a8d68d18.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_f319d4d99e6c68acdd6f46f1fff261b7.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_f319d4d99e6c68acdd6f46f1fff261b7.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_f319d4d99e6c68acdd6f46f1fff261b7.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_f319d4d99e6c68acdd6f46f1fff261b7.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_f91ce61ce31651f983353e93aa7c5dd1.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_f91ce61ce31651f983353e93aa7c5dd1.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_69a9c7a40e2b7f54087cbfd8318f870b.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_69a9c7a40e2b7f54087cbfd8318f870b.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_5c5b8ac94810640170b295acb849e97d.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_5c5b8ac94810640170b295acb849e97d.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_5c5b8ac94810640170b295acb849e97d.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_5c5b8ac94810640170b295acb849e97d.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_f1b2a28a37819a59b0e68af14df2bfaf.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_f1b2a28a37819a59b0e68af14df2bfaf.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_f1b2a28a37819a59b0e68af14df2bfaf.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_f1b2a28a37819a59b0e68af14df2bfaf.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_6065bdd1f798c9cd5e07c2cfcc051340.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_6065bdd1f798c9cd5e07c2cfcc051340.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_5cd36bf356942af3ac3e6e107f530214.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_5cd36bf356942af3ac3e6e107f530214.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_1f40d933721f360937d039488e05ae22.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_1f40d933721f360937d039488e05ae22.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_3fee84d2dd30c900459ee6f64a761d2a.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_e36130ba95c68f56503e96bcf3fdbf47.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_e36130ba95c68f56503e96bcf3fdbf47.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_1997ba1cc164983be696059e472d6d11.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_1997ba1cc164983be696059e472d6d11.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_159d70fe99a713b0bc73ffc9fc33caee.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_159d70fe99a713b0bc73ffc9fc33caee.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_159d70fe99a713b0bc73ffc9fc33caee.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_159d70fe99a713b0bc73ffc9fc33caee.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_dbba3f660d9e46235595bd32052597d9.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_dbba3f660d9e46235595bd32052597d9.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_6fc255891e75b62ef750ebe37e2511d7.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_6fc255891e75b62ef750ebe37e2511d7.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_6fc255891e75b62ef750ebe37e2511d7.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_59e92b663d2f77c0e7d570817213a31a.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_d86c54b94a5f79adc58ab793d7e663d7.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_d86c54b94a5f79adc58ab793d7e663d7.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_aaa4eaf4b204387878e622f25bf26ada.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_aaa4eaf4b204387878e622f25bf26ada.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_aaa4eaf4b204387878e622f25bf26ada.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_aaa4eaf4b204387878e622f25bf26ada.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_8ab1b0de0ac3c1bb06c73f9e5dc24c77.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_8ab1b0de0ac3c1bb06c73f9e5dc24c77.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_8ab1b0de0ac3c1bb06c73f9e5dc24c77.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_8ab1b0de0ac3c1bb06c73f9e5dc24c77.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_b448414fdd127593906427ae0199916f.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_b448414fdd127593906427ae0199916f.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_13ac9622832ad5c1450b7ac9b3fdf65a.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_13ac9622832ad5c1450b7ac9b3fdf65a.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_13ac9622832ad5c1450b7ac9b3fdf65a.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_13ac9622832ad5c1450b7ac9b3fdf65a.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_4ee1062e2d3c0060be2c600fc4a8897f.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_4ee1062e2d3c0060be2c600fc4a8897f.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_4ee1062e2d3c0060be2c600fc4a8897f.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_4ee1062e2d3c0060be2c600fc4a8897f.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_6fd1aeb1e2a5e1e1bbd105d6b9fe8d60.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_6fd1aeb1e2a5e1e1bbd105d6b9fe8d60.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_6fd1aeb1e2a5e1e1bbd105d6b9fe8d60.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_6fd1aeb1e2a5e1e1bbd105d6b9fe8d60.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_6fd1aeb1e2a5e1e1bbd105d6b9fe8d60.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_6fd1aeb1e2a5e1e1bbd105d6b9fe8d60.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_f151f75d9f9bc28979eac89b4e951490.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_f151f75d9f9bc28979eac89b4e951490.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_f151f75d9f9bc28979eac89b4e951490.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_f151f75d9f9bc28979eac89b4e951490.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_912b823ed305e7532a8a24f7be807a33.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_912b823ed305e7532a8a24f7be807a33.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_0a126a744d1d1e525a74d81016a3d68b.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_0a126a744d1d1e525a74d81016a3d68b.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_0a126a744d1d1e525a74d81016a3d68b.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_0a126a744d1d1e525a74d81016a3d68b.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_1f42f3dbc28324010707b84ae73cee29.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_1f42f3dbc28324010707b84ae73cee29.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_1f42f3dbc28324010707b84ae73cee29.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_1f42f3dbc28324010707b84ae73cee29.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_1c77a51c7274ed5dd28a0907e10bc40a.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_1c77a51c7274ed5dd28a0907e10bc40a.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_1c77a51c7274ed5dd28a0907e10bc40a.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_1c77a51c7274ed5dd28a0907e10bc40a.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_1c77a51c7274ed5dd28a0907e10bc40a.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_8d4e60a91b1c93c4f13166796b0f0c12.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_8d4e60a91b1c93c4f13166796b0f0c12.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_8d4e60a91b1c93c4f13166796b0f0c12.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_8d4e60a91b1c93c4f13166796b0f0c12.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_de6d6ed5ba25b91d9ebe3acd01fee027.text: Onde é que está a minha água?
Queria uma água, se faz favor.
sense_de6d6ed5ba25b91d9ebe3acd01fee027.translation: I would like a glass / bottle of water, please.

sense_eb7c8073d5aa30b1c099c25e63c6e67f.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_eb7c8073d5aa30b1c099c25e63c6e67f.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_0bb3bc000888c196eaf01bfd2175d4e8.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_0bb3bc000888c196eaf01bfd2175d4e8.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_57bbf57b138bac9767152798b9074089.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_57bbf57b138bac9767152798b9074089.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_57bbf57b138bac9767152798b9074089.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_57bbf57b138bac9767152798b9074089.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_57bbf57b138bac9767152798b9074089.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_57bbf57b138bac9767152798b9074089.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_fa82d1aeccf4669d8c32196743c4f9ee.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_fa82d1aeccf4669d8c32196743c4f9ee.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_ac4d1a7f381033be8a8b5ec5f9e72f37.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_ac4d1a7f381033be8a8b5ec5f9e72f37.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_a8032ac0bccc12c0fb00ea97ee39dce3.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_a8032ac0bccc12c0fb00ea97ee39dce3.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_a8032ac0bccc12c0fb00ea97ee39dce3.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_a8032ac0bccc12c0fb00ea97ee39dce3.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_ad622bdd2dd5c0b75171db0047dac686.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_ad622bdd2dd5c0b75171db0047dac686.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_aa5982ad08a1b7c3df02b9b58e3a9440.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_aa5982ad08a1b7c3df02b9b58e3a9440.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_0519ebcc341f92dc0533c0ed7d2ca9b3.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_0519ebcc341f92dc0533c0ed7d2ca9b3.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_0519ebcc341f92dc0533c0ed7d2ca9b3.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_0519ebcc341f92dc0533c0ed7d2ca9b3.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_0c49d0d6cb5862da00bbc1b07460ec5a.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_109fc86b166b6bd4ad23214e05a8ff9f.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_109fc86b166b6bd4ad23214e05a8ff9f.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_023325e6122ec9f01753e862b5ed48ed.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_023325e6122ec9f01753e862b5ed48ed.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_023325e6122ec9f01753e862b5ed48ed.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_023325e6122ec9f01753e862b5ed48ed.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_d99f31578e1580a45f3ca4c5318c5427.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_d99f31578e1580a45f3ca4c5318c5427.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_d99f31578e1580a45f3ca4c5318c5427.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_d99f31578e1580a45f3ca4c5318c5427.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_d99f31578e1580a45f3ca4c5318c5427.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_d99f31578e1580a45f3ca4c5318c5427.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_64903a20a74b0eaf68431d8dd607ccab.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_64903a20a74b0eaf68431d8dd607ccab.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_c8d7212831c7fea51304f8fc21aaff49.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_c8d7212831c7fea51304f8fc21aaff49.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_c8d7212831c7fea51304f8fc21aaff49.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_c8d7212831c7fea51304f8fc21aaff49.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_f416b5c9d0de46c185dd7e883e85c336.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_f416b5c9d0de46c185dd7e883e85c336.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_f416b5c9d0de46c185dd7e883e85c336.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_f416b5c9d0de46c185dd7e883e85c336.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_5ac2dbb78ead056c37f1a37e916f1400.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_5ac2dbb78ead056c37f1a37e916f1400.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_5ac2dbb78ead056c37f1a37e916f1400.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_5ac2dbb78ead056c37f1a37e916f1400.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_09411d87a6390844fecbdc7e9537beda.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_09411d87a6390844fecbdc7e9537beda.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_09411d87a6390844fecbdc7e9537beda.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_09411d87a6390844fecbdc7e9537beda.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_09d9ff593de5d4ca2b570838d8123d59.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_09d9ff593de5d4ca2b570838d8123d59.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_09d9ff593de5d4ca2b570838d8123d59.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_09d9ff593de5d4ca2b570838d8123d59.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_42eb8429f67ef72f7fcff83382a78bbf.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_42eb8429f67ef72f7fcff83382a78bbf.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_ec556c189cad3b90d56bc3122e4e0522.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_ec556c189cad3b90d56bc3122e4e0522.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_d24bc84405a9ebad74447f163310840b.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_d24bc84405a9ebad74447f163310840b.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_d7439a4d50b676741ac7b416226845c8.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_d7439a4d50b676741ac7b416226845c8.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_b88946149e0a5815847c6ff578595646.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_b88946149e0a5815847c6ff578595646.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_b88946149e0a5815847c6ff578595646.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_b88946149e0a5815847c6ff578595646.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_30e6596953235de87bb41de8c4020b74.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_30e6596953235de87bb41de8c4020b74.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_d55b9899f1caff4f77e627cd4ecab131.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_d55b9899f1caff4f77e627cd4ecab131.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_d55b9899f1caff4f77e627cd4ecab131.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_afb975c9109758df83e44080fad1986a.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_afb975c9109758df83e44080fad1986a.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_8a6f5f189518acff3aa3d7a9dff24edd.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_8a6f5f189518acff3aa3d7a9dff24edd.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_ddc76b90b0c1926fbf5ebfb9c5d2f78f.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_ddc76b90b0c1926fbf5ebfb9c5d2f78f.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_ddc76b90b0c1926fbf5ebfb9c5d2f78f.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_ddc76b90b0c1926fbf5ebfb9c5d2f78f.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_ddc76b90b0c1926fbf5ebfb9c5d2f78f.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_ddc76b90b0c1926fbf5ebfb9c5d2f78f.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_2966e49fbdbea885070e7c7ed0e5717f.translation: There was an accident in the highway.

sense_aaa6965a9a638220839b17a3a950ccd4.text: Se ela chegar, avise o diretor, por favor.
sense_aaa6965a9a638220839b17a3a950ccd4.translation: If she arrives, inform the director, please.

sense_aaa6965a9a638220839b17a3a950ccd4.text: Se precisar de mais papel verde, me avisa.
sense_aaa6965a9a638220839b17a3a950ccd4.translation: If you need more green paper, let me know.

sense_76ca1b7a817d8ef65772dc94c5e57343.text: Não conseguiria nunca extender os ossos numa cama, o unico desejo que tinha.
sense_76ca1b7a817d8ef65772dc94c5e57343.translation: She would never be able to stretch her bones on a bed, her only wish.

sense_21afd50b8094f9347933ac41bd5644a6.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_21afd50b8094f9347933ac41bd5644a6.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_057c6bfc66096acdd48eb3ab019c5750.text: O protesto de Hermione foi abafado por uma risadinha alta.
sense_057c6bfc66096acdd48eb3ab019c5750.translation: Hermione's objection was interrupted by a loud little laugh.

sense_d66840920eb3b0e0b57e008d0d0268bd.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_d66840920eb3b0e0b57e008d0d0268bd.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_d66840920eb3b0e0b57e008d0d0268bd.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_53729b84ddb4ff281181f5a3901a7af1.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_53729b84ddb4ff281181f5a3901a7af1.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_cf703316abda2084be3f791ed0333ee4.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_5b1e6d672546a0c12f9081ffdf8ccfb1.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_5b1e6d672546a0c12f9081ffdf8ccfb1.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_5b1e6d672546a0c12f9081ffdf8ccfb1.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_5b1e6d672546a0c12f9081ffdf8ccfb1.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_fb5fcc6d4c5a40c5f73e4925d99717b5.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_fb5fcc6d4c5a40c5f73e4925d99717b5.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_fb5fcc6d4c5a40c5f73e4925d99717b5.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_fb5fcc6d4c5a40c5f73e4925d99717b5.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_afe44c554bc9b52924d682c92f3b3292.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_14aae2489f2fde2dbeb6976a27f3ccaa.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_14aae2489f2fde2dbeb6976a27f3ccaa.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_14aae2489f2fde2dbeb6976a27f3ccaa.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_14aae2489f2fde2dbeb6976a27f3ccaa.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_4af40e5a8b1262b33d9475e4aff2694d.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_6c762bc3c7f3096553f36a33067495d5.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_6c762bc3c7f3096553f36a33067495d5.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_587e46826a695415c0cb7ce824f9bb6a.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.

sense_06d6e10585ea1795526dd8e975479bc2.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_06d6e10585ea1795526dd8e975479bc2.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_dfc3399d98d1f27f6a2de33872e2d788.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.

These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_c1c7f561b2751886f721d3138baa733a.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_077917b607679cd0bd77d08f761e6ed4.text: É para comermos toda a carne.

sense_077917b607679cd0bd77d08f761e6ed4.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_077917b607679cd0bd77d08f761e6ed4.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_10e761fbd4e2c80a8073985d93e58ffe.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_10e761fbd4e2c80a8073985d93e58ffe.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_dc9dd2224b2db9da5e797e525daa3dc2.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_dc9dd2224b2db9da5e797e525daa3dc2.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_dc9dd2224b2db9da5e797e525daa3dc2.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_dc9dd2224b2db9da5e797e525daa3dc2.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_426e2742c11c5861f94ec0ac0ec487f1.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_426e2742c11c5861f94ec0ac0ec487f1.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_31573ba4da907e9b33281328d891737e.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_31573ba4da907e9b33281328d891737e.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_1ad566ed6197c7a1ae7974fa386258ab.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_1ad566ed6197c7a1ae7974fa386258ab.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_61f7f2c5b896ff8349845f1b4f6a07c7.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_61f7f2c5b896ff8349845f1b4f6a07c7.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_896dbb18bfbcdd7b5a8ead0021a6c606.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_575be707e7a3f16c7e9dcc73e3e24deb.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_575be707e7a3f16c7e9dcc73e3e24deb.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_fb5e18555405588c804ae71b23ecc5fd.text: O jardim fica cheio de folhas caídas no outono.
sense_fb5e18555405588c804ae71b23ecc5fd.translation: The garden gets full of fallen leaves in autumn.

sense_fb5e18555405588c804ae71b23ecc5fd.text: Parece que tem uma árvore caída na estrada, por isso o engarrafamento.
sense_fb5e18555405588c804ae71b23ecc5fd.translation: It looks like there is a fallen tree on the road, that's why there's a the traffic jam.

sense_805546d14df474dcaf3290e33c487e1b.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_805546d14df474dcaf3290e33c487e1b.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_f5c69d61cb6d4967b1e4c321f0bfd0e3.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_d83fe5c12e5123f2c5a222de70612625.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_d83fe5c12e5123f2c5a222de70612625.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_d83fe5c12e5123f2c5a222de70612625.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_d83fe5c12e5123f2c5a222de70612625.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_783b67e159efbea0cba5f3c5b3b351a2.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_026f629425dddd1982f087cdfcff0f94.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_667b4aff09d997e05a1b1fdab34b1504.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_5115c1ac646150e9edf5c5d4a4f3066a.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_5115c1ac646150e9edf5c5d4a4f3066a.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_80e08cd0ba2608b02c93e48734bea13d.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_80e08cd0ba2608b02c93e48734bea13d.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_80e08cd0ba2608b02c93e48734bea13d.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_80e08cd0ba2608b02c93e48734bea13d.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_a4237c8638364fcdf0edb24b91fa83ba.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_a4237c8638364fcdf0edb24b91fa83ba.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_bc88869c1183b0aa2d8cca0e09539d20.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_3e1cd42965ca273cbf0e8a247bc5aa98.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_3e1cd42965ca273cbf0e8a247bc5aa98.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_3e1cd42965ca273cbf0e8a247bc5aa98.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_3e1cd42965ca273cbf0e8a247bc5aa98.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_a91b0d953674e086d98d2a35629e0ab8.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_a91b0d953674e086d98d2a35629e0ab8.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_a91b0d953674e086d98d2a35629e0ab8.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_a91b0d953674e086d98d2a35629e0ab8.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_854aa67fb9d870b4289195470ace76ac.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_854aa67fb9d870b4289195470ace76ac.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_d2c27cfd404440aae5c2f26f0adf5825.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_d2c27cfd404440aae5c2f26f0adf5825.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_d2c27cfd404440aae5c2f26f0adf5825.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_d9bc264d69e8dafbf4081f866a6a0742.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_77d6a537b563f0c2a0750fbc56020465.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_77d6a537b563f0c2a0750fbc56020465.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_c4a664ea8d02e947472594295856cdde.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.

sense_362fb4d6b887391d7f22589784c7e4bc.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_245bff3691058bb391ef7a6470151112.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_bf50390098384901cb7370decd1bf40b.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_bf50390098384901cb7370decd1bf40b.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_bf50390098384901cb7370decd1bf40b.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_f3465a1c243b8097cba51f9ea201841f.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_f3908b9953e84acba670558353b74eb4.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
sense_f3908b9953e84acba670558353b74eb4.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

sense_f3908b9953e84acba670558353b74eb4.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
sense_f3908b9953e84acba670558353b74eb4.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

sense_136d643b9943764e454a5ffa2f6b2774.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_13b72c1dd079ae9c890e903120674599.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_13b72c1dd079ae9c890e903120674599.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_13b72c1dd079ae9c890e903120674599.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_de3b735086c4099e1308198d33803033.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_de3b735086c4099e1308198d33803033.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_de3b735086c4099e1308198d33803033.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_de3b735086c4099e1308198d33803033.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_7dfa368798d4c55f6fd09e6fd96dabf6.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_7dfa368798d4c55f6fd09e6fd96dabf6.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_2b1915d2dd8c4565a9a7c325b267d035.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_2b1915d2dd8c4565a9a7c325b267d035.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_a719c96b9189fc753b4a44d8fe1ebdf6.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_efdb21bc07a8ae6211392fc5b6abceea.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_efdb21bc07a8ae6211392fc5b6abceea.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_efdb21bc07a8ae6211392fc5b6abceea.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_efdb21bc07a8ae6211392fc5b6abceea.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_efdb21bc07a8ae6211392fc5b6abceea.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_efdb21bc07a8ae6211392fc5b6abceea.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_053cb947ea8f1a278934f87f7232f402.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_053cb947ea8f1a278934f87f7232f402.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_053cb947ea8f1a278934f87f7232f402.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_053cb947ea8f1a278934f87f7232f402.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_54f621cc03dd53a2639338b69df01722.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_d1c534af8cc87d0f3a516ca7be4db4f3.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_0a615b0c2d2b73828edb5ad0a06b7b89.translation: I don't like that at all.

sense_0330a959e0635afea0781fa53d618e09.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_0330a959e0635afea0781fa53d618e09.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_546765c9c9c6de0e9f312507f8d3a54c.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_546765c9c9c6de0e9f312507f8d3a54c.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_546765c9c9c6de0e9f312507f8d3a54c.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_54895a6fba42b4101e130156e155b741.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_54895a6fba42b4101e130156e155b741.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_54895a6fba42b4101e130156e155b741.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_892e51f4153cd438aa2b669f8013359c.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_892e51f4153cd438aa2b669f8013359c.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_96ec0ebadce2fe1ff000b95b60496bee.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_96ec0ebadce2fe1ff000b95b60496bee.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_6489c8f5e3bf014c07ac38f10af9f7a7.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_6489c8f5e3bf014c07ac38f10af9f7a7.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_5b75e7d870be71ffdc841954605a22b6.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_5b75e7d870be71ffdc841954605a22b6.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_e91aba7b448794935a33c1c5d8e7e011.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_a1e94736c80e93962ee42ba6312daae1.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_c1ec54afd7c6d2d7b5a7969471ab75d5.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_95c4f107f0ddceaf366746eaaa5098ee.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_95c4f107f0ddceaf366746eaaa5098ee.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_d3bf34235b7f655a16d1f1b315143300.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_d3bf34235b7f655a16d1f1b315143300.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_d3bf34235b7f655a16d1f1b315143300.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_d3bf34235b7f655a16d1f1b315143300.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_4463eb1b589839fb06effa8a9b164628.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_4463eb1b589839fb06effa8a9b164628.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_4463eb1b589839fb06effa8a9b164628.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_4463eb1b589839fb06effa8a9b164628.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_c44adfb7f724ef6c48693943d8e723dc.text: O exército teve de abandonar o forte.
sense_c44adfb7f724ef6c48693943d8e723dc.translation: The army had to abandon the fort.

sense_c44adfb7f724ef6c48693943d8e723dc.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_c44adfb7f724ef6c48693943d8e723dc.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_3145bb7377b6d49f9473aff9f5f03541.text: O réu abandonou-se/se abandonou nas mãos do advogado.
sense_3145bb7377b6d49f9473aff9f5f03541.translation: The accused put himself in his lawyer’s hands.
We let ourselves be seized by sadness.

sense_ba0f2c0046639738b8ab5617f39d1157.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_ba0f2c0046639738b8ab5617f39d1157.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_ba0f2c0046639738b8ab5617f39d1157.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_ba0f2c0046639738b8ab5617f39d1157.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_fc7bb167a38812e54b9f3d5375221329.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_388d131fb5de7728c7d87c9a4d76d601.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_388d131fb5de7728c7d87c9a4d76d601.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_388d131fb5de7728c7d87c9a4d76d601.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_388d131fb5de7728c7d87c9a4d76d601.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_388d131fb5de7728c7d87c9a4d76d601.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_388d131fb5de7728c7d87c9a4d76d601.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_14d6b6b97a1077a9dc88f0ef1a6cbd5b.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_14d6b6b97a1077a9dc88f0ef1a6cbd5b.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_14d6b6b97a1077a9dc88f0ef1a6cbd5b.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_14d6b6b97a1077a9dc88f0ef1a6cbd5b.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_e29eda62af20ac00651b08aa22af5f16.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_e29eda62af20ac00651b08aa22af5f16.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_e29eda62af20ac00651b08aa22af5f16.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_cd574817a6b2f0b6f30d7f574b3455dc.text: […]e leuaram daly huũ tubaram que bertolameu dijz matou[…]
sense_cd574817a6b2f0b6f30d7f574b3455dc.translation: […] and they took from there a shark that Bartolomeu Dias killed […]

sense_cd574817a6b2f0b6f30d7f574b3455dc.text: Rodèa a Náo o Tubaráõ nas calmarias da Linha com os ſeos Pegadores ás coſtas, taõ cirzidos com a pelle, que mais parecem remẽdos, ou manchas naturaes, que os hoſpedes, ou companheiros.

sense_1dd9d8704969bb641924baf589a78529.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_1dd9d8704969bb641924baf589a78529.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_1dd9d8704969bb641924baf589a78529.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_1dd9d8704969bb641924baf589a78529.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_860af0fce150f4888521ec5a900bc195.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_860af0fce150f4888521ec5a900bc195.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_879f248060621a1f3a03625a7ad5870e.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_879f248060621a1f3a03625a7ad5870e.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_17b9e39c4f1fbcc0885bd51b27324411.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_17b9e39c4f1fbcc0885bd51b27324411.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_2a326227d975f1d305abea1c530ca113.text: A Irene é fiel ao seu marido.
sense_2a326227d975f1d305abea1c530ca113.translation: Irene is faithful to her husband.

sense_676f2428289bd87d22d34d0615d43c15.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_676f2428289bd87d22d34d0615d43c15.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_676f2428289bd87d22d34d0615d43c15.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_676f2428289bd87d22d34d0615d43c15.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_676f2428289bd87d22d34d0615d43c15.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_676f2428289bd87d22d34d0615d43c15.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_1419df33af3711c6aa2f27e1e407db0c.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_1419df33af3711c6aa2f27e1e407db0c.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_419506a4ab7c3120f1491975fc584e54.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_419506a4ab7c3120f1491975fc584e54.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_3073e3f69117d2c6981e1652ebb8e7ee.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_3073e3f69117d2c6981e1652ebb8e7ee.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_2171cabd3d9d4097e0a177b7f2aa0ca7.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_2171cabd3d9d4097e0a177b7f2aa0ca7.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_7be045d7f612443a20c30ff1a9d0bfce.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_7be045d7f612443a20c30ff1a9d0bfce.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_533b58b2dd0725a4cb9998b92799ce20.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_9421b07d7e389646afd114d51c5b26db.text: Fazer o bem não custa nada.
sense_9421b07d7e389646afd114d51c5b26db.translation: It costs nothing to do the right thing.

sense_9421b07d7e389646afd114d51c5b26db.text: Hoje eu fiz um bem: ajudei uma velhinha a atravessar a rua.
sense_9421b07d7e389646afd114d51c5b26db.translation: Today I did a good deed: I helped an old lady cross the street.

sense_bbcc052d41fdfa4b77f414f2fadbd81b.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_cfc9a9ac8b3b7e12cd7cb334f2d1f979.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_cfc9a9ac8b3b7e12cd7cb334f2d1f979.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_cfc9a9ac8b3b7e12cd7cb334f2d1f979.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_cfc9a9ac8b3b7e12cd7cb334f2d1f979.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_5f6a1bd1d632e81e8f5fc3fb9bf88fdd.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_5f6a1bd1d632e81e8f5fc3fb9bf88fdd.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_5f6a1bd1d632e81e8f5fc3fb9bf88fdd.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_5f6a1bd1d632e81e8f5fc3fb9bf88fdd.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_916d833b08d01f15ebae4067ea530787.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_916d833b08d01f15ebae4067ea530787.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_916d833b08d01f15ebae4067ea530787.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_89897f4546eee70ec5f465f114af38a2.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_fe5bee3744b309d0014fe8baba9f0af5.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_fe5bee3744b309d0014fe8baba9f0af5.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.

sense_ce248c2bb818d99a6ccc167761021dd5.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.

sense_b338b0117a4015b45cab3358b12766d7.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_b338b0117a4015b45cab3358b12766d7.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_1417ccb7747f4e7561921c292bde684e.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_1417ccb7747f4e7561921c292bde684e.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_836dd00983873b437ad468f55e0ddeaf.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_836dd00983873b437ad468f55e0ddeaf.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_836dd00983873b437ad468f55e0ddeaf.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_d376d43bf0dd8c346e28d455ec80b8bf.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_d376d43bf0dd8c346e28d455ec80b8bf.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_0c72dd994762a7ee830250037f3f6024.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_0c72dd994762a7ee830250037f3f6024.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_0c72dd994762a7ee830250037f3f6024.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_0c72dd994762a7ee830250037f3f6024.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_92974120d39caa10990fe026b0b56c08.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_92974120d39caa10990fe026b0b56c08.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_9e09ccb22377a92602f7ba4949e12136.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_9e09ccb22377a92602f7ba4949e12136.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_d1e3427d6ed9ede53b0a3404eedd3a67.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_f9a3e292bd6e41352c7f99ef55a9012f.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_f9a3e292bd6e41352c7f99ef55a9012f.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_f9a3e292bd6e41352c7f99ef55a9012f.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_f9a3e292bd6e41352c7f99ef55a9012f.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_4b2538dc485c59fd30054688ab2d0149.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_4b2538dc485c59fd30054688ab2d0149.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_8019f170aac159e65874856657cb0176.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_8019f170aac159e65874856657cb0176.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_8019f170aac159e65874856657cb0176.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_8019f170aac159e65874856657cb0176.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_162526e2a7fe5c1bbb6cbdebe5e937a1.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_c50989abed1b43a765703c92dc838e90.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_c50989abed1b43a765703c92dc838e90.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_c50989abed1b43a765703c92dc838e90.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_c50989abed1b43a765703c92dc838e90.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_0462bd78b305b2600705fa02235a6b14.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_0462bd78b305b2600705fa02235a6b14.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_88747157ccf2b7ed867d36678101e3cf.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_88747157ccf2b7ed867d36678101e3cf.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_cf88370a04bcb82c6b311a1fee761584.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_cf88370a04bcb82c6b311a1fee761584.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_cf88370a04bcb82c6b311a1fee761584.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_cf88370a04bcb82c6b311a1fee761584.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_e1a487a4bb08ae0255c0482b0802a28e.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_e1a487a4bb08ae0255c0482b0802a28e.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_e1a487a4bb08ae0255c0482b0802a28e.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_e1a487a4bb08ae0255c0482b0802a28e.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_2108b8cbdb05e035487ab93f6a887da3.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_9090301db6d32d5de3260576a44c3d25.text: Meu deus, que saco! Não posso fazer nada que você já vem brigar comigo!
sense_9090301db6d32d5de3260576a44c3d25.translation: My goodness, that's so annoying! I can't do anything without you telling me off!

sense_801a0212f2b8ac945df3d7361f3f1e30.translation: If she arrives, inform the director, please.

– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_20e8f07180abcd2f2acbe47244957827.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_3b78f10abcbc7d6c852af828054f77d4.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.
