sense_52a49b5721ccd7e91a6a059d5e666149.text: Dizem que os porcos-espinhos conseguem deixar seus espinhos armados.
sense_52a49b5721ccd7e91a6a059d5e666149.translation: They say that porcupines can make their quills erect.

sense_52a49b5721ccd7e91a6a059d5e666149.text: Tenho tantos redemoinhos que meu cabelo está sempre armado.
sense_52a49b5721ccd7e91a6a059d5e666149.translation: I have so many cowlicks that my hair is always sticking up.

sense_c318aa98b8032640cfb98c7dc7ea1c0d.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_c318aa98b8032640cfb98c7dc7ea1c0d.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_c318aa98b8032640cfb98c7dc7ea1c0d.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_c318aa98b8032640cfb98c7dc7ea1c0d.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_6771995df66f1761f6dd9cb026e011b8.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_6771995df66f1761f6dd9cb026e011b8.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_44346297186298fb2a1aabbb113d0374.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_44346297186298fb2a1aabbb113d0374.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_231670670e4f74297e2813ec34aec814.text: Se ela chegar, avise o diretor, por favor.
sense_231670670e4f74297e2813ec34aec814.translation: If she arrives, inform the director, please.

sense_231670670e4f74297e2813ec34aec814.text: Se precisar de mais papel verde, me avisa.
sense_231670670e4f74297e2813ec34aec814.translation: If you need more green paper, let me know.

sense_fbf53f281df629bb4cb5653066821990.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_fbf53f281df629bb4cb5653066821990.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_fbf53f281df629bb4cb5653066821990.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_fbf53f281df629bb4cb5653066821990.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_ca01632b35a16a302b8dfab56d6c278e.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_ca01632b35a16a302b8dfab56d6c278e.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_ca01632b35a16a302b8dfab56d6c278e.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_ca01632b35a16a302b8dfab56d6c278e.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_cd9aecc32efb361141bc88fde722e89b.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_cd9aecc32efb361141bc88fde722e89b.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_cd9aecc32efb361141bc88fde722e89b.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_cd9aecc32efb361141bc88fde722e89b.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_cd9aecc32efb361141bc88fde722e89b.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_043de0ef1ab1b20fcc2fe8c6d2b3cc26.text: Este dicionário não presta para nada.
sense_043de0ef1ab1b20fcc2fe8c6d2b3cc26.translation: This dictionary isn't useful for anything.

sense_95cb73a93e0c666522e5a1467f736510.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_95cb73a93e0c666522e5a1467f736510.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_95cb73a93e0c666522e5a1467f736510.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_95cb73a93e0c666522e5a1467f736510.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_d065f702591998e894b7fc50bc5d8cc2.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_d065f702591998e894b7fc50bc5d8cc2.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_ef1b15b18319ced2432c08cac8283570.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_ef1b15b18319ced2432c08cac8283570.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_a340f24e8b4854d394fa0a6ff1907c0e.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_a340f24e8b4854d394fa0a6ff1907c0e.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_a340f24e8b4854d394fa0a6ff1907c0e.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_a340f24e8b4854d394fa0a6ff1907c0e.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_248abc45171b73f11c7b9b40fdd780e3.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_248abc45171b73f11c7b9b40fdd780e3.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_0afc82ca9a66e9a52afa26fbece24e5e.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_0afc82ca9a66e9a52afa26fbece24e5e.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_a941a4f516655156b6be81edc5a42ec9.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_a941a4f516655156b6be81edc5a42ec9.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_3fcaae2b395c8a65e73ce2edbb2e8370.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_3fcaae2b395c8a65e73ce2edbb2e8370.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_cb8a8c2b50d6481a54348d56f4126077.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_cb8a8c2b50d6481a54348d56f4126077.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_cb8a8c2b50d6481a54348d56f4126077.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_cb8a8c2b50d6481a54348d56f4126077.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_db28b04cf28320223e49066c0c0b0fb4.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_db28b04cf28320223e49066c0c0b0fb4.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_ea356a4dbb93a0c50774bd35c89ea90e.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_25c8bca6bf04a4dc7836586a158480cd.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_25c8bca6bf04a4dc7836586a158480cd.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_25c8bca6bf04a4dc7836586a158480cd.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_25c8bca6bf04a4dc7836586a158480cd.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_29bd4be4e0bb39c6313f39f193f1b77d.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_29bd4be4e0bb39c6313f39f193f1b77d.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_18478f14b3577f97152bdc95cb5ff89f.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_18478f14b3577f97152bdc95cb5ff89f.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_eb7676ef70b96ee50a7665bbe5801bac.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_eb7676ef70b96ee50a7665bbe5801bac.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_eb7676ef70b96ee50a7665bbe5801bac.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_eb7676ef70b96ee50a7665bbe5801bac.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_770e5c7b442b709f61ffee16098ec642.literal_meaning: Son, we're going to have a talk when we get home.
sense_770e5c7b442b709f61ffee16098ec642.text: Filho, nós vamos conversar quando chegarmos em casa.
sense_770e5c7b442b709f61ffee16098ec642.translation: Son, I'm going to spank you when we get home.

sense_770e5c7b442b709f61ffee16098ec642.text: Repórter: [depois de perguntar por que Jeanderson falou palavrão no jogo] Cê viu o chinelo que ela mostrou pra você?
sense_770e5c7b442b709f61ffee16098ec642.translation: Interviewer: [after asking why Jeanderson cussed during the game] Didya see the chancla she showed you?

sense_9c2cb3b8057f5b729203641adc0d731a.text: Ela adora conversar com os amigos.
sense_9c2cb3b8057f5b729203641adc0d731a.translation: She loves to chat with her friends.

sense_9c2cb3b8057f5b729203641adc0d731a.text: Quero conversar com os senhores e exijo sua total e absoluta atenção.
sense_9c2cb3b8057f5b729203641adc0d731a.translation: I want to talk with you and I demand your total and absolute attention.

sense_d77df76abfe14c13c492f65fc7f0050e.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_d77df76abfe14c13c492f65fc7f0050e.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_7cf105c80e3eda9d5e2eb5b57b255182.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_7cf105c80e3eda9d5e2eb5b57b255182.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_7cf105c80e3eda9d5e2eb5b57b255182.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_7cf105c80e3eda9d5e2eb5b57b255182.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_ca08630638c1839920d1018087d39696.text: Os boxeadores estão trocando socos na cabeça.
sense_ca08630638c1839920d1018087d39696.translation: The boxers are exchanging blows to their heads.

sense_ca08630638c1839920d1018087d39696.text: Todo dia eu trocava umas ideias com o vizinho.
sense_ca08630638c1839920d1018087d39696.translation: I used to chat with the neighbor every single day.

sense_acdb2d3d04a102899c4f43e0e9de27ef.text: Troco um par de sapatos por uma blusa.
sense_acdb2d3d04a102899c4f43e0e9de27ef.translation: I’ll exchange a pair of shoes for a blouse.

sense_acdb2d3d04a102899c4f43e0e9de27ef.text: Eu e o meu primo trocamos livros.
sense_acdb2d3d04a102899c4f43e0e9de27ef.translation: My cousin and I traded books.

sense_acdb2d3d04a102899c4f43e0e9de27ef.text: O explorador trocou presentes com os nativos.
sense_acdb2d3d04a102899c4f43e0e9de27ef.translation: The explorer exchanged gifts with the natives.

sense_cdbf89f6c014447ea58cb59b232b3b89.text: Chegamos a casa, pois agora troquemo-nos.
sense_cdbf89f6c014447ea58cb59b232b3b89.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_b5ce8eee394a6a7aaf312b3dc6e5bccc.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.
sense_b5ce8eee394a6a7aaf312b3dc6e5bccc.translation: I want to replace my car with a new one.
We have to replace the burnt-out lightbulbs.

sense_6d60ff11ac2b9f0da648e018db422cf2.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_6d60ff11ac2b9f0da648e018db422cf2.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_cd5ed20afb384f021dd11a4e3c56ad7e.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_cd5ed20afb384f021dd11a4e3c56ad7e.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_cd5ed20afb384f021dd11a4e3c56ad7e.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_cd5ed20afb384f021dd11a4e3c56ad7e.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_6bb9585751e192ddf16cc41fbd0e2465.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_6bb9585751e192ddf16cc41fbd0e2465.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_6bb9585751e192ddf16cc41fbd0e2465.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_6bb9585751e192ddf16cc41fbd0e2465.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_ed459302d9880e532b09fe785c6fc80f.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_ed459302d9880e532b09fe785c6fc80f.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_ed459302d9880e532b09fe785c6fc80f.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_ed459302d9880e532b09fe785c6fc80f.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_cd473c1b797d6bd1d1bf5f61f861ca47.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_cd473c1b797d6bd1d1bf5f61f861ca47.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_cd473c1b797d6bd1d1bf5f61f861ca47.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_40c301fe242c030140528077b736c576.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_a9befff0711672007a0bd8a5d50334bc.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_a9befff0711672007a0bd8a5d50334bc.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_991ec8a0ba97614eacef474897d19ac5.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_991ec8a0ba97614eacef474897d19ac5.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_991ec8a0ba97614eacef474897d19ac5.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_991ec8a0ba97614eacef474897d19ac5.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_991ec8a0ba97614eacef474897d19ac5.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_991ec8a0ba97614eacef474897d19ac5.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_1bdf8d73b8828f887823c7f4af4d0c53.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_1bdf8d73b8828f887823c7f4af4d0c53.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_1bdf8d73b8828f887823c7f4af4d0c53.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_1bdf8d73b8828f887823c7f4af4d0c53.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_6c6805a755583b20ddb66d77d95293fa.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_ddace256490df85c73d451dcf7786d62.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_ddace256490df85c73d451dcf7786d62.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_ddace256490df85c73d451dcf7786d62.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_ddace256490df85c73d451dcf7786d62.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_acad344fe76da84899161574da79726a.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_acad344fe76da84899161574da79726a.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_a8c15436abec8316f5663a363873b548.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_a8c15436abec8316f5663a363873b548.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_2230d1b68548eb137225cbd727cb079b.translation: There was an accident in the highway.

sense_b2d6ddd2346e67710150488060c43592.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_6d35db16523d4a1b5a4357559d73c1e8.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_6d35db16523d4a1b5a4357559d73c1e8.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_b97aa14c5d461b07d87aded4d44a042d.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_1d6b6d1f5e2fb9163dc2bb0d1961e7dc.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_f38b6e4485d0f78a89d305d2675ab341.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_f38b6e4485d0f78a89d305d2675ab341.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_f38b6e4485d0f78a89d305d2675ab341.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_f38b6e4485d0f78a89d305d2675ab341.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_4ca8325d9dbae14ef3e58ca053e16da3.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_cae7e3f456dc065527506d79d1408450.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_cae7e3f456dc065527506d79d1408450.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_cae7e3f456dc065527506d79d1408450.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_cae7e3f456dc065527506d79d1408450.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_dce8beadd1aea2169b89ce3628ab0191.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_dce8beadd1aea2169b89ce3628ab0191.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_dce8beadd1aea2169b89ce3628ab0191.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_dce8beadd1aea2169b89ce3628ab0191.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_dce8beadd1aea2169b89ce3628ab0191.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_dce8beadd1aea2169b89ce3628ab0191.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_3c4d9977ee705817dddc69aaf68ac820.text: Não me importo que você venha.
sense_3c4d9977ee705817dddc69aaf68ac820.translation: I don't care whether you come.

sense_e897592443735c194131c12d325570fd.text: Este é um documentário sério sobre os romanos.
sense_e897592443735c194131c12d325570fd.translation: This is a serious documentary about the Romans.

sense_b2ddd1b21ed6cae3e80349f980e50fd4.text: Luiza lia um romance francez; ou tocava piano; ou pensava indignada nos beijos que lhe dei no pescoço.
sense_b2ddd1b21ed6cae3e80349f980e50fd4.translation: Luiza was reading a French novel; or playing piano; or thinking, outraged, about the kisses I gave her on the neck.

sense_b2ddd1b21ed6cae3e80349f980e50fd4.text: Alda contou para o grupo que a tia Belinha tinha ido sozinha a Paris e lá conhecera um conde francês, ligeiramente arruinado e ligeiramente maluco, com quem tivera um tórrido caso de verão.
sense_b2ddd1b21ed6cae3e80349f980e50fd4.translation: Alda told the group that aunt Belinha had gone alone to Paris and met a French count, slightly ruined and slightly mad, with whom she’d had a steamy summer affair.

sense_8c6a1294b6a48c78c92db4790c2efa7b.text: Dizem que os porcos-espinhos conseguem deixar seus espinhos armados.
sense_8c6a1294b6a48c78c92db4790c2efa7b.translation: They say that porcupines can make their quills erect.

sense_8c6a1294b6a48c78c92db4790c2efa7b.text: Tenho tantos redemoinhos que meu cabelo está sempre armado.
sense_8c6a1294b6a48c78c92db4790c2efa7b.translation: I have so many cowlicks that my hair is always sticking up.

sense_7f701e8e37f475376713d200d7c5518e.text: A rua está cheia de trânsito.
sense_7f701e8e37f475376713d200d7c5518e.translation: The street is full of traffic.

sense_46f101aef19f7e5219973e1a5f604ed3.text: Minha mãe ficou puta com a situação.
sense_46f101aef19f7e5219973e1a5f604ed3.translation: My mom became angry with the situation.

sense_c778396bd07552addc330e6e1667fa1b.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_c778396bd07552addc330e6e1667fa1b.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_30c7c7666e83cfd8273335d976895cb3.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_350b05fd3565fababcce7ad4b081d347.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_350b05fd3565fababcce7ad4b081d347.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_350b05fd3565fababcce7ad4b081d347.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_350b05fd3565fababcce7ad4b081d347.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_804aabc8a142b7f1e75c1564bd5b2522.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_804aabc8a142b7f1e75c1564bd5b2522.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_7caab04c8de9bb733a86131fc59b1c75.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_7caab04c8de9bb733a86131fc59b1c75.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_6a34d603be6fd01ee3f8a40d33ddc31e.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_6a34d603be6fd01ee3f8a40d33ddc31e.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_0557ac0a91947e51056d6397b881bd04.text: O Everest detém o recorde de montanha mais alta.
sense_0557ac0a91947e51056d6397b881bd04.translation: Everest holds the record of highest mountain.

sense_0557ac0a91947e51056d6397b881bd04.text: O recorde mundial de salto em altura é de 2,45 metros.
sense_0557ac0a91947e51056d6397b881bd04.translation: The world record in high-jump is 2.45 metres.

sense_46d5beb8a29da7bde38b26cf09f72474.text: Um conselho me seria muito útil.
sense_46d5beb8a29da7bde38b26cf09f72474.translation: A piece of advice would be very useful to me.

sense_b73a01ed83273f48f82ca58de18d2f6e.text: Farei vocês se arrependerem de ter nascido.
sense_b73a01ed83273f48f82ca58de18d2f6e.translation: I will make you regret having been born.

sense_b73a01ed83273f48f82ca58de18d2f6e.text: Os terroristas se arrependeram do ataque.

sense_aaea116bc38c3825a5d3095624737bbd.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_aaea116bc38c3825a5d3095624737bbd.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_6d1a2a024f362b37326eb149d2be376f.text: O exército teve de abandonar o forte.
sense_6d1a2a024f362b37326eb149d2be376f.translation: The army had to abandon the fort.

sense_6d1a2a024f362b37326eb149d2be376f.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_6d1a2a024f362b37326eb149d2be376f.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_b8768e7788c57ee0556fb90d977bd5d2.text: O réu abandonou-se/se abandonou nas mãos do advogado.
sense_b8768e7788c57ee0556fb90d977bd5d2.translation: The accused put himself in his lawyer’s hands.
We let ourselves be seized by sadness.

sense_e6ee3bcbeb44ba590275042800b757a2.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_e6ee3bcbeb44ba590275042800b757a2.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_e6ee3bcbeb44ba590275042800b757a2.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_e6ee3bcbeb44ba590275042800b757a2.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_e5ace806776b1e3d8b8061e893325db0.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_e5ace806776b1e3d8b8061e893325db0.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_41b1116f1e5f687995346e4b2ebd9719.text: Emprestei para uma porção de gente, mas ninguém me devolve.
sense_41b1116f1e5f687995346e4b2ebd9719.translation: I have loaned to a bunch of people, but nobody pays me back.

sense_41b1116f1e5f687995346e4b2ebd9719.text: Espero alguém que me empreste seu casaco em dia de chuva.
sense_41b1116f1e5f687995346e4b2ebd9719.translation: I’m waiting for someone who lends me their coat in a rainy day.

sense_e2c7f32f9ff2c60bc746316c6088f3b1.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_e2c7f32f9ff2c60bc746316c6088f3b1.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_9cbbc7b8bf468532a854b6cb771b4851.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_9cbbc7b8bf468532a854b6cb771b4851.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_9cbbc7b8bf468532a854b6cb771b4851.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_9cbbc7b8bf468532a854b6cb771b4851.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_0593d352dab128fd83b095f23998406d.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_0593d352dab128fd83b095f23998406d.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_0593d352dab128fd83b095f23998406d.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_0593d352dab128fd83b095f23998406d.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_25638fbb89ffa707eb9aa81bbfa91d82.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_25638fbb89ffa707eb9aa81bbfa91d82.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_f5a0abe6653311d9ea92f09a33412439.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_f5a0abe6653311d9ea92f09a33412439.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_f5a0abe6653311d9ea92f09a33412439.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_d4e9e6ba897d32ddfa82caca444f7ba9.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_d4e9e6ba897d32ddfa82caca444f7ba9.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_b1341b3c61648201897fdf9e84390fc2.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_b1341b3c61648201897fdf9e84390fc2.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_9314a31dfcf93db28273d95a7b60bb04.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_983ecd5b1464e01d008e94538a75e253.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_983ecd5b1464e01d008e94538a75e253.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_bf418b42a31d15afd32c94fad2644e58.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_46403e510ec2ea3f795b7f1c8e4472be.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_46403e510ec2ea3f795b7f1c8e4472be.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_d542153f292122e195ebb34336e5a3a3.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_6ab098b2b5b73bb88675362ae185d83c.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_6ab098b2b5b73bb88675362ae185d83c.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_5eb818fad893e62f5799894c3d3eaab6.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_5eb818fad893e62f5799894c3d3eaab6.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_dac283fe250b34802c8d0f2412db8258.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_dac283fe250b34802c8d0f2412db8258.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_dac283fe250b34802c8d0f2412db8258.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_d639d20fcc30dcbc9f6c625ca705f627.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_d639d20fcc30dcbc9f6c625ca705f627.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_26550b399f66fc7be1c4897fba5dcba3.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_26550b399f66fc7be1c4897fba5dcba3.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_09e73565a6c0455c641bf0b10be05a9f.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_09e73565a6c0455c641bf0b10be05a9f.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_be178f16dba094d6883115e7ef849267.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_be178f16dba094d6883115e7ef849267.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_9026a3526e72881d0e6d292634e6c3b6.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_9026a3526e72881d0e6d292634e6c3b6.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_8aced1a02b73c30670a395a0b3b3dc3f.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_8aced1a02b73c30670a395a0b3b3dc3f.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_332c95cf4690e4532dd6df7e68cf49c1.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_332c95cf4690e4532dd6df7e68cf49c1.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_332c95cf4690e4532dd6df7e68cf49c1.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_332c95cf4690e4532dd6df7e68cf49c1.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_6042f6e0048a9893398a962cd9a6e6ee.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_6042f6e0048a9893398a962cd9a6e6ee.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_6042f6e0048a9893398a962cd9a6e6ee.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_6042f6e0048a9893398a962cd9a6e6ee.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_09f9e2668376d604896869cedbe2d086.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_09f9e2668376d604896869cedbe2d086.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_ec6672c4d8a45722eba19999d137b7aa.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_ec6672c4d8a45722eba19999d137b7aa.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_5c9d8f27ac2e047b8f969d4998d39271.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_5c9d8f27ac2e047b8f969d4998d39271.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_acef61aca14562c7e883a52f5fb729cd.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_acef61aca14562c7e883a52f5fb729cd.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_acef61aca14562c7e883a52f5fb729cd.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_acef61aca14562c7e883a52f5fb729cd.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_fd5265c2bdb30370f3baa047486e7f7c.text: O êxito de Marilyn Monroe não a fez feliz.
sense_fd5265c2bdb30370f3baa047486e7f7c.translation: Marilyn Monroe's success did not make her happy.
I hope that he will succeed.

sense_71ddf2ce83b1e6b2a1a41fd7040eb0f9.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_71ddf2ce83b1e6b2a1a41fd7040eb0f9.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_c44ef0a62c2f12fcb8b7c578832e0520.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_d558cffb377fcf39f682ff8117935d6f.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_d558cffb377fcf39f682ff8117935d6f.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_d558cffb377fcf39f682ff8117935d6f.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_20699cb380ddbc3bcad6d4222029b806.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_20699cb380ddbc3bcad6d4222029b806.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_20699cb380ddbc3bcad6d4222029b806.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_20699cb380ddbc3bcad6d4222029b806.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_20699cb380ddbc3bcad6d4222029b806.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_f6520b20afd2d6bb465e5eb7b5bca0f6.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_f6520b20afd2d6bb465e5eb7b5bca0f6.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_f6520b20afd2d6bb465e5eb7b5bca0f6.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_f6520b20afd2d6bb465e5eb7b5bca0f6.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_35bf44d21ec9fb7b04dbf33819df7ffa.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

– Can we reach him?

sense_196f86f65ed6f72f98b3d6712f99bb58.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_a3ed13ea6f64fb6fe4fc76cb265b34bd.text: Será que os Androides Sonham com Ovelhas Elétricas?
sense_a3ed13ea6f64fb6fe4fc76cb265b34bd.translation: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
I had a dream about him.

sense_d470abc018fd70a6a2e1605859f9f742.text: Eu levei um susto quando ele me cutucou do nada.
sense_d470abc018fd70a6a2e1605859f9f742.translation: I got startled when he unexpectedly poked me.
That scared me! (lit.: Ay, what a scare!)

sense_1b5880868e5b89d99726e390869401c9.text: Minha mãe se dana comigo se escuta dessa!
sense_1b5880868e5b89d99726e390869401c9.translation: My mom will be mad at me if she hears about this!

sense_1b5880868e5b89d99726e390869401c9.text: Sinha Victoria ia damnar-se, e com razão.
sense_1b5880868e5b89d99726e390869401c9.translation: Mrs. Victoria would get mad, and rightfully so.

sense_992e8e68354f3219c6c6e32292ce4421.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_992e8e68354f3219c6c6e32292ce4421.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_d932153d9d1e0af1e90aa55338cd6963.text: Bebendo vinho / Quebrando as taças / Fudendo por toda casa / Se eu divido o maço, eu te amo, desgraça
sense_d932153d9d1e0af1e90aa55338cd6963.translation: Drinking wine / Breaking the glasses / Fucking all around the house / If I share the pack, I love you, disgrace

sense_f6f891433303aa4e59f8c00f11644e8f.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_f6f891433303aa4e59f8c00f11644e8f.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_f6f891433303aa4e59f8c00f11644e8f.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_f6f891433303aa4e59f8c00f11644e8f.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_40b0ccdd4aacf827dce6e352096d5e24.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_40b0ccdd4aacf827dce6e352096d5e24.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_8b656997961e60adeac94f101dac8635.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_8b656997961e60adeac94f101dac8635.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_19dc5adb308be7685f0a0a18b7b85b55.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_19dc5adb308be7685f0a0a18b7b85b55.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_edb7f0e6d2b34f1bec54fcb18ae83112.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_edb7f0e6d2b34f1bec54fcb18ae83112.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_edb7f0e6d2b34f1bec54fcb18ae83112.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_edb7f0e6d2b34f1bec54fcb18ae83112.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_d0541224fd0d37eb198fc26a7a90b094.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_d0541224fd0d37eb198fc26a7a90b094.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_6ffec270114c68a4b04f144e50dd62e8.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_a7bf5bca7c1939abf3d72cfe5ccd1ffc.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_a7bf5bca7c1939abf3d72cfe5ccd1ffc.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_a7bf5bca7c1939abf3d72cfe5ccd1ffc.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_a7bf5bca7c1939abf3d72cfe5ccd1ffc.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_08748b9a7052bfd745d790c2b2a9ea0a.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_08748b9a7052bfd745d790c2b2a9ea0a.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_08748b9a7052bfd745d790c2b2a9ea0a.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_08748b9a7052bfd745d790c2b2a9ea0a.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_7b1aaa1eadd331462017ba28260a30c2.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_7b1aaa1eadd331462017ba28260a30c2.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_7b1aaa1eadd331462017ba28260a30c2.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_7b1aaa1eadd331462017ba28260a30c2.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_3b8ae23d97191fbcd708f0f415076dcf.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_3b8ae23d97191fbcd708f0f415076dcf.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_3b8ae23d97191fbcd708f0f415076dcf.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_3b8ae23d97191fbcd708f0f415076dcf.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_3b8ae23d97191fbcd708f0f415076dcf.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_3b8ae23d97191fbcd708f0f415076dcf.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_7362845364c7c64c86bfc008778efadc.translation: They’ve been going out for three months.

sense_b637eed9d2a61c6bc4922f9b12f4b078.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_07b4dee8ec37dfc2ba795e8c9b424b50.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_cdca4e83627ef6f7b6ea223309a34366.text: A TV não está ligada na tomada.
sense_cdca4e83627ef6f7b6ea223309a34366.translation: The TV is not plugged in (lit.: not linked in the socket).

sense_cdca4e83627ef6f7b6ea223309a34366.text: De acordo com o documento, o governador está ligado ao esquema de corrupção.
sense_cdca4e83627ef6f7b6ea223309a34366.translation: According to the report, the governor is linked to the corruption scheme.

sense_3de6fe0570da9c4290ab0b4dd64be3b4.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_3de6fe0570da9c4290ab0b4dd64be3b4.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_58783768e13ae7083c44f531d8e69a4e.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_58783768e13ae7083c44f531d8e69a4e.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_2c0557a2259ff5c58527d620bb59e51f.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_2c0557a2259ff5c58527d620bb59e51f.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_2c0557a2259ff5c58527d620bb59e51f.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_d1c564ca847e37c7a1616acc29575c43.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_d1c564ca847e37c7a1616acc29575c43.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_d1c564ca847e37c7a1616acc29575c43.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_d1c564ca847e37c7a1616acc29575c43.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_84eaaf61ff98de59d478bb746743b0d6.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_84eaaf61ff98de59d478bb746743b0d6.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_dcc971bf8817a9f40800afeb228fc2e8.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_dcc971bf8817a9f40800afeb228fc2e8.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_94a8ff34d5267e00239678136fa956b7.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_94a8ff34d5267e00239678136fa956b7.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_50135bcfb13543493dcb3a62a96b083f.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_50135bcfb13543493dcb3a62a96b083f.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_50135bcfb13543493dcb3a62a96b083f.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_50135bcfb13543493dcb3a62a96b083f.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_8b9aef9e25a87193d8507bf732637c84.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_b92e247cc0b1df3162eb6da0fad5b7d6.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_b92e247cc0b1df3162eb6da0fad5b7d6.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_b92e247cc0b1df3162eb6da0fad5b7d6.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_b92e247cc0b1df3162eb6da0fad5b7d6.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_64e1c067f70ecc797011d4b2d0b8d2b0.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_64e1c067f70ecc797011d4b2d0b8d2b0.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_64e1c067f70ecc797011d4b2d0b8d2b0.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_64e1c067f70ecc797011d4b2d0b8d2b0.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_1282b7f42249a6a7bffe29832c7cf70c.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_1282b7f42249a6a7bffe29832c7cf70c.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_1282b7f42249a6a7bffe29832c7cf70c.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_1282b7f42249a6a7bffe29832c7cf70c.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_194ee657996231167270a80ff2382b4c.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_f31d4163e970585635477f48fbfb5a2b.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_f31d4163e970585635477f48fbfb5a2b.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_faec6b1f27f6759498f4b208f817432f.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_faec6b1f27f6759498f4b208f817432f.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_faec6b1f27f6759498f4b208f817432f.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_faec6b1f27f6759498f4b208f817432f.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_c68e1dfaf194e4bd51f7b37630135602.text: Você está afastado enquanto investigamos as alegações de corrupção.
sense_c68e1dfaf194e4bd51f7b37630135602.translation: You are suspended while we investigate the corruption allegations.

sense_c68e1dfaf194e4bd51f7b37630135602.text: […]o atleta Eduardo Bauermann foi comunicado que está afastado preventivamente dos treinos com o elenco profissional, a partir desta terça-feira[…]
sense_c68e1dfaf194e4bd51f7b37630135602.translation: The athlete Eduardo Bauermann has been made aware he is preemptively suspended from training with the professional team starting this Tuesday.

sense_1a8c488a79d6bbe6b286fbdeafe4a0d1.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_1a8c488a79d6bbe6b286fbdeafe4a0d1.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_03876083e7ef43e71c20292c3d004ba1.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_28b461290338d2bdb90b4d166547c4d8.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_28b461290338d2bdb90b4d166547c4d8.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_8c4864cec0019184c4b6bc3be980fef5.text: […] o empurrou tão rijo que deu com elle da eſcotilha abaixo […]
sense_8c4864cec0019184c4b6bc3be980fef5.translation: […] he pushed him so roughly that he sent him down the hatch […]

sense_8c4864cec0019184c4b6bc3be980fef5.text: Ele se aproximou e experimentou empurrá-la.
sense_8c4864cec0019184c4b6bc3be980fef5.translation: He came closer and tried to push it.

sense_9188db3d3ee18de7fa0376b5183f2332.text: O vendedor ficou me empurrando essa caixinha de som, e acabou que eu voltei com três.
sense_9188db3d3ee18de7fa0376b5183f2332.translation: The salesman kept pushing these speakers to me, and I ended up coming home with three.

sense_9188db3d3ee18de7fa0376b5183f2332.text: Mas ſobreveyo Perdiccas amigo de Agathocles, & empurrando hũa mentira com outra o tirou a ſalvo […]
sense_9188db3d3ee18de7fa0376b5183f2332.translation: But Perdiccas, friend of Agathocles, appeared and, pushing one lie after the other, got him out safely […]

sense_c71f254362febb3fd28859e2b372061c.text: Casgaste completamente para a mensagem que te mandei.
sense_c71f254362febb3fd28859e2b372061c.translation: You completely ignored the message I sent you.
She didn't give a shit about me.

sense_35bf50eeba788330fe5ecb4e7d1ab5b1.text: O stor tá-se a cagar para os novos alunos.
sense_35bf50eeba788330fe5ecb4e7d1ab5b1.translation: The prof doesn't give a shit about the new students.

sense_35bf50eeba788330fe5ecb4e7d1ab5b1.text: Se ele não quer ir à festa, o problema é dele. Pessoalmente, tou-me a cagar!
sense_35bf50eeba788330fe5ecb4e7d1ab5b1.translation: If he doesn't want to go to the party, that's his own problem. Personally, I don't give a shit!

sense_0a2c652bd1fc343d7ee647ba658c4799.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_0a2c652bd1fc343d7ee647ba658c4799.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_78fbe552b430b38a5064c2a8c25d8808.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_78fbe552b430b38a5064c2a8c25d8808.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_c62ca66144c31d6a668de3edb2100ed4.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_c62ca66144c31d6a668de3edb2100ed4.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_d0ea15ae9f8abb122e3dd1d36bf2a712.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_4c202f43053bbab620c33f6a25d02537.translation: His friends addicted him to drugs.

sense_6d5a3e82fa434575914fa06a4277f981.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_6d5a3e82fa434575914fa06a4277f981.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_b0816e26fec41f9ad93fb9d2492d161e.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_b0816e26fec41f9ad93fb9d2492d161e.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_d05508af8030cfb00c8198440daa3fbe.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_d05508af8030cfb00c8198440daa3fbe.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_faaf8aa2dfdb9374f9f6e1986bfafea5.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_faaf8aa2dfdb9374f9f6e1986bfafea5.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_faaf8aa2dfdb9374f9f6e1986bfafea5.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_faaf8aa2dfdb9374f9f6e1986bfafea5.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_faaf8aa2dfdb9374f9f6e1986bfafea5.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_e1c782fc834d5bfc3f28cfb78a5b181d.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_e1c782fc834d5bfc3f28cfb78a5b181d.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_e1c782fc834d5bfc3f28cfb78a5b181d.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_e1c782fc834d5bfc3f28cfb78a5b181d.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_2982291a6907b3e66658f257b5a2ca5b.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_2982291a6907b3e66658f257b5a2ca5b.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_2982291a6907b3e66658f257b5a2ca5b.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_2982291a6907b3e66658f257b5a2ca5b.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_9e26f225e826f4a3a540f3d8ed59ffd6.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_9e26f225e826f4a3a540f3d8ed59ffd6.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_9e26f225e826f4a3a540f3d8ed59ffd6.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_9e26f225e826f4a3a540f3d8ed59ffd6.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_5821750d3c2dffa4cbb727683e2ba09d.translation: Did you find a nice café?

sense_9bb41187749d329d15e2e9c233019f80.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_36be183a97932f8ef28899447ff157c5.text: A conversa era sobre parentes, os parentes estranhos, interessantes ou, por qualquer razão, notáveis de cada um. Alguém já tinha contado que um parente comia favo de mel com abelha dentro.
sense_36be183a97932f8ef28899447ff157c5.translation: The conversation was about relatives, the weird, interesting or, for any reason, notable relatives of each one. Someone had already told that a relative eat honeycombs with the bees inside.

sense_36be183a97932f8ef28899447ff157c5.text: Essa história de “amigos certos para as horas incertas”, além de pai, mãe, filhos e irmãos, é muito difícil de acontecer. Até mesmo os parentes mais próximos não ajudam os necessitados muitas vezes.
sense_36be183a97932f8ef28899447ff157c5.translation: Such a thing as “right friends for uncertain times”, aside from [one's] father, mother, children and siblings, is very unlikely to happen. Even the closest relatives don't help the ones in need most of the times.

sense_b0c404a78d504d1735d16e11b9723cea.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_ff250884bee47418a7580c08ab03485c.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_ff250884bee47418a7580c08ab03485c.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_8e40b51b4a6b96c6029f9a97d6e51e8e.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_51e5826e20bfb76e6647061e0190b431.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_51e5826e20bfb76e6647061e0190b431.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_e128b05d5a77f66e98aac9d6417cdb49.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_e128b05d5a77f66e98aac9d6417cdb49.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_6c11a968205fc4de185f1fde9dfc9149.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_6c11a968205fc4de185f1fde9dfc9149.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_9d698ef91a6beb2d6001f7fef96967f0.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_9d698ef91a6beb2d6001f7fef96967f0.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_9d698ef91a6beb2d6001f7fef96967f0.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_9d698ef91a6beb2d6001f7fef96967f0.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_7ecc39f063c7c3e8a97bfb283ad871b9.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_7ecc39f063c7c3e8a97bfb283ad871b9.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_1f85462e44a396fa97b218d71216ddbf.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_1f85462e44a396fa97b218d71216ddbf.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_6c6cf9d0b5ce159b025fdb9783e8981b.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_6c6cf9d0b5ce159b025fdb9783e8981b.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_91300afdb31a9bfe6324dc50cfcf7f88.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_a64f31210cc916ea972bb63947d52201.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_a64f31210cc916ea972bb63947d52201.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_a64f31210cc916ea972bb63947d52201.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_a64f31210cc916ea972bb63947d52201.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_435220c5c0ed2ecc288594dae765cae2.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_1ead51de9152ead6964daef668e22aaf.text: Ela adora conversar com os amigos.
sense_1ead51de9152ead6964daef668e22aaf.translation: She loves to chat with her friends.

sense_1ead51de9152ead6964daef668e22aaf.text: Quero conversar com os senhores e exijo sua total e absoluta atenção.
sense_1ead51de9152ead6964daef668e22aaf.translation: I want to talk with you and I demand your total and absolute attention.

sense_1ec72149cc44a58a50fac4ed14b6b2a3.literal_meaning: Son, we're going to have a talk when we get home.
sense_1ec72149cc44a58a50fac4ed14b6b2a3.text: Filho, nós vamos conversar quando chegarmos em casa.
sense_1ec72149cc44a58a50fac4ed14b6b2a3.translation: Son, I'm going to spank you when we get home.

sense_1ec72149cc44a58a50fac4ed14b6b2a3.text: Repórter: [depois de perguntar por que Jeanderson falou palavrão no jogo] Cê viu o chinelo que ela mostrou pra você?
sense_1ec72149cc44a58a50fac4ed14b6b2a3.translation: Interviewer: [after asking why Jeanderson cussed during the game] Didya see the chancla she showed you?

sense_fafeb7e8de6e116262f72c04c5fa41d1.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_fafeb7e8de6e116262f72c04c5fa41d1.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_da667b605fd50ba25077ca0cea093c65.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_da667b605fd50ba25077ca0cea093c65.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_da667b605fd50ba25077ca0cea093c65.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_6a22b337dbdaca0bedb43d1bb6d725ae.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_b024c503cd7590ae8ddbd5d18734e9e6.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_b024c503cd7590ae8ddbd5d18734e9e6.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_bb8de1c8a1f5df40c0d7d591c833e202.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_bb8de1c8a1f5df40c0d7d591c833e202.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_261972aa24d2dce310c44838934e3ec9.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_77e974b6b5d2ef3b8d3cf917be414be7.text: Meus cachorros que Estão agora com a idade de 17 anos. Foram criados por mim com leite ninho.
sense_77e974b6b5d2ef3b8d3cf917be414be7.translation: My dogs are 17 years old now. They were raised by me with powdered milk.

sense_77e974b6b5d2ef3b8d3cf917be414be7.text: Coloque a mousse de leite ninho por cima do de creme de avelã com cacau e leite e leve para gelar pôr^([sic – meaning por]) no mínimo 2 horas.
sense_77e974b6b5d2ef3b8d3cf917be414be7.translation: Pour the powdered milk mousse over the hazel, cocoa and milk cream and refrigerate it for at least 2 hours.

sense_38eaed739c8b83830d4d1ff4fe02134a.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_38eaed739c8b83830d4d1ff4fe02134a.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_07f6aaf6f873b6ad6f8a9a546e85f473.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_07f6aaf6f873b6ad6f8a9a546e85f473.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_fbcea9ee7cc4be689cba794a6f30bc86.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_fbcea9ee7cc4be689cba794a6f30bc86.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_fbcea9ee7cc4be689cba794a6f30bc86.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_fbcea9ee7cc4be689cba794a6f30bc86.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_fbcea9ee7cc4be689cba794a6f30bc86.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_fbcea9ee7cc4be689cba794a6f30bc86.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_e77cce9dfce8f4ecb28ee9892a8bfe50.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_17e5dee5f22aca247b199cb012966755.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_e6eaea4df6d61772e09cd1c39aed2151.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_d19cd3facab6d7091f32af29530cdf00.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_d19cd3facab6d7091f32af29530cdf00.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_bdc26331b19f787b2bcf50d83ea702e1.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_a15a4ce08377e30c18956bbca042a679.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_a15a4ce08377e30c18956bbca042a679.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_345889f24bb69c9c430d176ea8d93dcc.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_3b9b7bd4b854e5328d4e91c9902eb374.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_fcb1266facd78d3b3659e7e24eafefe4.text: Minha mãe se dana comigo se escuta dessa!
sense_fcb1266facd78d3b3659e7e24eafefe4.translation: My mom will be mad at me if she hears about this!

sense_fcb1266facd78d3b3659e7e24eafefe4.text: Sinha Victoria ia damnar-se, e com razão.
sense_fcb1266facd78d3b3659e7e24eafefe4.translation: Mrs. Victoria would get mad, and rightfully so.

sense_213924ea2defc3271c95a1b04ac7e334.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_213924ea2defc3271c95a1b04ac7e334.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_e76186885d4775ad34a12db27518f82c.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_e76186885d4775ad34a12db27518f82c.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_ebbb8648ff54ff33163a3901c8e222ac.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_ebbb8648ff54ff33163a3901c8e222ac.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_9c4df0bbfb465a260bdd574d642e7732.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_9c4df0bbfb465a260bdd574d642e7732.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_9c4df0bbfb465a260bdd574d642e7732.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_9c4df0bbfb465a260bdd574d642e7732.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_85e8210b7a6f7083f1aa98a10b6f4841.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_85e8210b7a6f7083f1aa98a10b6f4841.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_33df31035070205c726f9640d6b242da.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_33df31035070205c726f9640d6b242da.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_33df31035070205c726f9640d6b242da.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_8486445ee02f42541f1d5d43ff52e05f.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_8486445ee02f42541f1d5d43ff52e05f.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_5fb638ec52e911426bb31f23fabb7ebb.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_5fb638ec52e911426bb31f23fabb7ebb.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_8b8d7581a3fdb22c951235cee7f0421d.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_8b8d7581a3fdb22c951235cee7f0421d.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_8b8d7581a3fdb22c951235cee7f0421d.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_8b8d7581a3fdb22c951235cee7f0421d.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_8b8d7581a3fdb22c951235cee7f0421d.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_9f8f7f825c3f58d4beb2aef14ef4dcff.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_9f8f7f825c3f58d4beb2aef14ef4dcff.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_9f8f7f825c3f58d4beb2aef14ef4dcff.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_9f8f7f825c3f58d4beb2aef14ef4dcff.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_18f6ae7dea0ca6019a789c7fc30b5761.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_18f6ae7dea0ca6019a789c7fc30b5761.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_18f6ae7dea0ca6019a789c7fc30b5761.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_18f6ae7dea0ca6019a789c7fc30b5761.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_6acf638fe5088794b0e5e09f5a0a8dcb.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_0576a23500b80cc840a3613907747d8e.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_0576a23500b80cc840a3613907747d8e.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_98a59295c44e2eca7ab87d0a1f73428a.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_98a59295c44e2eca7ab87d0a1f73428a.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_156605aa93ce9efe82fa6fb6e13948ee.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_156605aa93ce9efe82fa6fb6e13948ee.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_f314977bc8ea4f0ca90824f035f7897b.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_f7e0928fc37122c19e793040ab57975d.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_f7e0928fc37122c19e793040ab57975d.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_f7e0928fc37122c19e793040ab57975d.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_f7e0928fc37122c19e793040ab57975d.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_68abd63d85b33e2ba33d74c654d76f49.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_68abd63d85b33e2ba33d74c654d76f49.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_148a76d54225983638d2a4d0f187a8fc.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_148a76d54225983638d2a4d0f187a8fc.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_148a76d54225983638d2a4d0f187a8fc.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_1f18652aac6614fb3981308848aab2ee.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_1f18652aac6614fb3981308848aab2ee.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_62748b5e99a6d6293c2ec050f94d3166.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_62748b5e99a6d6293c2ec050f94d3166.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_e07858051073f75f9e355f195c22cb31.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_e07858051073f75f9e355f195c22cb31.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_e07858051073f75f9e355f195c22cb31.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_e07858051073f75f9e355f195c22cb31.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_018e6b5ad998f3d508f7d2820a9a36d1.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_018e6b5ad998f3d508f7d2820a9a36d1.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_efb53d61c3df575022734e80663484f3.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_efb53d61c3df575022734e80663484f3.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_efb53d61c3df575022734e80663484f3.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_efb53d61c3df575022734e80663484f3.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_5e3010cfb2d9e921c05ff55867d7051c.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_5e3010cfb2d9e921c05ff55867d7051c.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_c51c39a899b839c67e8232526ae8cdb1.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_c51c39a899b839c67e8232526ae8cdb1.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_a6ddf0921056803d6746cb0f6d4ecd8a.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_ac1d5cb5d9befe0c897ad38fb6d8c190.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_ac1d5cb5d9befe0c897ad38fb6d8c190.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_a572bd4d2479a5991737b911f1ebbf09.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_a572bd4d2479a5991737b911f1ebbf09.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_5a994bc0ca9757ed967d4db39eb0d9a5.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_5a994bc0ca9757ed967d4db39eb0d9a5.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_5a994bc0ca9757ed967d4db39eb0d9a5.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_5a994bc0ca9757ed967d4db39eb0d9a5.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_ea8eaacaaf74452050ed94ed1fe9949e.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_ea8eaacaaf74452050ed94ed1fe9949e.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_4c428bd984d8c17fe40245c6abdfa15f.text: Roupas novas podem causar uma boa impressão.
sense_4c428bd984d8c17fe40245c6abdfa15f.translation: New clothes may cause a good impression.

sense_917e3cd5fa673b43dd61dae2404ede43.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_917e3cd5fa673b43dd61dae2404ede43.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_917e3cd5fa673b43dd61dae2404ede43.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_917e3cd5fa673b43dd61dae2404ede43.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_9350f5dc6c7946955fd706a13d44d47f.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_9350f5dc6c7946955fd706a13d44d47f.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_678d2b982b684642fee59693fdcea477.text: Por favor, cuide do cachorro enquanto estivermos fora.
sense_678d2b982b684642fee59693fdcea477.translation: Please take care of our dog while we're away.

sense_678d2b982b684642fee59693fdcea477.text: A cachorra Baleia corria na frente, o focinho arregaçado, procurando na catinga a novilha raposa.
sense_678d2b982b684642fee59693fdcea477.translation: Baleia the dog [doggess] ran ahead, her snout up high, looking for the young fox in the caatinga.

sense_f6619e7b24851b83460fa95ad1279595.text: Desconectar o computador direto da tomada sem desligá-lo antes pode queimá-lo.
sense_f6619e7b24851b83460fa95ad1279595.translation: Unplugging the computer directly without turning it off first may break it.

sense_2dddc6ff4e922aa65a838ac2ee1ea224.text: A TV não está ligada na tomada.
sense_2dddc6ff4e922aa65a838ac2ee1ea224.translation: The TV is not plugged in (lit.: not linked in the socket).

sense_2dddc6ff4e922aa65a838ac2ee1ea224.text: De acordo com o documento, o governador está ligado ao esquema de corrupção.
sense_2dddc6ff4e922aa65a838ac2ee1ea224.translation: According to the report, the governor is linked to the corruption scheme.

sense_9a39d109da03698d39f2f71fcec66032.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_9a39d109da03698d39f2f71fcec66032.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_fe742683f8c1a9dd43ac6a3c56fbc88f.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_fe742683f8c1a9dd43ac6a3c56fbc88f.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_fe742683f8c1a9dd43ac6a3c56fbc88f.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_fe742683f8c1a9dd43ac6a3c56fbc88f.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_3b9d694f0cbabf4a6fea78e3457aabb6.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_3b9d694f0cbabf4a6fea78e3457aabb6.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_b1c9f98ae1da8055d91d8cac747e469d.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_b1c9f98ae1da8055d91d8cac747e469d.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_b1c9f98ae1da8055d91d8cac747e469d.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_b1c9f98ae1da8055d91d8cac747e469d.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_c8f14b8bbf4981ea8415395bef184d0b.text: Não conseguiria nunca extender os ossos numa cama, o unico desejo que tinha.
sense_c8f14b8bbf4981ea8415395bef184d0b.translation: She would never be able to stretch her bones on a bed, her only wish.

sense_ea7beb2ae1239ce199d8ef0401ce9047.text: Chore o preço até que o diminuam.
sense_ea7beb2ae1239ce199d8ef0401ce9047.translation: Haggle for the price until they lower it.

sense_ea7beb2ae1239ce199d8ef0401ce9047.text: Chorei, chorei, até que o vendedor baixou o preço.
sense_ea7beb2ae1239ce199d8ef0401ce9047.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_94d767d63e8acb5e6eb6bf09b95f89c7.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_94d767d63e8acb5e6eb6bf09b95f89c7.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_94d767d63e8acb5e6eb6bf09b95f89c7.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_94d767d63e8acb5e6eb6bf09b95f89c7.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_d7ff9fb3c34c25d19be44016c0b8ccc5.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_62372b7bd11991f0211ac508a51c557b.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_2472919facfdaf56291db886c1889152.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_2472919facfdaf56291db886c1889152.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_349a3fc8c3a37711bca93985aae05387.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_349a3fc8c3a37711bca93985aae05387.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_61879f156d71db67703dbf075655bc71.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_61879f156d71db67703dbf075655bc71.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_7b220fb72218a532c6adc6c7b54e304a.text: Emprestei para uma porção de gente, mas ninguém me devolve.
sense_7b220fb72218a532c6adc6c7b54e304a.translation: I have loaned to a bunch of people, but nobody pays me back.

sense_7b220fb72218a532c6adc6c7b54e304a.text: Espero alguém que me empreste seu casaco em dia de chuva.
sense_7b220fb72218a532c6adc6c7b54e304a.translation: I’m waiting for someone who lends me their coat in a rainy day.

sense_bc76e8a93d17992d98f3c414410ed597.text: — Aqui me tem, prompto a luctar peito a peito contra o seu infortunio, e a vencêl-o.
sense_bc76e8a93d17992d98f3c414410ed597.translation: “Here you have me, ready to fight chest-to-chest against your misfortune, and to win against it.”

sense_d9d6bd2011e6bca9bc475c2f2f319acb.text: Eu temo o dia em que ninguém more mais aqui.
sense_d9d6bd2011e6bca9bc475c2f2f319acb.translation: I fear the day no one lives here any more.

sense_0ad1135d92ec98a80c21e16c4a054a9e.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_0ad1135d92ec98a80c21e16c4a054a9e.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_34e8ab83c0d1e8ff2884201e4d0147c1.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_34e8ab83c0d1e8ff2884201e4d0147c1.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_898e22765f89a5e40e3ffdeb555a8102.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_865dd42ddc38fa82faec6def2f98faca.text: A palavra “livro” significa um conjunto de páginas ligadas.
sense_865dd42ddc38fa82faec6def2f98faca.translation: The word “book” means a collection of bound pages.

sense_ffd79ec85f5de4366cce2e5cc4e705a5.text: Ela está cantando? / Ela está a cantar?

sense_ffd79ec85f5de4366cce2e5cc4e705a5.translation: We had been reading a lot.

sense_71dceb728876df3f0f1f7dc751459aa6.translation: The weather was cold (at that moment).

sense_277ec11b42cdacc866c439ec74bbe488.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_277ec11b42cdacc866c439ec74bbe488.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_1e45a6d7b4cdce3e493551fa62b43a1e.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_9816acebc72dd376824880563066fb6c.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_9816acebc72dd376824880563066fb6c.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_9816acebc72dd376824880563066fb6c.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_9816acebc72dd376824880563066fb6c.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_4b1c09063e060532d56c09240d01c596.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_4b1c09063e060532d56c09240d01c596.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_d4c3456652ac410874797523626d1db0.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_d4c3456652ac410874797523626d1db0.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_d4c3456652ac410874797523626d1db0.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_d4c3456652ac410874797523626d1db0.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_76a85283d14c623ebd1edc82f6c937b5.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_76a85283d14c623ebd1edc82f6c937b5.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_57e9a53d115bc5eb0a94f22596376ea7.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_57e9a53d115bc5eb0a94f22596376ea7.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_57e9a53d115bc5eb0a94f22596376ea7.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_57e9a53d115bc5eb0a94f22596376ea7.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_912cced13598b423636e414df0938ed2.text: Tu não consegues levantar o piano.
É algo que levantei do chão.
sense_912cced13598b423636e414df0938ed2.translation: It’s something I lifted from the floor.

sense_618d2dff4da439a8986fb2f0d48e3fb8.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_618d2dff4da439a8986fb2f0d48e3fb8.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_618d2dff4da439a8986fb2f0d48e3fb8.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_618d2dff4da439a8986fb2f0d48e3fb8.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_a073770b24e8145b0ce6515bf9daec13.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_a073770b24e8145b0ce6515bf9daec13.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_a073770b24e8145b0ce6515bf9daec13.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_a073770b24e8145b0ce6515bf9daec13.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_31a5e0d2cc1e4d93e7568f64ff61b876.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_84f57c420c3a99ab305f6753260e8371.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_84f57c420c3a99ab305f6753260e8371.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_84f57c420c3a99ab305f6753260e8371.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_84f57c420c3a99ab305f6753260e8371.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_3655106a1935935dfa66ff2c922479c2.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_3655106a1935935dfa66ff2c922479c2.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_3655106a1935935dfa66ff2c922479c2.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_3655106a1935935dfa66ff2c922479c2.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_c0812a9cc16d47259056a554ae320e3a.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_c0812a9cc16d47259056a554ae320e3a.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_c0812a9cc16d47259056a554ae320e3a.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_c0812a9cc16d47259056a554ae320e3a.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_8215b1e54ae3f1a2d3c18b4282ed9c58.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_8215b1e54ae3f1a2d3c18b4282ed9c58.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_8215b1e54ae3f1a2d3c18b4282ed9c58.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_8215b1e54ae3f1a2d3c18b4282ed9c58.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_8215b1e54ae3f1a2d3c18b4282ed9c58.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_8215b1e54ae3f1a2d3c18b4282ed9c58.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_9c957ba9b41345ff7738586a320cb672.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_9c957ba9b41345ff7738586a320cb672.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_9c957ba9b41345ff7738586a320cb672.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_fb827a1d308774e468a62adbdf60b07b.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_fb827a1d308774e468a62adbdf60b07b.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_fb827a1d308774e468a62adbdf60b07b.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_fb827a1d308774e468a62adbdf60b07b.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_d9fa9b0ea3eb7b1e4b3c562cee5a315c.text: Não me importo que você venha.
sense_d9fa9b0ea3eb7b1e4b3c562cee5a315c.translation: I don't care whether you come.

sense_ce7f91fd62ebcf40cfccef74f66de6c6.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_ce7f91fd62ebcf40cfccef74f66de6c6.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_4845c6a27ef7d21f57b1fe19c6b04817.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_4845c6a27ef7d21f57b1fe19c6b04817.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_4845c6a27ef7d21f57b1fe19c6b04817.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_4845c6a27ef7d21f57b1fe19c6b04817.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_2efc1b3a5d39004652729d9f0cc0575a.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_2efc1b3a5d39004652729d9f0cc0575a.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_2efc1b3a5d39004652729d9f0cc0575a.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_2efc1b3a5d39004652729d9f0cc0575a.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_eb257a00dac73b7f29fbffba759954fa.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_aff1649a3921368490bd436aa7c4423f.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_aff1649a3921368490bd436aa7c4423f.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_aff1649a3921368490bd436aa7c4423f.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_aff1649a3921368490bd436aa7c4423f.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_dcc95168fedfcb2ba0ef01d70afdf762.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_dcc95168fedfcb2ba0ef01d70afdf762.translation: They fought for the war to end.
