sense_fdca3ef5e2cf0b1eba39a8d03b23e724.text: […]e leuaram daly huũ tubaram que bertolameu dijz matou[…]
sense_fdca3ef5e2cf0b1eba39a8d03b23e724.translation: […] and they took from there a shark that Bartolomeu Dias killed […]

sense_fdca3ef5e2cf0b1eba39a8d03b23e724.text: Rodèa a Náo o Tubaráõ nas calmarias da Linha com os ſeos Pegadores ás coſtas, taõ cirzidos com a pelle, que mais parecem remẽdos, ou manchas naturaes, que os hoſpedes, ou companheiros.

sense_a0e8685d740f0cc99d3c58a6a515f7ac.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_a0e8685d740f0cc99d3c58a6a515f7ac.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_87d948fb8fda6bab45c2bd47c9be4c1b.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_87d948fb8fda6bab45c2bd47c9be4c1b.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_54463e52b0b6f97b4b826fe9f05630fc.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_54463e52b0b6f97b4b826fe9f05630fc.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_54463e52b0b6f97b4b826fe9f05630fc.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_54463e52b0b6f97b4b826fe9f05630fc.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_a81a40d48b781574452c5e4d40d93f5b.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_a81a40d48b781574452c5e4d40d93f5b.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_81e56091cd2cb06e7cd4f9d5254fb491.text: Esse papel de parede é um excelente pormenor.
sense_81e56091cd2cb06e7cd4f9d5254fb491.translation: That wallpaper is an excellent detail.

sense_b35fe2fd523b54a05362c6f1b0bf126a.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
sense_b35fe2fd523b54a05362c6f1b0bf126a.translation: I'm perfectly happy with the security I have …

sense_b35fe2fd523b54a05362c6f1b0bf126a.text: No portão de entrada está escrito "Entrance" em vez de "Entrada" e todas as ruas têm nomes em inglês, como "Flower Lane" e "Sunshine Street".
sense_b35fe2fd523b54a05362c6f1b0bf126a.translation: In the entrance gate, it's written “Entrance” instead of “Entrada” and all the streets have English names, such as “Flower Lane” and “Sunshine Street”.

sense_0331f771db17664398368ac04c10f21d.text: As palavras que dizes têm significado.
sense_0331f771db17664398368ac04c10f21d.translation: The words you say have meaning.

sense_0331f771db17664398368ac04c10f21d.text: Você deve ter cuidado com falsos amigos, do tipo "amigo-urso".
sense_0331f771db17664398368ac04c10f21d.translation: You must have caution with fake friends, the backstabbing kind.

sense_cb3ee6ba30a09fba13bc24318d3783f0.text: Eu o teria comprado, se tivesse dinheiro.
sense_cb3ee6ba30a09fba13bc24318d3783f0.translation: I would have bought it, if I had money.
I have been eating a lot of meat lately.

sense_cb3ee6ba30a09fba13bc24318d3783f0.text: Ninguém ia desconfiar dele com aquela cara de abestado. Até que era bom ter cara de abestado, nunca que fossem pensar que tinha sido ele.
sense_cb3ee6ba30a09fba13bc24318d3783f0.translation: No one was going to suspect him with that stupid face. It was even good to have a stupid face: they would never think it had been him.

sense_7695104f72c22a9355949654da114cee.text: Naquela manhã levantara-se ainda um pouco mais lânguido que do costume, porque passara mal a noite. A velha Isabel, que lhe ficava ao lado esquerdo, ouvindo-o suspirar com insistência, perguntou-lhe o que tinha.
sense_7695104f72c22a9355949654da114cee.translation: That morning he had gotten up a little more sluggish than usual, because he had been ill all night. The old woman Isabel, who was standing next to him on the left, heard him sighing insistently and asked him what he had.

sense_f94c8abdf7ec82febc956d18d1e59da3.text: O iRiver Spinn era um player de vídeo e áudio com estilo, do tamanho de um cartão de crédito, que tinha um display LCD de 3,3 polegadas.
sense_f94c8abdf7ec82febc956d18d1e59da3.translation: iRiver Spinn was a stylish video and audio player, the size of a credit card, that had a 3.3-inch LCD display.

sense_2489765a157e23a27bf9ed9355f20999.translation: Everyone considers John to be intelligent.

sense_0c81d8262f587a280293c305d0cdd8bc.text: Tem países em guerra naquela região.
sense_0c81d8262f587a280293c305d0cdd8bc.translation: There are countries at war in that region.

sense_0c81d8262f587a280293c305d0cdd8bc.text: Amanhã no seu enterro terá muitas flores!
sense_0c81d8262f587a280293c305d0cdd8bc.translation: Tomorrow at your funeral there will be many flowers!

sense_0c81d8262f587a280293c305d0cdd8bc.text: O mercado da esquina era nojento. Tinha gente de pé do lado de fora comendo manga e jogando os caroços no chão.
sense_0c81d8262f587a280293c305d0cdd8bc.translation: The corner market was disgusting. There were people standing outside eating mangoes and throwing their stones on the ground.

sense_ffeb1fb9d16dd1d3cdcf125023f7dc77.translation: This pen is ten centimeters long.

sense_3a96d106a220534828b7c924d4369ccd.translation: The cow will give birth to a calf.

sense_39dd9971502911eb23118ee43829e7b6.text: Não vale deixar o rei em xeque.
sense_39dd9971502911eb23118ee43829e7b6.translation: It is not permitted to leave the king under check.

sense_a0a1d78f9510439298bf9daed659c4e9.text: O ator valeu um prémio pelo seu desempenho.
sense_a0a1d78f9510439298bf9daed659c4e9.translation: The actor earned an award for his film.

sense_a0a1d78f9510439298bf9daed659c4e9.text: A guerra valeu críticas dos países da União Europeia.
sense_a0a1d78f9510439298bf9daed659c4e9.translation: The war drew criticism from the countries of the European Union.

sense_5329a928c8088bfcf45dda1ef3f09582.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_d78074ff4af36e1540ac5fefdcaafd80.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_d78074ff4af36e1540ac5fefdcaafd80.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_50ae64b2315d2efc74fcfb12a14f3b2c.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_50ae64b2315d2efc74fcfb12a14f3b2c.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_41c4100952e2c69611a16d10c45efe0c.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_41c4100952e2c69611a16d10c45efe0c.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_41c4100952e2c69611a16d10c45efe0c.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_41c4100952e2c69611a16d10c45efe0c.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_bb14a62624fb79f9ace1c99738381ab0.translation: I don't like that at all.

sense_22763e44695040c82cc6dff93c520cde.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_45dcd0bfa5ac3dbffbf5be19bef03f5d.translation: A book written with a pencil.
They bludgeoned the dog to death.

sense_2c0e7fac252657b796f7ea3027dfbe3b.text: O filme começa às duas horas.
sense_2c0e7fac252657b796f7ea3027dfbe3b.translation: The film starts at two o’clock.

sense_83340164387335f8eebc95c870a368ff.text: É mais barato comprar comida ao quilo.
sense_83340164387335f8eebc95c870a368ff.translation: It is cheaper to by food by the kilogram.

sense_e220be0d3a7004a85395ae8b7bf3bf79.text: A vila fica a onze milhas
sense_e220be0d3a7004a85395ae8b7bf3bf79.translation: The village is eleven miles away.

sense_e2b6eb83852d850212092d18c2a91d7f.translation: Let me show it to you...

sense_e2b6eb83852d850212092d18c2a91d7f.text: Não é bonito dizer isso a uma pessoa.
sense_e2b6eb83852d850212092d18c2a91d7f.translation: It's not nice to say that to a person.

sense_44b6df4d813b0932c219b377159eb65b.text: Ele puxou o temperamento ao pai.
sense_44b6df4d813b0932c219b377159eb65b.translation: He inherited his temperament from his father.

sense_1d688cb51efd7bdcc6d0c3eeecd4dee4.text: Infelizmente, um ladrão roubou-lhe o celular.
sense_1d688cb51efd7bdcc6d0c3eeecd4dee4.translation: Unfortunately, a robber stole her phone.

sense_2a6b3f852fe7df82507ff80f02cf2dfc.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_2a6b3f852fe7df82507ff80f02cf2dfc.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_abd27be48c506aba4dba0da29ff9efb7.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_abd27be48c506aba4dba0da29ff9efb7.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_abd27be48c506aba4dba0da29ff9efb7.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_abd27be48c506aba4dba0da29ff9efb7.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_508d403511e06c247af6c5c213814a54.translation: We laughed a lot at that film.

sense_1d0d09fe179ccfb60f7e30ac67f4b3b8.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_1d0d09fe179ccfb60f7e30ac67f4b3b8.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_1d0d09fe179ccfb60f7e30ac67f4b3b8.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_1d0d09fe179ccfb60f7e30ac67f4b3b8.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_95258b5e6bba6f3da3fe2b1ac63c1ff7.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_95258b5e6bba6f3da3fe2b1ac63c1ff7.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_ed806659d737ed71950b791636a3ed23.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_ed806659d737ed71950b791636a3ed23.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_f18e909503366bad0268ac5e789a7bad.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_f18e909503366bad0268ac5e789a7bad.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_acc11942ab755620a74d4a04e809a77c.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_acc11942ab755620a74d4a04e809a77c.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_9330a884d5bb76f2f33c0fa755db59be.translation: on the day before the exam

sense_6a63470f82a32cf3a904f94a4a05e141.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_6a63470f82a32cf3a904f94a4a05e141.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_6a63470f82a32cf3a904f94a4a05e141.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_0ea5afda903bc5a251c672e4af571f23.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_6574a62f9029ae56a62a42104774663a.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_6574a62f9029ae56a62a42104774663a.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_6574a62f9029ae56a62a42104774663a.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_6574a62f9029ae56a62a42104774663a.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_17a56d4028a04cca15c6584cde77cd72.text: As galinhas andam soltas pelo curral.
sense_17a56d4028a04cca15c6584cde77cd72.translation: The chickens roam free in the corral.

sense_c723c9c1f4de03ba0da90e515e14cd90.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_c723c9c1f4de03ba0da90e515e14cd90.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_c723c9c1f4de03ba0da90e515e14cd90.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_c723c9c1f4de03ba0da90e515e14cd90.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_063e9986621d739f5e7320c80ed5e482.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_063e9986621d739f5e7320c80ed5e482.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_c95d88820a5e5d238c6b3678e479ed58.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_0ccfa3f2b69c77f04e9bad4c4bb231a3.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_2bc8f6ea90d1625fd58bca98afb10c16.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_147a812d0b93d6dd1f1bb532e8d9c065.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_147a812d0b93d6dd1f1bb532e8d9c065.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_35ff83d702bd898bd111b8d062c89839.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_35ff83d702bd898bd111b8d062c89839.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_35ff83d702bd898bd111b8d062c89839.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_35ff83d702bd898bd111b8d062c89839.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_84efb53c300239314a65aa147a9da790.text: Acalme seus filhos, senão expulso vocês da loja.
sense_84efb53c300239314a65aa147a9da790.translation: Calm your children down or I will throw you out of the store.

sense_84efb53c300239314a65aa147a9da790.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_84efb53c300239314a65aa147a9da790.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_5476f4b9e27533fb1e78887ef91104eb.text: Depois da tempestade, o mar se acalmou.
sense_5476f4b9e27533fb1e78887ef91104eb.translation: After the storm, the sea calmed down.
The noise of the leaves calmed down.

sense_e7cdf39bf46279671228bfba8b8f0cf4.text: Apresentamos o novo produto ao mercado.
sense_e7cdf39bf46279671228bfba8b8f0cf4.translation: We presented the new product to the market.

sense_9226ebd031372e51214e53a7c706a0ab.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_1dec2755d33f5e92c27a90b8c8b576a9.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_11a60d3fedf943b638e2cc1800d39868.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_11a60d3fedf943b638e2cc1800d39868.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_321a980a43c743cdc37dd73b271bda31.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_baaaf7b29049d0249010e8653c886d20.text: Os bêbados começaram a se agarrar.
Um idiota queria se agarrar comigo.
sense_baaaf7b29049d0249010e8653c886d20.translation: Some idiot wanted to fight with me.

sense_4ed3c881d1550eefc9594d33d26595cb.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_4ed3c881d1550eefc9594d33d26595cb.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_65c831f539adde81df3a122dfdc46a34.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_65c831f539adde81df3a122dfdc46a34.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_65c831f539adde81df3a122dfdc46a34.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_65c831f539adde81df3a122dfdc46a34.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_46f945a5057109656cf0c5af11374fa7.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_46f945a5057109656cf0c5af11374fa7.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_46f945a5057109656cf0c5af11374fa7.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_46f945a5057109656cf0c5af11374fa7.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_fac92876b53dc889a9db2fabedf9196f.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_fac92876b53dc889a9db2fabedf9196f.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_12177c682b9268ba67a52e240da6dd23.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_12177c682b9268ba67a52e240da6dd23.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_9948ffddfd2616d62f0216e79ef5f8cc.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_9948ffddfd2616d62f0216e79ef5f8cc.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_08d8ad57b28007476b4dd0ad542595c4.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_08d8ad57b28007476b4dd0ad542595c4.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_08d8ad57b28007476b4dd0ad542595c4.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_08d8ad57b28007476b4dd0ad542595c4.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_d5922f65fef1bc4991f7fdd839f0bca4.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_0b15f8379a0754ea8750123520dd78d7.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_0b15f8379a0754ea8750123520dd78d7.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_0b15f8379a0754ea8750123520dd78d7.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_0b15f8379a0754ea8750123520dd78d7.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_0eef14a5a8f86fe7145deeaeeebe2509.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_0eef14a5a8f86fe7145deeaeeebe2509.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_0eef14a5a8f86fe7145deeaeeebe2509.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_0eef14a5a8f86fe7145deeaeeebe2509.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_af523f6eb940c783f9fa09cbdd480961.text: Aconteceu uma coisa bastante estranha ontem à noite.
sense_af523f6eb940c783f9fa09cbdd480961.translation: A very strange thing happened last night.

sense_af523f6eb940c783f9fa09cbdd480961.text: Comprei umas coisas com o salário desse mês.
sense_af523f6eb940c783f9fa09cbdd480961.translation: I bought some stuff with this month’s salary.

sense_864f0ea23a3e5f9fbc046754c6c3bb93.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_864f0ea23a3e5f9fbc046754c6c3bb93.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_864f0ea23a3e5f9fbc046754c6c3bb93.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_864f0ea23a3e5f9fbc046754c6c3bb93.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_fa1b1c710aca19f49a2f257315c9df2d.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_fa1b1c710aca19f49a2f257315c9df2d.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_fa1b1c710aca19f49a2f257315c9df2d.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_58e06708b42221fbad3a71fab053e8ed.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_58e06708b42221fbad3a71fab053e8ed.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_93ac29ace3b9ba3cbc3e123396567acb.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_93ac29ace3b9ba3cbc3e123396567acb.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_b5a2d6e7b4eaff49e6d13df62adbda2c.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_b5a2d6e7b4eaff49e6d13df62adbda2c.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_b5a2d6e7b4eaff49e6d13df62adbda2c.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_b5a2d6e7b4eaff49e6d13df62adbda2c.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_4cd9c924493d0b1b49aa4a769067a80c.text: Soltei um suspiro de extremo alivio, pois acabára de escrever o ultimo capitulo do meu livro.
sense_4cd9c924493d0b1b49aa4a769067a80c.translation: I sighed with extreme relief, for I had just finished writing the last chapter of my book.

sense_4cd9c924493d0b1b49aa4a769067a80c.text: Nesse longo periodo, tem elle recorrido a varios medicos, internando-se em hospitaes daqui e de Nietheroy, na esperança de encontrar allivio para os seus males;
sense_4cd9c924493d0b1b49aa4a769067a80c.translation: Throughout this long period, he has resorted to various doctors, hospitalizing himself in hospitals from here and Niterói, with the hope of finding relief of his ailments;

sense_ae429f9dbc51ef7034ce5816e548da5c.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_ae429f9dbc51ef7034ce5816e548da5c.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_ae429f9dbc51ef7034ce5816e548da5c.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_ae429f9dbc51ef7034ce5816e548da5c.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_c67167359289373c0dcb386bd71bdeed.text: Vocês estão cegos? A resposta é óbvia!
sense_c67167359289373c0dcb386bd71bdeed.translation: Are you guys blind? The answer is obvious!

sense_c6d6a239dd9bc0415f970857b3e23ff9.translation: I became blind in my left eye.

sense_3ae77bea0f2906308aaff9bd2cb3bb43.text: A conversa era sobre parentes, os parentes estranhos, interessantes ou, por qualquer razão, notáveis de cada um. Alguém já tinha contado que um parente comia favo de mel com abelha dentro.
sense_3ae77bea0f2906308aaff9bd2cb3bb43.translation: The conversation was about relatives, the weird, interesting or, for any reason, notable relatives of each one. Someone had already told that a relative eat honeycombs with the bees inside.

sense_3ae77bea0f2906308aaff9bd2cb3bb43.text: Essa história de “amigos certos para as horas incertas”, além de pai, mãe, filhos e irmãos, é muito difícil de acontecer. Até mesmo os parentes mais próximos não ajudam os necessitados muitas vezes.
sense_3ae77bea0f2906308aaff9bd2cb3bb43.translation: Such a thing as “right friends for uncertain times”, aside from [one's] father, mother, children and siblings, is very unlikely to happen. Even the closest relatives don't help the ones in need most of the times.

sense_a1d22d70e5d5077c3ae8ae1fdfd4f913.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_a1d22d70e5d5077c3ae8ae1fdfd4f913.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_a1d22d70e5d5077c3ae8ae1fdfd4f913.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_a1d22d70e5d5077c3ae8ae1fdfd4f913.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_3b30567d41df82233bf473374b0452f2.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_3b30567d41df82233bf473374b0452f2.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_296bda84689895450180cc2ce18a66a1.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_296bda84689895450180cc2ce18a66a1.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_6de60758c7ac3c05e6c21cee6e790a93.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_6de60758c7ac3c05e6c21cee6e790a93.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_356b6449320a1575c81d7e2323c15fc4.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_356b6449320a1575c81d7e2323c15fc4.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_356b6449320a1575c81d7e2323c15fc4.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_356b6449320a1575c81d7e2323c15fc4.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_f2954d0bf822ca347c714764608f219d.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_f2954d0bf822ca347c714764608f219d.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_673157828aa6ce1c9f4677100fba4978.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_673157828aa6ce1c9f4677100fba4978.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_673157828aa6ce1c9f4677100fba4978.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_673157828aa6ce1c9f4677100fba4978.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_673157828aa6ce1c9f4677100fba4978.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_673157828aa6ce1c9f4677100fba4978.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_06664c391b351d6f7394ee599fc21dd4.translation: We weren’t going to do anything.

sense_2d5ef9300150e73be6591d0a5a8346e2.text: O sinal verde ainda não foi!
sense_2d5ef9300150e73be6591d0a5a8346e2.translation: The green light still didn’t light up.

sense_5c387118e2bb872d3c5a41f2bdf46a66.translation: They went to the shopping centre.

sense_db7ad42bc1ffdda6a90a7ae8f392d885.text: Vai pela razão, não pelos sentimentos.
Se a luz não acender, pode encontrar o livro indo pelo tato.
sense_db7ad42bc1ffdda6a90a7ae8f392d885.translation: If the light doesn’t turn on, you can find the book by following your sense of touch.

sense_77266892e94744a20695f116bd96f584.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_77266892e94744a20695f116bd96f584.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_80e117ebe5feb0f0c245b0bf1fb2d096.text: A rua está cheia de trânsito.
sense_80e117ebe5feb0f0c245b0bf1fb2d096.translation: The street is full of traffic.

sense_d6937354a7220d4efcdd2038cb33d9f9.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_d6937354a7220d4efcdd2038cb33d9f9.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_d6937354a7220d4efcdd2038cb33d9f9.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_d6937354a7220d4efcdd2038cb33d9f9.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_b939306c1d308aadd3a70d90e18469d7.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_b939306c1d308aadd3a70d90e18469d7.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_b939306c1d308aadd3a70d90e18469d7.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_b939306c1d308aadd3a70d90e18469d7.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_f40497a3c0a65e77c108339ed7b43252.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_f40497a3c0a65e77c108339ed7b43252.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_9947b6e7233babdf663186f41c5bf78f.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_9947b6e7233babdf663186f41c5bf78f.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_9947b6e7233babdf663186f41c5bf78f.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_9947b6e7233babdf663186f41c5bf78f.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_ccc21d76892f336ba6bc55e7daaa97ff.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_ccc21d76892f336ba6bc55e7daaa97ff.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_ccc21d76892f336ba6bc55e7daaa97ff.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_ccc21d76892f336ba6bc55e7daaa97ff.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_756063e1fae0f269b164749cc08106d0.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_756063e1fae0f269b164749cc08106d0.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_756063e1fae0f269b164749cc08106d0.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_756063e1fae0f269b164749cc08106d0.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_16cf983f593acb5cfb1fec705437855a.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_16cf983f593acb5cfb1fec705437855a.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_f9e83eaaa21b8ae7e81758597a8d96d8.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_f9e83eaaa21b8ae7e81758597a8d96d8.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_f9e83eaaa21b8ae7e81758597a8d96d8.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_f9e83eaaa21b8ae7e81758597a8d96d8.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_47d52f43360f1e4333895ab51f1d6508.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_47d52f43360f1e4333895ab51f1d6508.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_47d52f43360f1e4333895ab51f1d6508.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_a9f19b7ed1283cfc2316dc41dfa6c655.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_5a898e6f0a757e125fda213be61e77a2.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_5a898e6f0a757e125fda213be61e77a2.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_cd16b74e610b3e83c86aafd90428ec0f.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_cd16b74e610b3e83c86aafd90428ec0f.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_cd16b74e610b3e83c86aafd90428ec0f.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_cd16b74e610b3e83c86aafd90428ec0f.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_e8dea094d1f57e89fb5ad1a9baee0871.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_e8dea094d1f57e89fb5ad1a9baee0871.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_e8dea094d1f57e89fb5ad1a9baee0871.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_e8dea094d1f57e89fb5ad1a9baee0871.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_ce92ac51a7d69f9488be60f318c7ce19.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_ce92ac51a7d69f9488be60f318c7ce19.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_ce92ac51a7d69f9488be60f318c7ce19.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_ce92ac51a7d69f9488be60f318c7ce19.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_605454372300fd99bf10be9e8dbc2ce7.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_605454372300fd99bf10be9e8dbc2ce7.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_605454372300fd99bf10be9e8dbc2ce7.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_605454372300fd99bf10be9e8dbc2ce7.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_605454372300fd99bf10be9e8dbc2ce7.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_605454372300fd99bf10be9e8dbc2ce7.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_8da45e5f9825953c54f5861f6d584fbc.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_8da45e5f9825953c54f5861f6d584fbc.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_8da45e5f9825953c54f5861f6d584fbc.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_8da45e5f9825953c54f5861f6d584fbc.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_f1b37244a1d892d50cb9cff772d9aec6.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_9cf1e2f9322162756eff5571391e60ff.translation: If you want to win, you must behave as a champion.

sense_9cf1e2f9322162756eff5571391e60ff.translation: Indeed, he was behaving very badly.

sense_9693e04b85c4176862d90523b5796b59.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_25d0b50639e9d804d9533df16238569e.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_957bff144692253dfd57e6e80833acb9.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_dfb1c2d405648a64dd02390705533e3f.translation: Stop being foolish and start thinking.

sense_dfb1c2d405648a64dd02390705533e3f.text: Infelizmente, o que fizemos foi extremamente tolo.

sense_60482be6a8c23db235ba571b106acd69.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_60482be6a8c23db235ba571b106acd69.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.

sense_bda5761b738b4b447c8c84103af270e2.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_7cc534c02830ab1aa7d121997056afdd.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_7cc534c02830ab1aa7d121997056afdd.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.

sense_62428332ac670e620a8f07bcfa2ecac1.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_a4e7af44b7de0705398c30792d17c746.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_c3739a64381dec5b0035f448961d8d94.text: Puz-me a tremer com violencia e a bater os dentes. Percebi que aquella attitude me condemnava e esforcei-me por cerrar os queixos e dominar os musculos, o que não consegui.

sense_f16f1911e1eca37c47815c9ce92fca2f.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_64d42857f784b52a759372e6772c0f4c.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_64d42857f784b52a759372e6772c0f4c.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_64d42857f784b52a759372e6772c0f4c.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_64d42857f784b52a759372e6772c0f4c.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_4dcd87a650601a5a0daad8404e31265a.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_4dcd87a650601a5a0daad8404e31265a.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_5ee410ddd0bb5a856832ae9c4e8ac412.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_5ee410ddd0bb5a856832ae9c4e8ac412.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_5ee410ddd0bb5a856832ae9c4e8ac412.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_5ee410ddd0bb5a856832ae9c4e8ac412.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_6f7d6281ce62fe7cc1484f800fa947ee.text: Estava andando quando notei uma moeda no chão.
sense_6f7d6281ce62fe7cc1484f800fa947ee.translation: I was walking when I noticed a coin on the floor.

sense_6f7d6281ce62fe7cc1484f800fa947ee.text: Notem que a porta está fechada.
sense_6f7d6281ce62fe7cc1484f800fa947ee.translation: Notice that the door is closed.

sense_6f7d6281ce62fe7cc1484f800fa947ee.text: Ela não foi a única a notar.
sense_6f7d6281ce62fe7cc1484f800fa947ee.translation: She was not the only one to notice.

sense_85baa05c5f77f3afc2fb7cbdf50f6800.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_85baa05c5f77f3afc2fb7cbdf50f6800.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_85baa05c5f77f3afc2fb7cbdf50f6800.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_85baa05c5f77f3afc2fb7cbdf50f6800.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_79dfe9c1f18385e6b1a6948ee05105d8.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_79dfe9c1f18385e6b1a6948ee05105d8.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_79dfe9c1f18385e6b1a6948ee05105d8.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_79dfe9c1f18385e6b1a6948ee05105d8.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_8ab53c8f7ab49ed1fd849630e3f483cd.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_8ab53c8f7ab49ed1fd849630e3f483cd.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_8ab53c8f7ab49ed1fd849630e3f483cd.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_8ab53c8f7ab49ed1fd849630e3f483cd.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_3bbf8e30736d963c616cf5f7e4a0cf8b.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_4f4c1b779960c1b07e99264f47c8bc58.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_c2d118de54fc819cff68348a3a01d9ec.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_75835e807e334e71db26257d91c84569.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_75835e807e334e71db26257d91c84569.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_75835e807e334e71db26257d91c84569.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_75835e807e334e71db26257d91c84569.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_75835e807e334e71db26257d91c84569.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_fa7f670ec3ed15ea47c71c3dacae9bae.translation: New clothes may cause a good impression.

sense_00447d041bb4bcd7bd49d831c9a69ad5.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_5f04a4e4efd14cf1b248e194d3ffb488.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_5f04a4e4efd14cf1b248e194d3ffb488.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_f3da6f1c10bd555b57b5e1120a8006e1.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_12e6959c009477c3e674255b0fb825a2.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_12e6959c009477c3e674255b0fb825a2.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_111e01b4cf4e4cddaf6262a40c391825.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_111e01b4cf4e4cddaf6262a40c391825.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_111e01b4cf4e4cddaf6262a40c391825.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_287088a52ea130ab3dbca80b17b5a810.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_53a07c67f850e53e688bd772cceb11b6.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_53a07c67f850e53e688bd772cceb11b6.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_8006ca9d15eb88e8b65697c28f21cae6.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_b1aa21db60bd9ebf05d774e4a1990548.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_edf13ca8cf39cbb8a06d2aaa1c1b1681.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_edf13ca8cf39cbb8a06d2aaa1c1b1681.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_8508c12b819439ecca835798af1d1862.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_8508c12b819439ecca835798af1d1862.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_8508c12b819439ecca835798af1d1862.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_8508c12b819439ecca835798af1d1862.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_3ed4171a6588c3b3fd405aff68e92a86.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_3ed4171a6588c3b3fd405aff68e92a86.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_3ed4171a6588c3b3fd405aff68e92a86.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_3ed4171a6588c3b3fd405aff68e92a86.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_63748647c4505c8a46178f89c3f7505a.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_63748647c4505c8a46178f89c3f7505a.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_63748647c4505c8a46178f89c3f7505a.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_63748647c4505c8a46178f89c3f7505a.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_12e867a37c27b9a65920b875d3b4a99d.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_12e867a37c27b9a65920b875d3b4a99d.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_8053c554f282b321073735083c158501.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_8053c554f282b321073735083c158501.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_8053c554f282b321073735083c158501.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_8053c554f282b321073735083c158501.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_63c39090e85e6447cfc65febc937cb94.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_63c39090e85e6447cfc65febc937cb94.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_63c39090e85e6447cfc65febc937cb94.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_63c39090e85e6447cfc65febc937cb94.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_4e90c816bd58a0b218779e21227cc732.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_4e90c816bd58a0b218779e21227cc732.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_eecc61711881c64b0a187ba5392c7a4e.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_eecc61711881c64b0a187ba5392c7a4e.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_dc8cb852040ad54c1de5f3286365af46.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_dc8cb852040ad54c1de5f3286365af46.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_111b373cc1e4acc579b09c57c726e103.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_111b373cc1e4acc579b09c57c726e103.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_111b373cc1e4acc579b09c57c726e103.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_d312cf60c1e61c53761fdb1808343b0d.text: A chuva de granizo que deu ontem estragou a porcaria do telhado.
sense_d312cf60c1e61c53761fdb1808343b0d.translation: Yesterday's hailstorm destroyed the damn roof.

sense_5f66b50691dd10dff7c858c7a1cb2cd3.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_5f66b50691dd10dff7c858c7a1cb2cd3.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_5f66b50691dd10dff7c858c7a1cb2cd3.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_5f66b50691dd10dff7c858c7a1cb2cd3.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_5f66b50691dd10dff7c858c7a1cb2cd3.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_5f66b50691dd10dff7c858c7a1cb2cd3.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_f1250df64ac8c3e05bb9f92f2e619f29.text: Perseverança é a melhor amiga do conhecimento.

sense_4093963e4aa5b9267dfbdfcd2f2922cc.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_9e724dd45aaaf49621fd3dd5247b77fa.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_993dfde920c04726c7e815d8872f164c.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_bc1418d0742a9edda18c7e59f5819961.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_37557dd51cb512ad561b99861310991a.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_37557dd51cb512ad561b99861310991a.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_8fd3598178eabdccf1ff2926cd0bc6be.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_8fd3598178eabdccf1ff2926cd0bc6be.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_a46fd35ccc17524ff0747ea1d67d8d8f.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_a46fd35ccc17524ff0747ea1d67d8d8f.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_8b336e6c757db8a20c73e5903c166eba.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_c435a4b80e19a2a294a2703156cab5a7.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_c435a4b80e19a2a294a2703156cab5a7.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_f7fdb57bb59d805d023f2e42a5275237.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_f7fdb57bb59d805d023f2e42a5275237.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_d045081eebdb6aef3494fa1a1fdefcc4.text: Não me importo que você venha.
sense_d045081eebdb6aef3494fa1a1fdefcc4.translation: I don't care whether you come.

sense_b48393a790059d6afad8ab00b22843fb.text: Olha que a cidade toda ficou vazia nessa tarde bonita pra te ver jogar.
sense_b48393a790059d6afad8ab00b22843fb.translation: Look how the whole city emptied out on this beautiful afternoon to watch you play

sense_b48393a790059d6afad8ab00b22843fb.text: Ó sino da minha aldeia, / Dolente na tarde calma, / Cada tua badalada / Soa dentro da minha alma.
sense_b48393a790059d6afad8ab00b22843fb.translation: Oh bell of my village, / Lazy in this peaceful afternoon, / Each one of your tollings / Resounds in my soul.

sense_b42ac701bef16825bb6e3a477b9e487e.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_b42ac701bef16825bb6e3a477b9e487e.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_b42ac701bef16825bb6e3a477b9e487e.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_b42ac701bef16825bb6e3a477b9e487e.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_786c5f9ea066ab76077fb3fb95f212ee.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_05cdffb2dad6b249df192ca8ae3a3514.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_90fcea5925da5f8131f49e72b2f79d27.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_c13b9e9089dc7ab58883c9a9176aec85.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_c13b9e9089dc7ab58883c9a9176aec85.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_a2859d63bd8f71be59265bc0fe739c17.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_a2859d63bd8f71be59265bc0fe739c17.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_ea5058dea0b82f4f383ee702f644ebf7.text: Minha perna doía tanto que eu não conseguia andar.
sense_ea5058dea0b82f4f383ee702f644ebf7.translation: My leg was hurting so much that I couldn’t walk.

sense_e07712e20f227d7238ff558f62ab6614.translation: The thieves cleaned out the house.

sense_295d273240b0e504af2b1649dc441906.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_295d273240b0e504af2b1649dc441906.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_21f3efede87501c053991443436b6fa4.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_21f3efede87501c053991443436b6fa4.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_21f3efede87501c053991443436b6fa4.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_21f3efede87501c053991443436b6fa4.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_937541c5915f5545ec9aa36a65d3b1ec.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_937541c5915f5545ec9aa36a65d3b1ec.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_8fbba2063428bba89a0efd819046456a.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_8fbba2063428bba89a0efd819046456a.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_ae5b4515bcda92b108811407940fb655.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_ae5b4515bcda92b108811407940fb655.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_ae5b4515bcda92b108811407940fb655.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_ae5b4515bcda92b108811407940fb655.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_831949d3ae8dca4c90714a53ff48cf4b.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_831949d3ae8dca4c90714a53ff48cf4b.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_dadcf54a7eab060c137c75c5109f4c5b.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_dadcf54a7eab060c137c75c5109f4c5b.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_378ffe35e15b3427acfa4413ba538684.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_378ffe35e15b3427acfa4413ba538684.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_18b5d6e855da541ac1e008874b7606d0.text: Fui figurante naquele filme, com um papel de jurada.
sense_18b5d6e855da541ac1e008874b7606d0.translation: I was an extra in that film, with a jurywoman role.

sense_18b5d6e855da541ac1e008874b7606d0.text: Pois então o que decidiram os jurados?
sense_18b5d6e855da541ac1e008874b7606d0.translation: So what have the jurors decided?

sense_18b5d6e855da541ac1e008874b7606d0.text: Um dos jurados, certamente o que votára pela negativa,—proferiu algumas palavras de defeza do moço.
sense_18b5d6e855da541ac1e008874b7606d0.translation: One of the jurymen—certainly the one who had voted not guilty—uttered some words in defence of the young man.

sense_2451b56bb168fa2896d916f81fdf6060.text: Todos os jurados lhe deram nota 10.
sense_2451b56bb168fa2896d916f81fdf6060.translation: All the judges scored him/her a 10.

sense_2451b56bb168fa2896d916f81fdf6060.text: Ele já foi jurado de muitos programas de TV desde os anos 80.
sense_2451b56bb168fa2896d916f81fdf6060.translation: He has been a judge in many TV shows since the 80s.

sense_39a5f91d909f31bec6fb5ad4a664eda1.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_39a5f91d909f31bec6fb5ad4a664eda1.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_39a5f91d909f31bec6fb5ad4a664eda1.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_39a5f91d909f31bec6fb5ad4a664eda1.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_cc612cd926d129c456e5323c7ee2ebfc.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_cc612cd926d129c456e5323c7ee2ebfc.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_cc612cd926d129c456e5323c7ee2ebfc.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_cc612cd926d129c456e5323c7ee2ebfc.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_e4820bfd46362aa25da912f8745617d9.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_e4820bfd46362aa25da912f8745617d9.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_ef8d85877a31096720690c7a96e29547.text: A chuva de granizo que deu ontem estragou a porcaria do telhado.
sense_ef8d85877a31096720690c7a96e29547.translation: Yesterday's hailstorm destroyed the damn roof.

sense_2291f57475e24098b927b192f1737895.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_5ecf20431531fff588a0b6b221e6ce59.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_5ecf20431531fff588a0b6b221e6ce59.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_5ecf20431531fff588a0b6b221e6ce59.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_5ecf20431531fff588a0b6b221e6ce59.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_ecb68ff248a162768ab06388e37e19fe.text: Onde é que você estava, hein?

sense_1748bf4b0db90f3ba9a8b773233411a1.text: Essa ponte não me parece muito segura.
sense_1748bf4b0db90f3ba9a8b773233411a1.translation: This bridge doesn’t look very safe.

sense_1748bf4b0db90f3ba9a8b773233411a1.text: Não te preocupes, voar é seguro.

sense_0cd7c7f65a2af9aa45f55fa6931faf04.text: Os bêbados começaram a se agarrar.
Um idiota queria se agarrar comigo.
sense_0cd7c7f65a2af9aa45f55fa6931faf04.translation: Some idiot wanted to fight with me.

sense_c3606e734eccd667df766830db3dbfb3.text: Desconectar o computador direto da tomada sem desligá-lo antes pode queimá-lo.
sense_c3606e734eccd667df766830db3dbfb3.translation: Unplugging the computer directly without turning it off first may break it.

sense_1f1a43dd9480c0dfa09218723e2cf707.text: Não apareceu um cristão para me ajudar.
sense_1f1a43dd9480c0dfa09218723e2cf707.translation: Not one soul showed up to help me.
It was enough to make a soul go crazy.

sense_5718a4cd98930ee4bb828f4f558aed3d.text: Estava andando quando notei uma moeda no chão.
sense_5718a4cd98930ee4bb828f4f558aed3d.translation: I was walking when I noticed a coin on the floor.

sense_5718a4cd98930ee4bb828f4f558aed3d.text: Notem que a porta está fechada.
sense_5718a4cd98930ee4bb828f4f558aed3d.translation: Notice that the door is closed.

sense_5718a4cd98930ee4bb828f4f558aed3d.text: Ela não foi a única a notar.
sense_5718a4cd98930ee4bb828f4f558aed3d.translation: She was not the only one to notice.

sense_d4b8a798fdf34ecf68ed0eb63fffed6c.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_d4b8a798fdf34ecf68ed0eb63fffed6c.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_0c48709824084e9cf382071a8bcf19c4.text: O réu abandonou-se/se abandonou nas mãos do advogado.
sense_0c48709824084e9cf382071a8bcf19c4.translation: The accused put himself in his lawyer’s hands.
We let ourselves be seized by sadness.

sense_c3fed43d3b663d95f89747c6f2725459.text: O exército teve de abandonar o forte.
sense_c3fed43d3b663d95f89747c6f2725459.translation: The army had to abandon the fort.

sense_c3fed43d3b663d95f89747c6f2725459.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_c3fed43d3b663d95f89747c6f2725459.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_0bfe2ca18560114b7377cce393736c9b.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_0bfe2ca18560114b7377cce393736c9b.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_b8f39a1f1f8115805c59fed245bc44bc.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_b8f39a1f1f8115805c59fed245bc44bc.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_b8f39a1f1f8115805c59fed245bc44bc.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_b8f39a1f1f8115805c59fed245bc44bc.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_fd88b7cd4ce235e403e800dcc3bde32f.text: Eu já havia entrado quando chegaste.
sense_fd88b7cd4ce235e403e800dcc3bde32f.translation: I had already gotten in when you arrived.

sense_fd88b7cd4ce235e403e800dcc3bde32f.text: Hei estudado muito, nos últimos dias.
sense_fd88b7cd4ce235e403e800dcc3bde32f.translation: I have been studying much, in these last days.

sense_153d664307dab234ec0400fc7e1bd9b9.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_153d664307dab234ec0400fc7e1bd9b9.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_153d664307dab234ec0400fc7e1bd9b9.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_153d664307dab234ec0400fc7e1bd9b9.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_153d664307dab234ec0400fc7e1bd9b9.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_153d664307dab234ec0400fc7e1bd9b9.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_3ec244bf652b26039949943c76f3fa74.text: […] o empurrou tão rijo que deu com elle da eſcotilha abaixo […]
sense_3ec244bf652b26039949943c76f3fa74.translation: […] he pushed him so roughly that he sent him down the hatch […]

sense_3ec244bf652b26039949943c76f3fa74.text: Ele se aproximou e experimentou empurrá-la.
sense_3ec244bf652b26039949943c76f3fa74.translation: He came closer and tried to push it.

sense_ec5626bd12732ed36820c8a954ca68b3.text: O vendedor ficou me empurrando essa caixinha de som, e acabou que eu voltei com três.
sense_ec5626bd12732ed36820c8a954ca68b3.translation: The salesman kept pushing these speakers to me, and I ended up coming home with three.

sense_ec5626bd12732ed36820c8a954ca68b3.text: Mas ſobreveyo Perdiccas amigo de Agathocles, & empurrando hũa mentira com outra o tirou a ſalvo […]
sense_ec5626bd12732ed36820c8a954ca68b3.translation: But Perdiccas, friend of Agathocles, appeared and, pushing one lie after the other, got him out safely […]

sense_cf1653d82980fb1b01e59a69229384d2.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_cf1653d82980fb1b01e59a69229384d2.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_475fcd1b8ded16f1043e40aeaeb7741a.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_475fcd1b8ded16f1043e40aeaeb7741a.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_710287e99c099b50b36d8f500e47d9b3.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_710287e99c099b50b36d8f500e47d9b3.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_710287e99c099b50b36d8f500e47d9b3.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_710287e99c099b50b36d8f500e47d9b3.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_710287e99c099b50b36d8f500e47d9b3.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_710287e99c099b50b36d8f500e47d9b3.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_570bfcf5bf96077adeadfa9505eb1d58.text: "Podia chamar um rancho folclórico, mas assim poderia estar a ofender os ranchos folclóricos. Acho que é mais rebaldaria ou bagunça (...)"
sense_570bfcf5bf96077adeadfa9505eb1d58.translation: “I could call it a folkloric ranch, but then I could be offending the folkloric ranches. I think it's more of a pandemonium or a mess (...)”

sense_570bfcf5bf96077adeadfa9505eb1d58.text: A bagunça é total e isto só lá vai quando, por via de lei, os clubes deixarem de ser os (não) “reguladores” de si próprios.
sense_570bfcf5bf96077adeadfa9505eb1d58.translation: It's a total mess and it won't stop being one until, by law, the clubs stop being the (non-)“regulators” of themselves.

sense_4cd396de1d6675b85f3e4b35b1a9837d.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_4cd396de1d6675b85f3e4b35b1a9837d.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_4cd396de1d6675b85f3e4b35b1a9837d.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_4cd396de1d6675b85f3e4b35b1a9837d.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_910cd963a27aa3a1d23c6ec8ffdde149.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_910cd963a27aa3a1d23c6ec8ffdde149.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_910cd963a27aa3a1d23c6ec8ffdde149.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_910cd963a27aa3a1d23c6ec8ffdde149.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_70a17e985229b35d1c7d6084b358c15e.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_70a17e985229b35d1c7d6084b358c15e.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_70a17e985229b35d1c7d6084b358c15e.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_70a17e985229b35d1c7d6084b358c15e.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_dd682bcc7c3ce9b6c0116ae63c65c498.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_dd682bcc7c3ce9b6c0116ae63c65c498.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_2dbd5dfb83247daff74aa11c01b27d0d.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_f91355f59d9e3a41da28663bfe8bcf9a.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_f91355f59d9e3a41da28663bfe8bcf9a.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_f91355f59d9e3a41da28663bfe8bcf9a.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_f91355f59d9e3a41da28663bfe8bcf9a.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_9ce60f2826295efeb0355ff51a212cbc.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_9ce60f2826295efeb0355ff51a212cbc.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_18cd6b198d5731c9821da9da3e5bd03a.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_18cd6b198d5731c9821da9da3e5bd03a.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_18cd6b198d5731c9821da9da3e5bd03a.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_18cd6b198d5731c9821da9da3e5bd03a.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_85a25f9f13afd38f668a01ed33f2e2bb.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_85a25f9f13afd38f668a01ed33f2e2bb.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_85a25f9f13afd38f668a01ed33f2e2bb.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_85a25f9f13afd38f668a01ed33f2e2bb.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_5050b16b59186fc454394a7b1c9b5774.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_5050b16b59186fc454394a7b1c9b5774.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_5050b16b59186fc454394a7b1c9b5774.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_5050b16b59186fc454394a7b1c9b5774.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_979b01337990a80619f173646d4ce781.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_979b01337990a80619f173646d4ce781.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_979b01337990a80619f173646d4ce781.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_979b01337990a80619f173646d4ce781.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_979b01337990a80619f173646d4ce781.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_979b01337990a80619f173646d4ce781.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_3a80bb69e0233643e2bd5ed14582ea17.text: Ei, neguin, tu foi pra festa ontem?
sense_3a80bb69e0233643e2bd5ed14582ea17.translation: Hey, my nigga, did you go to the party yesterday?

sense_31d1dcbe5eddc0decd55f0f5ce8cabee.text: Chegamos a casa, pois agora troquemo-nos.
sense_31d1dcbe5eddc0decd55f0f5ce8cabee.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_5a984a3734825c328c8264302f9f0742.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.
sense_5a984a3734825c328c8264302f9f0742.translation: I want to replace my car with a new one.
We have to replace the burnt-out lightbulbs.

sense_98ffde4ab8a3e74845195ca1f216b180.text: Troco um par de sapatos por uma blusa.
sense_98ffde4ab8a3e74845195ca1f216b180.translation: I’ll exchange a pair of shoes for a blouse.

sense_98ffde4ab8a3e74845195ca1f216b180.text: Eu e o meu primo trocamos livros.
sense_98ffde4ab8a3e74845195ca1f216b180.translation: My cousin and I traded books.

sense_98ffde4ab8a3e74845195ca1f216b180.text: O explorador trocou presentes com os nativos.
sense_98ffde4ab8a3e74845195ca1f216b180.translation: The explorer exchanged gifts with the natives.

sense_d715796aaff5fe8e67296d06a299544e.text: Os boxeadores estão trocando socos na cabeça.
sense_d715796aaff5fe8e67296d06a299544e.translation: The boxers are exchanging blows to their heads.

sense_d715796aaff5fe8e67296d06a299544e.text: Todo dia eu trocava umas ideias com o vizinho.
sense_d715796aaff5fe8e67296d06a299544e.translation: I used to chat with the neighbor every single day.

sense_1bf16544fddbaf3f05dd64dbfb1764e0.text: Gostava de ter um carro castanho.
sense_1bf16544fddbaf3f05dd64dbfb1764e0.translation: I would like to have a brown car.

sense_d5818210ed84ce109c0476eacd45d9c9.text: Roupas novas podem causar uma boa impressão.
sense_d5818210ed84ce109c0476eacd45d9c9.translation: New clothes may cause a good impression.

sense_b1a599c179db63c46646c5fefd137402.text: Um bocado de pessoas viu aquilo.
sense_b1a599c179db63c46646c5fefd137402.translation: A lot of people saw that.
I waited for a lot of time.

sense_616a8a3584151e4a85c7e53313970c66.text: Não vai se desculpar por ter pisado no meu pé?
sense_616a8a3584151e4a85c7e53313970c66.translation: Aren't you gonna apologize for stepping on my foot?

sense_616a8a3584151e4a85c7e53313970c66.text: Depois que o primeiro homem / Maravilhosamente pisou na lua / Eu me senti com direitos, com princípios / E dignidade / De me libertar
sense_616a8a3584151e4a85c7e53313970c66.translation: After the first man / Wonderfully stepped on the moon / I felt I had rights, principles / And dignity / To liberate myself

sense_9fc47bb4eec7c33ee1fc6678e877a841.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_9fc47bb4eec7c33ee1fc6678e877a841.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_9fc47bb4eec7c33ee1fc6678e877a841.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_9fc47bb4eec7c33ee1fc6678e877a841.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_41c62d1e897723d469aa3057dd7fcb42.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_41c62d1e897723d469aa3057dd7fcb42.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_ef92817d49b90fc786b2f7f6b5383560.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_ef92817d49b90fc786b2f7f6b5383560.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_df020f6f8981f1ffd52f73047392837f.text: No ano passado li três livros.
sense_df020f6f8981f1ffd52f73047392837f.translation: I read three books in the previous year.
I read three books last year.

sense_a0e9bf63c669ded04dab2c2cab70c575.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_a0e9bf63c669ded04dab2c2cab70c575.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_ca7a24e896a1440d39ab1c4e08d95d39.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_ca7a24e896a1440d39ab1c4e08d95d39.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_a5d88146eb06c24c8a8cf6940e5dcc95.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_a5d88146eb06c24c8a8cf6940e5dcc95.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_a5d88146eb06c24c8a8cf6940e5dcc95.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_a5d88146eb06c24c8a8cf6940e5dcc95.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_cae5cd0cca7bbb385666b01746aa631c.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_cae5cd0cca7bbb385666b01746aa631c.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_cae5cd0cca7bbb385666b01746aa631c.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_cae5cd0cca7bbb385666b01746aa631c.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_5f22201c6b193703f1f59d0dd667a4e6.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_5f22201c6b193703f1f59d0dd667a4e6.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_01e277973f4e6cfa5f7dbb2e591c6a8a.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_01e277973f4e6cfa5f7dbb2e591c6a8a.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_ec7aacd28065bfea0d39954456858b78.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_ec7aacd28065bfea0d39954456858b78.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_336f023a2a64a7a68e54a79cd35e6aef.translation: We need to win the competition.
It is not important to win.

sense_82e0bc2144e71efa82f527ea8cb6825f.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_82e0bc2144e71efa82f527ea8cb6825f.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_34ad265a39ee2c42716160a87ab985ce.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_34ad265a39ee2c42716160a87ab985ce.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_34ad265a39ee2c42716160a87ab985ce.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_34ad265a39ee2c42716160a87ab985ce.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.text: É um pássaro? Um avião? Não, é o Super-Homem... Não, mas também não é o Super-Homem!
sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.translation: It is a bird? An airplane? No, it's Superman... No, but it's not Superman either!

sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.text: O SUPER HOMEM! Defensor dos oprimidos, a maravilha fisica que havia jurado devotar sua existencia em auxiliar os necessitados.
sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.translation: SUPERMAN! Defender of the oppressed, the physical wonder who had sworn to devote his existence to helping those in need.

sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.text: Moço, venha me ajudar / Seja você o Super-Homem / Kit Carson ou até mesmo Búfalo Bill
sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.translation: Boy, come help me / Be you Superman / Kit Carson or even Buffalo Bill

sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.text: Henry Cavill anunciou na noite desta quarta-feira, 14, que não voltará a interpretar o Super-Homem no próximo filme do herói da DC.
sense_a5d9af35873a08b6ef8519287a44b792.translation: Henry Cavill announced on Wednesday night, the 14th, that he will not return to play Superman in the DC hero's next film.

sense_608a479867b3fe6e4bdc08ebc1e12cd4.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_608a479867b3fe6e4bdc08ebc1e12cd4.translation: Then the smile reappeared in his face …

sense_608a479867b3fe6e4bdc08ebc1e12cd4.text: Era difícil dizer se a professora os ouvira, pois seu rosto estava oculto pelas sombras.
sense_608a479867b3fe6e4bdc08ebc1e12cd4.translation: It was difficult to tell whether the teacher had heard them, because her face was hidden by the shadows.

sense_259ac01c3aa860330589bccc6e9696f2.text: Aplique xampu no seu cabelo até que ele fique macio.
sense_259ac01c3aa860330589bccc6e9696f2.translation: Apply shampoo onto your hair until it gets soft.

sense_259ac01c3aa860330589bccc6e9696f2.text: Se bem que as crianças não possam fazer uso dos mesmos preparados que os adultos contra as rachaduras da pelle, não quer dizer que não se deva applicar outros apropriados.
sense_259ac01c3aa860330589bccc6e9696f2.translation: Although children cannot make use of the same preparations as adults against cracked skin, this does not mean one should not apply other appropriate ones.

sense_cd0490e03675cab7055763386888b98e.text: Tudo se passou em pleno dia.
sense_cd0490e03675cab7055763386888b98e.translation: It all happened in broad daylight.
In the middle of Rua da Bainharia.

sense_c7efea03c6245ebdc774303d3f523abd.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_c7efea03c6245ebdc774303d3f523abd.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_c7efea03c6245ebdc774303d3f523abd.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_f233f6d72f743b235593176f884b3046.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_2ba389f9eebacca3ea9d5c591b7745d7.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_2ba389f9eebacca3ea9d5c591b7745d7.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_137f52585e07f3f059b555f599d23079.text: Este é um documentário sério sobre os romanos.
sense_137f52585e07f3f059b555f599d23079.translation: This is a serious documentary about the Romans.

sense_8e92c57153f038c02cb3cb112e5545ae.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_8e92c57153f038c02cb3cb112e5545ae.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_8e92c57153f038c02cb3cb112e5545ae.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_8e92c57153f038c02cb3cb112e5545ae.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_ed671923844c7354f6049582ba19dcb1.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_ed671923844c7354f6049582ba19dcb1.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_83835c59d67f8b6662ecdf48b1f1b37e.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_83835c59d67f8b6662ecdf48b1f1b37e.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_0f1f643774c5c0438a654e5efd2d0fad.text: Não apareceu um cristão para me ajudar.
sense_0f1f643774c5c0438a654e5efd2d0fad.translation: Not one soul showed up to help me.
It was enough to make a soul go crazy.

sense_d803c476d3685ab614742010803b4338.text: O rei comanda seu reino com excelência.
sense_d803c476d3685ab614742010803b4338.translation: The king commands his kingdom with excellence.

sense_d803c476d3685ab614742010803b4338.text: João comandava um batalhão da aeronática.
sense_d803c476d3685ab614742010803b4338.translation: John used to command an airforce batallion.

sense_8a2ff2fdd5a37a63330248f17445af4f.text: Peixe e vinho tinto não combinam.
sense_8a2ff2fdd5a37a63330248f17445af4f.translation: Fish and red wine don't go together.

sense_0a2b5558f2622bb6398e726fea7b483f.text: Não viu o caos que rolou no show de Taylor Swift pelo calor?
sense_0a2b5558f2622bb6398e726fea7b483f.translation: Didn't you see the chaos that happened at Taylor Swift's concert 'cause of the heat?

sense_0a2b5558f2622bb6398e726fea7b483f.text:
Avisou... Avisou... Avisou... Avisou...
Que vai rolar a festa! Vai rolar!
O povo do gueto mandou avisar...
Que vai rolar a festa! Vai rolar!
sense_0a2b5558f2622bb6398e726fea7b483f.translation:
(She) warned... (She) warned... (She) warned... (She) warned...
That the party will happen! It will happen!
The ghetto people told (her) to warn us...
That the party will happen! It will happen!

sense_3c9b525d95de449a10ff3e17a15049a2.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_3c9b525d95de449a10ff3e17a15049a2.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_3c9b525d95de449a10ff3e17a15049a2.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_a0045b281b639b4295f94a3b728c5c43.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_df2cc3805e7b94abd0a00c9e30dacb70.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_df2cc3805e7b94abd0a00c9e30dacb70.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_c9aa51e8abf17433e3c169003ff39b4e.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_c9aa51e8abf17433e3c169003ff39b4e.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_c9aa51e8abf17433e3c169003ff39b4e.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_6d8a119baea97ec579fef9161631fcec.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_6d8a119baea97ec579fef9161631fcec.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_c2814a0b65f46b25278543b7caae4508.text: Não vale deixar o rei em xeque.
sense_c2814a0b65f46b25278543b7caae4508.translation: It is not permitted to leave the king under check.

sense_833c44a8668b11445a4644035d5684c8.text: O ator valeu um prémio pelo seu desempenho.
sense_833c44a8668b11445a4644035d5684c8.translation: The actor earned an award for his film.

sense_833c44a8668b11445a4644035d5684c8.text: A guerra valeu críticas dos países da União Europeia.
sense_833c44a8668b11445a4644035d5684c8.translation: The war drew criticism from the countries of the European Union.

sense_c3adde5b7dbb33188776ecfa5e9ee9bc.text: Para/e de ser tolo e começa/ce a pensar.
sense_c3adde5b7dbb33188776ecfa5e9ee9bc.translation: Stop being foolish and start thinking.

sense_c3adde5b7dbb33188776ecfa5e9ee9bc.text: Infelizmente, o que fizemos foi extremamente tolo.
sense_c3adde5b7dbb33188776ecfa5e9ee9bc.translation: Unfortunately, what we did was extremely foolish.

sense_4f46b2bed6f5b7801a3e1cbff7f97265.text: Os tigres são distintos dos leões.

sense_84ae167653e925115b0fc35048331efe.text: O distinto cavaleiro participou da defesa da cidade.
sense_84ae167653e925115b0fc35048331efe.translation: The distinguished knight participated in the defense of the city.

sense_84ae167653e925115b0fc35048331efe.text: Achava-o superior, correcto, distincto, de uma aristrocracia innata que a encantava.
sense_84ae167653e925115b0fc35048331efe.translation: She found him superior, upstanding, distiguished, of an innate aristocracy that enchanted her.

sense_a4b6cb4a09c1acd1ddb949f4440e701e.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_a4b6cb4a09c1acd1ddb949f4440e701e.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_0138809c073191c8df98a0984cd706e7.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_0138809c073191c8df98a0984cd706e7.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_f248d81eae5819d8fd97a36cba36a2eb.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_f248d81eae5819d8fd97a36cba36a2eb.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_f248d81eae5819d8fd97a36cba36a2eb.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_f248d81eae5819d8fd97a36cba36a2eb.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_f248d81eae5819d8fd97a36cba36a2eb.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_f248d81eae5819d8fd97a36cba36a2eb.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_2e7dc1f42fb149ba26feee0bb74c76d4.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_2e7dc1f42fb149ba26feee0bb74c76d4.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_2e7dc1f42fb149ba26feee0bb74c76d4.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_2e7dc1f42fb149ba26feee0bb74c76d4.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_845846eeb34d6eeeb523e01933ce8d4f.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_845846eeb34d6eeeb523e01933ce8d4f.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_a7bc93f388adfbc209eedae2a40a3496.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_a7bc93f388adfbc209eedae2a40a3496.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_a7bc93f388adfbc209eedae2a40a3496.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_a7bc93f388adfbc209eedae2a40a3496.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_8be188b354d8114367325a72abb67ecc.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_8be188b354d8114367325a72abb67ecc.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_60c1d807d76a30886782a0d50d73e97f.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_60c1d807d76a30886782a0d50d73e97f.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_c564f74c35be0a141f9941019675a758.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_c564f74c35be0a141f9941019675a758.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_c564f74c35be0a141f9941019675a758.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_c564f74c35be0a141f9941019675a758.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_c564f74c35be0a141f9941019675a758.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_c564f74c35be0a141f9941019675a758.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_51f9a9d20f83a9a20a33f28b27a4d4d6.text: Os alunos assistiram às aulas de português.
sense_51f9a9d20f83a9a20a33f28b27a4d4d6.translation: The students attended the Portuguese classes.

sense_51f9a9d20f83a9a20a33f28b27a4d4d6.text: Assistimos o filme até o final.
sense_51f9a9d20f83a9a20a33f28b27a4d4d6.translation: We watched the film until the end.

sense_51f9a9d20f83a9a20a33f28b27a4d4d6.text: Nem gosto mais de assistir TV.
sense_51f9a9d20f83a9a20a33f28b27a4d4d6.translation: I don’t even like to watch TV anymore.

sense_a6c0acec16f9fdf4b622de20e648033a.text: Assistimos aqui em Guarulhos há tempo.
sense_a6c0acec16f9fdf4b622de20e648033a.translation: We live here in Guarulhos for a long time.

sense_a6c0acec16f9fdf4b622de20e648033a.text: Tenho próprio casal e nele assisto
