sense_a6c0acec16f9fdf4b622de20e648033a.translation: I have my own village and in it I reside

sense_dce618115d788fe729e6b017e0efb118.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_dce618115d788fe729e6b017e0efb118.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_dce618115d788fe729e6b017e0efb118.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_dce618115d788fe729e6b017e0efb118.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_2cbaaa08dc2c2235cc645d612b2934ff.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_2cbaaa08dc2c2235cc645d612b2934ff.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_2cbaaa08dc2c2235cc645d612b2934ff.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_2cbaaa08dc2c2235cc645d612b2934ff.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_6a8e54caa4232703997b0c92f64024f7.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_6a8e54caa4232703997b0c92f64024f7.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_6a8e54caa4232703997b0c92f64024f7.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_6a8e54caa4232703997b0c92f64024f7.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_6a8e54caa4232703997b0c92f64024f7.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_51190b08c6621d41b31afecd42c3a2c1.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_51190b08c6621d41b31afecd42c3a2c1.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_51190b08c6621d41b31afecd42c3a2c1.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_51190b08c6621d41b31afecd42c3a2c1.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_76b03c966480ca42b807fc3bb958017b.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_48be358432dd796c5b93a1063f3f4741.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_6ae69f761a6009e32879b7ac1b92e9b7.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_47eb243c2ecb6da8248513638c085678.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_47eb243c2ecb6da8248513638c085678.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_47eb243c2ecb6da8248513638c085678.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_47eb243c2ecb6da8248513638c085678.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_4214e6241bd2a09d55d4ebdd3afb92e5.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_4214e6241bd2a09d55d4ebdd3afb92e5.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_33d70362304ff3438f29d49dad651d17.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_33d70362304ff3438f29d49dad651d17.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_33d70362304ff3438f29d49dad651d17.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_33d70362304ff3438f29d49dad651d17.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_a6c0c92f0e560d1cf351c7a838216c0a.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_a6c0c92f0e560d1cf351c7a838216c0a.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_a6c0c92f0e560d1cf351c7a838216c0a.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_a6c0c92f0e560d1cf351c7a838216c0a.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_e79c550aa1560311db28abdad4b2d9ef.text: Estas grades de ferro estão aqui para nossa segurança.
sense_e79c550aa1560311db28abdad4b2d9ef.translation: These iron bars are here for our safety.

sense_e79c550aa1560311db28abdad4b2d9ef.text: A segurança está cem vezes mais rigorosa este verão.
sense_e79c550aa1560311db28abdad4b2d9ef.translation: The security is a hundred times more severe this summer.

sense_966fa911c4881f68fbabfba6987e222d.text: Fiquei com bode dessa menina: ela vive me criticando!
sense_966fa911c4881f68fbabfba6987e222d.translation: I'm tired of this chick: she always criticizes me!

sense_966fa911c4881f68fbabfba6987e222d.text: Eu tava tão ansioso pra esse na época e peguei bode dela pela transfobia
sense_966fa911c4881f68fbabfba6987e222d.translation: I was so excited for this one at the time and then I got sick of her because of her transphobia

sense_c7931ca9b233094bbb42e4da0a21167d.text: Me deu bode de fazer a lição de casa.
sense_c7931ca9b233094bbb42e4da0a21167d.translation: I don't feel like doing my homework.

sense_c7931ca9b233094bbb42e4da0a21167d.text: Ele acordou de bode esse domingo.
sense_c7931ca9b233094bbb42e4da0a21167d.translation: He woke up indisposed this Sunday.

sense_14ba4dbf60c705a42d5cbfc2d4c17740.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_14ba4dbf60c705a42d5cbfc2d4c17740.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_14ba4dbf60c705a42d5cbfc2d4c17740.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_14ba4dbf60c705a42d5cbfc2d4c17740.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_14ba4dbf60c705a42d5cbfc2d4c17740.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_14ba4dbf60c705a42d5cbfc2d4c17740.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_3bc35cf593893668834ff04be2175e30.text: A corda da guitarra soa desafinada.
sense_3bc35cf593893668834ff04be2175e30.translation: The guitar string sounds out of tune.

sense_3bc35cf593893668834ff04be2175e30.text: Ó sino da minha aldeia, / Dolente na tarde calma, / Cada tua badalada / Soa dentro da minha alma.
sense_3bc35cf593893668834ff04be2175e30.translation: Oh bell of my village, / Lazy in this peaceful afternoon, / Each one of your tollings / Resounds in my soul.

sense_b09c3e5cd01469530b07a7d3791019ff.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_b09c3e5cd01469530b07a7d3791019ff.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_738756250988d73324833b28a3f99123.text: Depois que a neve derreteu, as pessoas começaram a circular pelo parque.
sense_738756250988d73324833b28a3f99123.translation: After the snow melted, people started walking around the park.

sense_1eed5bdfd232f1452b3dd35646e7d8ed.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_1eed5bdfd232f1452b3dd35646e7d8ed.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_ff9738bd13cef77696be5db9d897bbe0.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_ff9738bd13cef77696be5db9d897bbe0.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_d11f75774ac207253370dfdda0d0f115.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_d11f75774ac207253370dfdda0d0f115.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_d11f75774ac207253370dfdda0d0f115.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_371fa8dccf1961819c68e8f0e45af1d6.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_371fa8dccf1961819c68e8f0e45af1d6.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_6ca7f172946f31079f40120096b770b9.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_6ca7f172946f31079f40120096b770b9.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_759018dd57b7f80e2daa29a7135db7e1.text: Chore o preço até que o diminuam.
sense_759018dd57b7f80e2daa29a7135db7e1.translation: Haggle for the price until they lower it.

sense_759018dd57b7f80e2daa29a7135db7e1.text: Chorei, chorei, até que o vendedor baixou o preço.
sense_759018dd57b7f80e2daa29a7135db7e1.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_eabb9679b458581c3305aaa6d729f351.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_eabb9679b458581c3305aaa6d729f351.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_0b7e46c7f160666bba8f4c3f27f15ae1.text: Peixe e vinho tinto não combinam.
sense_0b7e46c7f160666bba8f4c3f27f15ae1.translation: Fish and red wine don't go together.

sense_9045c59c98fccc5963d6ca92cc800be7.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_9045c59c98fccc5963d6ca92cc800be7.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_9045c59c98fccc5963d6ca92cc800be7.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_9045c59c98fccc5963d6ca92cc800be7.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_c5ad8f49c948c9fff00c7a3aa88a10da.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_c5ad8f49c948c9fff00c7a3aa88a10da.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_11d17d5565ff532f69f4561f9289a991.text: Desculpe, acho que dá mais medo se for meia-noite!
sense_11d17d5565ff532f69f4561f9289a991.translation: I'm sorry, I thought that it would be more fearsome if it were midnight!

sense_6712f6e03747674fe07d704a0f1216ef.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_6712f6e03747674fe07d704a0f1216ef.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_91f9c6f5e373375a58249c433debc5cc.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_91f9c6f5e373375a58249c433debc5cc.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_91f9c6f5e373375a58249c433debc5cc.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_91f9c6f5e373375a58249c433debc5cc.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_a4c7191f0c1ac93c3a85870aab436096.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_a4c7191f0c1ac93c3a85870aab436096.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_a4c7191f0c1ac93c3a85870aab436096.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_a4c7191f0c1ac93c3a85870aab436096.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_f8d9ca332d971b90f5ffc8cf1052ede9.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_f8d9ca332d971b90f5ffc8cf1052ede9.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_539c62d21e38b11e9d24bf799e084b4b.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_539c62d21e38b11e9d24bf799e084b4b.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_539c62d21e38b11e9d24bf799e084b4b.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_539c62d21e38b11e9d24bf799e084b4b.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_67a9117bbc1d37c8e94abee97a2d803e.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_f98ae86857d745a4bd4361957c2433cb.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_f98ae86857d745a4bd4361957c2433cb.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_5412aa5002e9b0706e0cff744e38e0d9.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_5412aa5002e9b0706e0cff744e38e0d9.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_021d18ff4350e89bc5fbced8b111a511.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_021d18ff4350e89bc5fbced8b111a511.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_021d18ff4350e89bc5fbced8b111a511.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_021d18ff4350e89bc5fbced8b111a511.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_7ddc7554c6416a572da44fcb3b8cc39e.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_7ddc7554c6416a572da44fcb3b8cc39e.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_c4cc82fe31f7d34dcbf760225acbbc0a.text: Eu temo o dia em que ninguém more mais aqui.
sense_c4cc82fe31f7d34dcbf760225acbbc0a.translation: I fear the day no one lives here any more.

sense_40f3682e0120c978f2686f56df74fd99.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_40f3682e0120c978f2686f56df74fd99.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_51c40f382450e26a551509d1ecdd338f.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_c5c796931ec91803c40c8baec662bd79.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_c5c796931ec91803c40c8baec662bd79.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_c5c796931ec91803c40c8baec662bd79.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_c5c796931ec91803c40c8baec662bd79.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_c5c796931ec91803c40c8baec662bd79.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_c5c796931ec91803c40c8baec662bd79.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_3f4e8e9157a3380f58ac844772396e28.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_3f4e8e9157a3380f58ac844772396e28.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_3f4e8e9157a3380f58ac844772396e28.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_3f4e8e9157a3380f58ac844772396e28.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_0adf2676fb2ce3e223f95ca9349ddce7.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_5557f23bcdfda79ba74ec60d715eb65c.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_5557f23bcdfda79ba74ec60d715eb65c.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_5557f23bcdfda79ba74ec60d715eb65c.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_5557f23bcdfda79ba74ec60d715eb65c.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_04c3c7b9135da12d775267fb9385a123.text: Chore o preço até que o diminuam.
sense_04c3c7b9135da12d775267fb9385a123.translation: Haggle for the price until they lower it.

sense_04c3c7b9135da12d775267fb9385a123.text: Chorei, chorei, até que o vendedor baixou o preço.
sense_04c3c7b9135da12d775267fb9385a123.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_59704b08dd2304e9eb7d3e92ce3dee13.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_59704b08dd2304e9eb7d3e92ce3dee13.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_59704b08dd2304e9eb7d3e92ce3dee13.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_59704b08dd2304e9eb7d3e92ce3dee13.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_d785df62771da49dbb2dd992b0b47145.text: Se queres vencer, deves te comportar como campeão.
sense_d785df62771da49dbb2dd992b0b47145.translation: If you want to win, you must behave as a champion.

sense_d785df62771da49dbb2dd992b0b47145.text: De fato, ele se comportava muito mal.
sense_d785df62771da49dbb2dd992b0b47145.translation: Indeed, he was behaving very badly.

sense_84e781b1685120ddbfc6ce280b8eedf4.translation: We need to win the competition.
It is not important to win.

sense_4dccfd070718fbc746cb85fea251b83d.text: Será que os Androides Sonham com Ovelhas Elétricas?
sense_4dccfd070718fbc746cb85fea251b83d.translation: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
I had a dream about him.

sense_8ece381b73a9f28eac9cc2314f977bd5.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_8ece381b73a9f28eac9cc2314f977bd5.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_8ece381b73a9f28eac9cc2314f977bd5.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_8ece381b73a9f28eac9cc2314f977bd5.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_fb82ee952478c46d9c1fcf4f28cea898.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_fb82ee952478c46d9c1fcf4f28cea898.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_ee702923ac5120d3f980d2b1a9b5d1fa.text: Um vestido preto cairia bem nela.
sense_ee702923ac5120d3f980d2b1a9b5d1fa.translation: A black dress would suit her well.

sense_e1ec97cee6f804d2eb74dd004622f03f.text: Saciado, cahiu de papo para cima, olhando as estrellas, que vinham nascendo.
sense_e1ec97cee6f804d2eb74dd004622f03f.translation: Satisfied, he fell belly-up, looking at the stars, which were coming up.

sense_1b9328a9120be1ac2ff4420fd623104f.translation: The apple fell from the branch.
The book fell from the table.

sense_3c3dbc844dc7f217e99cc1707dd2f052.text: Caiu uma pergunta sobre a revolução.
sense_3c3dbc844dc7f217e99cc1707dd2f052.translation: There was a question about the revolution.

sense_3c3dbc844dc7f217e99cc1707dd2f052.text: Eu não tinha estudado nada do que caiu na prova.
sense_3c3dbc844dc7f217e99cc1707dd2f052.translation: I hadn’t studied anything that was in the test.

sense_fe08b4bd3071f6f9c3afc9905355f5cc.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_fe08b4bd3071f6f9c3afc9905355f5cc.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_fe08b4bd3071f6f9c3afc9905355f5cc.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_fe08b4bd3071f6f9c3afc9905355f5cc.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_24c95c4d0b016844e48c49407bd79eaa.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_24c95c4d0b016844e48c49407bd79eaa.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_350a4261bee001aded6053c9c57d4abb.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_350a4261bee001aded6053c9c57d4abb.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_9126e49834fa9720f228e74ac3b25f63.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_9126e49834fa9720f228e74ac3b25f63.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_cf90b2c6a172d7afe5952b1b00a1afb9.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_cf90b2c6a172d7afe5952b1b00a1afb9.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_cf90b2c6a172d7afe5952b1b00a1afb9.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_cf90b2c6a172d7afe5952b1b00a1afb9.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: Dessa janela, sozinha / Olhar a cidade me acalma
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: Alone, from this windowsill / Looking at the city puts me at ease

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: Em scismar — sósinho — á noite — / Mais prazer encontro eu lá; / Minha terra tem palmeiras, / Onde canta o Sabiá.
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: When ruminating — alone — at night — / I find more pleasure there; / My land has palm trees, / where the Thrush sings.

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: O marquez tinha ido sósinho para França. Fôra, ao que se dizia, buscar a filha ao Sacré-Cœur.
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: The marquess had gone to France alone. He’d gone, supposedly, to fetch his daughter from the Sacré-Cœur.

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: — Ai! volto, volto... Não posso deixar sózinha a mãe do meu homem, que tem oitenta annos e está entrevada.
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: “Oh! I’ll go back, yes... I can’t leave my man’s mother, who’s eighty years old and paralysed, by herself.

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: No momento actual, não era possivel ao Brasil vencer sosinho as suas difficuldades financeiras, nem lhe será possivel.
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: Currently, it was not possible for Brazil to overcome its financial difficulties by itself, nor will it be possible.

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: Impossivel dar cabo daquella praga. Estirou os olhos pela campina, achou-se isolado. Sózinho num mundo coberto de pennas, de aves queriam comel-o.
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: It was impossible to put an end to that pest. He looked over the plains, found himself isolated. Alone in a world covered in feathers, in birds that sought to eat him.

sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.text: Uma canção dizendo tudo a ela / Que ainda estou sozinho, apaixonado
sense_92b45b2afbc53e493412fb3270f2c068.translation: A song telling her everything / That I’m still lonely, in love

sense_546bb3d3c3d6c21c01364a1b13cd5226.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_546bb3d3c3d6c21c01364a1b13cd5226.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_546bb3d3c3d6c21c01364a1b13cd5226.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_546bb3d3c3d6c21c01364a1b13cd5226.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_98c7b53ff31ffa13d4e847d55c7bb239.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_98c7b53ff31ffa13d4e847d55c7bb239.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_ca1a7bd358477e1f27f4742e0d8ee5fe.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_ca1a7bd358477e1f27f4742e0d8ee5fe.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_967a2e2ccf6556e59790a60f916c0c41.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_967a2e2ccf6556e59790a60f916c0c41.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_967a2e2ccf6556e59790a60f916c0c41.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_967a2e2ccf6556e59790a60f916c0c41.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_967a2e2ccf6556e59790a60f916c0c41.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_967a2e2ccf6556e59790a60f916c0c41.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_9476644fe30e69b39c18d741ee512064.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_9476644fe30e69b39c18d741ee512064.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_fa973ee16fea425ce2699e0a9c10edb3.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_fa973ee16fea425ce2699e0a9c10edb3.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_fa973ee16fea425ce2699e0a9c10edb3.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_fa973ee16fea425ce2699e0a9c10edb3.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_0cffc89e19d5ef027f00ce14642c9f1c.text: Os bêbados começaram a se agarrar.
Um idiota queria se agarrar comigo.
sense_0cffc89e19d5ef027f00ce14642c9f1c.translation: Some idiot wanted to fight with me.

sense_c387b4de0a46796e52db67bb7e9fdb82.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_c387b4de0a46796e52db67bb7e9fdb82.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_c387b4de0a46796e52db67bb7e9fdb82.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_c387b4de0a46796e52db67bb7e9fdb82.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_dccc05f3138b4006c1d5f9f788da0ad8.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_dccc05f3138b4006c1d5f9f788da0ad8.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_0de217242083f42a185b9b14f1444cb7.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_ed51f794a440bb11b06b232306a2761c.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_ed51f794a440bb11b06b232306a2761c.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_55c4fa1850e147125fcc2bb8cfc5f4bf.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_55c4fa1850e147125fcc2bb8cfc5f4bf.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_828277e81b586e1077a1d2fcb3033583.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_e002177eb02bc2729fe30659f07c3720.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_e002177eb02bc2729fe30659f07c3720.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_b76813bded8c99e80eac56cfd39008d0.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_09b4bbab6c0db273c8beac356154fd19.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_09b4bbab6c0db273c8beac356154fd19.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_fa16e1b29865b21b0899b7036c847dc6.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_fa16e1b29865b21b0899b7036c847dc6.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_d6578ffd9c03caa7c42fc4be222df60b.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_d6578ffd9c03caa7c42fc4be222df60b.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_f967c5b67c3b1fb43cfe6fa5c152ee8c.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_7c0d7e899259d8c6fea0110db493ffaa.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_7c0d7e899259d8c6fea0110db493ffaa.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_f18b6def363866110824db714f6fa8ef.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_eff14ff6a7b5676fb70740a63c6ddcfa.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_eff14ff6a7b5676fb70740a63c6ddcfa.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_a5b066142b385351839cf79864639e3c.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_a5b066142b385351839cf79864639e3c.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_453cd7a3135e2e0c92ec4af42a8fa926.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_6c6fab0923159742a1b0827d5b0ead67.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_644071d4d1023a54ef53a87e1f48c1b1.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_644071d4d1023a54ef53a87e1f48c1b1.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_644071d4d1023a54ef53a87e1f48c1b1.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_644071d4d1023a54ef53a87e1f48c1b1.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_773bfa41e19fa4078c2bda9538f91549.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_773bfa41e19fa4078c2bda9538f91549.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_b289303e92435f6177a026accab5faa2.text: Ela errou o caminho porque se confundiu.
sense_b289303e92435f6177a026accab5faa2.translation: She missed the way because she got confused.

sense_b289303e92435f6177a026accab5faa2.text: Todo mundo se confunde com isso.

sense_a4b1d431cbce2417fd03b46902ce1276.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_a4b1d431cbce2417fd03b46902ce1276.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_a4b1d431cbce2417fd03b46902ce1276.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_a4b1d431cbce2417fd03b46902ce1276.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_b2277dee1981d312fd023e49fa532e8b.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_b2277dee1981d312fd023e49fa532e8b.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_e9c63be117ff20c8649122892fb0cf2e.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_e9c63be117ff20c8649122892fb0cf2e.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_e9c63be117ff20c8649122892fb0cf2e.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_e9c63be117ff20c8649122892fb0cf2e.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_4d6a58ccdf113fc7de6aef64d3709f2f.text: Eu temo o dia em que ninguém more mais aqui.
sense_4d6a58ccdf113fc7de6aef64d3709f2f.translation: I fear the day no one lives here any more.

sense_104a916e35baee2db0a1ab118bd6f58a.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_f11759a99a79d6bd58c922e775837b4b.text: Eu me dediquei muito para conseguir este emprego.
sense_f11759a99a79d6bd58c922e775837b4b.translation: I really dedicated myself (in order) to get this job.
She dedicated herself to her studies.

sense_7f9b35bd7d46fc19710da3396f13c50a.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_9adb2ea0302a74f6758381d740be6ee8.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_9adb2ea0302a74f6758381d740be6ee8.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_9adb2ea0302a74f6758381d740be6ee8.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_9adb2ea0302a74f6758381d740be6ee8.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_d35b13db4f3072945aceb2b53aec6d04.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_d35b13db4f3072945aceb2b53aec6d04.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_d35b13db4f3072945aceb2b53aec6d04.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_d35b13db4f3072945aceb2b53aec6d04.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_10fbe1747e9753d832f30c2194cbcc0b.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_10fbe1747e9753d832f30c2194cbcc0b.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_10fbe1747e9753d832f30c2194cbcc0b.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_10fbe1747e9753d832f30c2194cbcc0b.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_b21999ed3d058177f12a356e49dfec6d.text: O carro foi vendido pelo seu antigo dono.
sense_b21999ed3d058177f12a356e49dfec6d.translation: The car was sold by its previous owner.

sense_b21999ed3d058177f12a356e49dfec6d.text: Espero que os criminosos sejam punidos.
sense_b21999ed3d058177f12a356e49dfec6d.translation: I hope the criminals are punished.

sense_486fb2b254a2f7a3c9edb4a261a2051b.text: A soma de um e dois é três.
sense_486fb2b254a2f7a3c9edb4a261a2051b.translation: The sum of one and two is three.

sense_5fca25a4bdce69e44354c47675fe46f4.text: Nenhum de nós é de um país estrangeiro.
sense_5fca25a4bdce69e44354c47675fe46f4.translation: None of us is from a foreign country.
These pieces of equipment are from Germany.

sense_5cfb06ec7b51a949cf4269853872a5e8.text: Minha casa é num bairro pobre.
sense_5cfb06ec7b51a949cf4269853872a5e8.translation: My house is in a poor neighbourhood.

sense_60728c03c52cdb788366d602d9a30ca0.text: É para comermos toda a carne.
sense_60728c03c52cdb788366d602d9a30ca0.translation: We are supposed to eat all the meat.

sense_60728c03c52cdb788366d602d9a30ca0.text: Não sei porque está demorando, já era para o filme ter começado.
sense_60728c03c52cdb788366d602d9a30ca0.translation: I don’t know why it is taking so long, the film should have started already.

sense_c8cee0f4abd7918270692059e8ed867c.text: Não mexa em nada que não for seu.
sense_c8cee0f4abd7918270692059e8ed867c.translation: Don’t touch anything that is not yours.
This house belongs to the mayor.

sense_f0aa16295771861c7f10231405588054.text: Desconectar o computador direto da tomada sem desligá-lo antes pode queimá-lo.
sense_f0aa16295771861c7f10231405588054.translation: Unplugging the computer directly without turning it off first may break it.

sense_3f5c41d8d878e2b730878561431356bd.text: […] o empurrou tão rijo que deu com elle da eſcotilha abaixo […]
sense_3f5c41d8d878e2b730878561431356bd.translation: […] he pushed him so roughly that he sent him down the hatch […]

sense_3f5c41d8d878e2b730878561431356bd.text: Ele se aproximou e experimentou empurrá-la.
sense_3f5c41d8d878e2b730878561431356bd.translation: He came closer and tried to push it.

sense_cba9a88857e79781bea51e1d8c924fba.text: O vendedor ficou me empurrando essa caixinha de som, e acabou que eu voltei com três.
sense_cba9a88857e79781bea51e1d8c924fba.translation: The salesman kept pushing these speakers to me, and I ended up coming home with three.

sense_cba9a88857e79781bea51e1d8c924fba.text: Mas ſobreveyo Perdiccas amigo de Agathocles, & empurrando hũa mentira com outra o tirou a ſalvo […]
sense_cba9a88857e79781bea51e1d8c924fba.translation: But Perdiccas, friend of Agathocles, appeared and, pushing one lie after the other, got him out safely […]

sense_08fcc7219e0ece63f9c0608a82ec9cc7.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_08fcc7219e0ece63f9c0608a82ec9cc7.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_08fcc7219e0ece63f9c0608a82ec9cc7.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_08fcc7219e0ece63f9c0608a82ec9cc7.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_3f1baea623d7aede8a02b21b61823aa9.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_3f1baea623d7aede8a02b21b61823aa9.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_3f1baea623d7aede8a02b21b61823aa9.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_3f1baea623d7aede8a02b21b61823aa9.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_10d50232524bdb5a962c75e05b170c20.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_10d50232524bdb5a962c75e05b170c20.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_10d50232524bdb5a962c75e05b170c20.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_10d50232524bdb5a962c75e05b170c20.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_10d50232524bdb5a962c75e05b170c20.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_10d50232524bdb5a962c75e05b170c20.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_2016207f8cc64e05d3c54626e7763553.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_2016207f8cc64e05d3c54626e7763553.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_2016207f8cc64e05d3c54626e7763553.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_2016207f8cc64e05d3c54626e7763553.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_3bc36121c25bc9379cc43f1eb5996665.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_3bc36121c25bc9379cc43f1eb5996665.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_25f2b2ef475b9124ad1b14adbc4c837e.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_25f2b2ef475b9124ad1b14adbc4c837e.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_ab97601ff588ed4a119b62933b6c8ab9.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_928efba15eb1c4f872ef2fc2e9ccd5e2.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_928efba15eb1c4f872ef2fc2e9ccd5e2.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_928efba15eb1c4f872ef2fc2e9ccd5e2.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_928efba15eb1c4f872ef2fc2e9ccd5e2.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_018d1b62a157e66c944878cdb838d447.text: Aplique xampu no seu cabelo até que ele fique macio.
sense_018d1b62a157e66c944878cdb838d447.translation: Apply shampoo onto your hair until it gets soft.

sense_018d1b62a157e66c944878cdb838d447.text: Se bem que as crianças não possam fazer uso dos mesmos preparados que os adultos contra as rachaduras da pelle, não quer dizer que não se deva applicar outros apropriados.
sense_018d1b62a157e66c944878cdb838d447.translation: Although children cannot make use of the same preparations as adults against cracked skin, this does not mean one should not apply other appropriate ones.

sense_2939e639eecd96c5401aaf8a40d6ae03.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_2939e639eecd96c5401aaf8a40d6ae03.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_2939e639eecd96c5401aaf8a40d6ae03.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_2939e639eecd96c5401aaf8a40d6ae03.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_b3f55e42396abe93462dd2652277e323.text: Chore o preço até que o diminuam.
sense_b3f55e42396abe93462dd2652277e323.translation: Haggle for the price until they lower it.

sense_b3f55e42396abe93462dd2652277e323.text: Chorei, chorei, até que o vendedor baixou o preço.
sense_b3f55e42396abe93462dd2652277e323.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_61053e13ef4d6ddb7f7d566cf4c900d7.translation: Cum for me, you naughty boy.

sense_61053e13ef4d6ddb7f7d566cf4c900d7.text: Sempre que gozo dentro eu me sinto profano / Ela sorri e fala, "Baco eu te amo / Se lembre, você é humano / 'Cê é forte, aguente o dano"
sense_61053e13ef4d6ddb7f7d566cf4c900d7.translation: Whenever I cum inside, I feel profane / She smiles and says, "Baco, I love you / Remember, you're human / You're strong, withstand the pain"

sense_febb9414c39ae16781e24a5f72e8045a.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_febb9414c39ae16781e24a5f72e8045a.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_febb9414c39ae16781e24a5f72e8045a.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_febb9414c39ae16781e24a5f72e8045a.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_7e2ae718ce9a2fe07705279518c4930d.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_7e2ae718ce9a2fe07705279518c4930d.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_483f306af76935fa55a9e4dac856f36e.text: A criança aprendeu a não colocar a mão no fogo da maneira mais difícil.
sense_483f306af76935fa55a9e4dac856f36e.translation: The child learned not to put his hand in the fire the hard way.

sense_483f306af76935fa55a9e4dac856f36e.text: 1607, Luís Vaz de Camões, Rimas, Amor é fogo que arde sem se ver
sense_483f306af76935fa55a9e4dac856f36e.translation: Love is a fire that burns without being seen

sense_8e8c2fc1a77ff88e95ce4f8b7e508827.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_8e8c2fc1a77ff88e95ce4f8b7e508827.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_2a203822714dd7facb6734b154f7f6fc.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_2a203822714dd7facb6734b154f7f6fc.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_2826fc7a4171d1b6579c0df75574fe16.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_2826fc7a4171d1b6579c0df75574fe16.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_2826fc7a4171d1b6579c0df75574fe16.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_2826fc7a4171d1b6579c0df75574fe16.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_9ac352c233f17918cb23f3067577301d.text: A natação é uma coisa que desfruto.
sense_9ac352c233f17918cb23f3067577301d.translation: Swimming is one thing I enjoy.

sense_9ac352c233f17918cb23f3067577301d.text: Ele desfruta de uma boa vida social.
sense_9ac352c233f17918cb23f3067577301d.translation: He enjoys a good social life.

sense_6718f1ab3e30a053c081ef775b20f84b.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_6718f1ab3e30a053c081ef775b20f84b.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_6718f1ab3e30a053c081ef775b20f84b.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_2032eb55bf572434a0f5e4084ca72374.text: Muitos estão condenados a morrer de fome ou de doença.
sense_2032eb55bf572434a0f5e4084ca72374.translation: Many are condemned to die of starvation or disease.

sense_2032eb55bf572434a0f5e4084ca72374.text: Puz-me a tremer com violencia e a bater os dentes. Percebi que aquella attitude me condemnava e esforcei-me por cerrar os queixos e dominar os musculos, o que não consegui.
sense_2032eb55bf572434a0f5e4084ca72374.translation: I started to shiver violently and gnashing my teeth. I realized that doing so doomed me and made an effort to close my jaw and take control of my muscles, which I could not do.

sense_34f8d31d0b41beb4c09e256cb80c52d5.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_34f8d31d0b41beb4c09e256cb80c52d5.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_34f8d31d0b41beb4c09e256cb80c52d5.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_34f8d31d0b41beb4c09e256cb80c52d5.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_258417d7b65d0f4fa69422edb1d03416.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_258417d7b65d0f4fa69422edb1d03416.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_258417d7b65d0f4fa69422edb1d03416.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_258417d7b65d0f4fa69422edb1d03416.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_e59ec03e16337958d590e67392755228.translation: They’ve been going out for three months.

sense_63425e5f37b78d607bb94d6db32db8aa.text: A gente puxava briga com qualquer um.

sense_63425e5f37b78d607bb94d6db32db8aa.translation: He initiated a chat with the neighbours.

sense_c797a605402f7fab6dee4cc59e489a6b.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_c797a605402f7fab6dee4cc59e489a6b.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_71e6e88caadf9f31d67c241de110fde4.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_71e6e88caadf9f31d67c241de110fde4.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_71e6e88caadf9f31d67c241de110fde4.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_71e6e88caadf9f31d67c241de110fde4.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_6be8c7a8497b08c90ba69819af8c36a8.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_6be8c7a8497b08c90ba69819af8c36a8.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_6be8c7a8497b08c90ba69819af8c36a8.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_6be8c7a8497b08c90ba69819af8c36a8.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_bee11b1c5be9ba82999c34f980fc66cd.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_bee11b1c5be9ba82999c34f980fc66cd.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_bee11b1c5be9ba82999c34f980fc66cd.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_bee11b1c5be9ba82999c34f980fc66cd.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_1a4613944e6f9c779d11595e8b2770a6.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_1a4613944e6f9c779d11595e8b2770a6.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_1a4613944e6f9c779d11595e8b2770a6.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_1a4613944e6f9c779d11595e8b2770a6.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_1a4613944e6f9c779d11595e8b2770a6.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_1a4613944e6f9c779d11595e8b2770a6.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_9c3cd88a0db9e911310fad41833b48f6.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_7f9387dbb1f4900110a8b4e059f79480.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
sense_7f9387dbb1f4900110a8b4e059f79480.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

sense_7f9387dbb1f4900110a8b4e059f79480.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
sense_7f9387dbb1f4900110a8b4e059f79480.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

sense_57c792f313d0078cae55a30536cc069f.text: Chegamos a casa, pois agora troquemo-nos.
sense_57c792f313d0078cae55a30536cc069f.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_4d4cee03fa69b89082e42a13e4cc9ea0.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.
sense_4d4cee03fa69b89082e42a13e4cc9ea0.translation: I want to replace my car with a new one.
We have to replace the burnt-out lightbulbs.

sense_fde89068d36b527d3ae19e3e1d67b79e.text: Os boxeadores estão trocando socos na cabeça.
sense_fde89068d36b527d3ae19e3e1d67b79e.translation: The boxers are exchanging blows to their heads.

sense_fde89068d36b527d3ae19e3e1d67b79e.text: Todo dia eu trocava umas ideias com o vizinho.
sense_fde89068d36b527d3ae19e3e1d67b79e.translation: I used to chat with the neighbor every single day.

sense_eabc67418652189721fd4ea92c6c95a1.text: Troco um par de sapatos por uma blusa.
sense_eabc67418652189721fd4ea92c6c95a1.translation: I’ll exchange a pair of shoes for a blouse.

sense_eabc67418652189721fd4ea92c6c95a1.text: Eu e o meu primo trocamos livros.
sense_eabc67418652189721fd4ea92c6c95a1.translation: My cousin and I traded books.

sense_eabc67418652189721fd4ea92c6c95a1.text: O explorador trocou presentes com os nativos.
sense_eabc67418652189721fd4ea92c6c95a1.translation: The explorer exchanged gifts with the natives.

sense_7f547eca7bfa0f08bf4c3f8a3c3a3e97.text: Os bêbados começaram a se agarrar.
Um idiota queria se agarrar comigo.
sense_7f547eca7bfa0f08bf4c3f8a3c3a3e97.translation: Some idiot wanted to fight with me.

sense_718b7e81ced4c03d3257d31d633ab51f.translation: The thieves cleaned out the house.

sense_d764026b3fac2ad18dbcd4d0293819bc.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_d764026b3fac2ad18dbcd4d0293819bc.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_4b4ee6f366be2c15222665cd9e7d7fb0.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_4b4ee6f366be2c15222665cd9e7d7fb0.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_4b4ee6f366be2c15222665cd9e7d7fb0.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_4b4ee6f366be2c15222665cd9e7d7fb0.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_d3fb2d64235c66b5a9acc5c6a7d1655e.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_d3fb2d64235c66b5a9acc5c6a7d1655e.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_d3fb2d64235c66b5a9acc5c6a7d1655e.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_d3fb2d64235c66b5a9acc5c6a7d1655e.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_9f68f1e76feafac2987c35351a5dc894.text: Dizem que os porcos-espinhos conseguem deixar seus espinhos armados.
sense_9f68f1e76feafac2987c35351a5dc894.translation: They say that porcupines can make their quills erect.

sense_9f68f1e76feafac2987c35351a5dc894.text: Tenho tantos redemoinhos que meu cabelo está sempre armado.
sense_9f68f1e76feafac2987c35351a5dc894.translation: I have so many cowlicks that my hair is always sticking up.

sense_21517ac1220cfbe44fc775abf42519e4.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_21517ac1220cfbe44fc775abf42519e4.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_21517ac1220cfbe44fc775abf42519e4.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_79cdd82f2041513459fd0c189ea4f4e8.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_79cdd82f2041513459fd0c189ea4f4e8.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_74de2bca304ba4cd3a800f6a9410b0d5.text: Este dicionário não presta para nada.
sense_74de2bca304ba4cd3a800f6a9410b0d5.translation: This dictionary isn't useful for anything.

sense_19de15b9fca8e0d3031664379b324d47.text: Bebendo vinho / Quebrando as taças / Fudendo por toda casa / Se eu divido o maço, eu te amo, desgraça
sense_19de15b9fca8e0d3031664379b324d47.translation: Drinking wine / Breaking the glasses / Fucking all around the house / If I share the pack, I love you, disgrace

sense_78b444d006b3d9dfb5a57fa4736d89a8.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_78b444d006b3d9dfb5a57fa4736d89a8.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_7123d64318746b3cdf3ce0a2959e7eb7.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_7123d64318746b3cdf3ce0a2959e7eb7.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_fe376ebf2194e993fa718d284841f801.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_fe376ebf2194e993fa718d284841f801.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_4631868b786887144542e56886c11caf.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_4631868b786887144542e56886c11caf.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_4631868b786887144542e56886c11caf.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_4631868b786887144542e56886c11caf.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_22219546c0d93507d59cdba5cef68b3c.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_22219546c0d93507d59cdba5cef68b3c.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_22219546c0d93507d59cdba5cef68b3c.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_22219546c0d93507d59cdba5cef68b3c.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_043f1880b9235ce55f7414984ec5cde8.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_043f1880b9235ce55f7414984ec5cde8.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_b0a7a3f009b10aab25f9e234b189089e.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_b0a7a3f009b10aab25f9e234b189089e.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_5b67bceb62d21e5e763a08bac5eec3e6.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_5b67bceb62d21e5e763a08bac5eec3e6.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_5b67bceb62d21e5e763a08bac5eec3e6.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_5b67bceb62d21e5e763a08bac5eec3e6.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_d7e49b33c7d46ed7bac2c6641e647ff3.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_d7e49b33c7d46ed7bac2c6641e647ff3.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_3be49d005fc14db62b07f27d4f42baed.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_3be49d005fc14db62b07f27d4f42baed.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_3be49d005fc14db62b07f27d4f42baed.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_3be49d005fc14db62b07f27d4f42baed.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_1bddfbf2afa882a8d1ca55fde5b3c5f5.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_1bddfbf2afa882a8d1ca55fde5b3c5f5.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_1bddfbf2afa882a8d1ca55fde5b3c5f5.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_1bddfbf2afa882a8d1ca55fde5b3c5f5.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_c7373cabb12d07ea126fec422189920b.text: Perseverança é a melhor amiga do conhecimento.

sense_dcf6d5cfd444283d08f81a38a7929bd6.text: Mel,ela tesourou com a sua mãe para você estar tão obcecada assim?
sense_dcf6d5cfd444283d08f81a38a7929bd6.translation: Mel, did she scissor your mother to make you obsessed like this?

sense_dcf6d5cfd444283d08f81a38a7929bd6.text:
CHEGUEI
tô preparada pra colar
quando o grave bater eu vou tesourar
na sua cara vou jogar e rebolar
por que eu sou linda lésbica e louca.
sense_dcf6d5cfd444283d08f81a38a7929bd6.translation:
IM HERE
and im all ready to trib
when the bass drops im gonna scissor
ill throw it on your face and twerk
cuz i’m a beautiful crazy lesbian.

sense_64099a7742210400e6959f8b81103f9f.text: Até agora, a proposta pra tesoureira do Banco do Brasil é a mais tentadora. Adoro tesourar, picotar e ganhar dinheiro. HAHAHA
sense_64099a7742210400e6959f8b81103f9f.translation: Up to this point, the offering for the treasurer role at Banco do Brasil is the most tempting. I love to scissor, cut things up and make money.

sense_64099a7742210400e6959f8b81103f9f.text: Esse cabelinho do MT é a coisa mais ridícula, só sobe pro profissional se virar homem e tesourar essa merda. Se bem que não tá jogando nada. Arthur Salles eu subiria.
sense_64099a7742210400e6959f8b81103f9f.translation: MT’s haircut is the most ridiculous thing, he’ll only become a pro player if he mans up and scissors this shit. Actually, he doesn’t even play well. I would move Arthur Salles up.

sense_e9c8f37d9a98533e299fb2fd68695c55.text: @Angelicakeka ja voltou linda q bom vc aki ai podemos tesourar os outros rsrs
sense_e9c8f37d9a98533e299fb2fd68695c55.translation: @Angelicakeka R u back bb that’s nice ur here so we can rant abt other people lol

sense_e9c8f37d9a98533e299fb2fd68695c55.text: Mas, só para chegar ao convite era uma tortura e depois, a lembrança de que se havia de dizer, de se commentar, de se conversar na botica e tesourar durante a ceia fazia desanimar.
sense_e9c8f37d9a98533e299fb2fd68695c55.translation: But just getting to the [wedding] proposal was already a torture, and then remembering that one would have to talk, comment, discuss at the pharmacy, and gossip over dinner was discouraging.

sense_bf070ee9783ab676b5b222d8b0a89f71.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_bf070ee9783ab676b5b222d8b0a89f71.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_16bfd6535d9b28e7e835adfafcce2d6c.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_16bfd6535d9b28e7e835adfafcce2d6c.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_16bfd6535d9b28e7e835adfafcce2d6c.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_16bfd6535d9b28e7e835adfafcce2d6c.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_b22674843180ea00eadadbce0fcabf64.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_a75c98b88c1e2ff1111ab477b065e8c0.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_a75c98b88c1e2ff1111ab477b065e8c0.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_a75c98b88c1e2ff1111ab477b065e8c0.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_a75c98b88c1e2ff1111ab477b065e8c0.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_d70097c7f1247755e70d574ee1277624.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_d70097c7f1247755e70d574ee1277624.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_d70097c7f1247755e70d574ee1277624.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_d70097c7f1247755e70d574ee1277624.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_636ba89dfe0de8680069ff21522addac.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_636ba89dfe0de8680069ff21522addac.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_636ba89dfe0de8680069ff21522addac.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_636ba89dfe0de8680069ff21522addac.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_30f0c63cfe1f3d65c87fb46d390ca440.translation: The thieves cleaned out the house.

sense_08bf2b066b7d10907d353bb0f4f4d1e7.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_08bf2b066b7d10907d353bb0f4f4d1e7.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_08bf2b066b7d10907d353bb0f4f4d1e7.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_08bf2b066b7d10907d353bb0f4f4d1e7.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_3b0aba5b4a7bdae102ee3e8edeba3814.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_3b0aba5b4a7bdae102ee3e8edeba3814.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_3b0aba5b4a7bdae102ee3e8edeba3814.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_3b0aba5b4a7bdae102ee3e8edeba3814.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_837a6d055246f610f57ee164a2dbe923.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_6ea3a56e2db6f87e05b8fcc6d426aa9c.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_6ea3a56e2db6f87e05b8fcc6d426aa9c.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_d14f91aa167d912b9cc8e45d7ef149af.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_d14f91aa167d912b9cc8e45d7ef149af.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_1d9909ac1100e09e473fb019818b4896.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_1d9909ac1100e09e473fb019818b4896.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_1d9909ac1100e09e473fb019818b4896.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_1d9909ac1100e09e473fb019818b4896.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_1d9909ac1100e09e473fb019818b4896.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_1d9909ac1100e09e473fb019818b4896.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_3ceed0dca53fdd198e88f461bd81a3b1.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_3ceed0dca53fdd198e88f461bd81a3b1.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_b83946eb84515d83f8b494df14f2759b.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_b83946eb84515d83f8b494df14f2759b.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_bb49d793204c686b28a2c59d219eb5e4.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_069f3b4c2a8a45a05157a5e0eb80cce7.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_e1c2a74d17a766d0b859960ad2cbd536.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_9c38782ffadd8637ea46741b913a1a5f.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_9c38782ffadd8637ea46741b913a1a5f.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_8540779f3daeb27fe77108af222f1f61.text: Eu temo o dia em que ninguém more mais aqui.
sense_8540779f3daeb27fe77108af222f1f61.translation: I fear the day no one lives here any more.

sense_f3cc47491a065069a9aef8579b0c192d.text: Desconectar o computador direto da tomada sem desligá-lo antes pode queimá-lo.
sense_f3cc47491a065069a9aef8579b0c192d.translation: Unplugging the computer directly without turning it off first may break it.

sense_0d058117e746c5c666a107ddfbc2b3b4.text: Roupas novas podem causar uma boa impressão.
sense_0d058117e746c5c666a107ddfbc2b3b4.translation: New clothes may cause a good impression.

sense_34a95c3e6e4b8b4545b52c222f519742.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_34a95c3e6e4b8b4545b52c222f519742.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_0233003a50cd25ff16bc37e7aa599677.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_0233003a50cd25ff16bc37e7aa599677.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_da87c27652ecf899b67694547a9ad578.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_da87c27652ecf899b67694547a9ad578.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_da87c27652ecf899b67694547a9ad578.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_da87c27652ecf899b67694547a9ad578.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_35ea8fd737c9168fac7f142b3a86291d.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_4fac8a3d9895c75ee8a2ef257b83ebbe.translation: They tried to throw the prisoners food.

sense_3d72b4553e748a4f73235795a2233899.text: Quando que o meu time joga?

sense_4e857bdbf9f42be412644054c1dff729.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_4e857bdbf9f42be412644054c1dff729.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_6dfd2accbce0cad49c9b5704831ec855.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_6dfd2accbce0cad49c9b5704831ec855.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_e959e96fbe0fd73292d99a45dec4f58f.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_e959e96fbe0fd73292d99a45dec4f58f.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_58eaf8628d9cb985bf70c2662033b7bc.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_58eaf8628d9cb985bf70c2662033b7bc.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_58eaf8628d9cb985bf70c2662033b7bc.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_58eaf8628d9cb985bf70c2662033b7bc.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_6bfe56faf1c21214409d900b3bc3ffe0.text: No ano passado li três livros.
sense_6bfe56faf1c21214409d900b3bc3ffe0.translation: I read three books in the previous year.
I read three books last year.

sense_bcafe40f3504f828970c5888622967be.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_bcafe40f3504f828970c5888622967be.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_b678f8a9a855fc36f7e86f1b68377591.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_b678f8a9a855fc36f7e86f1b68377591.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_7331d3d2b1b4c64b9fd12998a42a3e5c.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_7331d3d2b1b4c64b9fd12998a42a3e5c.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_7331d3d2b1b4c64b9fd12998a42a3e5c.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_7331d3d2b1b4c64b9fd12998a42a3e5c.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_9b0b3fa46b3fa39beb3741ca3388f407.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_9b0b3fa46b3fa39beb3741ca3388f407.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_9b0b3fa46b3fa39beb3741ca3388f407.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_9b0b3fa46b3fa39beb3741ca3388f407.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_7788cf22f66f1e5817cb0cce0c8d332e.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_7788cf22f66f1e5817cb0cce0c8d332e.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_a2de51924211341c7f047fa2d741812f.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_a2de51924211341c7f047fa2d741812f.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_9f53d949fefc56e71add167335cc98dc.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_9f53d949fefc56e71add167335cc98dc.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_c7ccb21688f7c5b8284763d35ae853da.text: Crispiniano quis virar valente. Que é que adiantava? Fifi reteve com dificuldade umas lágrimas sinceras.
sense_c7ccb21688f7c5b8284763d35ae853da.translation: Crispiniano wanted to become valiant. What was the point? Fifi retained with difficulty some sincere tears.

sense_c7ccb21688f7c5b8284763d35ae853da.text: Subornar também não adianta. Quer dizer: é impossível. Melhor é revelar o segredo.
sense_c7ccb21688f7c5b8284763d35ae853da.translation: Bribing also doesn't work. I mean: it is impossible. It is better to reveal the secret.

sense_b039182ddbbd86bab8358967622ba1b6.text: Eu me admiro com a beleza do mundo.

sense_b039182ddbbd86bab8358967622ba1b6.translation: They would be dazzled looking at the stars.

sense_7e0134679b6b96be3076d16e68ab0c9c.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_7e0134679b6b96be3076d16e68ab0c9c.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_bcc0bca2458fa842c81cd953677cc5e4.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_bcc0bca2458fa842c81cd953677cc5e4.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_1e2196177357f5daa8658f15834a6632.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_1e2196177357f5daa8658f15834a6632.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_1e2196177357f5daa8658f15834a6632.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_1e2196177357f5daa8658f15834a6632.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_1e2196177357f5daa8658f15834a6632.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_1e2196177357f5daa8658f15834a6632.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_5589d582b2127593da9385a07b01e957.text: Não viu o caos que rolou no show de Taylor Swift pelo calor?
sense_5589d582b2127593da9385a07b01e957.translation: Didn't you see the chaos that happened at Taylor Swift's concert 'cause of the heat?

sense_5589d582b2127593da9385a07b01e957.text:
Avisou... Avisou... Avisou... Avisou...
Que vai rolar a festa! Vai rolar!
O povo do gueto mandou avisar...
Que vai rolar a festa! Vai rolar!
sense_5589d582b2127593da9385a07b01e957.translation:
(She) warned... (She) warned... (She) warned... (She) warned...
That the party will happen! It will happen!
The ghetto people told (her) to warn us...
That the party will happen! It will happen!

sense_1d9c56cb3b6e33a958e3d6aedd13793b.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_1d9c56cb3b6e33a958e3d6aedd13793b.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_1d9c56cb3b6e33a958e3d6aedd13793b.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_1d9c56cb3b6e33a958e3d6aedd13793b.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_165ef646782ebba3cfb9186afc599f87.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_165ef646782ebba3cfb9186afc599f87.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_c1a18581d42e9eeaed3ca7c238a6d95f.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_c1a18581d42e9eeaed3ca7c238a6d95f.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_4a2b975c8eb9c1f2ecb3972ed1fa3a3b.translation: There was an accident in the highway.

sense_7db9a915eb6b691383e6a5313d7c9585.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_7db9a915eb6b691383e6a5313d7c9585.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_7db9a915eb6b691383e6a5313d7c9585.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_7db9a915eb6b691383e6a5313d7c9585.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_cb7df0bffd932ed6bd3e0bc29dc550ea.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_cb7df0bffd932ed6bd3e0bc29dc550ea.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_7ba33618ecf6c68bea1691e506dab2e5.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_7ba33618ecf6c68bea1691e506dab2e5.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_7ba33618ecf6c68bea1691e506dab2e5.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_7ba33618ecf6c68bea1691e506dab2e5.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_54838edd1744223812807010cf2f0d6c.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_54838edd1744223812807010cf2f0d6c.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_df633cdf17b8f945120be28a158291db.text: Os meses andam e eu continuo nesta situação.
sense_df633cdf17b8f945120be28a158291db.translation: The months pass and I continue on this situation.

sense_05e0e8ab2523058726807715bf9a5b7a.text: Ela está andando de ônibus para economizar tempo.
sense_05e0e8ab2523058726807715bf9a5b7a.translation: She’s traveling by bus to save time.

sense_998a17238c6d68f5363e52b8785761c1.text: Eu já andei pela França e Itália.
sense_998a17238c6d68f5363e52b8785761c1.translation: I’ve already been to France and Italy.

sense_998a17238c6d68f5363e52b8785761c1.text: Faz algum tempo que o xerife não anda por aqui.
sense_998a17238c6d68f5363e52b8785761c1.translation: It's been some time since the sheriff has been around here.

sense_a76398294d2cf83d01c133a82e8a2df8.text: Preciso de andar com o projeto.
sense_a76398294d2cf83d01c133a82e8a2df8.translation: I need to hurry up with the project.

sense_635d28c6af2daa36764243d244101b40.text: Será que os Androides Sonham com Ovelhas Elétricas?
sense_635d28c6af2daa36764243d244101b40.translation: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
I had a dream about him.

sense_533b2062c242b6f84c664bba68a190f5.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_533b2062c242b6f84c664bba68a190f5.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_533b2062c242b6f84c664bba68a190f5.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_b7dd37ecd0c07f48162a409e7cf54f8f.text: Farei vocês se arrependerem de ter nascido.
sense_b7dd37ecd0c07f48162a409e7cf54f8f.translation: I will make you regret having been born.

sense_b7dd37ecd0c07f48162a409e7cf54f8f.text: Os terroristas se arrependeram do ataque.

sense_722c86256f04481578963c2c2fb33e0d.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_722c86256f04481578963c2c2fb33e0d.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_722c86256f04481578963c2c2fb33e0d.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_722c86256f04481578963c2c2fb33e0d.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_ca998fad446fad7c2ee395d44a638513.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_ca998fad446fad7c2ee395d44a638513.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_ca998fad446fad7c2ee395d44a638513.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_ca998fad446fad7c2ee395d44a638513.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_9f4c0bc840c001ad9108bbc1c3710c07.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_9f4c0bc840c001ad9108bbc1c3710c07.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_9f4c0bc840c001ad9108bbc1c3710c07.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_9f4c0bc840c001ad9108bbc1c3710c07.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_5784abf54364e50dcd2efa8ac717b371.text: Ela errou o caminho porque se confundiu.
sense_5784abf54364e50dcd2efa8ac717b371.translation: She missed the way because she got confused.

sense_5784abf54364e50dcd2efa8ac717b371.text: Todo mundo se confunde com isso.

sense_a0652aa195fd5cc5e9bfd324f7d383df.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_a0652aa195fd5cc5e9bfd324f7d383df.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_9fdccec868dedce3a1ef6761048c73d3.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_9fdccec868dedce3a1ef6761048c73d3.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_4c5fce146413de19dd8bd68c1450fa54.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_4c5fce146413de19dd8bd68c1450fa54.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_4c5fce146413de19dd8bd68c1450fa54.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_4c5fce146413de19dd8bd68c1450fa54.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_67698cee2a08ab7d703f402414de2393.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_67698cee2a08ab7d703f402414de2393.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_90c56238ffd52cac7e7b76dc3c7951ec.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_90c56238ffd52cac7e7b76dc3c7951ec.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_2fbbc8224fba7ae5b20082f2ba7d3f5a.text: Mel,ela tesourou com a sua mãe para você estar tão obcecada assim?
sense_2fbbc8224fba7ae5b20082f2ba7d3f5a.translation: Mel, did she scissor your mother to make you obsessed like this?

sense_2fbbc8224fba7ae5b20082f2ba7d3f5a.text:
CHEGUEI
tô preparada pra colar
quando o grave bater eu vou tesourar
na sua cara vou jogar e rebolar
por que eu sou linda lésbica e louca.
sense_2fbbc8224fba7ae5b20082f2ba7d3f5a.translation:
IM HERE
and im all ready to trib
when the bass drops im gonna scissor
ill throw it on your face and twerk
cuz i’m a beautiful crazy lesbian.

sense_d99ca012c812a141ece0b8c04cbf4eed.text: Até agora, a proposta pra tesoureira do Banco do Brasil é a mais tentadora. Adoro tesourar, picotar e ganhar dinheiro. HAHAHA
sense_d99ca012c812a141ece0b8c04cbf4eed.translation: Up to this point, the offering for the treasurer role at Banco do Brasil is the most tempting. I love to scissor, cut things up and make money.

sense_d99ca012c812a141ece0b8c04cbf4eed.text: Esse cabelinho do MT é a coisa mais ridícula, só sobe pro profissional se virar homem e tesourar essa merda. Se bem que não tá jogando nada. Arthur Salles eu subiria.
sense_d99ca012c812a141ece0b8c04cbf4eed.translation: MT’s haircut is the most ridiculous thing, he’ll only become a pro player if he mans up and scissors this shit. Actually, he doesn’t even play well. I would move Arthur Salles up.

sense_f1cbd2902652dbd2fb3f6e54234ad0f8.text: @Angelicakeka ja voltou linda q bom vc aki ai podemos tesourar os outros rsrs
sense_f1cbd2902652dbd2fb3f6e54234ad0f8.translation: @Angelicakeka R u back bb that’s nice ur here so we can rant abt other people lol

sense_f1cbd2902652dbd2fb3f6e54234ad0f8.text: Mas, só para chegar ao convite era uma tortura e depois, a lembrança de que se havia de dizer, de se commentar, de se conversar na botica e tesourar durante a ceia fazia desanimar.
sense_f1cbd2902652dbd2fb3f6e54234ad0f8.translation: But just getting to the [wedding] proposal was already a torture, and then remembering that one would have to talk, comment, discuss at the pharmacy, and gossip over dinner was discouraging.

sense_59f94e83dadc69d39d507301437b374e.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_59f94e83dadc69d39d507301437b374e.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_59f94e83dadc69d39d507301437b374e.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_59f94e83dadc69d39d507301437b374e.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_59f94e83dadc69d39d507301437b374e.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_ea341f77ca37867d9bab0e9bd90c6a82.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_ea341f77ca37867d9bab0e9bd90c6a82.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_ea341f77ca37867d9bab0e9bd90c6a82.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_ea341f77ca37867d9bab0e9bd90c6a82.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_cb902598bc428a3996e2f39b6de9ac09.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_cb902598bc428a3996e2f39b6de9ac09.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_cb902598bc428a3996e2f39b6de9ac09.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_cb902598bc428a3996e2f39b6de9ac09.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_a3cd5652e8e8d65bd18987c044ce888a.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_a3cd5652e8e8d65bd18987c044ce888a.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_a3cd5652e8e8d65bd18987c044ce888a.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_a3cd5652e8e8d65bd18987c044ce888a.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_a3cd5652e8e8d65bd18987c044ce888a.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_a3cd5652e8e8d65bd18987c044ce888a.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_5f57fd18507ae5b0a59aebb4312eec7c.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_5f57fd18507ae5b0a59aebb4312eec7c.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_5f57fd18507ae5b0a59aebb4312eec7c.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_5f57fd18507ae5b0a59aebb4312eec7c.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_0581f8c8e658499e430f475c3fcffc96.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_08a1255e984d8abcd2b4f3044ac8af28.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_08a1255e984d8abcd2b4f3044ac8af28.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_db5fedabfcc044342f2999b8befffbb8.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_db5fedabfcc044342f2999b8befffbb8.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_db5fedabfcc044342f2999b8befffbb8.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_db5fedabfcc044342f2999b8befffbb8.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_83b512b35898b786ab6763b0fafd3cf9.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_83b512b35898b786ab6763b0fafd3cf9.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_83b512b35898b786ab6763b0fafd3cf9.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_83b512b35898b786ab6763b0fafd3cf9.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_05ab61ab9a359d56d81bd7c2b5926bd8.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_05ab61ab9a359d56d81bd7c2b5926bd8.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_2b7de1cfcd2c05d952fde2aba9513403.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_2b7de1cfcd2c05d952fde2aba9513403.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_87b69c3cf4f8211d19705c5731833c77.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_87b69c3cf4f8211d19705c5731833c77.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_87b69c3cf4f8211d19705c5731833c77.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_87b69c3cf4f8211d19705c5731833c77.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_e135e52932455e21655a8ad2ee19c06a.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_e135e52932455e21655a8ad2ee19c06a.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_6025050c7a773325a78dac96f3a2ce4b.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_6025050c7a773325a78dac96f3a2ce4b.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_6025050c7a773325a78dac96f3a2ce4b.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_6025050c7a773325a78dac96f3a2ce4b.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_443e157cbb3c2452664113d5800a28d1.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_cc7987157b0a249dfa5f29f3fcd1046b.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_cc7987157b0a249dfa5f29f3fcd1046b.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_cc7987157b0a249dfa5f29f3fcd1046b.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_d5496172b82247e9b017bdde14798b77.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_d5496172b82247e9b017bdde14798b77.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.
