sense_d5496172b82247e9b017bdde14798b77.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_d5496172b82247e9b017bdde14798b77.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_ef7f9d523abc0736d85adcad564eb6e8.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_ef7f9d523abc0736d85adcad564eb6e8.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_ef7f9d523abc0736d85adcad564eb6e8.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_ef7f9d523abc0736d85adcad564eb6e8.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_8e64edd3c031b5f6ba32b38163ebc545.text: O carro está a funcionar/funcionando bem mal.
sense_8e64edd3c031b5f6ba32b38163ebc545.translation: The car is running pretty badly.

sense_7ec043dfc6df7a88366c334dacd1b2d4.text: Tudo se passou em pleno dia.
sense_7ec043dfc6df7a88366c334dacd1b2d4.translation: It all happened in broad daylight.
In the middle of Rua da Bainharia.

sense_ff20fd5ad37addc63caac93fa1874964.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_ff20fd5ad37addc63caac93fa1874964.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_ff20fd5ad37addc63caac93fa1874964.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_ff20fd5ad37addc63caac93fa1874964.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_b5165da22a489bc8279333871b924209.text: A rainha logo voltará da guerra.
sense_b5165da22a489bc8279333871b924209.translation: The queen will soon return from the war.
We have returned to our native land.

sense_65c50c190b424410caf140bc5d4b04c8.text: Se voltarem seus olhos à esquerda, poderão ver o pôr do sol.
sense_65c50c190b424410caf140bc5d4b04c8.translation: If you turn our eyes left, you can see the sunset.

sense_50538098b4aa2bbe259739809721765f.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_50538098b4aa2bbe259739809721765f.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_a1028ecb92ce138735f5a888c3e3d84f.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_a1028ecb92ce138735f5a888c3e3d84f.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_35d53484b5d2653f2ac6717a1086ab9c.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_35d53484b5d2653f2ac6717a1086ab9c.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_35d53484b5d2653f2ac6717a1086ab9c.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_5d5657fb173020141c3e471a369dbc1a.text: O rei comanda seu reino com excelência.
sense_5d5657fb173020141c3e471a369dbc1a.translation: The king commands his kingdom with excellence.

sense_5d5657fb173020141c3e471a369dbc1a.text: João comandava um batalhão da aeronática.
sense_5d5657fb173020141c3e471a369dbc1a.translation: John used to command an airforce batallion.

sense_4c3cb2da747f93b86cb7b654781a93c0.text: Havia várias poças de sangue no chão do hospital.
sense_4c3cb2da747f93b86cb7b654781a93c0.translation: There were several pools of blood on the hospital floor.

sense_4c3cb2da747f93b86cb7b654781a93c0.text: Deixei o guarda-chuva cair na poça.
sense_4c3cb2da747f93b86cb7b654781a93c0.translation: I dropped the umbrella in the puddle.

sense_29c559a1ac338d1d10452eef7393100b.text: Muitos estão condenados a morrer de fome ou de doença.
sense_29c559a1ac338d1d10452eef7393100b.translation: Many are condemned to die of starvation or disease.

sense_29c559a1ac338d1d10452eef7393100b.text: Puz-me a tremer com violencia e a bater os dentes. Percebi que aquella attitude me condemnava e esforcei-me por cerrar os queixos e dominar os musculos, o que não consegui.
sense_29c559a1ac338d1d10452eef7393100b.translation: I started to shiver violently and gnashing my teeth. I realized that doing so doomed me and made an effort to close my jaw and take control of my muscles, which I could not do.

sense_fb80d5ad3dd6273af0542b6a116f4b91.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_fb80d5ad3dd6273af0542b6a116f4b91.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_4fd092b4a8813e648e79b882beff3331.text: Este é um documentário sério sobre os romanos.
sense_4fd092b4a8813e648e79b882beff3331.translation: This is a serious documentary about the Romans.

sense_b666b59cba15ea77d5c86044b26bb4a2.text: Não apareceu um cristão para me ajudar.
sense_b666b59cba15ea77d5c86044b26bb4a2.translation: Not one soul showed up to help me.
It was enough to make a soul go crazy.

sense_7bf62c15a21decba0b3cf6f36809f69b.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
sense_7bf62c15a21decba0b3cf6f36809f69b.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
They called me ugly at school.

sense_785e30ba2b777a615cbf675db299a753.text: Os botânicos chamam àquele tipo de árvore (de) gimnosperma.
sense_785e30ba2b777a615cbf675db299a753.translation: Botanists call that type of tree a gymnosperm.
to call someone a true friend

sense_785e30ba2b777a615cbf675db299a753.text: Deus chamou à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite.
sense_785e30ba2b777a615cbf675db299a753.translation: God called the light day, and the darkness He called night.

sense_1418958aff0b394cf17c77a7bf618c83.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_1418958aff0b394cf17c77a7bf618c83.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_b5d8599cac92c1d486943b1c077f11a6.text: Tocou o braço da mulher, apontou o ceo, ficaram os dois algum tempo aguentando a claridade do sol.
sense_b5d8599cac92c1d486943b1c077f11a6.translation: He touched his wife’s arm, pointed at the sky, and the two stayed for some time putting up with the sun’s brightness.

sense_fe1e3f6c28b186a873765dc39c96b6a9.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_fe1e3f6c28b186a873765dc39c96b6a9.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_6efc3bd4e2bb0b4456d5321f862abf66.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_6efc3bd4e2bb0b4456d5321f862abf66.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_6efc3bd4e2bb0b4456d5321f862abf66.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_6efc3bd4e2bb0b4456d5321f862abf66.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_fc9df634cea13b69148ce07e514b0188.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_fc9df634cea13b69148ce07e514b0188.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_e411406579c107ee58fc61c5f73be96a.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_e411406579c107ee58fc61c5f73be96a.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_e411406579c107ee58fc61c5f73be96a.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_fca4a92ea33c32bb23353fb8d31380d3.text: É melhor partirmos para a ofensiva.
sense_fca4a92ea33c32bb23353fb8d31380d3.translation: We are better off going on the offensive.

sense_fca4a92ea33c32bb23353fb8d31380d3.text: Na defesa reaparecerá Domingos, e a offensiva, com a efficiente collaboração de Valido, adquiriu nova potencialidade.
sense_fca4a92ea33c32bb23353fb8d31380d3.translation: Domingos will return to the defense, and the offense, with the effective support of Valido, has gained new strength.

sense_5e7da17901ddc60937eca09e54d8a867.translation: They’ve been going out for three months.

sense_f75dc108081f6de1a78d46b97448d698.text: Evite respirar pela boca enquanto corre
sense_f75dc108081f6de1a78d46b97448d698.translation: Avoid breathing by the mouth when running

sense_f75dc108081f6de1a78d46b97448d698.text: Ah! é que umas são a ignorancia na sua perfeição mais divina, outras guardam na bocca o gosto amargo de todos os fructos vedados que teem devorado!
sense_f75dc108081f6de1a78d46b97448d698.translation: Ah! It is that some embody ignorance in its most divine perfection, while others carry in their mouth the bitter taste of all the forbidden fruits they have devoured!

sense_15edff1f52c1354203485f7695787748.text: Chore o preço até que o diminuam.
sense_15edff1f52c1354203485f7695787748.translation: Haggle for the price until they lower it.

sense_15edff1f52c1354203485f7695787748.text: Chorei, chorei, até que o vendedor baixou o preço.
sense_15edff1f52c1354203485f7695787748.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_00956de391eab4eaa47d08a6f4404d5b.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_00956de391eab4eaa47d08a6f4404d5b.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_00956de391eab4eaa47d08a6f4404d5b.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_00956de391eab4eaa47d08a6f4404d5b.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_551c5a30a6aa8fdb0d700f03edf5becb.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_551c5a30a6aa8fdb0d700f03edf5becb.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_3973242d3a19a461392dedbe44474a6a.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_3973242d3a19a461392dedbe44474a6a.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_3973242d3a19a461392dedbe44474a6a.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_3973242d3a19a461392dedbe44474a6a.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_cfdf628ea7c124e370ce65751fcddaf9.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_106286136c55ffa9f791b49375fb6a90.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_106286136c55ffa9f791b49375fb6a90.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_8137611654b5616353dac83697381be5.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_8137611654b5616353dac83697381be5.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_2cdd56099faeacfabe74d65d0d0d50ae.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_616a6a66c1b54072a1b28f911c36da04.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_616a6a66c1b54072a1b28f911c36da04.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_c9f49816cb9c14f2118bd49bbd6c6a1b.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_90b558ac78c0ad67ff7e71bab5c347a5.text: Levei a comida à minha irmã.
sense_90b558ac78c0ad67ff7e71bab5c347a5.translation: I took the food to my sister.

sense_69377fd03d5d0d16f2ab215a8fb1de0e.text: Vamos levar com a culpa deste ataque.
sense_69377fd03d5d0d16f2ab215a8fb1de0e.translation: We will take the blame for this attack.

sense_69377fd03d5d0d16f2ab215a8fb1de0e.text: Ele levara uma flechada no joelho.
sense_69377fd03d5d0d16f2ab215a8fb1de0e.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_865339f3705fbe8c4b6c19dc74060801.translation: to miss home, to feel homesick

sense_865339f3705fbe8c4b6c19dc74060801.text: E hoje, quando do sol a claridade / Forra o meu barracão, sinto saudade / Da mulher, pomba-rola que voou
sense_865339f3705fbe8c4b6c19dc74060801.translation: And today, when the sunlight covers my home, I miss the woman, the dove who flew away.

sense_d169555ee7ace4755b30171e16592e5b.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_d169555ee7ace4755b30171e16592e5b.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_d169555ee7ace4755b30171e16592e5b.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_d169555ee7ace4755b30171e16592e5b.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_21a9fe5856700b46ac22f700b94eb778.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_21a9fe5856700b46ac22f700b94eb778.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_21a9fe5856700b46ac22f700b94eb778.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_21a9fe5856700b46ac22f700b94eb778.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_2fde919887748f332ebfdaa464d85f44.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_2fde919887748f332ebfdaa464d85f44.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_2fde919887748f332ebfdaa464d85f44.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_2fde919887748f332ebfdaa464d85f44.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_2fde919887748f332ebfdaa464d85f44.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_dcd78de066e2452d127ea5b721987e35.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_da908c5f68e7ecab61e2a25733a9f769.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_da908c5f68e7ecab61e2a25733a9f769.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_49ffd8d53a45b0767ebf97169edc05f2.text: Você está afastado enquanto investigamos as alegações de corrupção.
sense_49ffd8d53a45b0767ebf97169edc05f2.translation: You are suspended while we investigate the corruption allegations.

sense_49ffd8d53a45b0767ebf97169edc05f2.text: […]o atleta Eduardo Bauermann foi comunicado que está afastado preventivamente dos treinos com o elenco profissional, a partir desta terça-feira[…]
sense_49ffd8d53a45b0767ebf97169edc05f2.translation: The athlete Eduardo Bauermann has been made aware he is preemptively suspended from training with the professional team starting this Tuesday.

sense_39ed4f869a34e12dcb2c5edb3a81b133.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_71aea10ad8914c6e9058776c7a920510.text: O acontecimento começou um debate sobre o crime.
sense_71aea10ad8914c6e9058776c7a920510.translation: The occurrence started a debate about crime.

sense_71aea10ad8914c6e9058776c7a920510.text: Aperte play para começar o vídeo.
sense_71aea10ad8914c6e9058776c7a920510.translation: Press play to start the video.

sense_5dd2356da4c5102b02be7ba8805417bf.text: A TV não está ligada na tomada.
sense_5dd2356da4c5102b02be7ba8805417bf.translation: The TV is not plugged in (lit.: not linked in the socket).

sense_5dd2356da4c5102b02be7ba8805417bf.text: De acordo com o documento, o governador está ligado ao esquema de corrupção.
sense_5dd2356da4c5102b02be7ba8805417bf.translation: According to the report, the governor is linked to the corruption scheme.

sense_591e4b9a0c03da2104ae24813c62c8f9.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_591e4b9a0c03da2104ae24813c62c8f9.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_129c191d5f5f7950721bcb2e4a6d8260.text: Corre o boato que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_129c191d5f5f7950721bcb2e4a6d8260.translation: The rumour/rumor that I am about to die is running around.

sense_129c191d5f5f7950721bcb2e4a6d8260.text: Corre que eu estou prestes a morrer.
sense_129c191d5f5f7950721bcb2e4a6d8260.translation: [Rumour/rumor] has it that I am about to die.

sense_9590427395a2323280cd7b3303f4111b.text: Fiquei observando as gotas correndo na janela.
sense_9590427395a2323280cd7b3303f4111b.translation: I was observing the drops flowing on the window.

sense_9590427395a2323280cd7b3303f4111b.text: O Tejo é mais bello que o rio que corre pela minha aldeia
sense_9590427395a2323280cd7b3303f4111b.translation: The Tagus is more beautiful than the river that flows through my village

sense_3967a75f36d1a55c93a50a39c2307b11.text: […] o empurrou tão rijo que deu com elle da eſcotilha abaixo […]
sense_3967a75f36d1a55c93a50a39c2307b11.translation: […] he pushed him so roughly that he sent him down the hatch […]

sense_3967a75f36d1a55c93a50a39c2307b11.text: Ele se aproximou e experimentou empurrá-la.
sense_3967a75f36d1a55c93a50a39c2307b11.translation: He came closer and tried to push it.

sense_2e1462734c3588805c4d12fb52e38075.text: O vendedor ficou me empurrando essa caixinha de som, e acabou que eu voltei com três.
sense_2e1462734c3588805c4d12fb52e38075.translation: The salesman kept pushing these speakers to me, and I ended up coming home with three.

sense_2e1462734c3588805c4d12fb52e38075.text: Mas ſobreveyo Perdiccas amigo de Agathocles, & empurrando hũa mentira com outra o tirou a ſalvo […]
sense_2e1462734c3588805c4d12fb52e38075.translation: But Perdiccas, friend of Agathocles, appeared and, pushing one lie after the other, got him out safely […]

sense_b7f42bb3c172aa2fdc5e2345bf1a4336.translation: It is easy to annoy someone.

sense_d37262a929e975c85bc5827538d3bb16.text: Desconectar o computador direto da tomada sem desligá-lo antes pode queimá-lo.
sense_d37262a929e975c85bc5827538d3bb16.translation: Unplugging the computer directly without turning it off first may break it.

sense_31bb2db1b7f9ca3d2dbda6316629b5a8.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_ea6d55cfada9c339e187a01a8e11f509.translation: He had taken an arrow to the knee.

sense_7a3cfd77e5b18d555e93b3ae5f5d6f71.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_7a3cfd77e5b18d555e93b3ae5f5d6f71.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_f758136be7e69dcb8fd537be8dab1a38.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_f758136be7e69dcb8fd537be8dab1a38.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_f8e6a3a89085b60a3c38b8ae80d4d85b.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_f8e6a3a89085b60a3c38b8ae80d4d85b.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_535078843d3821c12a02314443abfb19.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_535078843d3821c12a02314443abfb19.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_71a33e60ba4a62f334bf7fceeeb1d1bc.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_71a33e60ba4a62f334bf7fceeeb1d1bc.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_71a33e60ba4a62f334bf7fceeeb1d1bc.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_71a33e60ba4a62f334bf7fceeeb1d1bc.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_85efb320731f0702ab530836a0fa82cc.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_85efb320731f0702ab530836a0fa82cc.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_85efb320731f0702ab530836a0fa82cc.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_85efb320731f0702ab530836a0fa82cc.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_293c3c9e673817f1265ec0e6b284e9f7.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_293c3c9e673817f1265ec0e6b284e9f7.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_75b75350a2f4cbf093ba06cbcb031fd5.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_75b75350a2f4cbf093ba06cbcb031fd5.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_29d9d4e839d1a13133685f6ab6b3491e.text: A chuva de granizo que deu ontem estragou a porcaria do telhado.
sense_29d9d4e839d1a13133685f6ab6b3491e.translation: Yesterday's hailstorm destroyed the damn roof.

sense_1457d65acd4048e4ad62b05abcbf2735.translation: It is easy to annoy someone.

sense_858e35599480b77dee006ada41d71534.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_858e35599480b77dee006ada41d71534.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.

sense_deae5bd767bd0509e47c26835e80b100.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
sense_deae5bd767bd0509e47c26835e80b100.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

sense_deae5bd767bd0509e47c26835e80b100.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
sense_deae5bd767bd0509e47c26835e80b100.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

sense_8ca05ac72dc1173de7a62399f7cbc1a9.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_90cd301546f30ee63c63119e19f63091.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_90cd301546f30ee63c63119e19f63091.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_90cd301546f30ee63c63119e19f63091.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_90cd301546f30ee63c63119e19f63091.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_90cd301546f30ee63c63119e19f63091.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_90cd301546f30ee63c63119e19f63091.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_858907f42e0e22e007a8b14cd3df3b2c.text: Eu receberia uma bolada no rosto se ficasse lá.
sense_858907f42e0e22e007a8b14cd3df3b2c.translation: I would be hit in the face by a ball if I stayed there.

sense_b8ef9cac1051170629673749849f90fa.text: Ele se colocou em último lugar na maratona.
sense_b8ef9cac1051170629673749849f90fa.translation: He got last place in the marathon.

sense_b8ef9cac1051170629673749849f90fa.text: É praticamente impossível se colocar entre os três primeiros.
sense_b8ef9cac1051170629673749849f90fa.translation: It’s nearly impossible to place in the top three positions.

sense_64f14d60e4467920fa58ce11acd8a8fd.text: Não reclame, pois foi você mesmo que se colocou nessa situação.
sense_64f14d60e4467920fa58ce11acd8a8fd.translation: Don’t complain, you put yourself in this situation.

sense_64f14d60e4467920fa58ce11acd8a8fd.text: O pobre rapaz, que conhecia a falsa posição em que se collocara com a sua phrase, sentia-se humilhado e como que vendido n’aquelle meio.
sense_64f14d60e4467920fa58ce11acd8a8fd.translation: The poor young lad, who knew the false position in which he had put himself with his phrase, felt humiliated and embarrassed in the group.

sense_b16960d4904144815be9558e909b8030.text: Coloca as chaves em cima da mesa, faz favor.
sense_b16960d4904144815be9558e909b8030.translation: Put the keys on the table, please.

sense_b16960d4904144815be9558e909b8030.text: Fui collocar a chicara na bandeja.
sense_b16960d4904144815be9558e909b8030.translation: I went to set the teacup on the tray.

sense_2c6a3e0d9a1a71375725dbe767eaf0bf.text: Fico feliz que você me entenda.
sense_2c6a3e0d9a1a71375725dbe767eaf0bf.translation: I'm glad that you understand me.

sense_0aeb3e8adc1af3d3bc8fbb859c328539.text: Liguem os motores e se preparem para a largada!
sense_0aeb3e8adc1af3d3bc8fbb859c328539.translation: Turn your engines on and prepare for the start of the race!

sense_40c966e5196e4518056102fba60a66e3.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_40c966e5196e4518056102fba60a66e3.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_26f56ff1042ff009ef455aa93c19aeb5.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_26f56ff1042ff009ef455aa93c19aeb5.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_0d01b4ffe3b681011196066d8f774f29.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_0d01b4ffe3b681011196066d8f774f29.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_0d01b4ffe3b681011196066d8f774f29.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_0d01b4ffe3b681011196066d8f774f29.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_ebcfdb5171070b498132266af7ec9fab.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_ebcfdb5171070b498132266af7ec9fab.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_95fe07177790aac05fe1fbd4dc81326a.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_95fe07177790aac05fe1fbd4dc81326a.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_7f7388bb73394e9e2fed08cb1000bdf5.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_7a6d47f3ca9e2fc4cb60a299a16e674f.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_7a6d47f3ca9e2fc4cb60a299a16e674f.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_7a6d47f3ca9e2fc4cb60a299a16e674f.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_d9abf22b1b391e34801e80ba0d0d902f.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_d9abf22b1b391e34801e80ba0d0d902f.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_9b3b1163a0fe0d348c97ff7d21129c0b.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_83a132abd6b2912666b7c3a4c64748d2.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_83a132abd6b2912666b7c3a4c64748d2.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_0d43f7f82c7200708fa9260728ff52b9.text: Vocês estão cegos? A resposta é óbvia!
sense_0d43f7f82c7200708fa9260728ff52b9.translation: Are you guys blind? The answer is obvious!

sense_a2606c02660bf10fc5fbd864ee32538c.translation: I became blind in my left eye.

sense_e19313b1048db44ac7fc73fa3689c9ad.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_1e8f9a980534c1d9469b5dcb10ba0dda.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_1e8f9a980534c1d9469b5dcb10ba0dda.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_114e02cf359518e968373b8992fe6b2e.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_114e02cf359518e968373b8992fe6b2e.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_dc42a5673c9e4d35466cfe7ad59d6fd0.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_932efed9c318d7cddd88fcf7f5bf92b9.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_932efed9c318d7cddd88fcf7f5bf92b9.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_75edc3e6e342592a7663c3acd26221d5.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_89c76ffbd047fed10a7b92c83168c827.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_89c76ffbd047fed10a7b92c83168c827.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_5bdb8071c9f315a51fbd0ff35f0ad0ce.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_5bdb8071c9f315a51fbd0ff35f0ad0ce.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_5bdb8071c9f315a51fbd0ff35f0ad0ce.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_5bdb8071c9f315a51fbd0ff35f0ad0ce.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_e48d67280b9c57f94add0bb515fbbf24.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_e48d67280b9c57f94add0bb515fbbf24.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_e48d67280b9c57f94add0bb515fbbf24.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_e48d67280b9c57f94add0bb515fbbf24.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_b0879f1206a20855a307530acbdaac73.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_b0879f1206a20855a307530acbdaac73.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_3f84a32e3ec9a1702ebade1c8bc1b29d.text: O João e a Ana terminaram.
Terminarei com a Maria hoje mesmo.
sense_3f84a32e3ec9a1702ebade1c8bc1b29d.translation: I’ll break up with Mary today.

sense_ad32a6234748db88efad97b2053f1120.text: A morte das personagens principais terminou a história.
sense_ad32a6234748db88efad97b2053f1120.translation: The death of the main characters concluded the story.
A barrier was at the end of the path.

sense_9e9e9d9fa3ba2a7377ace4548002965a.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_2294f4c80d4abb3127e650fb090d5265.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_2294f4c80d4abb3127e650fb090d5265.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_f5088beffab657be0dbd19b5fda79ea2.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_f5088beffab657be0dbd19b5fda79ea2.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_09345840d55f75cd4c9c59b0473b14f1.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_09345840d55f75cd4c9c59b0473b14f1.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_09345840d55f75cd4c9c59b0473b14f1.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_09345840d55f75cd4c9c59b0473b14f1.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_09345840d55f75cd4c9c59b0473b14f1.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_09345840d55f75cd4c9c59b0473b14f1.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_a6ae88d1966674d6b302adf9f01d8d67.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_a6ae88d1966674d6b302adf9f01d8d67.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_a6ae88d1966674d6b302adf9f01d8d67.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_a6ae88d1966674d6b302adf9f01d8d67.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_e13f2d62d811816dc1a4ff3436eeaede.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_e13f2d62d811816dc1a4ff3436eeaede.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_e13f2d62d811816dc1a4ff3436eeaede.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_e13f2d62d811816dc1a4ff3436eeaede.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_24dda1917c4c9d1fb0979f17450a4d40.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_24dda1917c4c9d1fb0979f17450a4d40.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_24dda1917c4c9d1fb0979f17450a4d40.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_24dda1917c4c9d1fb0979f17450a4d40.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_24dda1917c4c9d1fb0979f17450a4d40.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_24dda1917c4c9d1fb0979f17450a4d40.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_ec0da06cb889e6addde2131349566713.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_ec0da06cb889e6addde2131349566713.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_ec0da06cb889e6addde2131349566713.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_ec0da06cb889e6addde2131349566713.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_0f631fe0ae43393912bcd6070d8bca64.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_0f631fe0ae43393912bcd6070d8bca64.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_0f631fe0ae43393912bcd6070d8bca64.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_0f631fe0ae43393912bcd6070d8bca64.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_0f631fe0ae43393912bcd6070d8bca64.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_0f631fe0ae43393912bcd6070d8bca64.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_035198a89225eb4a21f175fc3783021f.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_035198a89225eb4a21f175fc3783021f.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_035198a89225eb4a21f175fc3783021f.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_035198a89225eb4a21f175fc3783021f.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_c63366188c25cd16f1202a4c8ac83d39.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_c229d9847309acfbd154598f454909c3.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_c229d9847309acfbd154598f454909c3.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_c229d9847309acfbd154598f454909c3.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_c229d9847309acfbd154598f454909c3.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_c67a529c1807fd1835f0e6b582dc44b3.text: As florestas daquela região ainda estão intactas.
sense_c67a529c1807fd1835f0e6b582dc44b3.translation: The forests in that region are still untouched.
Fortunately I have emerged from the accident unscathed.

sense_55f1f89a821b1935c88d18b92efc7bc4.translation: The frost will kill the crop.

sense_dfe14cfeb6b8a0d5b909b4c66bc55a12.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_dfe14cfeb6b8a0d5b909b4c66bc55a12.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_71321a2a02ac7e759260acbfe64e0100.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_71321a2a02ac7e759260acbfe64e0100.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_71321a2a02ac7e759260acbfe64e0100.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_71321a2a02ac7e759260acbfe64e0100.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_1a50f40f614c64b45bbcc2241c5996f2.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_1a50f40f614c64b45bbcc2241c5996f2.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_1a50f40f614c64b45bbcc2241c5996f2.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_1a50f40f614c64b45bbcc2241c5996f2.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_ed5fce641ba730d78ed7758ad93dc1eb.text: A palavra “livro” significa um conjunto de páginas ligadas.
sense_ed5fce641ba730d78ed7758ad93dc1eb.translation: The word “book” means a collection of bound pages.

sense_d50f9c40cc4635fbe46838ecfb6c615e.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_d50f9c40cc4635fbe46838ecfb6c615e.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_d50f9c40cc4635fbe46838ecfb6c615e.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_2b9aba0af01bb38628fb26001672ecae.text: Emprestei para uma porção de gente, mas ninguém me devolve.
sense_2b9aba0af01bb38628fb26001672ecae.translation: I have loaned to a bunch of people, but nobody pays me back.

sense_2b9aba0af01bb38628fb26001672ecae.text: Espero alguém que me empreste seu casaco em dia de chuva.
sense_2b9aba0af01bb38628fb26001672ecae.translation: I’m waiting for someone who lends me their coat in a rainy day.

sense_e319b631106c01cff63bb76ee3f3f99c.text: Nós sentimos pela perda de sua encomenda.
sense_e319b631106c01cff63bb76ee3f3f99c.translation: We are sorry for the loss of the product you ordered.

sense_75411108b4c964334f14395cb676124e.text: Sinto que não há nada que possamos fazer.
sense_75411108b4c964334f14395cb676124e.translation: I feel that there is nothing we can do.

sense_75411108b4c964334f14395cb676124e.text: O problema é que ela sente que ninguém virá.
sense_75411108b4c964334f14395cb676124e.translation: The problem is that she thinks no one will come.

sense_df4dd9815159f83bd58940b4bc3162a8.text: Daqui já não se sente o barulho.
sense_df4dd9815159f83bd58940b4bc3162a8.translation: From here one can no longer hear the noise

sense_df4dd9815159f83bd58940b4bc3162a8.text: Já consigo sentir os seus passos chegando.
sense_df4dd9815159f83bd58940b4bc3162a8.translation: I can already overhear his footsteps coming.

sense_18b9bfc2795e11a61bfccb2edde76023.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_18b9bfc2795e11a61bfccb2edde76023.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_777d9483add535f91c798b1e9af2b71d.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_69bb692c23abdde631d482697509edc6.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_69bb692c23abdde631d482697509edc6.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_b2f8406cc86daa7e018b245b6b0df8d5.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_d6f2b46d9b3bf379842da32fc2e11e80.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_d6f2b46d9b3bf379842da32fc2e11e80.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_769c4ded2d49d6bf7846211876f9dcb3.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_49fb33194625c655d6e9eac0995b8146.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_49fb33194625c655d6e9eac0995b8146.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_cd9e533d65afced182432750b81c0d1f.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_cd9e533d65afced182432750b81c0d1f.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_cd9e533d65afced182432750b81c0d1f.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_cd9e533d65afced182432750b81c0d1f.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_dcf38900c1961b0d9ba3562d7aef8ffc.translation: A book written with a pencil.
They bludgeoned the dog to death.

sense_6f0e56a840a7729990179c8090982c84.translation: Let me show it to you...

sense_6f0e56a840a7729990179c8090982c84.text: Não é bonito dizer isso a uma pessoa.
sense_6f0e56a840a7729990179c8090982c84.translation: It's not nice to say that to a person.

sense_6db049566ffe2eb1875d9bc96ee919a2.literal_meaning: Unfortunately, a robber stole [from] her the phone.
sense_6db049566ffe2eb1875d9bc96ee919a2.text: Infelizmente, um ladrão roubou-lhe o celular.
sense_6db049566ffe2eb1875d9bc96ee919a2.translation: Unfortunately, a robber stole her phone.

sense_81501ab3af21c1df69ec11519f9336e5.text: O filme começa às duas horas.
sense_81501ab3af21c1df69ec11519f9336e5.translation: The film starts at two o’clock.

sense_383c9564e01aca1b78d6dfa10b5be754.text: É mais barato comprar comida ao quilo.
sense_383c9564e01aca1b78d6dfa10b5be754.translation: It is cheaper to by food by the kilogram.

sense_d3c870691a75728373b18a4349af5693.text: Ele puxou o temperamento ao pai.
sense_d3c870691a75728373b18a4349af5693.translation: He inherited his temperament from his father.

sense_ab4a3b30a6a10d59185937b5612ae018.text: A vila fica a onze milhas
sense_ab4a3b30a6a10d59185937b5612ae018.translation: The village is eleven miles away.

sense_037fbf4d58b96abb1c4f81e29344a59f.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_037fbf4d58b96abb1c4f81e29344a59f.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_037fbf4d58b96abb1c4f81e29344a59f.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_e8453ef88dcc2b7c00991013baceea64.text: O exército teve de abandonar o forte.
sense_e8453ef88dcc2b7c00991013baceea64.translation: The army had to abandon the fort.

sense_e8453ef88dcc2b7c00991013baceea64.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_e8453ef88dcc2b7c00991013baceea64.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_22412718764012ea80ba5bcc3884af98.text: O réu abandonou-se/se abandonou nas mãos do advogado.
sense_22412718764012ea80ba5bcc3884af98.translation: The accused put himself in his lawyer’s hands.
We let ourselves be seized by sadness.

sense_cecc7e77d61b30b24b13381861339914.text: Essa porcaria de celular barato não durou um dia.
sense_cecc7e77d61b30b24b13381861339914.translation: That bloody cheap mobile didn’t last a day.

sense_cecc7e77d61b30b24b13381861339914.text: Não se preocupe com essas pessoas baratas.
sense_cecc7e77d61b30b24b13381861339914.translation: Don’t worry about those worthless people.

sense_713cc6d82c5e6b96e7f2868c39785b37.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_713cc6d82c5e6b96e7f2868c39785b37.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_713cc6d82c5e6b96e7f2868c39785b37.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_713cc6d82c5e6b96e7f2868c39785b37.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_1860b5104f649cda9080bc273f469f6e.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_1860b5104f649cda9080bc273f469f6e.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_1110cd7176d0f3bf6fe25261a3d7fe00.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.
sense_1110cd7176d0f3bf6fe25261a3d7fe00.translation: I played Hansel and my sister played Gretel.

sense_cf1319518a855d6de6578d78f1944365.text: Estou a fazer inglês. / Estou fazendo inglês.

sense_a500f96296c230c20273be76968c9c8c.text: Sua doação concorre para o fim da miséria.
sense_a500f96296c230c20273be76968c9c8c.translation: Your donation contributes to the end of misery.
We contributed to finishing the project.

sense_26befbe77b232c85448bc80b200f0833.text: Aquele homem fez um crime terrível.
sense_26befbe77b232c85448bc80b200f0833.translation: That man committed a horrible crime.
I answered by making an affirmative gesture.

sense_05ab2954961e00f68c5db76f952e17f6.text: Eu fiz de João e a minha irmã fez de Maria.

sense_201a29e5240114c15d51afd598a10523.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_c52b790be8b46496649219d172d2c607.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_c52b790be8b46496649219d172d2c607.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_625c37543f842ff0c2cda2bf881aca34.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_625c37543f842ff0c2cda2bf881aca34.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_625c37543f842ff0c2cda2bf881aca34.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_625c37543f842ff0c2cda2bf881aca34.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_2d72990290376ef8872b56b4247264ac.text: Preencheu os bolsos com as lascas de prata, que pesavam, e isso fazia sua única veste escorregar um pouco para baixo. Não se importaria de pagar cofrinho, ninguém o observaria.
sense_2d72990290376ef8872b56b4247264ac.translation: He filled his pockets with the silver chips, who were heavy, and it made his only clothes slip a bit downwards. He didn't care to show his plumber's crack, noöne would see it.

sense_96e2e60e190a5028bd22372ba53c56f5.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.
sense_96e2e60e190a5028bd22372ba53c56f5.translation: I want to replace my car with a new one.
We have to replace the burnt-out lightbulbs.

sense_1cd0abc21bbf07abb6baf53bfe7f0fe6.text: Os boxeadores estão trocando socos na cabeça.
sense_1cd0abc21bbf07abb6baf53bfe7f0fe6.translation: The boxers are exchanging blows to their heads.

sense_1cd0abc21bbf07abb6baf53bfe7f0fe6.text: Todo dia eu trocava umas ideias com o vizinho.
sense_1cd0abc21bbf07abb6baf53bfe7f0fe6.translation: I used to chat with the neighbor every single day.

sense_218f7e7294a93ab313e9f4599aefc6d9.text: Troco um par de sapatos por uma blusa.
sense_218f7e7294a93ab313e9f4599aefc6d9.translation: I’ll exchange a pair of shoes for a blouse.

sense_218f7e7294a93ab313e9f4599aefc6d9.text: Eu e o meu primo trocamos livros.
sense_218f7e7294a93ab313e9f4599aefc6d9.translation: My cousin and I traded books.

sense_218f7e7294a93ab313e9f4599aefc6d9.text: O explorador trocou presentes com os nativos.
sense_218f7e7294a93ab313e9f4599aefc6d9.translation: The explorer exchanged gifts with the natives.

sense_67fd2f51d5ec5922a47ccf827c51efd1.text: Chegamos a casa, pois agora troquemo-nos.
sense_67fd2f51d5ec5922a47ccf827c51efd1.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_f66ec4f2ab346e9fff762c81e3656ece.text: Quero trocar meu carro por um novo.
sense_f66ec4f2ab346e9fff762c81e3656ece.translation: I want to replace my car with a new one.
We have to replace the burnt-out lightbulbs.

sense_7dcb2cbd1c1c7755a411fb7d282dd3d1.translation: The boxers are exchanging blows to their heads.

sense_5c5093d3c61eeef2e69f6dff7154774a.translation: We are home, so now let's change ourselves.

sense_378f7304b745847966165c0f4f80df44.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_378f7304b745847966165c0f4f80df44.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_378f7304b745847966165c0f4f80df44.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_378f7304b745847966165c0f4f80df44.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_1b45b45dbda52d7d55844964b5f2a9db.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_1b45b45dbda52d7d55844964b5f2a9db.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_65ed0f4310cd65179f5964c147cd6adc.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_65ed0f4310cd65179f5964c147cd6adc.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_4190eef3f3edbbb549e9072b20e53863.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_4190eef3f3edbbb549e9072b20e53863.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_96887ef4cf0da61bb56578ad332bf9f3.text: Está difícil associar as coisas que você diz.
sense_96887ef4cf0da61bb56578ad332bf9f3.translation: It’s hard to associate the things you are saying.

sense_96887ef4cf0da61bb56578ad332bf9f3.text: O investigador associará os novos achados com o crime.
sense_96887ef4cf0da61bb56578ad332bf9f3.translation: The investigator will associate the new findings with the crime.

sense_1af4c55960c69cc77a72e92a1ac211b4.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_1af4c55960c69cc77a72e92a1ac211b4.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_1af4c55960c69cc77a72e92a1ac211b4.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_1af4c55960c69cc77a72e92a1ac211b4.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_1af4c55960c69cc77a72e92a1ac211b4.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_1af4c55960c69cc77a72e92a1ac211b4.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_300ddee322b8eaa650a579ee917c825f.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_300ddee322b8eaa650a579ee917c825f.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_fb33c780a814f31bee62cd89072d2840.text: Nenhum de vocês precisa pedir permissão para ninguém.
sense_fb33c780a814f31bee62cd89072d2840.translation: Neither of you has to ask anyone for permission.

sense_fb33c780a814f31bee62cd89072d2840.text: Peço que vocês parem de fazer barulho.
sense_fb33c780a814f31bee62cd89072d2840.translation: I ask you to stop making noise.

sense_fb33c780a814f31bee62cd89072d2840.text: Se está com dificuldade, peça por ajuda.
sense_fb33c780a814f31bee62cd89072d2840.translation: If you are having difficulties, ask for help.

sense_fd3a210f7a8c0771a69b21c82a898e12.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_fd3a210f7a8c0771a69b21c82a898e12.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_fd3a210f7a8c0771a69b21c82a898e12.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_fd3a210f7a8c0771a69b21c82a898e12.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_e255cfbeadc1209d96fe9773e3dc9357.text: Fui figurante naquele filme, com um papel de jurada.
sense_e255cfbeadc1209d96fe9773e3dc9357.translation: I was an extra in that film, with a jurywoman role.

sense_e255cfbeadc1209d96fe9773e3dc9357.text: Pois então o que decidiram os jurados?
sense_e255cfbeadc1209d96fe9773e3dc9357.translation: So what have the jurors decided?

sense_e255cfbeadc1209d96fe9773e3dc9357.text: Um dos jurados, certamente o que votára pela negativa,—proferiu algumas palavras de defeza do moço.
sense_e255cfbeadc1209d96fe9773e3dc9357.translation: One of the jurymen—certainly the one who had voted not guilty—uttered some words in defence of the young man.

sense_7281fdebef6b19b24add89eb60fb42c9.text: Todos os jurados lhe deram nota 10.
sense_7281fdebef6b19b24add89eb60fb42c9.translation: All the judges scored him/her a 10.

sense_7281fdebef6b19b24add89eb60fb42c9.text: Ele já foi jurado de muitos programas de TV desde os anos 80.
sense_7281fdebef6b19b24add89eb60fb42c9.translation: He has been a judge in many TV shows since the 80s.

sense_2e59281e68738573570ed40b6f55cf7f.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_2e59281e68738573570ed40b6f55cf7f.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_2e59281e68738573570ed40b6f55cf7f.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_2e59281e68738573570ed40b6f55cf7f.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_ab31b535f89b06626eb98fcb93bcf9c7.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_ab31b535f89b06626eb98fcb93bcf9c7.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_3b5e778c5574bff33850419e32a85e12.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_3b5e778c5574bff33850419e32a85e12.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_36c8c269c02abfd74bbf60023f3802c2.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_36c8c269c02abfd74bbf60023f3802c2.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_77629226ea2d7481893e39258e9c6eb3.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_77629226ea2d7481893e39258e9c6eb3.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_77629226ea2d7481893e39258e9c6eb3.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_77629226ea2d7481893e39258e9c6eb3.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_29b782af4905b9f4cdb33260ef6eef73.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_29b782af4905b9f4cdb33260ef6eef73.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_29b782af4905b9f4cdb33260ef6eef73.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_29b782af4905b9f4cdb33260ef6eef73.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_d2386ed026dec33f327f58820aaafe5b.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_d2386ed026dec33f327f58820aaafe5b.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_19bc3ca442bd0ed6a31daacef9d1a423.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_19bc3ca442bd0ed6a31daacef9d1a423.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_e70cdf2e9bafd98c0b6fd24106285e76.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_e70cdf2e9bafd98c0b6fd24106285e76.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_e70cdf2e9bafd98c0b6fd24106285e76.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_e70cdf2e9bafd98c0b6fd24106285e76.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_5fde1198946e1510d63ce94a35d5e06b.text: Ela não gosta de tomar sopa.
sense_5fde1198946e1510d63ce94a35d5e06b.translation: She doesn't like to eat soup.

sense_b5b86f9482be9403314e3878aa3b1d3b.text: Formigas. Formiguinhas pequenininhas, marchando em linha. E elas falam. Elas dizem coisas impossíveis de entender porque eu não falo formiguês.
sense_b5b86f9482be9403314e3878aa3b1d3b.translation: Ants. Little, tiny ants, marching in line. And they speak. They say things impossible to understand because I don't speak antese.

sense_b5b86f9482be9403314e3878aa3b1d3b.text: — E que língua se falava na Bélgica, afinal?
sense_b5b86f9482be9403314e3878aa3b1d3b.translation: And what language do they speak in Belgium anyway?

sense_2a6be0a8f83f689dd2508ac4af0652c7.translation: Can I help you in any way?

sense_769792d569d2dbaef8ea58d2a8e1fb9d.text: Ela lutou e lutou, mas nunca conseguiu uma vida melhor.
sense_769792d569d2dbaef8ea58d2a8e1fb9d.translation: She fought and fought, but never got a better life.

sense_769792d569d2dbaef8ea58d2a8e1fb9d.text: Eles lutaram pelo fim da guerra.
sense_769792d569d2dbaef8ea58d2a8e1fb9d.translation: They fought for the war to end.

sense_70e345b2f6d06016cc0f48513803b4b3.text: Deixe que os polacos lutem contra os invasores.
sense_70e345b2f6d06016cc0f48513803b4b3.translation: Let the Polish fight the invaders.
I kept laughing at the little children fighting [one another].

sense_70e345b2f6d06016cc0f48513803b4b3.text: A legião deve lutar com os hunos ainda hoje.
sense_70e345b2f6d06016cc0f48513803b4b3.translation: The legion should fight the Huns today.

sense_cc64604a2a0567ea44a7f35f92cbf7db.text: Meu irmão disse que lutaria na guerra.
sense_cc64604a2a0567ea44a7f35f92cbf7db.translation: My brother said he would fight in the war.

sense_cc64604a2a0567ea44a7f35f92cbf7db.text: Nosso exército ficou com medo de lutar.
sense_cc64604a2a0567ea44a7f35f92cbf7db.translation: Our army was scared to fight.

sense_cc64604a2a0567ea44a7f35f92cbf7db.text: Hoje morreu o último veterano que lutou a batalha de Verdun.
sense_cc64604a2a0567ea44a7f35f92cbf7db.translation: The last veteran who fought in the Battle of Verdun died today.

sense_77d4f5e15c068fad1dcbf8e61cc6fd36.text: Não lutes, tomarás a vacina quer queira ou não.
sense_77d4f5e15c068fad1dcbf8e61cc6fd36.translation: Don’t struggle, you will be vaccinated whether you like it or not.

sense_77d4f5e15c068fad1dcbf8e61cc6fd36.text: Se tentarem te assaltar, faça tudo que mandarem e não lute.
sense_77d4f5e15c068fad1dcbf8e61cc6fd36.translation: If they try to rob you, do everything they tell you and don’t struggle.

sense_1b6f847af1b2cba428414ba9fd2b7637.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_1b6f847af1b2cba428414ba9fd2b7637.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_1b6f847af1b2cba428414ba9fd2b7637.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_8023ba350492065c317860bf200edf39.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_8023ba350492065c317860bf200edf39.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_21b5d07aab37b00803d7269ad21ca779.text: Não me lembro onde pus as chaves.
sense_21b5d07aab37b00803d7269ad21ca779.translation: I don’t remember where I put the keys.

sense_21b5d07aab37b00803d7269ad21ca779.text: […] abriu a gaveta do armário, pegou um alfinete de segurança, parou diante de mim, tirou a medalha da minha mão e se curvou e a pôs no meu colete […]
sense_21b5d07aab37b00803d7269ad21ca779.translation: […] she opened the wardrobe’s drawer, took out a safety pin, stood in front of me, took the medal from my hand and kneeled and put it on my vest […]

sense_fa92a0fe5ecbee929bb6eb000a0c4dcb.translation: His dream was to visit Paris.

sense_4cd2581f2a10f55d01270b2ce857b3f7.text: ... mas ele não vai retribuir o meu amor.
sense_4cd2581f2a10f55d01270b2ce857b3f7.translation: ... but he won’t love me back.

sense_4cd2581f2a10f55d01270b2ce857b3f7.text: Ela se recusa a retribuir nossas chamadas.
sense_4cd2581f2a10f55d01270b2ce857b3f7.translation: She has refused to call us back.

sense_3fe72663570fe661ed86f927392c7a83.text: Não sei fazer isso, mas ela sabe.
sense_3fe72663570fe661ed86f927392c7a83.translation: I don’t know how to do this, but she knows.

sense_d5d2e714d9b445b5907bf1ac210afc6c.text: Perguntaram-me a resposta, mas eu não sabia.
sense_d5d2e714d9b445b5907bf1ac210afc6c.translation: They asked me the answer, but I didn’t know.

sense_a76cce4aaab6c9ca5e670a2b7f83f65f.text: Eu sei qual é a capital da Assíria.
sense_a76cce4aaab6c9ca5e670a2b7f83f65f.translation: I know what is the capital of Assyria.

sense_a76cce4aaab6c9ca5e670a2b7f83f65f.text: Olho-Tonto, você sabe que isso é nojento, não sabe?
sense_a76cce4aaab6c9ca5e670a2b7f83f65f.translation: Mad-Eye, you know that this is disgusting, don't you?

sense_a76cce4aaab6c9ca5e670a2b7f83f65f.text: Ele sabe duzentos algarismos do número neperiano.
sense_a76cce4aaab6c9ca5e670a2b7f83f65f.translation: He knows two hundred digits of Euler’s number.

sense_7077fdf7220611cdbccf9ef5775ed50b.text: De novo, através da investigação, torna-se claro.
sense_7077fdf7220611cdbccf9ef5775ed50b.translation: Again, by investigation, it becomes clear.

sense_a28c1c29c2ea4b06652836c2860c9510.text: Chore o preço até que o diminuam.
sense_a28c1c29c2ea4b06652836c2860c9510.translation: Haggle for the price until they lower it.

sense_a28c1c29c2ea4b06652836c2860c9510.text: Chorei, chorei, até que o vendedor baixou o preço.
sense_a28c1c29c2ea4b06652836c2860c9510.translation: I haggled and haggled until the salesman lowered the price.

sense_50c5894ca95bbe822bbaab178c697f2d.text: Não faça barulho, senão pode acordar os vizinhos.
sense_50c5894ca95bbe822bbaab178c697f2d.translation: Don’t make noise, or you could wake the neighbours up.
Honestly, you're going to wake everyone up!

sense_cb20920ab32bc654a922b4bc2978ad23.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos a Londres.
sense_cb20920ab32bc654a922b4bc2978ad23.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_cb20920ab32bc654a922b4bc2978ad23.text: Em algumas horas chegaremos em Londres.
sense_cb20920ab32bc654a922b4bc2978ad23.translation: In a few hours we will arrive at London.

sense_c8f224bcb3a2332b17e01b15fa45693f.text: Eu lembro-me do que ele disse.

sense_3d45fed10f903194a7d8649c733d2189.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.
