sense_9c441c94e955feb54ecb6bd8e1475230.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_9c441c94e955feb54ecb6bd8e1475230.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_9c441c94e955feb54ecb6bd8e1475230.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_939c114da1b42cb003bbecf8fcd78a1d.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_939c114da1b42cb003bbecf8fcd78a1d.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_939c114da1b42cb003bbecf8fcd78a1d.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_939c114da1b42cb003bbecf8fcd78a1d.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_cd8a2d2fc08f309db1c86a47dc52b7f4.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_cd8a2d2fc08f309db1c86a47dc52b7f4.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_40d595d3b64499c6e3674e2015c44aca.text: A chuva de granizo que deu ontem estragou a porcaria do telhado.
sense_40d595d3b64499c6e3674e2015c44aca.translation: Yesterday's hailstorm destroyed the damn roof.

sense_32f1f4077425bf69fa36c9294144e9ac.text: Este livro trata o tema da matemática.
sense_32f1f4077425bf69fa36c9294144e9ac.translation: This book covers the subject of mathematics.

sense_32f1f4077425bf69fa36c9294144e9ac.text: Este livro trata de vários temas.

sense_765d5c8f43cb1643ff45b2ea633e0151.text: A Igreja dá conforto aos pobres.
sense_765d5c8f43cb1643ff45b2ea633e0151.translation: The Church gives the poor comfort.

sense_aac5ff046758f589efeaba7a92d9c54d.text: A cerca me deu um choque elétrico.
sense_aac5ff046758f589efeaba7a92d9c54d.translation: The fence gave me an electric shock.

sense_49a416ed52d8f9e1e86c346e1211f933.translation: That well used to produce water.

sense_cd1d1e03991554e0eaa91f1a81818b4f.text: O João vai nos dar recomendações.

sense_e0897bdad3611028273da313a92c03ab.text: A minha equipa vai dar dois a zero à tua.
Meu time vai dar de dois a zero no seu.

sense_b7c505fb08775530a38e321fe56d4844.translation:
– Can we reach him?
– Yes, we can.

sense_b7c505fb08775530a38e321fe56d4844.text: Não dá para ele fazer isso.

sense_33edfe6d5ea25466487caaf7fe5dad0b.text: Roupas novas podem causar uma boa impressão.
sense_33edfe6d5ea25466487caaf7fe5dad0b.translation: New clothes may cause a good impression.

sense_e59f54e00b7b01c83f3506b44c800706.text: Meti o livro na mochila e fui embora.
sense_e59f54e00b7b01c83f3506b44c800706.translation: I put my book in my backpack and left.

sense_e59f54e00b7b01c83f3506b44c800706.text: Descalçou-se, metteu as meias no bolso, tirou o paletot, a gravata e o collarinho, roncou alliviado.
sense_e59f54e00b7b01c83f3506b44c800706.translation: He took off his shoes, shoved his socks in his pocket, shrugged off his overcoat, his tie and his collar, and snored relieved.

sense_497cb68af49981d066b6d58dd3d151ca.text: Se ela chegar, avise o diretor, por favor.
sense_497cb68af49981d066b6d58dd3d151ca.translation: If she arrives, inform the director, please.

sense_497cb68af49981d066b6d58dd3d151ca.text: Se precisar de mais papel verde, me avisa.
sense_497cb68af49981d066b6d58dd3d151ca.translation: If you need more green paper, let me know.

sense_8d898bbb253f93e596c95df5c5b6566c.text: Tu não consegues levantar o piano.
É algo que levantei do chão.
sense_8d898bbb253f93e596c95df5c5b6566c.translation: It’s something I lifted from the floor.

sense_58d6b4fde3e4e3076aee808311e78657.text: Permita-me reduzir a tua ignorância sobre o assunto.
sense_58d6b4fde3e4e3076aee808311e78657.translation: Allow me to reduce your ignorance on the subject.

sense_58d6b4fde3e4e3076aee808311e78657.text: Nunca estive mais orgulhoso da minha ignorância.
sense_58d6b4fde3e4e3076aee808311e78657.translation: I have never been more proud of my ignorance.

sense_6ee5aedefc6f99cf4f96532747cca3c6.text: A segunda batalha foi muito mais violenta.
sense_6ee5aedefc6f99cf4f96532747cca3c6.translation: The second battle was a lot more violent.

sense_07f9edfd0ead8b4aea38f87609760778.text: Você está afastado enquanto investigamos as alegações de corrupção.
sense_07f9edfd0ead8b4aea38f87609760778.translation: You are suspended while we investigate the corruption allegations.

sense_07f9edfd0ead8b4aea38f87609760778.text: […]o atleta Eduardo Bauermann foi comunicado que está afastado preventivamente dos treinos com o elenco profissional, a partir desta terça-feira[…]
sense_07f9edfd0ead8b4aea38f87609760778.translation: The athlete Eduardo Bauermann has been made aware he is preemptively suspended from training with the professional team starting this Tuesday.

sense_3b856bcf38a0dce48d7cf807d4f8cd8b.translation: I got out of the swimming pool.

sense_67645a590554f2627413d73d812152e0.translation: My book had come out that week.

sense_6902f9a3342803aa18d3f453ce2f8407.translation: I stopped working at the market.

sense_02ad364df3df1deb67f16b1e605add0f.text: Comprando duas, tá saindo cada uma por R$ 60.
sense_02ad364df3df1deb67f16b1e605add0f.translation: If you buy two, they'll cost R$ 60 each.

sense_11a48f83ad981c00cebe0e08820afd64.text: No tabuleiro político, ganha quem investir mais em publicidade.
sense_11a48f83ad981c00cebe0e08820afd64.translation: In the political gameboard, he who invests most in publicity wins.

sense_11a48f83ad981c00cebe0e08820afd64.text: A Europa foi um tabuleiro durante a segunda guerra mundial.
sense_11a48f83ad981c00cebe0e08820afd64.translation: Europe was a gameboard during the Second World War.

sense_fafbda469356030f607a33c1fd4a2a92.translation: His friends addicted him to drugs.

sense_8c4d4a2dc3c068c18b458353a6a623a5.text: Quando é que tiras a carta?
sense_8c4d4a2dc3c068c18b458353a6a623a5.translation: When are you going to get your driving license?
I got the highest score on the exam!

sense_03ba8f7fb5f8f2076a660096bc1c6230.translation: We need to take that out of the kitchen.

sense_03ba8f7fb5f8f2076a660096bc1c6230.text: Não lhe tire isso; é a única coisa que ela tem.
sense_03ba8f7fb5f8f2076a660096bc1c6230.translation: Don't take that away from her; it's the only thing she has.

sense_bbbf3d089b668cf22b7812efa6759a23.translation: I travelled to a distant village.

sense_83de8cac5a9d55595abd2aaa662d473a.translation: They found some coins inside the chest.

sense_4842a76986313784b95d9dc1bd6e6886.translation: The book is on the table.

sense_4842a76986313784b95d9dc1bd6e6886.text: Então o sorriso reapareceu em seu rosto [...]
sense_4842a76986313784b95d9dc1bd6e6886.translation: Then the smile reappeared on his face …

sense_f2b4b35e00011b37905330cf27ed2ddc.text: Quero dar um soco na tua cara.
sense_f2b4b35e00011b37905330cf27ed2ddc.translation: I want to punch you in the face.
Shove a lawsuit down their throats.

sense_7df145d70be5982d76d7c79e4bac0843.text: Esse papel de parede é um excelente pormenor.
sense_7df145d70be5982d76d7c79e4bac0843.translation: That wallpaper is an excellent detail.

sense_19340f6d96d6a96b614a3a14564d5fd0.text: As plantas crescem mais rapidamente em estufas.

sense_53c77c838ae1d25c56ccbc4fee722a8c.text: Está difícil associar as coisas que você diz.
sense_53c77c838ae1d25c56ccbc4fee722a8c.translation: It’s hard to associate the things you are saying.

sense_53c77c838ae1d25c56ccbc4fee722a8c.text: O investigador associará os novos achados com o crime.
sense_53c77c838ae1d25c56ccbc4fee722a8c.translation: The investigator will associate the new findings with the crime.

sense_4508baaa79cba42dc9c0ca70a17f0a7b.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_4508baaa79cba42dc9c0ca70a17f0a7b.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_621f9ce6f27d52594d47d2e60ea19d33.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_621f9ce6f27d52594d47d2e60ea19d33.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_621f9ce6f27d52594d47d2e60ea19d33.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_621f9ce6f27d52594d47d2e60ea19d33.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_c82230a28b4e996b3a6b1a692f983164.text: Eu preciso ir lá hoje porque amanhã vai estar fechado.
sense_c82230a28b4e996b3a6b1a692f983164.translation: I must go there today because it will be closed tomorrow.

sense_219ddfea09ab432f8f452f7092fd0f3d.text: Os agricultores queriam colher o trigo.
sense_219ddfea09ab432f8f452f7092fd0f3d.translation: The farmers wanted to harvest the wheat.

sense_219ddfea09ab432f8f452f7092fd0f3d.text: Ô Rosa, Rosinha / Quisera possuir teu coração / E ter o teu amor por toda a vida
sense_219ddfea09ab432f8f452f7092fd0f3d.translation: Oh, Rose, sweet Rose / I’d like to own your heart / And have your love for all my life

sense_48a8249db77a4fb36ea2410f3093854c.text: A palavra “livro” significa um conjunto de páginas ligadas.
sense_48a8249db77a4fb36ea2410f3093854c.translation: The word “book” means a collection of bound pages.

sense_1ee36754ef72bbafab724815cc994359.text: O exército teve de abandonar o forte.
sense_1ee36754ef72bbafab724815cc994359.translation: The army had to abandon the fort.

sense_1ee36754ef72bbafab724815cc994359.text: Não o perdoou por abandonar o serviço em vez de seguir você.
sense_1ee36754ef72bbafab724815cc994359.translation: She didn't forgive him for abandoning his service instead of following you.

sense_6712bdb0f614a6c721aa06b788ab6799.text: O réu abandonou-se/se abandonou nas mãos do advogado.
sense_6712bdb0f614a6c721aa06b788ab6799.translation: The accused put himself in his lawyer’s hands.
We let ourselves be seized by sadness.

sense_f7c216818aef21e676e2dc6a330bea12.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_3b6c3ae063ef50b3ee4098e5d15e0256.text: Calças rosas, roxas, de cetim ou veludo, camisas com brilhos e golas, rostos com maquiagem cintilante e coisas do tipo. Parece look de drag queen "montada", mas não era bem assim.
sense_3b6c3ae063ef50b3ee4098e5d15e0256.translation: Pink or purple pants, made of satin or velvet, shirts with glitter and collars, faces with shimmering makeup and the like. It looks like the outfit of a drag queen "en femme", but it wasn’t quite like that.

sense_3b6c3ae063ef50b3ee4098e5d15e0256.text: Ao falar sobre suas fotografias, uma crossdresser, certa vez, afirmou: "quando posto ou vejo uma fotografia minha montada é como se eu estivesse montada naquele momento, mesmo que eu não esteja, sabe?".
sense_3b6c3ae063ef50b3ee4098e5d15e0256.translation: While talking about her photographs, a crossdresser once said: "when I post or look at a picture of myself en femme, it’s as if I were en femme in that moment, even if I’m not, you know?".

sense_2a89af56610d05ef07ea262903c5a8bf.text: Eu me dediquei muito para conseguir este emprego.
sense_2a89af56610d05ef07ea262903c5a8bf.translation: I really dedicated myself (in order) to get this job.
She dedicated herself to her studies.

sense_2ea826e6fcd07d2bc8fe1c854b6ae086.text: Mandei o recepcionista ver um táxi para o meu pai.
sense_2ea826e6fcd07d2bc8fe1c854b6ae086.translation: I told the receptionist to get a cab for my dad.

sense_2ea826e6fcd07d2bc8fe1c854b6ae086.text: Por favor, me vê 500 g de queijo.
sense_2ea826e6fcd07d2bc8fe1c854b6ae086.translation: I would like 500 g of cheese, please.

sense_1e6f95348a4a590383d2f8c0cf63fbe9.text: Veja se o jantar já está pronto.
Fomos ver quando é que os meteorologistas previam que ia chover.
sense_1e6f95348a4a590383d2f8c0cf63fbe9.translation: We went to check when the meteorologists predicted it was going to rain.

sense_7a1ce641d47bf95df47ab623629b9496.text: Estas botas são porcarias e baratas porque vêm da China.
sense_7a1ce641d47bf95df47ab623629b9496.translation: These boots are crap and cheap because they are from China.

sense_8bf45674bc671fbe1a5b0bd9ac6c777f.text: O inseticida prometeu que acabaria com as baratas.
sense_8bf45674bc671fbe1a5b0bd9ac6c777f.translation: The insecticide promised to exterminate cockroaches.

sense_8bf45674bc671fbe1a5b0bd9ac6c777f.text: Nosso time acabou com o deles!

sense_319d80748d7e377759ab73c9efd55924.text: Eu ficava complicando tudo no nosso jogo.
sense_319d80748d7e377759ab73c9efd55924.translation: I would keep complicating everything in our game.

sense_319d80748d7e377759ab73c9efd55924.text: João fica lendo o dia inteiro.
sense_319d80748d7e377759ab73c9efd55924.translation: John tends to read all day.

sense_319d80748d7e377759ab73c9efd55924.text: Esses caras ficam só falando, não fazem nada, tá ligado?
sense_319d80748d7e377759ab73c9efd55924.translation: Those guys be only talkin', no actin', know what I mean?

sense_77ca0313710f581e6fa37a6eb55b6c85.text: A casa dela fica na esquina desse quarteirão.
sense_77ca0313710f581e6fa37a6eb55b6c85.translation: Her house is on the corner of this block.

sense_77ca0313710f581e6fa37a6eb55b6c85.text: Londres fica no sul da Inglaterra.
sense_77ca0313710f581e6fa37a6eb55b6c85.translation: London is in the south of England.

sense_3c55211cf48fa89de0822b2457c65fa5.translation: We were disgusted by that food.

sense_b1a4a99c8a634d07ea535986186ba1b7.text: Ela ficou em casa, não quis vir com a gente.
sense_b1a4a99c8a634d07ea535986186ba1b7.translation: She stayed home, didn't wanna come with us.

sense_b1a4a99c8a634d07ea535986186ba1b7.text: E quantos serão bastante tolos para ficar longe de mim?
sense_b1a4a99c8a634d07ea535986186ba1b7.translation: And how many will be foolish enough to stay away from me?

sense_3523ffbab6d48cf7abac7d5de6491d4f.text: Como assim vais sair com esta tempestade sem agasalho? Estás-te a passar?
sense_3523ffbab6d48cf7abac7d5de6491d4f.translation: What do you mean you're going out in this storm without a coat? Are you going crazy?
She went off the deep end.

sense_f7563cf5617bf855a16fdc26f5c247f4.text: Demorou anos para a dor nas minhas costas passar.
sense_f7563cf5617bf855a16fdc26f5c247f4.translation: It took years for the pain in my back to go away.
The time for planting has passed.

sense_7625912d9fe0d894fdb61f69827bb3a8.text: Querem que eu passe a geografia.
sense_7625912d9fe0d894fdb61f69827bb3a8.translation: They want me to pass geography.

sense_7625912d9fe0d894fdb61f69827bb3a8.text: São poucos que passam no vestibular.
sense_7625912d9fe0d894fdb61f69827bb3a8.translation: Few people pass the university admittance test.

sense_8fbfadb00739aa0eed20278877413647.text: Meu filho idiota não passará da quinta série.
sense_8fbfadb00739aa0eed20278877413647.translation: My stupid son won’t pass fifth grade.

sense_8fbfadb00739aa0eed20278877413647.text: Estudei e mesmo assim não passei.
sense_8fbfadb00739aa0eed20278877413647.translation: I studied but I still didn’t pass.

sense_bad6b5bc3af0283ffe60c80f5eb3e9eb.text: O preço da maçã passou de trinta centavos durante a seca.
sense_bad6b5bc3af0283ffe60c80f5eb3e9eb.translation: The price an apple went over thirty cents during the drought.

sense_5bdeb6f8b6de0e3f2db6511eed760402.text: Por que você passou a sua vez?
sense_5bdeb6f8b6de0e3f2db6511eed760402.translation: Why did you skip your turn?

sense_2f0b5e69fea9c51681a33101aab66f64.text: Não vi ninguém passar pela casa.
sense_2f0b5e69fea9c51681a33101aab66f64.translation: I didn’t see anyone passing by the house.

sense_daa9e6ae9a4dc4ac5799fca3bf24ec9a.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
sense_daa9e6ae9a4dc4ac5799fca3bf24ec9a.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

sense_daa9e6ae9a4dc4ac5799fca3bf24ec9a.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
sense_daa9e6ae9a4dc4ac5799fca3bf24ec9a.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

sense_c1345f2549b4c182267c56d8757a22cd.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_c1345f2549b4c182267c56d8757a22cd.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_c1345f2549b4c182267c56d8757a22cd.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_c1345f2549b4c182267c56d8757a22cd.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_c1345f2549b4c182267c56d8757a22cd.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_c1345f2549b4c182267c56d8757a22cd.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_88b9edd36c0b69bc2a323ba49b236807.text: Após vinte anos de casamento, a minha esposa deixou-me.
sense_88b9edd36c0b69bc2a323ba49b236807.translation: After twenty years of marriage, my wife has left me.

sense_d1e2ce115c1b2991d82529d0dafcba02.text: Minha mãe não me deixa ficar acordado até tarde.
sense_d1e2ce115c1b2991d82529d0dafcba02.translation: My mom won’t let me stay up late.

sense_d1e2ce115c1b2991d82529d0dafcba02.text: Mandaram lacrar todas as saídas e não deixar ninguém [passar]...
sense_d1e2ce115c1b2991d82529d0dafcba02.translation: They ordered me to seal all the exits and not to let anyone [pass]...

sense_2c698ce91c0a0de7408625e8e3b60734.text: A guerra deixara um rastro de destruição.
sense_2c698ce91c0a0de7408625e8e3b60734.translation: The war had left a wake of destruction.

sense_2c698ce91c0a0de7408625e8e3b60734.text: Além disso, como?... Sim, como poderia despachá-la, sem deixar sinais comprometedores do crime?... Envenenando-a?... Dariam logo pela coisa! Matá-la a tiro?... Pior!
sense_2c698ce91c0a0de7408625e8e3b60734.translation: Besides, how?... Yeah, how could I dispose of her without leaving compromising signs of the crime?... By poisoning her?... They'd know it straight ahead! By shooting her?... Even worse!

sense_7c3942877b5652cc91f410fa16f4b926.translation: The terrorists ran away from jail.

sense_02dd308b49b3df53734cec220cb4bc4b.text: Não deveríamos ter tocado o alarme.
sense_02dd308b49b3df53734cec220cb4bc4b.translation: We shouldn't have sounded the alarm.

sense_b043b0bbfec4415212ebcebf51646419.text: A chuva de granizo que deu ontem estragou a porcaria do telhado.
sense_b043b0bbfec4415212ebcebf51646419.translation: Yesterday's hailstorm destroyed the damn roof.

sense_f214b67229cdea47b540c300a8006ede.text: Ainda não sei muito bem como é que eu vou fazer, mas pode deixar que eu me viro assim mesmo.
sense_f214b67229cdea47b540c300a8006ede.translation: I still don't know how exactly I'm gonna make it, but don't worry, I'll handle it anyway.

sense_74751d9140efedf1a7a6c7592ef756ed.text: O cara era o maior vida louca, sério, e ainda assim virou evangélico, do nada!
sense_74751d9140efedf1a7a6c7592ef756ed.translation: The dude was a plain gangsta, really, and even so turned into a born-again Christian, all of a sudden!

sense_74751d9140efedf1a7a6c7592ef756ed.text: Ela ter aparecido na TV fez com que ela virasse uma espécie de subcelebridade entre os amigos.
sense_74751d9140efedf1a7a6c7592ef756ed.translation: Her appearing on TV made her becoming a sort of subcelebrity among her friends.

sense_676415af5e13fdf5ce8ef01e4af21796.text: Aquela mulher virou a cabeça dele.

sense_5307d8efe48152b19c525c990d0f5285.text: Na Umbanda, até um branco pode virar num Preto-Velho.
sense_5307d8efe48152b19c525c990d0f5285.translation: In Umbanda, even a White may receive an Old Black.

sense_5307d8efe48152b19c525c990d0f5285.text: Ontem eu acordei virado no Jiraya
sense_5307d8efe48152b19c525c990d0f5285.translation: Yesterday I woke up super stressed (that is, inspired by the Japanese series Sekai Ninja Sen Jiraiya).

sense_93cbbb4780c7fdcfe94903df8c1a3eaf.text: E aí, bora virar hoje jogando um Warzinho?
sense_93cbbb4780c7fdcfe94903df8c1a3eaf.translation: So, how about we spend this night playing some Risk?

sense_93cbbb4780c7fdcfe94903df8c1a3eaf.text: A nenê chorou a noite inteira, e eu fui trabalhar virada.
sense_93cbbb4780c7fdcfe94903df8c1a3eaf.translation: The baby cried all night long, and I went to work without having slept.

sense_100087c11e50112b60991dafe32014bf.translation: The rain ate away the grate.
That pneumonia has destroyed his health.

sense_dbdfb5c8e786505096432e1240777e50.text: Estou com vontade de comer um pedaço de torta.
sense_dbdfb5c8e786505096432e1240777e50.translation: I feel like eating a slice of pie.

sense_5ce2065548501bec7ec96cb5ddff7998.text: Este carro não come muita gasolina.
sense_5ce2065548501bec7ec96cb5ddff7998.translation: This car doesn't use much petrol.

sense_5ce2065548501bec7ec96cb5ddff7998.text: Já comi todo o meu salário.
sense_5ce2065548501bec7ec96cb5ddff7998.translation: I have already eaten up my entire salary.

sense_48415352cceb9be10bdddd95b8a1e4b1.translation: I made a mistake when I changed my job.

sense_3b60eb28d73219bd85869e1025c36de9.text: As pedras de gelo batiam contra o telhado.
sense_3b60eb28d73219bd85869e1025c36de9.translation: The hailstones were striking the roof.

sense_3b60eb28d73219bd85869e1025c36de9.text: O pássaro bateu no vidro e morreu.
sense_3b60eb28d73219bd85869e1025c36de9.translation: The bird hit the glass and died.

sense_3b60eb28d73219bd85869e1025c36de9.text: Os aviões se bateram no ar.

sense_b1c0ef2570db57cd2bedc7db4c5d738a.text: O sol bate nessa parede durante a tarde.
sense_b1c0ef2570db57cd2bedc7db4c5d738a.translation: The sunlight shines on this wall during the afternoon.

sense_b1c0ef2570db57cd2bedc7db4c5d738a.text: A sombra do balão bate bem na gente.
sense_b1c0ef2570db57cd2bedc7db4c5d738a.translation: The balloon cast its shadow right over us.

sense_c0dc9e810c048d81974951fde8777fb4.text: Durante a enchente, a água bateu na nossa cintura.
sense_c0dc9e810c048d81974951fde8777fb4.translation: During the flood, the water reached our waists.

sense_c0dc9e810c048d81974951fde8777fb4.text: O preço da maçã está batendo nos cinquenta centavos.
sense_c0dc9e810c048d81974951fde8777fb4.translation: The price of the apple is reaching fifty cents.

sense_2354af0945121df7183338e3484e8f2d.text: Abra/e a boca e diga/diz aaaaa.
sense_2354af0945121df7183338e3484e8f2d.translation: Open your mouth and say aaaaah.

sense_09b4ad242e54c0559657bb352f97ec05.text: Vamos à festa para comer... Digo, celebrar.
sense_09b4ad242e54c0559657bb352f97ec05.translation: We're going to the party to eat... I mean, to celebrate.

sense_09b4ad242e54c0559657bb352f97ec05.text: “Ir para o céu” você diz... morrer?
sense_09b4ad242e54c0559657bb352f97ec05.translation: By “go to heaven” you mean... to die?

sense_5ca80f98be61cc3d1094d92679331fa6.text: Pizza com abacaxi? Onde vamos parar?!
sense_5ca80f98be61cc3d1094d92679331fa6.translation: Pineapple pizza? Where will it end?!

sense_5ca80f98be61cc3d1094d92679331fa6.text: Dei um pontapé tão forte na bola que ninguém sabe onde ela foi parar.
sense_5ca80f98be61cc3d1094d92679331fa6.translation: I kicked the ball so hard that no one knows where it ended up.

sense_d60355919ea419793b621aaee96dfff9.text: A palavra “livro” significa um conjunto de páginas ligadas.
sense_d60355919ea419793b621aaee96dfff9.translation: The word “book” means a collection of bound pages.

sense_ef174e47ff494dde6abe380ed359d11f.text: Deves usar o martelo para arrancar os pregos.
sense_ef174e47ff494dde6abe380ed359d11f.translation: You must use the hammer to pull the nails off.

sense_ef174e47ff494dde6abe380ed359d11f.text: Você pode usar sua varinha para tentar me desarmar, ou para se defender de qualquer outra maneira que consiga pensar.
sense_ef174e47ff494dde6abe380ed359d11f.translation: You may use your wand to try to disarm me, or to defend yourself in any other way that you can think of.

sense_64ce2975e198262857c4e72b18125f80.translation: They want to cut the expenses fast!

sense_64ce2975e198262857c4e72b18125f80.text: A companhia cortou a água do meu prédio porque eu não paguei a conta.
sense_64ce2975e198262857c4e72b18125f80.translation: The company cut the water supply to my building because I didn’t pay the bill.

sense_1b59d506de2aae470a0ba86ae9c5cfc5.text: A estrada da minha casa corta a avenida.
sense_1b59d506de2aae470a0ba86ae9c5cfc5.translation: The street of my house crosses the avenue.
Parallel lines never cross one another.

sense_6247f32a46e91a33cb1cae20d678429d.text: Corte a torta em sete pedaços.
sense_6247f32a46e91a33cb1cae20d678429d.translation: Cut the pie into seven pieces.
I got cut in the thorn thicket.

sense_beb9d744c42eff499b0bfcb314994cc7.text: Os soldados não queriam continuar com a guerra.
sense_beb9d744c42eff499b0bfcb314994cc7.translation: The soldiers didn’t want to continue with the war.
Keep going until you can't stand it any more.

sense_beb9d744c42eff499b0bfcb314994cc7.text: Continuamos o jogo apesar da chuva.
sense_beb9d744c42eff499b0bfcb314994cc7.translation: We went on with the game despite the rain.

sense_beb9d744c42eff499b0bfcb314994cc7.text: [...] o único professor presente quando entraram [na sala de aula] era Binns, [...] preparando-se para continuar sua monótona lengalenga sobre a guerra dos gigantes.
sense_beb9d744c42eff499b0bfcb314994cc7.translation: … the only present teacher when they entered [the classroom] was Binns, … preparing to continue his monotonous explanation about the giants' war.

sense_5afea6d3547aef1c63d8f1babb7be604.text: Eu já esperava por isso mesmo.
É melhor do que eu esperava.
sense_5afea6d3547aef1c63d8f1babb7be604.translation: It is better than I expected.

sense_74ede31b6d35571d29684424747e206f.text: Este dicionário não presta para nada.
sense_74ede31b6d35571d29684424747e206f.translation: This dictionary isn't useful for anything.

sense_88ba1785646a9664c44b1d40f5e24629.translation: I find that house very ugly.

sense_1eca8708b105dafd02e22bb61e51de69.text: Acho que vocês deviam ir embora.
sense_1eca8708b105dafd02e22bb61e51de69.translation: I think you all should go away.

sense_f8e833618e3e2cc6dcf9e5f56758238e.text: Preciso de achar as chaves da minha casa.
sense_f8e833618e3e2cc6dcf9e5f56758238e.translation: I need to find the keys to my house.

sense_f8e833618e3e2cc6dcf9e5f56758238e.text: Nenhum dos estudantes achou a resposta correta.
sense_f8e833618e3e2cc6dcf9e5f56758238e.translation: None of the students found the correct answer.

sense_8eb641e3b8b4cc6b602707ede72d4c7f.text: Me diga o que você acha.
sense_8eb641e3b8b4cc6b602707ede72d4c7f.translation: Let me know what you think.

sense_8eb641e3b8b4cc6b602707ede72d4c7f.text: O que acharam do novo livro?
sense_8eb641e3b8b4cc6b602707ede72d4c7f.translation: What did they think of the new book?

sense_1cfc6976434249ad4213ebbed5554d66.text: Nossa, esse exercício me pegou agora.
sense_1cfc6976434249ad4213ebbed5554d66.translation: Whoa, this question sure stumped me.
